arumpeṟaṟ pulavari āṟṟup paṭuttalum
				- nūṟpā, 2z4511c
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi patti nūl. murukaṉ aruḷip peṟṟa pulavar oruvar, patti mikunta maṟṟoru pulavari ammurukaṉpāl āṟṟuppaṭuttutal murukāṟṟuppaṭiyiṉ poruḷākum. ``piṟa āṟṟuppaṭikaḷ āṟṟuppaṭuttappaṭupavar kaḷatu peyarōṭu cārtti vaḻaṅkappaṭum; āṉāl, tiru murukāṟṟuppaṭi pāṭṭuṭit talivaṉ peyarōṭu cārntu vaḻaṅkum. piṟavaṟṟiṟ kāṇappaṭuvaṉavākiya āṟṟappaṭuttu vāṉi viḷittalum, taṉatu niliyi viḷakkalum, āṟṟup paṭuttuvāṉ taṉatu paḻiyanili, paricil peṟṟa muṟi eṉpavaṟṟik kūṟutalum itil viḷakkappaṭāmal uyttuṇara vikkappaṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa.12
pattuppāṭṭip patippitta ṭākṭar u.vē,. cāmināta aiyaravarkaḷukkuk kiṭitta perumpāṉmiyāṉa ēṭukaḷuḷ tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi cērkkappaṭṭirukkavilli.13 mēlum, neṭunalvāṭi pāṭiya nakkīrar,  pēraracarkaḷiyum ciṟṟaracarkaḷiyum pāṭiyavar; tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi pāṭiya nakkīrar, kaṭavuḷ pattiyiṟ ciṟantu viḷaṅkiṉavar. ivar pāṭiya tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi 11ām tirumuṟiyil cērkkap paṭṭiruppatum ivar piṟkālattiṉar eṉpatiyē ātarikkiṉṟatu. itaṉ āciriyari `nakkīratēva nāyaṉār eṉṟu 11ām tirumuṟi kūṟukiṉṟatu.14
iṉi ippāṭaṟceytiyik koṇṭu itaṉ kālatti iṅku ārāyvōm.
paripāṭalil murukaṉ piṟappu
civaperumāṉ umiyammiyuṭaṉ neṭuṅkālam toṭarntu iṉpuṟṟiruntamiyāl, intiraṉ ceṉṟu iṟivaṉiṭam oruvaram tarumāṟu vēṇṭiṉāṉ. iṟivaṉ icivu tantavuṭaṉ, umiyik kūṭātirukkumpaṭi civaṉi vēṇṭiṉāṉ; acurari aḻikkattakum civacatti poruntiya piḷḷiyi aruḷumpaṭi vēṇṭiṉāṉ. civaṉ avvēṇṭu kōḷukku icintu, taṉatu vīriyatti veḷippaṭutti, atic cētappaṭutti, oru kūṟu maṭṭum intiraṉiṭam koṭuttāṉ.
atu tēvacēṉāpatiyākum takuti uṭiyateṉṟu muṉivar eḻuvar tamatu yōkacattiyāl uṇarntu, ataṉi intiraṉiṭamiruntu peṟṟucceṉṟu, vēḷvittīyaliṭṭu, ataṉ vēkattik kuṟittu, ataṉit tam maṉiviyari uṭkoḷḷac colliṉār. aruntati oḻinta aṟuvar ataṉi uṇṭu caravaṇap poykiyil āṟu kuḻantikaḷip peṟṟaṉar.
intiraṉ poṟāmi koṇṭu akkuḻantikaḷiṉ mītu taṉ vaccirāyutatti eṟiya, kuḻantikaḷ āṟum āṟu mukamum paṉṉiraṇṭu kikaḷum uṭiya orē kuḻantiyāy māṟi viṭṭaṉa. kaṭuvaṉ iḷaveyiṉaṉār eṉṟa pulavar icceyti yiṉi 5ām paripāṭalil (aṭi, 26-55) kūṟiyuḷḷār.
ikkatiyi oppukkoṇṭāṟpōlavē āciriyar nallantuvaṉār eṭṭām paripāṭalil (aṭi, 127-128),
``maṟumiṭaṟ ṟaṇṇaṟku mācilōṉ tanta
neṟinīr aruvi acumpuṟu celvam
eṉṟu pāṭiyuḷḷār.
murukaṉ piṟantavuṭaṉ intiraṉ poṟāmi koṇṭu akkuḻantiyit taṉ vaccirāyutattāl tākkiṉāṉ eṉṟu kaṭuvaṉ iḷaveyiṉaṉār pāṭiyataṟkēṟpavē, kēcavaṉār tam pāṭalil (paripāṭal 14, aṭi, 25-26),
``piṟanta ñāṉṟēniṉṉi yuṭkic
ciṟantōr añciya cīruṭi yōyē
eṉṟu pāṭiyuḷḷatu nōkkaṟpālatu.


tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyil murukaṉ piṟappu
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyil (aṭi, 254-255),
``aivaruḷ oruvaṉ aṅki ēṟpa
aṟuvar payanta āṟamar celva
eṉṉum aṭikaḷ murukaṉatu piṟappik kuṟikkiṉṟaṉa. nilam, nīr, tī, kāṟṟu, vicumpu ākiya aivaruḷ oruvaṉ taṉ uḷḷaṅkiyil (civaṉ tantatip) peṟṟāṉ. civaṉ etit tantāṉ eṉpatu, mūlattil illi. ippakutikku uriyum viḷakkamum varintuḷḷa nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, ``aivaruḷ oruvaṉ tī. avaṉ `aṅkiyēṟpa eṉṟatu, iṟivaṉiṭat tiṉiṉṟum intiraṉ vāṅkiya karuppattiṉi muṉivar vāṅkit tamakkut tarikkalākāmiyiṉ, iṟivaṉ kūṟākiya muttīkkuṇṭattu iṭṭataṉik kūṟiṟṟu, eṉṟu viḷakkam taṟtuḷḷār. nacciṉārkkiṉiyar paripāṭal 5ām pāṭaliṉ karutti iṅkuḷḷa mutalaṭikku ēṟṟik kūṟiyuḷḷār. itē karuttiṉi 50ām aṭiyiṉ uri aṭiyilum eḻuti, ``itaṉi, `pāyirum paṉikkaṭal eṉṉum paripāṭṭāṉ uṇarka. ivvāṟaṉṟi, vēṟu vēṟu purāṇam kūṟuvārum uḷar, eṉṟum eḻutiyuḷḷami nōkkaṟpālatu.
itaṉi nōkka, nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kālattilēyē murukaṉ piṟappup paṟṟip paripāṭaṟceytiyiṉum vēṟupaṭṭa varalāṟu kūṟappaṭṭami teḷivām. avvēṟu paṭṭa ceyti yātu?
kantapurāṇattil murukaṉ piṟappu
kacciyappa civācāriyar iyaṟṟiya kantapurāṇam tiruvavatārappaṭalattil murukaṉ piṟappup paṟṟik kūṟum ceyti piṉ varumāṟu
piramaṉ tirumāl intiraṉ mutaliyōr civaṉikkaṇṭu,  cūraṉ mutaliya acurari aḻikkattakka mintaṉi utavumpaṭi vēṇṭiṉar (ce.42). apperumāṉ uṭaṉē taṉkaṇ āṟu mukaṅkaḷit tōṟṟuvittāṉ (ce. 43). avaṟṟiluḷḷa āṟu neṟṟik kaṇkaḷiliruntum āṟu tīppoṟikaḷ veḷippaṭṭaṉa (ce.45). ``ippoṟikaḷ oru mintaṉ uruvattip peṟum. ammintaṉ acurari velvaṉ. nīṅkaḷ ippoṟikaḷik kaṅkiyil viṭuṅkaḷ. kaṅki caravaṇap poykiyil ivaṟṟi uykkum, eṉṟaṉaṉ (55); kāṟṟuttēvaṉiyum tīttēvaṉiyum nōkki, ``nīvir iruvīrum ippoṟikaḷik kaṅkiyil viṭumiṉ,  eṉṟu paṇittāṉ (66-67). kāṟṟuttēvaṉ civaṉi vaṇaṅki, attīppoṟikaḷit taṉ talimītu tāṅkikkoṇṭu tīkkaṭavuḷuṭaṉ ceṉṟāṉ (77); vaḻiyil avaṟṟit tīkkaṭavuḷ talimītu vittāṉ (84). tīkkaṭavuḷ avaṟṟik koṇṭu ceṉṟu kaṅkiyil iṭṭāṉ (85). kaṅki avaṟṟic caravaṇap poykiyil uyttatu (87).
iṟivaṉ aruḷāl appoṟikaḷ āṟu mukaṅkaḷiyum paṉṉiraṇṭu kikaḷiyum koṇṭa oru kuḻantiyāy viḷaṅka, akkuḻanti tāmari malarmītu vīṟṟiruntatu (92-96). ataṉik kaṇṭa ari mutaliya amarar kuḻantiyip pālūṭṭi vaḷarkkumpaṭi kārttiki mātar aṟuvari ēviṉar (114-115). avvaṟuvarum taṉṉi nōkki aṉpuṭaṉ varutalik kaṇṭa `aṟumuka oruvaṉ vēṟāy acciṟār uruvam koṇṭāṉ (ce.116).

tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi kuṟikkum murukaṉ piṟappum vaḷarppum
civapirāṉiṭamiruntu veḷippaṭṭa tīppoṟikaḷi mutalil ēṟṟavaṉ kāṟṟukkaṭavuḷ (aivaruḷ oruvaṉ) eṉpatu kantapurāṇa varalāṟṟāl terikiṟatu. avaṉ avaṟṟi mutalil taṉ aṅkiyil ēṟṟa piṉṉarē talimītu vittiruttal iyalpākum. murukaṉ kārttikip peṇkaḷ taṉṉi aṭitaṟku muṉpu āṟu mukaṅkaḷik koṇṭa orē kuḻantiyāy iruntāṉ. piṉṉarē tāymār aṟuvarkku ēṟpa āṟu kuḻantikaḷāy māṟiṉāṉ eṉpatu kantapurāṇa varalāṟu. āyiṉum muṉivar maṉiviyar aṟuvarē āṟu piḷḷikaḷip peṟṟaṉar eṉpatu piripāṭaṟceytiyākum.
``aṟuvar payanta āṟamar celva
eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyil kuṟittami, āṟu tīppoṟikaḷiliruntu piṟanta murukaṉi aṟuvar pālūṭṭi vaḷarttami paṟṟi upacāra vaḻakkāy amintatākum.
kaṇṇaṉip peṟṟavaḷ tēvaki: vaḷarttavaḷ yacōti. āyiṉum, yacōti kaṇṇaṉi nōkki, `peṟṟa eṉakkaruḷi (1:5:8) eṉṟu kūṟiyatākap periyāḻvār pāṭiyuḷḷār.
``eṉṉa nōṉpu nōṟṟāḷkolō
	ivaṉip peṟṟa vayiṟuṭiyāḷ
eṉṉum vārtti eytuvitta
	iruṭi kēcā muliyuṇāyē (2:2:6)
eṉṟu yacōti kaṇṇaṉip pālarunta aḻittatākap periyāḻvār pāṭiyuḷḷami kāṇattakkatu. `uṉṉip peṟṟa kuṟṟamallāl (3:1:7) eṉṟu piṟitōriṭattilum yacōti kūṟuvatākap periyāḻvār pāṭiyuḷḷār. ivvupacāra vaḻakkup paṟṟiyē `vaḷartta kārttiki makaḷir aṟuvarum murukaṉip `payantavar eṉṟu nakkīrar pāṭiyatākak koḷvatē iṅkup poruttamākum.
murukaṉ civaṉatu vīriyattiliruntu piṟantati viḷakkamākak kūṟum (aṭi, 26-55) paripāṭal (ce-5), 81 aṭikaḷi uṭiyatu. nakkīrar ikkatiyē kūṟavirumpiyiruppiṉ, 317 aṭikaḷik koṇṭa tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyil paripāṭalip pōlavē innikaḻcciyi virittuk kūṟiyirukkalām. avar aṅṅaṉam kūṟātu,
``aivaruḷ oruvaṉ aṅki ēṟpa
aṟuvar payanta āṟamar celva
eṉa iraṇṭē aṭikaḷiṟ kūṟiyiruttal, murukaṉ piṟappup paṟṟiya paripāṭaṟ ceyti avarkku uṭaṉpāṭaṉmiyi uyttuṇara vippatākum.
``aivaruḷ oruvaṉ aṅki ēṟpa, eṉpatu, civaṉiṭamiruntu mutaṉ muṟiyāka vīriyattiyō allatu tīppoṟikaḷiyō taṉ kikaḷiṟ peṟṟuk koṇṭa aivaruḷ oruvaṉiyē  uṇarttum. paripāṭaṟ katippaṭi civaṉiṭamiruntu vīriyatti mutaliṟ peṟṟavaṉ intiraṉ. intiraṉ aivaruḷ oruvaṉākāṉ. avaṉiṭamiruntu muṉivar ataṉip peṟṟaṉar. avarkaḷ ataṉi vēḷvittīyil iṭṭārkaḷ. iṅṅaṉam iraṇṭu kimmāṟiya ceytiyi nakkīrar kuṟikka virumpiyiruppiṉ, ataṉit teḷivākak kuṟittirukkalām. ivar aṅṅaṉam kuṟikkavilli. kantapurāṇac ceytippaṭi civaṉuṭiya poṟikaḷ āṟaṉiyum taṉ talimītu vittukkoṇṭavaṉ kāṟṟukkaṭavuḷāvaṉ. avaṉ avaṟṟik kiyil vāṅkit tāṉē taṉ talimītu vittiruttal kūṭum! eṉavē, kantapurāṇac ceytiyē ivvaṭi kaḷukkup poruttameṉpatu terikiṟatu eṉṟu kūṟalām.
paripāṭalil murukaṉippaṟṟi eṭṭuppāṭalkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟip pulavar eḻuvar pāṭiyuḷḷaṉar. 5ām pāṭalip pāṭiya kaṭuvaṉ iḷaveyiṉaṉār pōlavē, āciriyar nallantuvaṉār 8ām pāṭalil, murukaṉ civaṉukkum umiyammikkum piṟantavaṉ (aṭi. 127-128) eṉṟa kūṟiyuḷḷār. civaṉuṭiya tīppoṟikaḷiliruntu murukaṉ piṟantāṉ eṉṟu kantapurāṇam kūṟum ceyti murukaṉip paṟṟiya eṭṭup paripāṭalkaḷilum illāmi kavaṉikkattakum. intap piṟceyti caṅka kālat tamiḻakattil vaḻakkup peṟṟiruppiṉ, mēlē collappaṭṭa pulavar eḻuvaruḷ oruvarēṉum itaṉik kūṟiyiruppar allarō? aṅṅaṉam oruvarum kuṟippiṭāmiyē nōkka murukaṉ civaṉukkum umikkum piṟantavaṉ eṉṟa kati oṉṟē caṅka kālat tamiḻakattil vaḻakkup peṟṟiruntatu eṉpatē poruntu vatākum.
aṭuttu nakkīrar murukaṉi, `malimakaḷ makaṉē, `koṟṟavi ciṟuva, `paḻiyōḷ kuḻavi eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷami, apperumāṉ civapirāṉukku makaṉātaliṉ eṉka. kaṇavaṉāṉa civapirāṉ aruḷāṟpiṟanta murukaṉ, accivapirāṉ maṉivi yāṉa umātēvikkum makaṉ eṉṟu upacāra vaḻakkāyk kūṟutal poruttamēyākum.
murukaṉum kaṭavuḷar piṟarum
puṟanāṉūṟṟil (ce.56) ilavantikip paḷḷittuñciya naṉmāṟaṉip pāṭiya nakkīrar, avaṉi nōkki, ``nī pakivari aḻittalil civaṉiyoppāy; valimiyil palarāmaṉi yoppāy; pukaḻil tirumāliyoppāy; muṉṉiyatu muṭippatil murukaṉeyoppāy. innālvarum ñālam kākkum kālamuṉpiṉi uṭiyavar; tōlā nallici uṭiyavar, eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār. innakkīrar ippāṭalil civaṉ, palarāmaṉ, tirumāl, murukaṉ ākiya nālvariyum camappaṭuttiyuḷḷami teḷivu. tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyip pāṭiya nakkīrar, ``mummūrttikaḷum tattam toḻil puriyum  talivarākumpaṭi murukaṉ tōṉṟiṉāṉ, (aṭi, 162, 172-176) eṉṟu pāṭiyuḷḷār. itaṉāl, murukaṉ mummūrttikaḷiṉum mēlāṉavaṉ eṉpatu innakkīrar karutteṉpatu terikiṟatu.
puṟanāṉūṟṟuppāṭalil (56),
``ñālam kākkum kāla muṉpiṉ
tōlā nallici nālvar
eṉṟu nālvariyum camaniliyiṉarākavē nakkīrar kūṟiyuḷḷār. aḵtāvatu, ñālaṅkākkum kālamuṉpum tōlā nalliciyum innālvarkkum iyaṟkiyākavē amintuḷḷaṉa eṉpati ippāṭalil nakkīrar kuṟittuḷḷār. āyiṉum, tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyil nakkīrar, `murukaṉ tōṉṟiya kāraṇattāl mummūrttikaḷ taṅkaḷ toḻil puriyum talivarkaḷāṉārkaḷ, eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār. iṅṅaṉam murukaṉ piṟanta kāraṇattāl mummūrttikaḷ toḻil puriyum talivarkaḷāṉārkaḷ eṉpataṉāl, ammūrttikaḷiṉ talimi ceyaṟkiyāy amintatu eṉpatu terikiṉṟatu.
`palarum pukaḻkiṉṟa ayaṉ, ari, araṉ eṉṉum mūvarum tattamakkuriya toḻilkaḷi muṉpu pōla nikaḻttit talivarāka vēṇṭit tammuṭiya cīriya paṭittal, kāttal, aḻittal eṉṉum toḻilkaḷip paṇṭu pōlap peṟu muṟiyiṉik kuṟi vēṇṭic cēra vantu kāṇumpaṭi murukaṉ teyvayāṉiyāruṭaṉ tiruvāvinaṉkuṭiyil .iruttalu muriyaṉ, eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri. iṅṅaṉam poruḷ koḷḷiṉum, murukaṉ mummūrttikaḷiṉum mēlāṉavaṉ eṉṉum poruḷē peṟappaṭutal kāṇalām.
puṟanāṉūṟṟup pāṭalil annālvarkkum attoḻil kaḷ iyaṟki yāy amintaṉa eṉṟu kūṟiya nakkīrar (avarē tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi āciriyarāyiṉ) tam kūṟṟukku māṟupaṭat tamatu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyil kūṟiyiruppārā?
caṅkakālappulavar, naṉmāṟaṉip pāṭiya nakkīrar pōlavē kaṭavuḷar palariyum ciṟappittē pāṭuvar. cāṉṟākak kaṭuvaṉ iḷaveyiṉaṉār paripāṭalil tirumāliyum murukaṉiyum taṉittaṉi pāṭalil pārāṭṭi yuḷḷār. caṅkakālap pulavar perumakkaḷ piṟkālattār pōla oru teyvatti uyarttuvataṟkup piṟa teyvaṅkaḷit tāḻttip pāṭiṉamikkuc cāṉṟilli.
tirumāliyum palatēvaṉiyum `iruperun teyvam eṉṟu puṟanāṉūṟṟup pāṭaloṉṟu (ce-58) kārik kaṇṇaṉārāl pāṭappaṭṭatu. tirumāliyum civaṉiyum `iruperun teyvam eṉṟu akanāṉūṟṟup pāṭal oṉṟu (ce.360) maturik kaṇṇāttaṉārāṟpāṭappaṭṭatu. cilappatikāram pāṭiya iḷaṅkō aṭikaḷ civaṉiyum murukaṉiyum tirumāliyum vāyārāp pārāṭṭip pāṭiyuḷḷamiyē ēṟṟa cāṉṟākum.
`paripāṭalil (8) murukaṉikkāṇa mummūrttikaḷum maṟṟattēvarum tirupparaṅkuṉṟam vantaṉar eṉpatu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatē? eṉiṉ, aṅku ammūvarum avarik kuṟiyirakka vantaṉar eṉṟu appāṭal āciriyar kūṟavilli; `niṉṉik kāṇpatu kāraṇamāka vantaṉar eṉṟē kūṟiyuḷḷār. vaḷḷi tirumaṇam tirupparaṅkuṉṟattil naṭipeṟṟati 19ām pāṭalikkoṇṭu aṟiyalām.
mēlum, civapirāṉ piḷḷiyākiya murukaṉi muḻumutaṟkaṭavuḷākkic civaperumāṉē avaṉiṭam ceṉṟu varam vāṅkiyatākap piṟkālattār pāṭiyatu pōlac caṅkakālap pulavar yāṇṭum civapirāṉi murukaṉukkut tāḻntavaṉākak kūṟāmiyum aṟitaṟpālatu.
mummūrttikaḷukkut talimi tarum niliyil murukaṉ piṟantāṉ eṉpatu, murukaṉ mummūrttikaṭkum uyarntavaṉ eṉṟu poruḷpaṭuva tākum. iṅṅaṉam caṅka kālap pulavar yāṇṭum pāṭavilli. murukaṉi muḻumutaṟkaṭavuḷākak karutum nili (kumāra camayam) caṅka kālattiṟkup piṟpaṭṭatākum. ākavē, murukaṉi muḻumutaṟkaṭavuḷākap pāṭiyuḷḷa tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyāciriyarāṉa nakkīrar, caṅka kāla nakkīrariṉ vēṟāvar eṉṟu koḷvatē poruttamākum.
āvi naṉkuṭi
caṅka kāla vēḷiruḷ āvi eṉpavaṉum avaṉ kuṭiyiṉarum oru vakiyiṉar. avarkaḷ paḻanimali nāṭṭiyāṇṭavarkaḷ. vēḷ āvi eṉpavaṉ avaruḷ mutalvaṉ. vēḷāviyiṉ marapil vantavaṉē viyāvik kōpperumpēkam eṉpavaṉ. ivaṉ `āviyar kō (puṟam.147) eṉappaṭṭāṉ. `āvi naṉkuṭi eṉpataṟku (vēḷ) āvi (kkōviṉ) nalla kuṭiyiruppu eṉpatu poruḷ. āyiṉ, tirumurukāṟṟup paṭip patippukaḷil `āviṉaṉkuṭi eṉpatē kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. ā (pacu), iṉaṉ (cūriyaṉ), vaḻipaṭṭup pēṟu peṟṟa kuṭiyiruppu eṉṟa purāṇa varalāṟṟit taḻuvi (ā +iṉaṉ+kuṭi) āviṉaṉkuṭi eṉap piṟkālattār ēṭukaḷil eḻutiyirukkalām eṉṟu koḷvatu poruttamākum. atutiruttal peṟāmal acciṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. `āviṉaṉkuṭi eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyil kūṟappaṭum iṭappeyar caṅkakāla nūlkaḷil illi.
centil murukaṉukku uriyatāka maturi marutaṉ iḷanākaṉār puṟanāṉūṟṟil (ce.55) pāṭiyuḷḷār. paraṅkuṉṟattil murukaṉ eḻuntaruḷi yiruppatāka maturi marutaṉ iḷanākaṉarum erukkāṭṭūrt tāyaṅ kaṇṇaṉārum akanāṉūṟṟil (ce.59, 149) pāṭiyuḷḷaṉar.
`alivāy eṉpatu murukaṉukkuriyateṉap paraṇar akanāṉūṟṟiṟ (ce.266) pāṭiyuḷḷār. tirumurukāṟṟup paṭiyilum `alivāy kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu,. itu, `nāmaṉūr alivāy eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār. ituvē centil eṉpatu aṟiñar karuttu.
centil, ceṅkōṭu, veṇkuṉṟam, ērakam eṉpavi murukaṟkuriya iṭaṅkaḷ eṉṟu cilappatikāram ceppukiṟatu. iṅku ērakam kuṟippiṭap paṭṭuḷḷatu. naviramaliyil kāriyuṇṭikkaṭavuḷ kōvil iruntatu eṉṟu malipaṭu kaṭām pakarkiṉṟatu. akkālattil āvinaṉkuṭiyil murukaṉ kōvil iruntirukkumāyiṉ, acceyti ainnūṟṟuvarkkum mēṟpaṭṭa caṅkakālap pulavaruḷ oruvarālēṉum kuṟikkap paṭṭirukkumaṉṟō? mēlum, `āvinaṉkuṭi eṉṉum peyarē caṅkakālappākkaḷil iṭam peṟavilli eṉpatum iṅkuk kavaṉikkattakum.
ayiri maliyip pāṭumpōtu, ammali koṟṟavikkuriya maliyeṉac caṅkakālap pulavarāṟ pāṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. (patiṟṟuppattu, 79). ivvāṟē paraṅkuṉṟamum, centilum murukaṉukkuriyaṉavākap pāṭap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa. paraṇar varalāṟṟukkuṟippi amittē ceyyuḷ pāṭum iyalpuṭiyavar. avar pēkaṉip pāṭiyuḷḷār. appāṭṭil āvinaṉkuṭi paṟṟiya pēccē illi. avar kālattil centilip pōlavum paraṅkuṉṟam pōlavum āvi naṉkuṭi murukaṉ talamākac ciṟappuṟṟirukkumāyiṉ, avar kūṟātirār eṉpatu uṟuti. ivi aṉittiyum nōkki, caṅkakālattil āvi naṉkuṭi murukaṉukkuriya oru talamāy iruntiruttal iyalātu eṉṟu karututal poruttamākum.
muṭivuri
ivi aṉittiyum naṭuvuniliyiliruntu ārāynta tāl, `tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyip pāṭiya nakkīrar caṅka kāla nakkīrariṉ vēṟāvar: kālattāṟpiṟpaṭṭavar, eṉpatu teḷivākum
`tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi caṅkakālattiṟpāṭappaṭṭa tāyiṉum, civacamayat toṭarpu karutip patiṉōrām tirumuṟiyiṟ cērkkappaṭṭatu, eṉṟu cilar kūṟuvar. aṅṅaṉamāyiṉ, caṅka kālattilēyē murukaṉmītu pāṭappaṭṭavi eṉpatu teḷivākat teriyum eṭṭup paripāṭalkaḷum appatiṉōrāntirumuṟiyiṟcērkkappaṭāmikkuk kāraṇam yātu? tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi maṭṭum attirumuṟiyiṟ cērkkappaṭṭamikkuk kāraṇam yātu?
neṭunalvāṭiyil uḷḷa coṟkaḷ cilavum coṟṟoṭarkaḷ cilavum tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyilum varuvatāl, ippāṭalkaḷiyum caṅkakāla nakkīrarē pāṭiyirukkalām eṉpatu cilar karuttu. cilappatikārac coṟkaḷum toṭarkaḷum maṇimēliyil varuvati aṟiñar naṉku aṟivar; eṉavē, avviru nūlkaḷiyum pāṭiyavar oruvarē eṉṟu collakkūṭumō? kālattāl muṟpaṭṭa varuṭiya coṟkaḷiyum toṭarkaḷiyum ciṟanta karuttuk kaḷiyum piṟkālap pulavar tam pākkaḷiṟ kiyāḷutal iyalpeṉpati aṟiñar aṟivar. ivi aṉittiyum nōkkat tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi caṅkakāla nakkīrarṟ pāṭappaṭṭateṉṟu eṉṟu koḷvatē poruttamākum
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyiṉ naṭi caṅkac ceyyuḷkaḷiṉ naṭiyi ēṟattāḻa ottuḷḷatu; caṅkakālak kuṟiñci nilamakkaḷatu murukavaḻipāṭṭi naṉku paṭam piṭittuk kāṭṭukiṟatu; ki.pi. ēḻām nūṟṟāṇṭil tōṉṟiya tirumuṟi pāṭalkaḷiṟ kuṟippiṭappaṭṭa `tiru eṉṉum aṭimoḻiyit tirumurukāṟṟup paṭiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa talaṅkaḷ peṟavilli.
muruka vaṇakkam caṅkakālattiṟ ciṟappuṟṟiruntatu. paripāṭalil murukaṉip paṟṟiya pāṭalkaḷ iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. ki.pi. 6ām nūṟṟāṇṭu mutal uṇṭāṉa nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷil civavaṇakkamē ciṟappuṟalāyiṟṟu eṉpataṟkup paṉṉiru tirumuṟikaḷē ēṟṟa cāṉṟākum. ivi aṉittiyum nōkka, tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi caṅkakālattiṟkup piṉpum (ki.pi. 300kkup piṉpu) appar campantarkku muṉpum (ki.pi. 600kku muṉpu) pāṭappaṭṭirukkalām eṉṟu kūṟutal poruttamākum.15
3. āṟṟuppaṭi ilakkiyam

tolkāppiyar kālam
pattuppāṭṭuḷ aintu pāṭalkaḷ āṟṟuppaṭiyip paṟṟiyaviyātaliṉ, caṅkakāla āṟṟuppaṭi ilakkiyattiṉ tōṟṟattiyum vaḷarcciyiyum paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷi iṅku aṟital nalam payappatākum.
iṉṟuḷḷa tamiḻ nūlkaḷuḷ kālattāl muṟpaṭṭatu tolkāppiyam. atu pāṇṭiyaṉ talinakarāṉa kapāṭapurattil pāṇṭiyaṉ aviyil araṅkēṟṟam ceyyappaṭṭatu eṉpatu kaḷaviyaluriyuḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. piṉpu annakaram kaṭalāl koḷḷappaṭṭatu eṉṟu atē kaḷaviyaluri kūṟukiṉṟatu.1 ki.mu. 4ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ kaṭippakutiyil vāḻnta muriya cantirakuptaṉ (ki.mu. 325-301) amiccaṉāṉa kuṭilyaṉ tāṉ iyaṟṟiya poruḷ nūlil `pāṇṭiya kavāṭakam eṉṉum oru muttiṉ vakiyik kuṟittuḷḷāṉ.2 atu pāṇṭi nāṭṭuk kapāṭapurattuk kaṭalil kiṭitta muttu ātaliṉ, appeyar peṟṟatu. kapāṭapura aḻiviṟkup piṉpu koṟki muttukkaḷē peyar peṟṟaviyām. aviyē iṉṟuḷḷa toki nūlkaḷuḷ pēcappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. oru nakaram aḻinta piṉpu ataṉ peyarāl oru poruḷ vaḻakkup peṟutal perumpālum vaḻakkamilli. ātalāl, kuṭilyaṉ kālattil kapāṭapuram iruntatu eṉpatu poruttamākum.3 kapāṭapura aḻiviṟkuc caṟṟu muṉpu tolkāppiyam ceyyappaṭṭatu eṉṟu kaḷaviyal uri kūṟuvatāl, tolkāppiyam ēṟattāḻak ki.mu. 4ām  nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ iṟutiyil ceyyappaṭṭirukkalām eṉṟu koḷvatu poruttamākum. eṉavē, tolkāppiyar kālam ēṟattāḻak ki.mu. 300 eṉṟu koḷvatu ēṟpuṭittākum.
āṟṟuppaṭi
kūttar eṉpavar, taṉikkūttilum, kati taḻuvivarum kūttilum vallavar. pāṇar eṉpavar, icittamiḻil vallavar; kuḻal, yāḻ mutaliya icikkaruvikaḷōṭu pāṭupavar. porunar eṉpavar, ērkkaḷam allatu pōrkkaḷam ceṉṟu pāṭum kūttar. avar naṭippilum vallavar. viṟali eṉpavaḷ, uḷḷakkuṟippip puṟattē veḷippaṭumpaṭi viṟalpaṭa (tiṟamiyāka) naṭippavaṉ. innālvarum tamakkut tuṇiyāyiṉārōṭu ciṟṟaracariṭamum pēraracariṭamum ceṉṟu tam kalittiṟaṉik kāṭṭip paricu peṟṟu mīḷvar; aṅṅaṉam mīṇṭuvarupavar, vaḷḷalkaḷi nāṭiccellum tammip pōṉṟa kalivāṇari vaḻiyiṟkāṇiṉ, avarmītu irakkam koḷvar; avarkaḷukku utaviceyya viḻivar; ataṉāl, tammi ātaritta vaḷḷaliṭam ceṉṟu paricil peṟṟu makiḻumāṟu avarkaḷi āṟṟuppaṭuttuvar (vaḻikūṟi aṉuppuvar). iṅṅaṉam āṟṟuppaṭuttutal `āṟṟuppaṭi eṉappaṭum.
kūttaṉ oruvaṉ maṟṟoru kūttaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttutal `kūttarāṟṟup paṭi eṉappaṭum; pāṇaṉ oruvaṉ maṟṟoru pāṇaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttutal `pāṇāṟṟuppaṭi eṉappaṭum; porunaṉ oruvaṉ maṟṟoru porunaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttutal `porunarāṟṟuppaṭi eṉappaṭum. viṟali orutti maṟṟoru viṟaliyi āṟṟuppaṭuttutal `viṟali āṟṟuppaṭi eṉappaṭum. iṅṅaṉamaṉṟip pulavar kūttariyō pāṇariyō porunariyō viṟaliyiyō āṟṟuppaṭuttutalum uṇṭu. āṟṟuppaṭuttupavaratu peyarik koṇṭē acceyyuḷ iṉṉa āṟṟuppaṭi eṉappeyar peṟum.
aruḷuṇarcciyāl tōṉṟiya ivvāṟṟappaṭimuṟi tolkāppiyam puṟattiṇiyiyalil (nūṟpā, 36) kīḻ varumāṟu kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu:
``kūttarum pāṇarum porunarum viṟaliyum
āṟṟiṭik kāṭci uṟaḻat tōṉṟip
peṟṟa peruvaḷam peṟaark kaṟivuṟīic
ceṉṟupayaṉ etirac coṉṉa pakkamum
eṉat tolkāppiyattilē kāṇappaṭum. ivvāṟṟup paṭimuṟi, tolkāppiyarkku muṉṉarē innāṭṭil paṉṉeṭuṅkālam vaḻaṅkiyiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟum, ittuṟiyil pala pāṭalkaḷ iruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟum karuta ivvaṭikaḷ iṭat tarukiṉṟaṉa.
iṉṟu namakkuk kiṭṭiyuḷḷa caṅkanūlkaḷuḷ puṟanāṉūṟṟilum patiṟṟup pattilum pattuppāṭṭilumē āṟṟuppaṭippāṭalkaḷ cila kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. mutal iru nūlkaḷiṟkāṇappaṭum āṟṟuppaṭippāṭalkaḷ 5 aṭi mutal 31 aṭikaḷ variyiṟkoṇṭa ciṟu pāṭalkaḷēyākum. pattuppāṭṭiṟ kāṇappaṭum āṟṟuppaṭippāṭalkaḷō, pala nūṟu varikaḷik koṇṭavi.


puṟanāṉūṟṟil āṟṟuppaṭi
pāṇāṟṟuppaṭi: kōvūr kiḻār, cōḻaṉ nalaṅkiḷḷiyiṉ koṭit taṉmiyikkūṟi avaṉiṭam oru pāṇaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (ce.68). ālattūr kiḻār, cōḻaṉ kuḷamuṟṟattut tuñciya kiḷḷi vaḷavaṉiṭam pāṇaṉ oruvaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (69). kōvūr kiḻārum ikkiḷḷi vaḷavaṉic ceṉṟu kāṇumpaṭi pāṇaṉ oruvaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (70). marutaṉ iḷanākaṉār, nāñcil vaḷḷuvaṉiṭam paraṇaṉ oruvaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (138). paraṇar eṉpavar, viyāvik kōpperum pēkaṉiṭam pulavar oruvari āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (141). mōcikīraṉār, koṇkāṉaṅkiḻāṉiṭam pāṇaṉ oruvaṉi āṟṟuppaṭutti yuḷḷār (155). māṭalaṉ maturikkumaraṉār, īrntūr kiḻāṉ tōyaṉ māṟaṉ eṉpavaṉiṭam pāṇaṉ oruvaṉi āṟṟup paṭuttiyuḷḷār (180). ivi yāvum `pāṇāṟṟuppaṭi eṉappaṭum.
viṟaliyāṟṟuppaṭi: neṭumpalliyattaṉār eṉṟa pulavar, palyākacāli mutukuṭumip peruvaḻutiyiṭam viṟali oruttiyi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (64). auviyār eṉṟa peṇpāṟpulavar, atiyamāṉ neṭumāṉañciyiṭam viṟaliyi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (103). kapilar eṉpavar, vēḷ pāriyiṭam viṟali oruttiyi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (105). muṭamōciyār eṉṟa pulavar, āy vēḷiṭam viṟali oruttiyi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (133).
pulavar āṟṟuppaṭi: itu tolkāppiyar kūṟātatu; ātaliṉ, avarkku muṉpum avar kālattum vaḻakkil illātatu eṉṟu karututal takum. poykiyār eṉṟa pulavar, cēramāṉ kōkkōti mārpaṉ eṉpavaṉiṭam pulavar oruvari āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (48).
porunarāṟṟuppaṭi, kūttarāṟṟuppaṭi ākiya iraṇṭiṟkum puṟanāṉūṟṟup pāṭalkaḷil cāṉṟilli.
patiṟṟuppattil āṟṟuppaṭi
kapilar, celvakkaṭuṅkō vāḻiyātaṉiṭam pāṇaṉ oruvaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (67)
kāppiyāṟṟuk kāppiyaṉār, kaḷaṅkāyk  kaṇṇinār muṭic cēraliṭam viṟali oruttiyi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (40). paraṇar, ceṅkuṭṭuvaṉiṭam viḷaliyi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (49). kākkipāṭiṉiyār nacceḷḷiyār eṉṟa peṇ pāṟpulavar, āṭukōṭpāṭṭuc cēralātaṉiṭam viṟaliyi āṟṟup paṭuttiyuḷḷār (57, 60). ariciṟkiḻār eṉpavar, peruñcēral irumpoṟi yiṭam viṟali oruttiyi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyuḷḷār (78). peruṅkuṉṟūr kiḻār, iḷañcēral irumpoṟiyiṭam viṟali oruttiyi āṟṟuppaṭutti yuḷḷār (87).
porunarāṟṟuppaṭi, kūttarāṟṟuppaṭi, pulavarāṟṟup paṭikaḷukkup patiṟṟuppattil cāṉṟilli.

pattuppāṭṭil āṟṟuppaṭi
pattuppāṭṭil tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi, porunar āṟṟup paṭi, ciṟupāṇ āṟṟuppaṭi, perumpāṇ āṟṟuppaṭi, kūttar āṟṟuppaṭi eṉṉum aintu pāṭalkaḷ iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. puṟanāṉūṟṟilum patiṟṟuppattilum uḷḷa āṟṟuppaṭip pāṭalkaḷ 5 aṭi mutal 31 aṭikaḷ variyilum peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. āyiṉum, pattuppāṭṭil uḷḷa āṟṟuppaṭi kaḷuḷ ovvoṉṟum pala nūṟu aṭikaḷik koṇṭatu eṉpatu muṉ kūṟappaṭṭatu.
(1) tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi, `pulavarāṟṟuppaṭi eṉavum vaḻaṅkum. itu murukaṉ aruḷ peṟṟa pulavaṉ oruvaṉ, avvaruḷip peṟa viḻiyum pulavaṉ oruvaṉi ammurukaṉiṭam āṟṟuppaṭuttuvatu. itu tolkāppiyam kūṟāta ceyti yākum. itaṉip pāṭiyavar nakkīrar.
(2) porunarāṟṟuppaṭi eṉpatu, karikāl vaḷavaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭu varum porunaṉ oruvaṉ, vaḷḷali nāṭiccellum vaṟiya porunaṉi vaḻiyiṟkaṇṭu, avaṉik karikālaṉiṭam āṟṟuppaṭuttuvatāka muṭattāmakkaṇṇiyār eṉṟa pulavar pāṭiyatu.
(3) ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi eṉpatu, ōymāṉāṭṭuc ciṟṟaracaṉāṉa nalliyakkōṭaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa ciṟupāṇaṉ oruvaṉ, vaṟiya ciṟupāṇaṉi avvaḷḷalpāl āṟṟuppaṭuttuvatāka iṭikkaḻināṭṭu nallūr nattattaṉār eṉaṟa pulavar pāṭiyatu.
(4) perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi eṉpatu, toṇṭi nāṭṭu maṉṉāṉa iḷantiriyaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu  mīṇṭa perumpāṇaṉ oruvaṉ, vaṟiya perumpāṇaṉ oruvaṉi avvēntaṉiṭam āṟṟuppaṭuttuvatākak kaṭiyalūr uruttiraṅkaṇṇaṉār eṉṟa pulavar pāṭiyatu.
(5) kūttarāṟṟuppaṭi eṉṟa malipaṭukaṭām, ceṅkaṇmāttu vēḷ naṉṉaṉcēy naṉṉaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭu vanta kūttaṉ, vaṟiya kūttaṉi vaḻiyiṟkaṇṭu, avaṉi avvaḷḷalpāl āṟṟuppaṭuttuvatāka iraṇiya muṭṭattup peruṅkuṉṟūrp peruṅ kucikaṉār pāṭiyatu.

āṟṟuppaṭiyiṉ amippu
pāṇāṟṟuppaṭi
pāṇaṉatu vaṟiyaniliyi muṟkūṟi, nalaṅkiḷḷiyiṉ vīrattiyum koṭittaṉmiyiyum kūṟi, avaṉiṭam celliṉ maṟṟa vaḷḷalkaḷi maṟakkumpaṭi paricil nalkuvāṉ eṉṟu kōvūrkkiḻār pāṇaṉi avaṉpāl āṟṟup paṭuttiyuḷḷār (puṟam.68). itu 19 aṭikaḷ koṇṭa ceyyuḷ.
pāṇaṉuṭiya yāḻ, pacittaṉmi, kantiyuṭiya ivaṟṟi muṉṉarkkūṟi, piṉṉarc cōḻaṉ kuḷamuṟṟattut tuñciya kiḷḷi vaḷavaṉatu vīrattik kūṟi, avaṉiṭam celliṉ avaṉ paricilarkkut tēr vaḻaṅkuvatik kāṇalāmeṉṟum, pāṇaṉ poṟṟāmari peṟalāmeṉṟum kūṟi, avaṉi avvaḷḷalpāl āṟṟuppaṭutti, 21 aṭikaḷ koṇṭapāṭali ālattūr kiḻār pāṭiyuḷḷār (puṟam-69).
pāṇaṉatu perumpayaṇatti mutaliṟkūṟi, piṉṉar nāñcil vaḷḷuvaṉatu koṭicciṟappiyum koṭuttalil tavaṟāmiyiyum kūṟi, avaṉi avvaḷḷalpāl āṟṟuppaṭutti, 11 aṭikaḷ koṇṭa pāṭalip pāṭiyuḷḷār marutaṉ iḷanākaṉār (puṟam.138).
paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭu varum pāṇaṉ, viṟaliyari vicārittali muṟkūṟi, pēkaṉik kāṇā muṉpu tāṉum vaṟiyaṉāyiruntati aṭuttukkūṟi, pēkaṉ mayilukkup pōrvi tantatik kūṟi, avaṉatu koṭic ciṟappi iṟutiyiṟkūṟip pāṇaṉip pēkaṉpāl āṟṟuppaṭuttum muṟiyil paraṇar 45 aṭikaḷik koṇṭa ceyyuḷip pāṭiyuḷḷār (puṟam.141). 
āṭukōṭpāṭṭuc cēralātaṉuṭiya vīracceyalkaḷi muṟkūṟi, avaṉiṭam pāṭiccellumpaṭi iṭiyiṟ kūṟi, avaṉ maṉiviyar ciṟappiyum avaṉatu koṭit taṉmiyiyum piṟkūṟik kākki pāṭiṉiyār nacceḷḷiyār eṉṟa peṇpāṟpulavar viṟaliyi āṟṟuppaṭuttip patiṟṟuppattil 15 aṭikaḷ koṇṭa oru ceyyuḷip (57) pāṭiyuḷḷār.
`peruñcēral irumpoṟiyiṉ kuṉṟam itu eṉa mutalil kūṟi, avaṉ pōrcceyalkaḷi aṭuttukkūṟi, aricil kiḻār viṟaliyi āṟṟuppaṭuttip patiṟṟuppattil 14 aṭikaḷik koṇṭa pāṭalip (78) pāṭiyuḷḷār.
`iḷañcēral irumpoṟiyiṭam celliṉ naṉkalam taruvāṉ, eṉṟu mutaliṟkūṟi, aṭuttu avaṉatu nalliyalpik kūṟi, viṟaliyi avvaḷḷalpāl āṟṟuppaṭuttip peruṅkuṉṟūr kiḻār patiṟṟuppattil 5 aṭikaḷ koṇṭa oru ceyyuḷip (87) pāṭiyuḷḷār.
pulavar āṟṟuppaṭi
cēramāṉ kōkkōti mārpaṉatu toṇṭi nakaracciṟappik kūṟi, avaṉiṭam pulavaric cellumāṟu poykiyār puṟanāṉūṟṟil 9 aṭikaḷikkoṇṭa pāṭalip (48) pāṭiyuḷḷār.

āṟṟuppaṭiyiṉ potu amippu
ippāṭaṅkaḷuḷ oṉṟiṟkūṟiyatu pōla maṟṟoṉṟiṟ ceytikaḷ muṟippaṭi kūṟappaṭavilli. vaḷḷaliṉ pōrc ciṟappu, koṭicciṟappu, avaṉ maṉiviyar ciṟappu, avaṉatu nāṭṭuc ciṟappu, ūrcciṟappu, pāṇaṉ allatu viṟaliyatu vaṟiya nilimi,  avartam icikkaruvikaḷ ākiyavi kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa; ciṟappāka ovvoru ceyyuḷilum vaḷḷalatu koṭicciṟappu viṭāmaṟ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. perumpāṉmiyāṉa ceyyuḷ kaḷil koṭicciṟappum pōrcciṟappum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. `iṉṉa vaḷḷaliṭam cel eṉpatu ovvoru ceyyuḷilum iṭam peṟṟuḷḷatu. ovvoru ceyyuḷum ciṟcila aṭikaḷiyē koṇṭatākaliṉ, nāṭu, ūr, pōrkaḷ, koṭi, paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭavar ciṟappikkappeṟṟa muṟi mutaliyaṉa vivaramākat terivikkap paṭavilli. palanūṟu aṭikaḷik koṇṭa pattuppāṭṭuḷ iṭam peṟṟuḷḷa āṟṟuppaṭippāṭalkaḷil ivi aṉittum mikatteḷivāka viḷakkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. iṉi avvāṟṟuppaṭic ceytikaḷik kāṇpōm.

porunar āṟṟuppaṭi
inneṭumpāṭal irunūṟṟu nāṟpatteṭṭu aṭikaḷi uṭiyatu. karikāl vaḷavaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭuvarum porunaṉ, viṟali mutaliyavaruṭaṉ vaḷḷali nāṭic cellum vaṟiya porunaṉi vaḻiyiṟcantittu, avaṉi viḷittal (aṭi 1-3), yāḻiṉ varuṇaṉi (4-24), viṟali varuṇaṉi (25-47), porunaṉatu vaṟumi, tāṉ collum vaḷḷaliṭam cellumāṟu vaṟpuṟuttal (48-63), tāṉ karikālaṉik kaṇṭami, karikālaṉ taṉṉi varavēṟṟup puttāṭi aḷittami, tāṉ tēṟalarunti ōyvukoṇṭami, pala vaki uṇavup poruḷkaḷi uṇṭami, vīṭu tirumpa viṭi kēṭṭami, karikālaṉ aṉpāṟciṉam koṇṭami, piṉpu paricil nalkiṉami (64-129). karikālaṉ piṟappum pōrc ceyalkaḷum (130-150), avaṉikkāṇiṉ avaṉ puriya porunaṉi uṭiyālum uṇavālum upacarittu vēṇṭum aṇikaḷiyum piṟavaṟṟiyum nalkuvāṉ, ēḻaṭi naṭantu vaḻiyaṉuppuvāṉ eṉpatu (151-177), karikālaṉ āṇṭa cōḻa nāṭṭuvaḷam( marutam, neytal, mulli varuṇaṉi), kāviriyiṉ ciṟappu (178-248) ākiya aṉittum inneṭumpāṭaliṟ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.

ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi
pāṇ-pāṭṭu; pāṇar-pāṭuvōr.ivar icippāṇar, yāḻppāṇar, maṇṭippāṇar eṉappalarāvar. icip pāṇar, miṭaṟṟuppāṭal vallavar; yāḻ vācittup pāṭuvōr yāḻppāṇar; `maṇṭi eṉṉum peyarkoṇṭa uṇ kalatti vittiruppavar maṇṭippāṇarāvar. yāḻppāṇar ciṟiya yāḻi  icittuppāṭuvōrum periya yāḻi icittup pāṭuvōrum eṉa iru vakiyiṉarāvar. muṉṉavar ciṟupāṇar eṉṟum, piṉṉavar perumpāṇar eṉṟum vaḻaṅkappaṭuvar.
ciṟupāṇaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttiya kāraṇattāl ippāṭal `ciṟupāṇ āṟṟuppaṭi eṉappeyar peṟṟatu. iḵtu irunūṟṟupattoṉpatu aṭikaḷik koṇṭa neṭumpāṭṭākum.
iḷavēṉiṟparuvam  (aṭi1-9),apparuvattil pālivaḻi naṭantuvarum viṟaliyiṉ varuṇaṉi(10-33), ciṟiyayāḻi ēntiya ciṟupāṇaṉ vaṟumiyāl kalaṅkiya nilimi(34-40) cēranāṭṭuc ciṟappum ataṉ talinakarāṉa vañciyiṉ ciṟappum-(41-50), pāṇṭi nāṭṭuc ciṟappum ataṉtalinakarāṉa maturiyiṉ ciṟappum(51-67), cōḻanāṭṭuc ciṟappum ataṉ kōnakarāṉa uṟiyūrc ciṟappum (68-83), kaṭieḻu vaḷḷalkaḷ ciṟappu(84-113), nalliyak kōṭaṉatu māvilaṅki nakaracciṟappu, nalliyakkōṭaṉ ciṟappu(114-126), paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa ciṟupāṇaṉatu muṉṉiyavaṟiya nili, atunīṅka vaḷḷal taṉakku poruḷīntami(127-143), kiṭaṅkilukkuc cellumneṟi, neytal nilavaruṇaṉi, eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam, aṅkuḷḷavar upacarippu(144-163) eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattilirunta vēlūr cellum vaḻiyiluḷḷa mulli nilavaruṇaṉi (164-177),.....cellum vaḻiyiluḷsmarutaniyvaruṇad(178-195), kiṭaṅkišnakaracciṟapò(196-202). nalliyakkōṭaṉ iyalpukaḷ, avaṉ aviyil iruttal (203-220), yāḻi icittu avaṉ ciṟappiṉip pāṭa, avaṉ ciṟupāṇaṉi  upacarittuk koṭi vaḻaṅkutal (221-269) ākiya iviyaṉittum paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa ciṟupāṇaṉ vaṟiya pāṇaṉukkuk kūṟiyaviyākum.
perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi
inneṭumpāṭal, ainnūṟu aṭikaḷiyuṭiyatu. itaṉ kaṇ mutuvēṉil, pēriyāḻ varuṇaṉi, perumpāṇaṉatu vaṟiya nili (1-22), paricil peṟṟa perum pāṇaṉuṭiya muṉṉiya vaṟiya nili nīṅkip paricil peṟṟu varutal, iḷantiriyaṉ ciṟappu (23-45), kāñcikkuc cellum vaḻiyil umaṇar vāṇikam, vaḻikaḷ, vaḻikaḷil kāvalar, miḷaku vāṇikam, ulkuṭipperuvaḻikāvalar ,pāilayil eyiṉar vāḻvu, eyiṉar araṇkaḷ, mulilanilavaruṇaṉi, maruta nilavaruṇiṉa, marutanilattil valiyar, pāṇar vāḻkki, maṟiyavar uṟipati, nīrpbpayaṟṟu, paṭṭivaḷam (46-351), paṭṭiṉattiliruntu kāñci cellum vaḻiyiln tāppukkuṭikaḷ, pērūrkaḷ, vaḷḷikkūttāṭum makkaḷ uḷḷa ciṟṟūrkaḷ, ivaṟṟukkappāl uḷḷatirubvaḵkah, aṅkuḷḷa aṭarnta cāliyum, nīrvaḷamum, appāl uḷḷakaccimūtūr (352-392),kāñcivaruṇaṉi,(393-411), iḷantiriyaṉvīram, araciyal, avaṉip pahrāṭṭal, upacarippu, koṭicciṟappu(411-500) eṉpaṉa iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. kūttāraṟṟuppaṭi 

(malipaṭukaṭām)
innīṇṭa pāṭal ainnūṟṟeṇpattu mūṉṟu aṭikaḷiyuṭiyatu. `ceṅkaṇmā eṉpatu naṉṉaṉukkuriya talinakaram. annakaram naṉṉaṉuṭiya malikaḷukkut teṟku nilattil uḷḷatu. annakarattiyaṭittakum vaḻiyi ammalikaḷiṉ vaḻiyē ceṉṟu paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭu cellum kūttaṉ, vaṟiya kūttaṉukkum avaṉ kūṭṭattārkkum kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. eṉavē, avaṉ kūṟiyatil, mutalil aṭivāram nōkkic cellum vaḻi aṭivārap pakuti, mali vaḷam, malikaḷiṉ mītuḷḷa kuṟiñci-pāli-mulli-marutanila amippukaḷ, cēyāṟu, ataṉ oru kari vaḻiyē teṟku nōkkic ceṉṟu taliyiluḷḷa ceṅkaṇmā nakaratti aṭiyum vaḻi, araṇmaṉic ciṟappu, naṉṉaṉ koṭittiṟam eṉpaṉa muṟiyē ippāṭalil amintuḷḷaṉa. iṉi avaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷaṉa kāṇka:
mutalil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷavi vaḷḷali nāṭic cellum kūttar vittirunta icikkaruvikaḷ, yāḻiṉ varuṇaṉi, viṟaliyar varuṇaṉi, naṉṉaṉiṭam cellumāṟu kūṟutal, naṉṉaṉatu koṭittaṉmi kūṟal, avaṉatu naviramaliyil uḷḷa kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷ, naṉṉaṉatu vīram ākiyavaṟṟik kūṟal. piṉpu avaṉik kāṇac cellattakam vaḻi kūṟutal (1-94).
aṭivāram nōkkic cellum vaḻiyil uḷḷa nilattiṉ taṉmiyum viḷiporuḷkaḷum, aṭivārattu ūrkaḷ (95-169), malimītu vaḻi, uṇavu vaki, pōtaṟkariya vaḻi, naviramali, kāriyuṇṭikkaṭavuḷ, vaḻittuṉpam, kuṉṟiṉkāvalar vaḻi kāṭṭal, pala vaki olikaḷ (170-348), ariya vaḻi, naṭukaṟkaḷ, mulli nilam, marutanilam, cēyāṟu, ataṉ orukariyippaṟṟic cellavēṇṭuvatu (349-477), talinakaracciṟappu, araṇmaṉi muṟṟattil uḷḷa malipaṭuporuḷkaḷ, naṉṉaṉip pārāṭṭal, naṉṉaṉatu avi, naṉṉaṉatu upacarippu, koṭi (478-583).
nāṉkilum potuc ceytikaḷ
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa nāṉku āṟṟuppaṭikaḷilum potuvāy uḷḷa ceytikaḷ yāvi?
vaḷḷali nāṭic cellum putiya vaṟiya porunaṉ, pāṇaṉ, kūttaṉ, uṭaṉ ceṉṟavar ākiyōratu vaṟiya icikkaruvikaḷ paṟṟiya kuṟippu, paricil peṟṟa pāṇaṉ vaḷḷalik kāṇumuṉ irunta taṉatu vaṟiya niliyiyum vaḷḷalik kaṇṭapiṉpu peṟṟa celvaniliyiyum paṟṟiya kuṟippu, vaḷḷaliṉ nalliyalpukaḷ, avaṉatu talinakarattukkuc cellattakka vaḻi, avaṉatu talinakarac ciṟappu, avaṉ varavēṟpu, avaṉatu vīram, upacarippu, paricuvaḻaṅkaḷ eṉpaṉa mēlē collappaṭṭa nāṉku āṟṟuppaṭikaḷilum potuppaṭiyāy iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaviyākum.
enta nāṭṭilum perumpālum ` kuṟiñci, pāli, mulli, marutam, neytal ākiya aivaki nilaṅkaḷum irukkalām. āyiṉ, cōḻa nāṭṭil maliyum malicārnta kuṟiñcinilamum illi; iṅṅaṉamē naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭil kaṭalum kaṭal cārnta neytal nilamum illi. malināṭē kuṟiñciyāyiṉam, kūttarāṟṟuppaṭi pāṭiya āciriyar kuṟiñci nilamākiya malikaḷiṉmītu mulli, pāli, marutanilaṅkaḷ iruppatākap pāṭiyuḷḷār;  maliyil pulveḷiyuḷḷa pakuti mulli; kaṟkaḷum pāṟikaḷum uḷḷa pakuti pāli; tiṉi mutaliyaṉa viḷiyum pakuti kuṟiñci; karumpum nellum payirākum āṟṟup pakuti nilam marutam eṉa malimītuḷḷa viḷivik koṇṭu nāṉilaṅkaḷip pirittuk kūṟiyuḷḷār.
ovvōr āṟṟuppaṭiyilum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa vaḻi cuṟṟu vaḻiyākavē kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. avvaḻi akkāla makkaḷ payaṇam ceyta vaḻiyāyirun tirukkalām; allatu aivaki nila varuṇaṉiyi āṟṟuppaṭiyiṟ pukuttik kūṟuvēṇṭum eṉṟu eṇṇi avaṟṟi uḷḷaṭakkiya cuṟṟu vaḻiyākavum irukkalām. uṇmi ippoḻutu aṟiyumāṟilli. porunarāṟṟup paṭiyil porunaṉ enta ūriyum kuṟippiṭāmal, marutam-mulli- neytal-kuṟiñci nilappakutikaḷi varuṇittuc celvatāl, avaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻiyi mēṟpōkkākavum kūṟa iyalavilli. naṉṉaṉatu malināṭum talinakarāṉa ceṅkaṇmāvum paṭattil kuṟikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa. kūttaṉ eṅkiruntu naṭantu ceṉṟu enta maliyil mutalil ēṟiṉāṉ eṉpatu ataṟku cāṉṟilli. āyiṉ, naviramaliyiliruntu cēyāṟu variyum, piṟaku aṅkiruntu ceṅkam variyum ceṉṟavaḻiyi oruvāṟu tuṇiyalām.
ciṟupāṇaṉ kūṟiya ōymāṉāṭṭu vaḻiyil perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiya toṇṭi nāṭṭu vaḻiyum oruvāṟu aṟiyalām. ivi mikka tolivuḷḷa vaḻikaḷ. ivi muṉṉarc colliyavāṟu uṇmi vaḻikaḷā allatu aivaki nila varuṇaṉikkākap pulavar kaṟpittaviyā eṉpatit tuṇiyac cāṉṟilli. āyiṉ, ovvoru vaḻiyilum avvaḻiyik kūṟiya pulavar, aivaki nila varuṇaṉiyi viṭāmaṟkūṟiyiruppatik kāṇa, ivvaḻikaḷ pulavar kaṟpaṉi vaḻikaḷ ākalām eṉṟu karututal takum.
iṅṅaṉam karutuvatu poruttamākum eṉpataṟkuk kūttarāṟṟup paṭiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa vaḻiyē ēṟṟa cāṉṟākum.
paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭu vanta kūttaṉ maliyaṭivārattit tāṇṭic cellum vaḻiyil -malippakutikkuc ciṟitu tolivil uḷḷa nilappakutiyil - vaṟiya kūttaṉic cantittu, nilappakutiyilē (maliyilaṉṟu) uḷḷa naṉṉaṉatu ceṅkaṇmā eṉṉum talinakarattukku āṟṟuppaṭuttiṉāṉ eṉpatip pāṭalē kūṟukiṟatu. avaṉ āṟṟuppaṭuttiya pōtu avarkaḷ irunta iṭam nilam; maliyaṉṟu. naṉṉaṉatu tali nakaramum nilattilētāṉ uḷḷatē tavira, maliyilaṉṟu. annakarattiṟku maliyēṟāmalē maliyōramākavē teṟku nōkki variṉ, ceṅkaṇmāvi eḷitil aṭiyalām. ivvaḷavu eḷiya vaḻi irukka, kūttaṉ mali vaḻiyik kūṟiyatākap pulavar pāṭiyatēṉ?
pulavar ammalikaḷi naṉku pārviyiṭṭavar; vaḻit tuṉpaṅkaḷi nukarntavar; malimītu palavaki nilaṅkaḷik kaṇṭu kaḷittavar; naviramaliyil araṇum kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷ kōyilum iruntaṉa; vēṟumalikaḷil naṭukaṟkaḷ iruntaṉa; āṅkāṅku naṉṉaṉiṉ malināṭṭuk. kuṭiyiruntu kāval kāttaṉar. malivaḷam kaṇṇukkiṉiya kāṭciyit tantatu. mali vaḻiyik kūṟiṉāltāṉ avvaḻiyil iviyaṉittiyum amittuk kūṟu iyalum. naṉṉaṉatu nāṭṭil malivaḷamē ciṟanta vaḷam. ivaṟṟik kūṟi malikaḷic ciṟappippatāl naṉṉaṉ makiḻvāṉ eṉṟu eṇṇiyavar ātalāl, inta iṭakkāṉa malivaḻiyip paricil peṟṟa kūttaṉ putiya kūttaṟkuk kūṟiyatākap pulavar pāṭiṉār eṉṟu karutuvatē ēṟpuṭiyatu.
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi amippu
tolkāppiyar, kūttar, pāṇar, porunar, viṟaliyar ākiya nālvariyum poruḷutavi puriyum vaḷḷalpāl āṟṟuppaṭuttuvatu āṟṟuppaṭi eṉak kūṟiṉār. itaṉāl pulavari āṟṟuppaṭuttutal avarkku muṉpum avar kālattilum vaḻakkil illi eṉpatu teḷivākiṟatu. inniliyil, maṉitaṉit teyvattiṭam āṟṟuppaṭuttum vaḻakkam avar kalattil vaḻakkil illi eṉpatu teḷivākiṟatu. inniliyil, maṉitaṉit btayvattiṭam āṟṟuppaṭuttum vaḻakkam avar kahlattil aṟavē illi eṉpatu taḷivu. āṟṟuppaṭikaḷ āṟṟuppaṭuttappaṭum pāṇar, kūttar, porunar, viṟali eṉṉum peyarkaḷōṭu cārttip pāṇāṟṟuppaṭi, kūttarāṟṟuppaṭi, poru narāṟṟuppaṭi, viṟaliyāṟṟup paṭi eṉa vaḻaṅkappaṭum. āyiṉ, tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi immuṟiyil amintataṉṟu. murukaṉ aruḷpeṟṟa pulavar oruvar putiya pulavar oruvari murukaṉpāl āṟṟuppaṭuttuvatāka nakkīrar itaṉip pāṭiyuḷḷār. ātaliṉ, itu pulavar āṟṟuppaṭi eṉṉum peyarip peṟṟatu eṉṟu cilar kūṟuvar. āyiṉ, itu pulavarāṟṟuppaṭi eṉṉum peyaril vaḻakkup peṟāmal, tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi eṉṟē peruvaḻakkup peṟṟuḷḷatu. mēlum, itu caṅkakālattiṟku (ki.pi. 300kku)p piṉpum, appar-campantarkku (ki.pi. 600kku) muṉpum pāṭappaṭṭirukkalām eṉpatu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭatu. iṉi, itaṉ amippik kāṇpōm:
itu munnūṟṟuppatiṉēḻaṭikaḷik koṇṭa nīṇṭa akavaṟpāvākum. murukaṉ kuṟiñci nilac ciṟappuk kaṭavuḷ ātalāl, potuppaṭa malināṭṭukkuriya murukaṉ eṉpati uṇartta vaḷam mikunta mali oṉṟaṉic4  ciṟappittukkūṟi, ammalikku urimi pūṇṭa murukaṉ, tirupparaṅkuṉṟam, tiruccīralivāy, tiru āvi naṉkuṭi, tiru ērakam eṉṉum nāṉku ciṟappuṭit talaṅkaḷil eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷāṉ eṉṟu kūṟi, apperumāṉ mēlum kuṉṟutōṟāṭal koṇṭavaṉ eṉṟum kuṟamakaḷ ceyyum murukavaḻipāṭum kūṟi, apperumāṉip putiya pattaṉ eppaṭi vaḻipaṭa vēṇṭum eṉpatic cuṭṭi, murukaṉaruḷ puriyum tiṟattiṉiyum kūṟi ippāṭal muṭivuṟukiṉṟatu.
piṟa āṟṟuppaṭikaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭum āṟṟuppaṭuttap paṭuttuvōṉ taṉatu paḻiya niliyi viḷakkutal, paricil peṟṟa muṟiyik kūṟutal eṉpaṉa immurukāṟṟup paṭiyil teḷivākak kūṟappaṭavilli eṉpatu kavaṉikkattakkatu.
itaṉkaṇ mutaṟpakutiyil murukaṉ tiruvuruvac ciṟappu, avaṉ māli vicēṭaṅkaḷ, cūraramakaḷir ceyalkaḷ, murukaṉ cūraṉi veṉṟami, maturiyiṉ ciṟappu, tirupparaṅkuṉṟattiṉ iyaṟkivaḷam eṉpavi kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa (aṭi, 1-77); iraṇṭām pakutiyil murukaṉatu yāṉiyiṉ iyalpu, apperumāṉuṭiya āṟumukaṅkaḷiṉ ceyalkaḷ, tiruccīrali vāyil avaṉ iruttal eṉpavi iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa (aṭi, 78-125); mūṉṟām pakutiyil murukaṉi vaḻipaṭum muṉivar oḻukkam, tēvamakaḷir iyalpukaḷ, tirumāl mutaliyavar paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa (aṭi, 127-176); nāṉkām pakutiyil antaṇar iyalpum avarkaḷ tiruvērakattil murukaṉ vaḻipaṭum muṟimiyum kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. (aṭi, 177-189); aintām pakutiyil kuṉṟakkuravi, murukaṉi vaḻipaṭum makaḷir, āṭumakaḷir, pāṭumakaḷir iyalpukaḷ, avartam aṇi āṭi ceyal mutaliyaṉa iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa (aṭi, 190-217); āṟām pakutiyil murukaṉ eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷ, tēvarāṭṭi apperumāṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttum muṟi, avaṉit tutikkum muṟi, apperumāṉiṭam ceṉṟu aruḷ perum vaḻi, avaṉuṭiya toṇṭartam iyalpukaḷ, murukaṉ aruḷ puriyum muṟi, paḻamutircōli vaḷam ākiyavi kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
inta muṟi vippu, mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa porunar āṟṟuppaṭi mutaliyavaṟṟil illi.
4. āṟṟuppaṭi vaḻikaḷ
1. tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi
murukaṉatu aruḷip peṟṟa aṭiyavaṉ oruvaṉ, avvaruḷ peṟa virumpiya maṟṟoruvaṉi murukaṉiṭam āṟṟuppaṭuttum muṟiyil muṟiyē paraṅkuṉṟam, āvi naṉkuṭi, alivāy, ērakam ākiya nāṉku iṭaṅkaḷit teḷivākak kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ; piṟa iṭaṅkaḷi (mali, āṟu mutaliyavaṟṟi)p potuppaṭaccuṭṭic ceṉṟuḷḷāṉ. ippāṭalip pāṭiyavar nakkīrar. avarāl mutaliṟcuṭṭap paṭṭatu maturiyi aṭuttuḷḷa paraṅkuṉṟam. ātalāl, avarāl pāṭappaṭṭa murukaṉaṭiyāṉ maturiyiliruntu putiya aṭiyavaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttiṉāṉ eṉṟu koḷvatu poruttamākum.
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa mutal iṭam paraṅkuṉṟam. atu maturi māvaṭṭattil caṅka kāla maturikku aṇmiyil nēr mēṟkil iruntatu; iṉṟuḷḷa maturikkut teṉmēṟkil-ēṟattāḻa aintu kal tolivil- uḷḷatu.
iraṇṭāvatākak kūṟappaṭum iṭam alivāy. inta alivāyē puṟanāṉūṟu mutaliya nūlkaḷil kūṟappaṭum `centil eṉṟum, iṉṟiya `tiruccentūr eṉṟum aṟiñar karutukiṉṟaṉar. ivviṭam tirunelvēli māvaṭṭattuk kaṭaṟkariyil amintuḷḷatu. iṅkuḷḷa murukaṉ kōvil perumpukaḻ peṟṟatu.
mūṉṟāvatākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa iṭam, āvi naṉkuṭi eṉpatu. iḵtu iṉṟuḷḷa paḻaṉi eṉṉum ūrākum. ivvūril maliyaṭivārattil uḷḷa kōvilē tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyil kuṟikkappeṟṟatākum.
nāṉkāvatākak kūṟappaṭṭatu ērakam eṉṉum iṭamākum. `itu mali nāṭṭakattatu, eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār. mali nāṭu eṉpatu mēṟkut toṭarcci maliyic cārnta nilappakuti ākum. ērakam eṉpatu nākarkōvilukku aṇmiyiluḷḷa vēḷmali (vēḻi mali) eṉṟu cilar kūṟuvar. tirumurukāṟṟup paṭiyiluḷḷa ērakam paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷik kāṇa, ērakam eṉpatu, teṉ kaṉṉaṭa māvaṭṭattup puttūr vaṭṭattuk kiḻakkuk kōṭiyil mēṟku malittoṭariṉ mēṟkup pakkattil uḷḷa `kumāra kṣēttiram eṉṉum iṭamāy irukkalām. `murukaṉukkuriya iṭaṅkaḷ eṉṉum pakutiyil itu paṟṟi viḷakkappaṭum.
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyil murukaṉ kōvil koṇṭuḷḷaṉavākac ciṟappittuk kūṟappaṭum iṭaṅkaḷ inta nāṉkēyākum. murukaṉ aruḷ peṟṟa aṭiyavaṉ, apperumāṉ aruḷippeṟa virumpum aṭiyavaṉukku innāṉkiyum kūṟiya piṉpu, ``murukaṉ kuṉṟutōṟum āṭal purikiṉṟāṉ. ūrmaṉṟaṅkaḷilum nīrttuṟiyilum palvēṟu iṭaṅkaḷilum avaṉ tōṉṟuvāṉ, eṉṟu kūṟi muṭittuḷḷāṉ.
ivvivaraṅkaḷi nōkka, āṟṟuppaṭuttiya aṭiyavaṉ murukaṉ eṅkum iruppavaṉ eṉpatip putiyavaṉukku aṟivuṟutti, akkālattil ciṟappuṟṟirunta murukaṉukkuriya iṭaṅkaḷ nāṉki maṭṭum viḷakkamākakkūṟi āṟṟuppaṭuttiṉāṉ eṉṟu koḷvatē poruttamākum.
avaṉ kūṟiya iṭaṅkaḷuḷ paraṅkuṉṟamum āvi naṉkuṭiyum maturi māvaṭṭattil uḷḷavi; alivāy maturikkut teṉkiḻakkil ēṟattāḻa nūṟu kal tolivil uḷḷatu. ērakam maturikku neṭuntolivu vaṭamēṟkil mēṟku malit toṭarccikku mēṟkil uḷḷatu.
āṟṟuppaṭuttiya aṭiyavaṉ kūṟiya muṟippaṭiyē putiyavaṉ attalaṅkaḷik kāṇavēṇṭumāyiṉ, mutalil tirupparaṅkuṉṟatti vaḻivaṭṭu, piṉpu ēṟattāḻa nūṟu kal tūram teṟkē ceṉṟu alivāyi aṭiya vēṇṭum. aṅkuḷḷa murukaṉi vaḻipaṭṭa piṉpu avaṉ mīṇṭum maturi māvaṭṭattiluḷḷa paḻaṉiyi aṭiya vēṇṭum; piṉpu aṅkiruntu apputiyavaṉ teṉ kaṉṉaṭa māvaṭṭattiluḷḷa ērakatti aṭiyavēṇṭum. āṟṟuppaṭuttiya aṭiyavaṉ paraṅkuṉṟatti aṭuttu āvi naṉkuṭiyik kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum. atuvē muṟiyākum. avaṉ ekkāraṇaṅ koṇṭō aṅṅaṉam kūṟāmal, iraṇṭāvatākak kuṟikka vēṇṭiya iṭatti mūṉṟāvatākak kuṟittuviṭṭāṉ. oruvēḷi avaṉ inta iṭaṅkaḷiyellām putiyavaṉ ceṉṟu kāṇavēṇṭum eṉṟu niṉittuk kūṟavilli pōlum! avaṉ, murukaṉ ciṟappākak kōvil koṇṭirunta iṭaṅkaḷit teḷivākakkūṟi, piṉpu apperumāṉ tōṉṟum catukkam canti nīrttuṟi mutaliyavaṟṟiyellām kūṟi, attakiya perumāṉic caraṇaṭivatē uyyum vaḻi eṉṟu eṇṇik kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟu koḷvatē poruttamākum.
2. porunar āṟṟuppaṭi
itu karikāṟcōḻaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa porunaṉ vaḻiyil putiya porunaṉik kaṇṭu avaṉi avvaḷḷalpāl āṟṟuppaṭuttiyatākap pāṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itaṉip pāṭiyavar muṭattāmakkaṇṇiyār. ivarē nāmō ūrō aṟiyumāṟilli. ippāṭalil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa nilavaruṇaṉi, putiya porunaṉ cellattakum vaḻi eṉpaṉa cōḻanāṭu paṟṟiyaṉavākavē uḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟi nōkka, paricu peṟṟa porunaṉ putiya porunaṉic cōṇāṭṭu elliyuḷ āṟṟuppaṭuttiṉāṉ eṉṟu koḷvatē poruttamākum.
porunarāṟṟuppaṭi irunūṟṟunāṟpatteṭṭu aṭikaḷi uṭiyatu. inneṭumpāṭṭip pāṭiya āciriyar oṉṟu mutal 178 aṭikaḷ variyil viṟaliyiṉ varuṇaṉi, porunaṉ karikālaṉiṭam ceṉṟa pōtirunta vaṟiya nili, karikālaṉatu upacarippu, avaṉuṭiya vīram koṭi paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ ākiyavaṟṟikkūṟi, 179 ām aṭiyiliruntu 248ām aṭi variyil (69 aṭikaḷil) cōḻanāṭṭu vaḷattik kūṟiyuḷḷār. ivar, putiya pāṇaṉ etu vaḻiyākac ceṉṟu karikālaṉi evvūril kāṇavēṇṭum eṉpati ippāṭaliṟ kuṟikkavēyilli eṉpatu kavaṉikkattakkatu. ivar ippakutiyil kāviriyiṉ nīrvaḷam, cōḻa nāṭṭu marutanilac ciṟappu, ciṟṟūrkaḷiṉ vaḷam ākiyavaṟṟiyē kūṟiyuḷḷār. ivvivaraṅkaḷi nōkka, perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi, kūttarāṟṟuppaṭi ākiya mūṉṟiyum pāṭiya āciriyarkaḷip pōla ivar putiya porunaṉukku muṟippaṭi vaḻikūṟavilli eṉpatu teḷivākiṟatu. piṟa āṟṟuppaṭikaḷ putiya pāṇaṉiyō kūttaṉiyō āṟṟuppaṭuttum muṟiyil, kuṟippiṭṭa ovvoru vaḷḷaliyum pukaḻvataṟkākavē pāṭappaṭṭatu. eṉiṉum, avaṟṟuḷ ovvoṉṟilum vaḻi cemmiyākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. attakiya vaḻi ipporunarāṟṟup paṭiyil kūṟappaṭavilli. karikālaṉuṭiya talinakarattiṉ peyarum ciṟappum kuṟikkappaṭavilli. eṉavē, putiya porunaṉ etu vaḻiyākac ceṉṟu karikālaṉikkāṇa vēṇṭum eṉṟu paricu peṟṟa porunaṉ virumpiṉāṉ eṉpati ippāṭal koṇṭu kūṟakkūṭavilli. ivi aṉittiyum nōkka, karikālaṉatu ciṟappiyum cōḻanāṭṭu vaḷattiyumē kūṟi, paricu peṟṟa porunaṉ putiya porunaṉik karikālaṉiṭam āṟṟuppaṭuttiṉāṉ eṉṟu karutattakum muṟiyil ippāṭal amintuḷḷatu eṉṉalām.
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyilum porunarāṟṟup paṭiyilum- ciṟupāṇ āṟṟuppaṭi, perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭi, kūttārāṟṟuppaṭi eṉpavi pōlat teḷivāka vaḻi kūṟappaṭavilli eṉpatu aṟiyattakkatu. immuṟiyil muṉṉiraṇṭum oru vakiyiṉa; piṉṉavi mūṉṟum vēṟu vakiyiṉa eṉpatu niṉiviṟkoḷḷattakum.
3. ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi
ōymāṉāṭṭu nalliyakkōṭaṉ kiṭaṅkil eṉṉum taṉ talinakaril iruntāṉ. avaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa ciṟupāṇaṉ, vēṟoru ciṟupāṇaṉi avaṉiṭam āṟṟup paṭuttiyatāka iṭikkaḻināṭṭu nallūr nattattaṉār eṉṟa pulavar ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭiyip pāṭiyuḷḷār.
paricil peṟṟa ciṟupāṇaṉ putiyapāṇaṉi nōkki, ``kaṭal parantu eṟṟip porutalālē aliyum nīriyuṭiya kariyil veḷḷiya maṇaliṭattu niṉṟa tāḻi, aṉṉam pōlap pūkkum; iḷavēṉiṟkālam toṭaṅkukiṉṟa nāḷil ceruntimalar taṉṉik kaṇṭārip poṉ eṉṟu maruḷacceyyum; kaḻimuḷḷi nīlamaṇi pōlap pūkkum; neṭiya tāḷiṉiyuṭiya puṉṉimaram nittilam pōla arumpukaḷi veḷippaṭuttum. nī ivaṟṟi neytal nilattu neṭuvaḻiyiṟkāṇalām. avvaḻiyil  nīlamaṇi pōlum (uppaṅ) kaḻi cūḻnta ūrkaḷiyuṭiya paṭṭiṉam kāṇalām. atu matilōṭē (eyilōṭē) peyar peṟṟa paṭṭiṉam1 (matiṟpaṭṭiṉam, allatu cōppaṭṭiṉam, allatu eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam) eṉṟu kūṟukiṟāṉ. nacciṉārkkiṉiyar `eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam eṉṟē uri kūṟiyuḷḷār. ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi iṟuti veṇpāvil nalliyakkōṭaṉ `eyiṟpaṭṭiṉa nāṭaṉ eṉṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷāṉ.
`eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam eṉpatu iṟṟināḷ tiṇṭivaṉam vaṭṭattil uḷḷa marakkāṇamāyirukkalām eṉṟu aṟiñar kūṟuvar.2 marakkāṇattiṟku vaṭamēṟkil - ēṟattāḻa irupatukal tolivil-kiṭaṅkil irukkiṟatu. marakkāṇattiṟkut teṉmēṟkil vēlūr uḷḷatu. vēlūriliruntu kiṭaṅkilukkup pōkum pātiyil āmūr iruppatākac ciṟupāṇaṉ ceppiyuḷḷāṉ. ataṟku aṇmiyil kiṭaṅkil iruppatākakkūṟi, āmūr vaḻic cellumpaṭi tūṇṭukiṟāṉ.
mutalil eyiṟpaṭṭiṉatti aṭiyumpaṭi ciṟupāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉukkuk kūṟukiṟāṉ; ataṉi aṭiyattakum kaṭalōra vaḻiyiyum pulappaṭuttukiṟāṉ. vaṭakkiliruntō allatu teṟkiliruntōtāṉ kariyōramāka oruvaṉ eyiṉpaṭṭiṉatti aṭital kūṭum. teṟkiliruntu puṟappaṭum oruvaṉ kiṭaṅkilukkuc cella - allatu vēlūrukkuc cella - vaṭakkiluḷḷa eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam cellat tēviyilli; avaṉ nērē vēlūrukkō allatu kiṭaṅkilukkō vaṭakku allatu vaṭamēṟku nōkkic cellalām. ivvivaraṅkaḷiyum, `kaṭalōramākac celliṉ eyiṟpaṭṭiṉatti aṭiyalām, eṉṟu ciṟupāṇaṉ kūṟutaliyum nōkka, nattattaṉār tamatu ūrākiya (eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiṟka vaṭakkiluḷḷa) iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭu nallūriliruntē parica peṟṟa ciṟupāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttiyatākap pāṭiyirukkalām eṉṟu karututal poruttamākum.
`iṭikkaḻi nāṭu eṉpatu ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattu maturāntakam vaṭṭattil uppaṅkaḻikkum kaṭaṟkarikkum iṭippaṭṭa nilappakutiyākum. aḵtu ippoḻutu `eṭakkanāṭu eṉṟu maruvi vaḻaṅkappaṭukiṟatu. annāṭṭiṉ teṉkōṭiyil `nallūr eṉṉum ciṟṟūr uḷḷatu. nattattaṉār eṉṟa pulavar avvūril iruntār eṉṉum cevi vaḻicceyti iṉṟum avvūrilum cuṟṟuppuṟa ūrkaḷilum nilittuḷḷatu.
aṅkiruntu puṟappaṭṭa ciṟupāṇaṉ kaṭalōramākat teṟku nōkki naṭantu, ōymāṉāṭṭic cērnta kaṭaṟkarip paṭṭiṉamāṉa eyiṟpaṭṭiṉatti aṭiyumpaṭi vaḻi kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. iraṇṭiṟkum iṭiyil ēṟattāḻa eṭṭukkal tolivu irukkalām. eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiliruntu mulli nilavaḻiyē ceṉṟāl, vēlūri aṭiyalām eṉpatu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiṟkut teṉmēṟkil ēṟattāḻa 12 kal tolivil vēlūr uḷḷatu. vēlūrukkum āmūrukkum iṭiyil marutanilam uḷḷatu. `āmūr eṉṉum ūr iṉṟu illi. vēlūrukku mēṟkil koṇṭāmūrum vaṭamēṟkil ciṟṟāmūr, nallāmūr eṉṉum ūrkaḷum uḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟuḷ nallāmūr kiṅkilukkut teṟkil āṟu kal tolivil uḷḷatu. maṟṟavi mikutolivil uḷḷaṉa. āmūr vari nāṭṭu vaḷappam kūṟiya pulavar, āmūrip paṟṟip pēciyapiṟaku āmūrkkum kiṭaṅkilukkum iṭippaṭṭa nilattip paṟṟi oṉṟum kūṟāmal kiṭaṅkilip paṟṟip pēcat toṭaṅki viṭṭār. eṉavē, āmūr kiṭaṅkilukku aṇmiyil iruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu terikiṟata. inniliyil ottu varuvatu iṉṟuḷḷa nallāmūrēyākam. atu vēlūrukku vaṭa mēṟkil ēṟattāḻa 11 kal tolivil uḷḷatu.
4. perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi
perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭiyip pāṭiyavar kaṭiyalūr uruttiraṅ kaṇṇaṉār eṉpavar. kaṭiyalūr eṉṉumūr evviṭattatu eṉpatu kūṟa iyalavilli. avar kūṟiyuḷḷa perumpāṇaṉ putiya perumpāṇaṉi eṅkuc cantittāṉ eṉpatum teriyavilli. āyiṉ, apperumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻiyil vēṟṟaracar nāṭu kūṟappappaṭavilli; toṇṭi nāṭṭu nilaṅkaḷum ūrkaḷumē kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟik kūrntu nōkkiṉ, perum pāṇaṉ toṇṭināṭṭiṉ uṭpakutiyiliruntē putiya pāṇaṉukkuk kāñcikkuc cella vaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ eṉpatu teḷivākat terikiṟatu.
perumpāṇaṉ putiyapāṇaṉukku mūṉṟu iṭaṅkaḷit teḷivākak kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. avi muṟiyē `nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉṉum iṭattiṉ elli yil aminta tuṟimukanakaram, kāñcikku muṉṉuḷḷa paḷḷikoṇṭa perumāḷkōvil (tiruveḵkā), kāñcimānakaram eṉpaṉavākum. perumpāṇaṉ mutalil tuṟimuka nakaratti aṭiya avaṉukku vaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ; piṉpu aṅkiruntu kāñcikkuc  cella vaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. itaṉāl apputiyavaṉ eḷitil kāñcikkuc cellum vaḻiyiyē perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ eṉṟu karututal takum. avaṉ mutalil kaṭaṟkari nakari aṭiyumpaṭi kūṟiyuḷḷati nōkka, avaṉ vaḻi kūṟiya iṭattiliruntu akkaṭaṟkari nakari aṭivatē eḷiteṉak karutiyiruttal vēṇṭum. avaṉ kaṭaṟkarikkuc cēymiyiliruntu vaḻi kūṟiyiruppiṉ, kaṭaṟkari nakari mutalil aṭiyumpaṭi kūṟiyirāṉ; mikutiyāka naṭakkumpaṭi ceytirāṉ. eṉavē, perumpāṇaṉ kaṭaṟkarikku aṇmiyiliruntē putiṇa pāṇaṟka vaḻi kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum eṉak koḷvatu poruttamākum.
tuṟimuka nakarattiṟkup pōkum vaḻi
perumpāṇaṉ putiya perumpāṇaṉic cantitta iṭattilirunta kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻi itu eṉpati niṉiviṟ koṇṭu, kīḻ varum ceytikaḷik kavaṉittal vēṇṭum:
1. umaṇar uppu vaṇṭikaḷiyum taṉi māṭukaḷiyum ōṭṭic cellum neṭiya vaḻikaḷ vaḻiyiṟkāṇappaṭum. avvaḻikaḷil vaṇikar kaḻutikaḷiṉmītu miḷakuppotikaḷi ēṟṟic ceṉṟu vāṇikam ceyvar. avvaḻikaḷil cuṅkaccāvaṭikaḷ uṇṭu; nāṭukāval ceyyum viṟpaṭi vīrar ūrkaḷ uṇṭu. avvaḻikaḷiṟkāṭukaḷum uṇṭu.
2. kāṭukaḷit tāṇṭiyatum pāli nilam kāṇappaṭum. aṅku eyiṉar īttilik kuṭicikaḷil vāḻvar. ippāli nilattik kaṭantavuṭaṉ eyiṉar araṇkaḷ irukkum.
3. araṇkaḷukku appāl mulli nila makkaḷākiya iṭiyar kuṭiyiruppukaḷ kāṇappaṭum.
4. mulli nilam tāṇṭiya piṉpu vayalum vayal cārnta iṭamumākiya marutanilam kāṇappaṭum.
5. marutanilattil kuḷaṅkaḷum ērikaḷum uṇṭu. taruppippul vēynta kuṭicikaḷil vāḻum valiyar, nīr nilikaḷil vali vīci mīṉ piṭippar. marutanilattil uḷḷa kuḷaṅkaḷilum ērikaḷilum maṇamikka malarkaḷ malarntirukkum. aṅkuḷḷōr avaṟṟip paṟippar.
6. ammarutanilap pakutiyil celliṉ, maṟiyavar uṟipati (piṟkāla akaram allatu piramatēyam, allatu caturvēti maṅkalam) oṉṟi aṭiyalām. aṅku vētamōti vēḷvi ceyyum vētiyar vāḻvar.
7. aṭuttu, makaḷir nīrāṭum tuṟi kāṇappaṭum. attuṟiyil makaḷir nekiḻaviṭṭa maṇikaḷ patitta nakiyic ciccilippaṟavi eṭuttuc ceṉṟu maṟiyavar vēḷvic cāliyil naṭṭuvitta tūṇmītu amarum. ammaṟiyavar vāḻum iṭam `nīrpeyaṟṟu eṉpatu. ataṉ elliyil tuṟimukam amintuḷḷatu.
8. aṅku mēṟṟiciyiliruntu veṇṇiṟak kutirikaḷiyum vaṭaticiyiliruntu pala poruḷkaḷiyum koṇṭuvarum kappalkaḷ cūḻntu kiṭakkum kaṭaṟpakkam uṇṭu. aṅkup paṇṭacālikaḷiyum paratavar māṭaṅkaḷiyum celvar vaḷamaṉikaḷiyumuṭiya paṭṭiṉam uṇṭu. kalaṅkari viḷakkamum aṅku uṇṭu.
tuṟimuka nakarattiliruntu kāñcikku vaḻi
1. tuṟimukappaṭṭiṉattiliruntu kāñci nōkkic cellum vaḻiyil teṉṉantōppukaḷ mikutiyāyuṇṭu. attōppukaḷil makkaḷ kuṭiyiruppukaḷ irukkum. aṅkup palāppaḻamum, vāḻippaḻamum, iḷanīrum, nuṅkum kiṭikkum.
2. avaṟṟukkappāl uḷḷa vaḻiyil viṇ varuṭum māṭaṅkaḷiyuṭiya ūrkaḷ kāṇappaṭum.
3. piṉpu vaḷḷikkūttāṭum puṟanāṭukaḷ pala irukkum.
4. ivi aṉittiyum kaṭanta piṉpu, perumāḷ paḷḷi koṇṭuḷḷa iṭam kāṇappaṭum. aṅka veyil nuḻiyāta iḷamarakkā uṇṭu; maṇal uṇṭu; nīr niṟinta kuḻikaḷ, poḻilkaḷ mutaliyaṉa uṇṭu. aṅkup poḻutu pōkkac celpavar kuppikkaḷḷip paruki aḻakiya makaḷirōṭu pakaṟpoḻutu viḷiyāṭip periya nīrttuṟiyil nīrāṭuvar.
5. piṉpu cōlikaḷum kāvaṟkāṭum cūḻnta kāñci mānakara matil kāṇappaṭum. ammatil ceṅkal matilākum. ammatiluḷḷa kāñci mūtūr amintirukkum.
5. kūttarāṟṟuppaṭi
(malipaṭukaṭām)
caṅkakāla naṉṉaṉatu malināṭu iṉṟuḷḷa vaṭavārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭattil vaṭakkut teṟkākap paraviyuḷḷa cavvātu malikaḷum avaṟṟic cūḻavuḷḷa nilappakutiyumākum. ammalikaḷiṉ aṭivārap pakutiyil irunta kuṟuṅkāṭṭil vaṟiya kūttaṉum avaṉic cērnta viṟali mutaliyōrum taṅkiyiruntaṉar. appoḻutu naṉṉaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu malikaḷil vaḻi naṭantu aṭivāratti aṭintu, kuṟuṅkāṭṭu vaḻiyē tirumpi vantukoṇṭirunta kūttar talivaṉ, vaṟiya kūttarik kuṟuṅkāṭṭil cantittāṉ; avarkaḷi naṉṉaṉpāl āṟṟuppaṭutta virumpi, akkuṟuṅkāṭṭiliruntu naṉṉaṉatu ceṅkaṇ mānakarukkuc cellum mali vaḻiyik kūṟiṉāṉ.
paricil peṟṟa pāṇaṉ mutalil kuṟuṅkāṭṭiliruntu maliyaṭivāram nōkkic cellum vaḻiyik kūṟi, aṅkup payirāvaṉavaṟṟi virittuk kūṟiṉāṉ; mali ēṟic celkiyil cila ūrkaḷil kiṭikkum uṇavu vakikaḷik kūṟiṉāṉ; mali vaḻikaḷil tiṉippuṉatti aḻikkum paṉṟikaḷip piṭikkak kaṟpoṟikaḷ vikkappaṭṭiruttal vaḻakkamātalāl, pakalil maṭṭum payaṇam ceyyumpaṭi vaṟpuṟuttiṉāṉ; palarum pōkāta vaḻiyiluḷḷa tuṉpaṅkaḷi eṭuttuk kūṟiṉāṉ; vaḻiyil naviramali, aṅkuḷḷa kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷ kōvil, naviramaliyil irunta kōṭṭi, tūcippaṭi ākiyavi  paṟṟi aṟivittāṉ; kāṭṭil kāṉavaṉ ampu paṭṭa paṉṟi iṟattal, malippāmpukaḷ iruttal paṟṟik kūṟikkuṟavarum maruḷum kuṉṟam, ataṉ ucciyil kāval puriyum kāṉavar, ammalippakkattil uṇṭākum pala vaki ōcikaḷ ākiyavaṟṟi viḷakkamākak kūṟiṉāṉ.
naṉṉaṉatu periyamaliyit tāṇṭiya piṟaku āṅkāṅku irunta araṇkaḷ, aṅkirunta ciṟu vaḻikaḷ, avaṟṟik kaṭakkum muṟi, vaḻi kāṭṭiyiṉ utavi peṟṟup pōtal, periya kāṭukaḷ, vaḻiyil naṭukaṟkaḷ, yāḻ vācittu naṭukaṟkaḷi vaṇaṅkutal paṟṟi aṟivuṟuttiṉāṉ; naṉṉaṉōṭu māṟupaṭṭa makkaḷ vāḻum ūrkaḷ āyiṉum, avarkaḷ putiyavari upacarittal, kāṭṭil kōvalar upacarippu, mēlum vaḻi naṭappiṉ nāṭu kākkam vēṭar upacarippu, mēlum vaḻiyil mulli nila ūrkaḷ, valiyar upacarippu, marutanila ūrkaḷ, cēyāṟu etirppaṭal, ataṉ kari vaḻiyē celliṉ naṉṉaṉ talinakarāmākiya ceṅkaṇmāvi aṭital ākiyavi paṟṟik kūṟiṉāṉ.
perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiya vaḻi
kāñciyit talinakarāyk koṇṭu toṇṭi nāṭṭi āṇṭu vanta toṇṭimāṉ tiriyaṉiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭu vantu koṇṭirunta perumpāṇaṉ oruvaṉ, vaṟiya perumpāṇaṉ oruvaṉi vaḻiyiṟkaṇṭu, tāṉkaṇṭa avviṭattiliruntu apputiyavaṉik kāñcikkuc ceṉṟu paricil peṟumāṟu āṟṟuppaṭuttal perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭiyiṉ nōkkamākum.
toṇṭi nāṭu eṉpatu ēṟattāḻa iṉṟuḷḷa ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu, vaṭavārkkāṭu, nellūr māvaṭṭattiṉ teṉpakuti, teṉṉārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭattil ōymāṉāṭu nīṅkalākat tiṇṭivaṉa vaṭṭattiṉ mēṟkuppakuti, viḻuppuravaṭṭam ākiyavaṟṟit taṉṉakattē koṇṭa nilappakutiyākum.
perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭiyip pāṭiyavar kaṭiyalūr uruttiraṅkakaṇṇaṉār eṉpavar. kaṭiyalūr eṉpatu evviṭattatu eṉpatu aṟiya iyalavilli. avar kūṟiyuḷḷa perumpāṇaṉ putiya perumpāṇaṉi eṅkuc cantittāṉ eṉpatum teriyavilli. āyiṉ, apperumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻiyil vēṟṟaracar nāṭu kūṟappaṭavilli; toṇṭi nāṭṭu nilaṅkaḷam ūrkaḷumē kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟik kūrnta nōkkiṉ, perumpāṇaṉ toṇṭi nāṭṭiṉuḷḷiruntē putiṇa pāṇaṉukkuk kāñcikkuc cella vaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ eṉpatu teḷivākat terikiṟatu.
perumpāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉukku mūṉṟu iṭaṅkaḷit teḷivākak kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. avi muṟiyē, nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉṉum iṭattiṉ elliyil aminta tuṟimukanakaram, kāñcikku muṉṉuḷḷa paḷḷikoṇṭa perumāḷ kōvil (tiruveḵkā), kāñci mānakaram eṉpaṉavākum. avaṉ mutalil tuṟimuka nakaratti aṭiyavaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ; piṉpu aṅkiruntu kāñcikkuc cellavaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. itaṉāl apputiyavaṉ eḷitil kāñcikkuc cellum vaḻiyiyē perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ eṉṟu karututal takum. avaṉ mutalil kaṭaṟkari nakari aṭiyumpaṭi kūṟiyuḷḷati nōkka, avaṉ vaḻikūṟiya iṭattiliruntu akkaṭaṟkari nakari aṭivati eḷiteṉak karutiyiruttal vēṇṭum. avaṉ kaṭaṟkarikkuc cēymiyiliruntu vaḻi kūṟiyiruppiṉ, kaṭaṟkari nakari mutalil aṭiyumpaṭi kūṟiyirāṉ; mikutiyāka naṭakkumpaṭi ceytirāṉ. eṉavē, perumpāṇaṉ kaṭaṟkarikku aṇmiyiliruntē putiyapāṇaṟku vaḻi kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum eṉak koḷvatu poruttamākum.
tuṟimuka nakarattiṟkup pōkum vaḻi
perumpāṇaṉ putiya perumpāṇaṉic cantitta iṭattiliruntu kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻi itu eṉ koṇṭu, kīḻvarum ceytikaḷik kavaṉi
1.``ckz® uppu vaṇṭikaḷiyum ōṭṭic cellum neṭiya vaḻikaḷ vaḻi avvaḻikaḷil vaṇikar kaḻutikaḷiṉmītu miḷakup potikaḷi ēṟṟic ceṉṟu vāṇikam ceyvar. avvaḻikaḷil cuṅkaccāvaṭikaḷ uṇṭu; nāṭu kāval ceyyum viṟpaṭi vīrar ūrkaḷ uṇṭu. avvaḻikaḷiṟkāṭukaḷum uṇṭu.
2. ``kāṭukaḷit tāṇṭiyatum pāli nilam kāṇappaṭum. aṅku īttilik kuṭicikaḷil vāḻum eyiṟṟiyar, māṉ tōlil paṭuttiruppar; pullariciyi nilavuraliṟkuṟṟi, uvar nīril camippar; uppukkaṇṭam uṇpar. eyiṉar tūṟukaḷil vēṭṭiyāṭip paṉṟi, muyal mutaliyavaṟṟip piṭippar.
``ippāli nilattik kaṭantavuṭaṉ eyiṉar araṇkaḷ irukkum. aṅkuc civanta neṟcōṟum uṭumpiṉ poriyalum uṇṇakkiṭikkum.
3. ``araṇkaḷukku appāl iṭiyar kuṭiyiruppu uḷḷa mulli nilam kāṇappaṭum. aṅku vāḻum iṭiyar āṭṭukkiṭāyiṉ tōlip pāyalākakkoḷvar; mōr, pāl mutaliyavaṟṟi viṟṟup paṇṭaṅkaḷi vāṅki eṇpar; tiṉiccōṟum, varakuccōṟum, pālum, avarip paruppukkūṭṭum uṇpar; varaku vikkōlāl aminta kūri vīṭukaḷil vāḻvar.
4. ``mulli nilattik kaṭanta piṉpu vayalum vayal cārnta iṭamumākiya marutanilam kāṇappaṭum. aṅku neṟcōṟum peṭṭikkōḻip poriyalum karuppañcāṟum karuppuk kaṭṭiyum uṇṇakkiṭikkum.
5. ``marutanilattil kuḷaṅkaḷum ērikaḷum uṇṭu. taruppippuṟ kuṭicikaḷil vāḻum valiyar nīrnilikaḷil valivīci mīṉpiṭippar; avaṟṟi viṟṟu vāḻvar. aṅkuc cuṭṭa mīṉ iṟicciyum aricikkūḻāl ākkiya kaḷḷum uṇavākak kiṭikkum.
``marutanilattil uḷḷa kuḷaṅkaḷilum ērikaḷilum maṇamikka malarkaḷ malarntirukkum. aṅkuḷḷōr avaṟṟip paṟippar. nīyum uṉṉic cērntavarum appūkkaḷic cūṭalām.
6. ``ammarutanilap pakutiyil celliṉ, maṟiyavar uṟipati (piṟkāla akaram allatu piramatēyam allatu caturvēti maṅkalam) oṉṟi aṭiyalām. aṅku vētamōti vēḷvi ceyyum vētiyar vāḻvar.
7.``mL¤J makaḷir nīrāṭum tuṟi kāṇappaṭum. attuṟiyil makaḷir nekiḻaviṭṭa maṇikaḷ patitta nakiyic ciccilippaṟavi eṭuttuc ceṉṟu maṟiyavar vēḷvic cāliyil naṭṭuvitta tūṇiṉmītu amarum; ammaṟiyavar vāḻumiṭam nīrppeyarttu (nīrppēr) eṉpatu. ataṉ elliyil tuṟimukam amintuḷḷatu.
8. ``aṅku mēṟṟiciyiliruntu veṇṇiṟak kutiri kaḷiyum vaṭaticiyiliruntu pala poruḷkaḷiyum koṇṭu varum kappalkaḷ cūḻntukiṭakkum kaṭaṟpakkam uṇṭu. aṅkup paṇṭacālikaḷiyum paratavar māṭaṅkaḷiyum celvar vaḷamaṉikaḷiyumuṭiya paṭṭiṉam uṇṭu. kalaṅkari viḷakkamum aṅku uṇṭu. appaṭṭiṉam piṟpaṭak kāñciyi nōkkic celvīr.
tuṟimukanakarattiliruntu kāñcikku vaḻi
1. ``tuṟimukappaṭṭiṉattiliruntu kāñcinōkkic cellum vaḻiyil teṉṉantōppukaḷ mikutiyāyuṇṭu. attōppukaḷil makkaḷ kuṭiyiruppukaḷ irukkum. aṅkup palāppaḻamum, vāḻippaḻamum, iḷanīrum, nuṅkum kiṭikkum.
2. ``avaṟṟukkappāl uḷḷa vaḻiyil viṇ varuṭum māṭaṅkaḷiyuṭiya ūrkaḷ kāṇappaṭum.
3. ``piṉpu vaḷḷikkūttāṭum puṟanāṭukaḷ pala irukkum.
4. ``ivi aṉittiyum kaṭantapiṉpu perumāḷ paḷḷi koṇṭuḷḷa iṭam kāṇappaṭum. aṅku veyil nuḻiyāta iḷamarakkā uṇṭu; maṇal uṇṭu; nīr niṟinta kuḻikaḷ, poḻilkaḷ mutaliyaṉa uṇṭu. aṅkup poḻutu pōkkac celpavar kuppikkaḷḷip paruki, aḻakiya makaḷirōṭu pakaṟpoḻutu viḷiyāṭip periya nīrttuṟiyil nīrāṭuvar. nīṅkaḷ aṅku iḷippāṟuṅkaḷ; perumāḷi vāḻtti yāḻi vācittuc celluṅkaḷ.
5. ``piṉpu cōlikaḷum kāvaṟkāṭum cūḻnta kāñci mānakara matil kāṇappaṭum. ammatil ceṅkalmatilākum. ammatilukkuḷ kāñci mūtūr amintirukkum.
tuṟimukanakaram etu?
perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷa ivvaḻikaḷil iraṇṭām vaḻi kaṭaṟkarippaṭṭiṉattiṟkum kāñcikkum iṭippaṭṭa tātaliṉ, nām ārāyattēvi illi. mutal vaḻi eṅkiruntu toṭaṅkiyiruttal kūṭum eṉpatik kaṇṭaṟital payaṉtarum. ataṉik kaṇṭaṟiyum muṉpu, perumpāṇaṉ kuṟippiṭṭuḷḷa `nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉṟa iṭam yāteṉak kāṇpatu nalam. ataṉ elliyil tuṟimukam iruntateṉṟum iṟakkumati nikaḻnta teṉṟum aṅku vaḷam mikunta paṭṭiṉam iruntateṉṟum perumpāṇaṉē kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ.
ōymāṉāṭṭukku vaṭakkēyirunta toṇṭināṭṭil māmallapuramē pallavar kālattil ciṟanta tuṟimukap paṭṭiṉamāyiruntatu. ki.pi. 7ām nūṟṟāṇṭil naracimmavarmaṉ ilaṅkiyaracaṉāṉa māṉavaṉmaṉukku utaviyāka irumuṟi kappaṟpaṭiyi māmallapurattiliruntē ilaṅkikku aṉuppiṉāṉ.1 atē nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ muṟpātiyil yuvāṉ cuvāṅ eṉṟa cīṉavaḻippōkkaṉ inta māmallapuram ciṟanta tuṟimukanakaram eṉṟu pārāṭṭiyuḷḷāṉ.2 ki.pi. 8ām nūṟṟāṇṭil vāḻnta tirumaṅkiyārvār māmallapuram ciṟanta tuṟimukanakaram eṉpatik kīḻ varum pāṭalil teḷivākak kuṟittuḷḷār:
``pulaṅkoḷnitik kuviyōṭu
	puḻikkimmāk kaḷiṟṟiṉamum
nalaṅkoḷnava maṇikkuviyum
	cumanteṅkam nāṉṟo cintu 
kalaṅkaḷiyaṅ kum mallik
	kaṭaṉmallit talacayaṉam
valaṅkoḷmaṉat tāravari
	vāṅkoḷēṉ maṭaneñcē.3
ivaṟṟi nōkkat toṇṭi nāṭṭil māmallapuramē ciṟanta tuṟimukanakarāy iruntatu eṉpatu teḷivākum. āyiṉ, `immāmallapuramē toṇṭimāṉ tiriyaṉ kālattilum tuṟimukanakarāmāy iruntatā? eṉpatu āyvukkuriyatu.
``nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉpataṉ elliyil tuṟimukap paṭṭiṉam iruntatu, eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi pēcukiṟata. ``nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉpatu yātu? `peyaṟṟu eṉpatu peyal+ṟu eṉṉum iraṇṭāl āṉatu; `peytaliyuṭiyatu eṉpatu itaṟkup poruḷākum. `nīrppeyaṟṟu4 eṉpatu `nīriṉatu peytaliyuṭiyatu eṉap poruḷpaṭum. itu kaṭaṟkarippakuti eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi kūṟukiṟatu. eṉavē, pāṭalil kuṟikkappaṭṭa nīr kaṭal nīrāy iruttal vēṇṭum. kaṭal nīr kaḻi vaḻiyē nilattuṭceṉṟu eppoḻutum kaṭal nīrip peytukoṇṭiruppatāl, ---peytaliyuṭiyatu eṉṉum poruḷil innilappakuti `nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉṟu pulavarāl kuṟikkappaṭṭatu pōlum!
`nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉpatu `kaṭal nīr uṭpeytalik koṇṭatākiya nilam eṉap poruḷpaṭalām; aḵtāvatu, uppaṅkaḻiyiyuṭiya nilappakutiyākum. annilappakutiyāṉa elliyil (kaṭalōrattil) tuṟimukamum paṭṭiṉamum iruntaṉa eṉpatē iṅku koḷḷat takum poruḷākum.1 ittakiya iṭam yātu?
māmallapurattiṟku iraṇṭukal teṟkē kaṭal nīr nilattuḷ nuḻintu māmallapurattiṟkut teṉmēṟkil arikkal tolivu vari paraviyuḷḷatu; māmallapurattiṟku mēṟkil toṭaṅki vaṭakkē mūṉṟu kaltolivil uḷḷa cāḷuvaṉ kuppam variyil maṇal veḷi paraviyuḷḷatu. iṅṅaṉam māmallapurattiṟku vaṭakkilum teṟkilum uḷḷa maṇal veḷiyi ūṭuruvikkoṇṭē iṉṟiya pakkiṅkām kālvāy celkiṟatu. immaṇal veḷikaḷ paṇṭikkālattil kaṭal nīrip peṟṟiruntamiyāṟṟāṉ iṉṟu maṇal veḷikaḷāyuḷḷaṉa. eṉavē, caṅkakālattil kaṭal nīrp peytaliyuṭiya nilamāka ippakutiyiruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu teḷivu. ūrār ippakutiyi iṉṟu `kaḻi veḷi eṉkiṉṟaṉar. ittakiya pakutiyil elliyil tuṟimukamum paṭṭiṉamum iruntaṉa eṉṟu perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. ākavē, avaṉ kuṟittavi piṟkāla māmallapuram irunta pakutiyākum. 
iṅṅaṉamāyiṉ, `nīrppeyaṟṟu nilattiyaṭiya uppaṅkaḻiyit tāṇṭutal vēṇṭum. akkaḻikku muṉṉarē maṟiyavar uṟiyapati iruntiruttal vēṇṭum. ki.pi. ēḻām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ iṭippakutiyil (ki.pi. 630-660) vāḻnta mutalām naracimmavarmaṉ iraṇṭām pulikēciyi veṉṟamiyāl, taṉṉi `makāmallaṉ (māmallaṉ) eṉṟu vaḻaṅkik koṇṭāṉ. avaṉ taṉatu nāṭṭup periya tuṟimuka nakarattit tiruttiyamittu ataṟku `makāmallapuram eṉap peyariṭṭāṉ. atuvē nāḷaṭivil `māmallapuram eṉṟum, `mallapuram eṉṟum, `māmalli eṉṟum `malli eṉṟum maruvi vaḻaṅkalāyiṟṟu. iṅṅaṉam naracimmavarmaṉ `makāmallapuram eṉṟu peyariṭumuṉpu, attuṟimuka nakaram eppeyar peṟṟiruntatu eṉpati iṅkuḷḷa cāṉṟukaḷik koṇṭu aṟiya iyalavilli. perumpāṇaṉ tuṟimukap pakutiyik kūṟi, ataṉi aṭuttirunta pakutiyip `paṭṭiṉam eṉṟu kuṟippiṭṭiruttalik kāṇa, piṟkāla māmallapuram irunta pakuti caṅkakālattil `paṭṭiṉam eṉa vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu eṉṟu karutuvatē poruttamākum.
perumpāṇaṉ, mutaliṟ kaṭaṟkariyil uḷḷa paṭṭiṉam cella vaḻi kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. nilappaṭatti (ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭapaṭatti)k kavaṉittup pārttuc cila uṇmikaḷi iṅku aṟital vēṇṭum. paṭṭiṉattiliruntu vaṭamēṟkil ēṟattāḻa 35 kaltolivil kāñciyuḷḷatu. perumpāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉi mikavum uḷ nāṭṭil cantittiruppiṉ, aṅkirunta kiḻakkut ticiyil (kaṭaṟkarip) paṭṭiṉattiṟkuc ceṉṟu, aṅkirunta vaṭamēṟkil uḷḷa kāñcikkuc cellumpaṭi neṭuntolivu vaḻiyik kūṟiyirāṉ; cantitta iṭattiliruntē vaṭamēṟkilō, teṉmēṟkilō uḷḷa kāñcikkup pōkumpaṭi vaḻi kūṟiyiruppāṉ. avaṉ aṅṅaṉam kūṟāmi, tāṉ putiya pāṇaṉic cantittu vaḻi kūṟat toṭaṅkiya iṭam, kaṭaṟkarikku aṇmiyil iruntiruttal kūṭum eṉpati uṇarttukiṟatu. mēlum, akkālattil aḵtu cemmiyāṉa pātiyāyum iruntirukkalām. kaṭaṟkarikkuc ciṟitu uḷtaḷḷiya variyākap paṭṭiṉattiṟku vaṭamēṟkiliruntum teṉmēṟkiliruntum appaṭṭiṉatti nōkki varalām. inta iraṇṭuḷ oṉṟiyē perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum. avaṉ paṭṭiṉattiṟkuc cellum vaḻi paṟṟik kūṟiya vivaraṅkaḷi ārāyiṉ, avaṉ kūṟiyatu enta vaḻi eṉpatu pulappaṭum. avi muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
perumpāṇaṉ, mutalil umaṇar uppu vaṇṭikaḷiyum taṉimāṭu kaḷiyum ōṭṭicceṉṟa neṭiya vaḻikaḷik kūṟiyuḷḷār; avvaḻikaḷil kaḻutikaḷiṉmītu miḷakup potikaḷi ēṟṟi vāṇikam ceyyum vaṇikariyum, avvaḻikaḷil irunta cuṅkac cāvaṭikaḷiyum kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ; aṭuttu nāṭukāval ceyyum viṟpaṭivīrar ūrkaḷiyum kāṭukaḷiyum kuṟittuḷḷāṉ.
avaṉ kūṟiya iṭattiliruntu paṭṭiṉam nōkkic cellumvaḻi (kūrntu paṭittup pārppiṉ), neytal- pāli-mulli-marutam, mīṇṭum neytal eṉṉum muṟiyil amintuḷḷatikkāṇalām. ammuṟiyiṟcelliṉ, mutal umaṇar uppu vaṇṭikaḷ cellum neṭiyavaḻikaḷik kāṇalām. umaṇaruṭiya uppu vaṇṭikaḷ uppaḷaṅkaḷi liruntē uppi ēṟṟik koṇṭum cellum. eṉavē, perumpāṇaṉ payaṇam toṭaṅkum iṭattiṟku arukil perumpālum uppaḷaṅkaḷ iruntirukkalām. aṅkiruntu uppu vaṇikar uppi vaṇṭikaḷil ēṟṟi uḷnāṭu nōkkic cellutal vaḻakkam.`ulku’ eṉpatu `cuṅkam eṉap poruḷ paṭum. atu kaṭalvaḻiyē iṟakkumatiyākum poruḷkaḷukku vitikkappaṭṭa variyākum. ivvariyi vāṅkum āyattuṟikaḷ kaṭaṟkariyi aṭuttē iruttal vaḻakkam eṉpati aṟiyap perumpāṇaṉ kaṭaṟkarikku aṇittāṉa vaḻiyiyē kūṟiṉāṉ eṉpatē poruttamākum.
attakiya uppaḷaṅkaḷ mēṟkūṟappaṭṭa paṭṭiṉattiṟku vaṭakkil kaṭaṟkarippakutiyil kōvaḷam, kēḷampākkam pakutikaḷil iṉṟuḷḷaṉa. āyiṉ, paṇṭik kālattil iruntamikkuk kalveṭṭukaḷiṟ cāṉṟilli.1 ceyyūr, cūṇāmpēṭu eṉṉum iṭaṅkaḷil uppaḷaṅkaḷ mikutiyākum. ceyyūr, uppaḷaṅkaḷ cōḻar kālattilum, peyar peṟṟavi.2 ivvuppaḷaṅkaḷ caṅka kālattilum iruntirukkalām eṉṟu karututal poruttamākum.
nāṭukāval ceyyum viṟpaṭi vīrar ūrkaḷ vaḻiyil iruntaṉa. avaṟṟiyaṭuttuk kāṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. kāṭukaḷukku appāl pālinilam- pāli nilattil muyal, paṉṟi vāḻum tūṟukaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟukkappāl vēṭṭuvar araṇkaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟik kaṭantu iṭiyar vāḻnta mulli nilappakuti iruntatu. appāl vaḷam mikunta marutanilam iruntatu.
ivvivaraṅkaḷi niṉiviṟkoṇṭu uppaḷaṅkaḷ mikunta ceyyūrukku vaṭakkil iṉṟuḷḷa ūrppeyarkaḷik kāṇpatu nalam payakkum. vēṭṭikkārakkuppam, ceṅkāṭṭūr, pālūr (pāliyūr), toṇṭimāṉ ciṉṉattoṇṭimāṉ nallūr, nallāṟṟūr (marutanallūr, nilam), āyappākkamum avaṟṟiṉ poruḷum kāṇat takkavi. katiravācakaṉ paṭṭiṉam eṉṟa caturaṅkappaṭṭiṉattiṟkum māmallapurattiṟkum iṭiyil mikappala ērikaḷum kuḷaṅkaḷum iruttal kāṇalām. ``kuḷaṅkaḷilum ērikaḷilum pūtta malarkaḷi makkaḷ paṟippārkaḷ. nīṅkaḷ avaṟṟic cūṭic celluṅkaḷ, eṉṟu perumpāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉukkuk kūṟiṉāṉ allaṉō? annīrnilikaḷ iviyāyiruttal kūṭum.
ivaṟṟukkappāl maṟiyavar uṟipati iruntatākap perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. māmallapurattiṟkuc ciṟitu mēṟkil kaḻi veḷikkappāl pūñcēri eṉṉum ciṟṟūr irukkiṟatu. atu mikappaḻiya kālattil pirāmaṇar ūrāy iruntateṉṟu tam muṉṉōr kūṟiyatāka iṉṟu avvūril uḷḷa mutiyavar kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. mutaṟcaṭiyavarmaṉ cuntara pāṇṭiyaṉ kālattil (ki.pi. 1266il) māmallapurattuk kalveṭṭoṉṟu terivikkiṟatu.1 māmallapurattup   perumāḷ kōvil paṭṭarkaḷ ayyaṉaṅkarāc caturvēti maṅkalattil vāḻntaṉar eṉṟu māmallapurattup perumāḷ kōvil paṭṭarkaḷ vāḻnta avvūr māmallapurattiṟku miku aṇmiyil iruntiruttal vēṇṭum. iṉṟu ippeyaruṭaṉ ōr ūrum māmallapurattiṟku aṇmiyil illi. atu kālappōkkil aḻintu pōyirukkalām. iṅṅaṉamē ki.pi. iraṇṭām nūṟṟāṇṭil iruntateṉap perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiya maṟiyavar uṟipatiyum kālappōkkil aḻintirukkalām.
perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷa vaḻipaṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷiyum maturāntakam ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu vaṭṭaṅkaḷiṉ kaṭalōrap pakutiyil uḷḷa ūrkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷiyum avvūrkaḷ paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷiyum ottiṭṭuk kāṇkiyil, perumpāṇaṉ ceyyūrukkut teṟkilō, ciṟitu taḷḷit teṉmēṟ kilō iruntu putiyapāṇaṉukku vaḻi kūṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu uyttuṇarappaṭum.
iṉip perumpāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉi evviṭattilirunta āṟṟuppaṭuttiyiruttal kūṭum eṉpatik kāṇpōm:
kāñci, maturi, koṟki, ārkkāṭu pōṉṟa caṅkakālap peyarkaḷ periya nakaraṅkaḷik kuṟippaṉa ātalālum, caṅkakālattiṟkup piṟpaṭṭa ilakkiyaṅkaḷilum toṭarntu kuṟikkappaṭṭu vantamiyālum iṉṟaḷavum makkaḷ pēccu vaḻakkil māṟāmal irunta varukiṉṟaṉa. āyiṉum, varalāṟṟuc ciṟappup peṟāta cila ūrkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷum pulavar piṟanta ūrkaḷ palavaṟṟiṉ peyarkaḷum pāṭal peṟṟa talaṅkaḷ palavaṟṟiṉ peyarkaḷum iṉṟu māṟi vaḻaṅkukiṉṟaṉa. caṅka kālattiṟkup piṉpu innāṭṭi ayalaracar pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷ āṇṭamiyum ūrkaḷil araciyal-camayac ciṟappukaḷ kālappōkkil kuṟintamiyum potumakkaḷiṉ tavaṟāṉa uccarippumē peyarmāṟṟattiṟkuc ciṟappuṭik kāraṇaṅ kaḷākum. kalveṭṭukaḷilē kāṇappaṭum paṇṭip peyarkaḷ ikkālattil evvevvāṟu māṟutal aṭintuḷḷaṉa eṉpati iṅku aṟivatu nallatu:

nākarkōvil pakutiyil īraveṅkām- īrāṅkyam eṉavum, veḷḷi veṅkāyam - veḷḷāṅkyam eṉavum, patanīr-patani eṉavum pini eṉavum, tiṟavukōl-tuṟaval eṉavum, tūmpumaṭi eṉpatu tūmpāmaṭi eṉavum māṟi vaḻaṅki varutalum iṅku niṉivu kūrtaṟkuriyatu. ivaṟṟikkāṇa, perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭiyip pāṭiya uruttiraṅkakaṇṇaṉāratu ūrp payarum ivvāṟu urukkulintu pōyirukkumō eṉpatu eṇṇa vēṇṭuvatāyuḷḷatu.
ceyyūrukkut teṉmēṟkil ēṟattāḻa āṟarikkal tolivil kaṭukkalūr eṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ oru ciṟṟūr uḷḷatu. caṅkakālak kaṭiyalūr eṉṟa peyar kālappōkkil pala māṟutalkaḷi aṭintu iṉṟu kaṭukkalūr eṉṟu vaḻaṅkukiṟatu eṉṟu koḷḷalām. kaṭiyalūr- `kaṭukalūr allatu `kaṭukkalūr eṉa evvāṟu māṟiyiruttal kūṭum eṉpatu ārāyccikkuriyatu.
1.	(cuṅkam) tavirttaruḷiṉa eṉpatu (cuṅkam) tavuttaruḷiṉa eṉṟu tiripuvaṉa cakkaravartti irācarāca tēvaṉatu tirukkaḷarp paṭṭayattil āḷappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itaṉāl, collil uḷḷa ikaram makkaḷ uccarippāl ukaramātal kūṭum eṉpatu terikiṟatu. ivvāṟē kaṭiyalūr eṉpatu kaṭuyalūr eṉa māṟiyirukkalām.
2. atiyamāṉ eṉṉum peyar kālappōkkil atikamāṉ eṉavum, potiyil mali eṉpatu potiki mali eṉavum māṟi vaḻaṅkuvati nām naṉku aṟivōm. iṅku yakaram kakaramāy māṟiviṭṭatu. ivvāṟē kaṭiyalūr-kaṭukalūr eṉa māṟiyirukkalām.
3. ati-atti, iti-itti, eti-etti eṉa varuvatu pōlavum, putūr-puttūr eṉa varuvatu pōlavum, kaṭukalūr eṉpatu kaṭukkalūr eṉa māṟiyirukkalām. ivaṟṟi nōkka, caṅkakālak kaṭiyalūr iṉṟu kaṭukkalūr eṉṟu māṟiyatil viyappilli.
4. pañcāyattu oṉṟippil amintuḷḷa ciṟṟūrkaḷil paṭṭiyalil intak kaṭukkalūr, kaṭukkāḷūr eṉa acciṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itu pūvalūr eṉpatu pūvāḷūr eṉa māṟi vaḻaṅkappaṭutal pōlak koḷḷat takkatākum. ūrppeyarkaḷ iṅṅaṉam kālappōkkil urumāṟutali mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa palacāṉṟukaḷi nōkki eḷitil uṇaralām.
kaṭukkalūriliruntu vaṭakku nōkkip puṟappaṭum oruvaṉ uppaḷappakuti, kāṭu, pāli vaḻikaḷilē naṭantu ceṉṟutāṉ vaḷam mikunta marunilap pakutiyi aṭital kūṭum eṉpati aṟintukoḷḷalām. caṅkakālattil pālāṟu ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu vaṭṭattiṟ pāyavilli; vaṭavārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭattiliruntu tirumāṟpēṟu, tiruppācūr, tiruvēṟkāṭu, tirumulli vāyil vaḻiyākac ceṉṟu, eṇṇūrukku arukiṟkaṭaliṟkalantu vantatu; ki.pi. 13ām nūṟṟāṇṭilō ataṟkup piṉṉarōtāṉ kāñcikku arukil pāyumāṟu ataṉpōkku māṟṟappaṭṭatu.1 eṉavē, caṅkakālattil pālāṟu ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattiṟ pāyavilli eṉpatu iṅku aṟiyattakum. ataṉāṟṟāṉ atuperum pāṇāṟṟuppaṭiyil kuṟikkappaṭavilli.
anta marunilappakutiyil iṉṟiya pālāṟu kaṭaloṭu kalakkum iṭattiṟku vaṭakkil oru ciṟiya āṟum pala kuḷaṅkaḷum ērikaḷum amintuḷḷaṉa. anta marutanilap pakutiyik kaṭantāl, uppu nīrum maṇalum kalanta pakuti māmallapurattiṟku mēṟkil amintuḷḷami kāṇalām. itu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭatu.
itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa vaḻi ēṟpuṭittāyiṉ, caṅka kālak kaṭiyalūr eṉpatu iṉṟuḷḷa kaṭukkalūlō eṉpatu poruttamāyiṉ, uruttiraṅ kaṇṇaṉār, tamatu ūrākiya kaṭiyalūriliruntē māmallapurattiṟkuc cellum vaḻiyiyum, aṅkiruntu kāñcikkuc cellum vaḻiyiyum tāmē perumpāṇaṉāyiruntu putiya perumpāṇaṉukkuk kūṟiṉār eṉṟu koḷvatu poruttamākum.
uruttiraṅkaṇṇaṉār iḷantiriyaṉiyum karikāla vaḷavaṉiyum pāṭiṉa periyārāvar. karikālaṉ kālam ki.pi. mutal nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ iṟutiyum iraṇṭām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ muṟpakutiyumākum eṉpatu muṉpē viḷakkappaṭṭatu. ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi ki.pi. mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭil pāṭappaṭṭateṉpatum mēlē kūṟappaṭṭatu. ataṉip pāṭiya nattattaṉār ūrāṉa iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭu nallūr, kaṭukkalūrukkut teṉkiḻakkil iraṇṭarik kal tolivil amintuḷḷatu. avar ciṟupāṇaṉukkuk kūṟiya vaḻiyi ārāyiṉ, avaṉit tamatu nallūriliruntē puṟappaṭac coṉṉār eṉpatu teḷivākum.
tamakku ēṟattāḻa oru nūṟṟāṇṭukku muṉpu tamatu ūrukku aṇmiyil vāḻnta kaṭiyalūr uruttiraṅkaṇṇaṉār tammūriliruntē kāñcikku vaḻi kūṟip perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi pāṭiyatu pōlavē nattattaṉār tamatu nallūriliruntē kiṭaṅkilukku vaḻi kūṟic ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭiyip pāṭiṉār eṉpati avar kuṟittuḷḷa vaḻiyi nōkkit teḷivuṟa uṇaralām. intap perumpulavar iruvarum toṇṭi nāṭṭiṉarāvar. ivaruḷ muṉṉavar, toṇṭi nāṭṭut talinakarukku vaḻiyi kūṟiṉār; piṉṉavar toṇṭi nāṭṭi aṭuttirunta ōymāṉāṭṭut talinakarukku vaḻiyik kūṟiṉār.
5. aivaki nilaṅkaḷ
1. kuṟiñci nilam
muṉṉuri
tamiḻccāṉṟōr tamiḻaka nilatti nāṉku vakiyākap pirittu `nāṉilam eṉappeyariṭṭaṉar. avi kuṟiñci, mulli, marutam, neytal eṉappaṭum. kuṟiñci eṉpatu, maliyum mali cārnta iṭamumākum. ippakutiyiṟ kuṟiñci eṉṉum peyar koṇṭa malarkaḷē ciṟappāṉavi. kāṉavar avaṟṟi virumpi aṇintaṉar. ikkāraṇaṅkaḷāl ippakuti kuṟiñci eṉap peyar peṟṟateṉak koḷḷalām. maliyilum mali cārnta iṭattilum kāṭukaḷ iruttalē peruvaḻakku. akil, cantaṉam, ciṟu mūṅkil, peru mūṅkil, palā, curapuṉṉi, vāḻi, mā mutaliya palavaki maraṅkaḷ ceṟinta kāṭukaḷ irukkum. kuraṅkiṉaṅkaḷ, yāṉi, puli, karaṭi, kāṭṭuppaṉṟi, kāṭṭuppacu, variyāṭu mutaliya vilaṅkukaḷ akkāṭukaḷil iruttal iyalpu. mēṟkut toṭarcci mali pōṉṟa periya malikaḷilum avaṟṟiṉ carivukaḷilum miḷakukkoṭi, maraṅkaḷic cuṟṟip paṭarum. periya malikaḷil nīraruvikaḷ kīḻ nōkkip pāyntapaṭiyirukkum. kuṟṟāla nīraruviyē itaṟkēṟṟa cāṉṟākum.
kuṟiñci nilat talivaṉ, ` veṟpaṉ, poruppaṉ, cilampaṉ eṉṉum tiṇippeyar peṟṟāṉ; talivi `koṭicci eṉappaṭṭāḷ. kuṭi makkaḷuḷ āṭavar, `kāṉavar, kuṉṟuvar, vēṭṭuvar eṉappaṭṭaṉar; avar tam peṇṭir, `kuṉṟuvittiyar, vēṭṭuvittiyar, kuṟattiyar eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉar. kuṟiñci nila kaṭavuḷ murukaṉ.
innilattavar toḻil tiṉi mutaliyaṉa payiriṭutal, tēṉ eṭuttal, kiḻaṅku akaḻtal, kiḷōṭṭutal, vēṭṭiyāṭal mutaliyaṉa. ivarkaḷ `murukiyam, toṇṭakappaṟi, kuṟiñci yāḻ eṉṟa icikkaruvikaḷip payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; kuṟiñcippaṇṇip pāṭiṉārkaḷ. kuṟiñci nila vilaṅkukaḷuṭciṟantavi puli, karaṭi, paṉṟi, yāṉi eṉpaṉa: paṟavikaḷuṭ ciṟantavi kiḷiyum mayilumākum. kāntaḷ malarum, vēṅki malarum, cuṉik kuvaḷi malarum iṅkuc ciṟantavi. kuṟiñci nila ūrkaḷ, ` ciṟukuṭi, kuṟiñci eṉap peyarpeṟṟaṉa.
kuṟiñci nilam iyaṟkiyaḻaku vāyntatu; taṉimi nirampiyatu. ātaliṉ kaḷavu oḻukkattiṟku ēṟṟa iṭamāṉa itaṉikkoṇṭu kūṭalum kūṭal nimittamum in nilattukkuriyavi eṉap pulavar pulaṉeṟi vaḻakkam ceytaṉar.
maliyaruviyiṉ māṇpu
tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyip pāṭiya nakkīrar oru periya aruviyip paṟṟik kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār; avar kūṟiyuḷḷa vivaraṅkaḷ paṭittu iṉpuṟattakuvaṉavākum.
``maliyucciyil pala iṭaṅkaḷil tōṉṟum aruvikaḷ kīḻ nōkkip pāykiyil kāṟṟāl alippuṇṇum pala tukiṟkoṭikaḷip pōlak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivvaruvikaḷ ōriṭattil oṉṟu cērntu pēraruviyāy uruveṭuttuk kīḻ nōkkip pēririccal iṭṭukkoṇṭu pāykiṉṟaṉa. appēraruvi taṉ pōkkil ciṟu mūṅkiliṉ vērip piḷakkiṟatu; tēṉīkkaḷ amitta tēṉkūṭukaḷik keṭukkiṟatu; naṉku muṟṟiṉa āciṉip palāppaḻaṅkaḷ veṭittuc citaṟiya cuḷikaḷik koṇṭu celkiṟatu. maliyucciyil uḷḷa curapuṉṉiyiṉ naṟiya malarkaḷ avvaruvi nīril utirkiṉṟaṉa. aruviyiṉ ōṭṭattiyum ōciyiyum kaṇṭum kēṭṭum karukkuraṅkukaḷuṭaṉ kariya mukattiyuṭiya mucukkalikaḷ naṭuṅkukiṉṟaṉa. aruvi nīr, pukariyaṇinta mattakattiyuṭiya periya peṇ yāṉi kuḷiraṭiyumpaṭi vīcukiṟatu; taṉ pōkkil akappaṭṭa yāṉikkompukaḷit taṉṉuḷ aṭakki, poṉṉum maṇiyum niṟam viḷaṅkumpaṭi mēlē koṇṭu kutittu, tattutaliyuṟṟup poṭiyāṉa poṉṉit teḷḷukiṟatu; vāḻiyiṉ periya mutal tuṇiyumpaṭiyum tēṅkiṉ iḷanīrkkuli utirumpaṭiyum avviraṇṭaṉiyum mōtukiṟatu; miḷakukkoṭiyiṉ kariya kottukaḷic cāyvikkiṟatu; mayilkaḷ, kōḻikaḷ mutaliya paṟavikaḷi veruvi ōṭacceykiṟatu; āṇ paṉṟiyiyum karaṭiyiyum malikkukikaḷil patuṅkum paṭi ceykiṟatu; kariya kompukaḷiyuṭiya kāṭṭup pacukkaḷiṉ erutukaḷi muḻakkamiṭac ceykiṟatu. iṅṅaṉam pēraruvi pāykiṉṟa periya maliyil paḻam muṟṟiṉa cōli pala irukkiṉṟaṉa. (aṭi, 295-317).


iṉikkum cuṉi nīr
kuṟiñci nilam kaṟpāṟikaḷ mikunta iṭamātaliṉ, paḻutta miḷaku appāṟikaḷiṉmītu cintikkiṭattal iyalpu; nīṇṭa periya cuṉikaḷil māmpaḻaṅkaḷ mutaliya paḻaṅkaḷ utirntu kiṭattal iyalpu. iṅṅaṉamē cuṉiyiṉ arukil uḷḷa palā marattu muṟṟiya paḻam veṭittu veḷippaṭum cuḷikaḷ cuṉi nīril viḻutalum iyalpu. ippaḻaṅkaḷil uḷḷa tēṉ, cuṉinīril kalakkum. tēṉ kalanta cuṉinīri mayil parukum; parukavē, mayakka muṇṭākit taḷḷāṭum (ku.pā. aṭi, 186-194).
ciṟukuṭi
malimītu vaḷarum maram, ceṭi, koṭikaḷiliruntu utirum maṇamikka malarkaḷāl maliccāral, maṇam ceyta maṉipōla maṇattal iyalpu. accāralil malivāṇar kuṭiyiruppu amintirukkum. atu `ciṟukuṭi eṉappaṭum. aḵtāvatu, cila vīṭukaḷik koṇṭa kuṭiyiruppu eṉpatu poruḷ. aṅku vāḻum kāṉavar, kāvaṭiyit tōḷiṟ(   ) kāvumaram tammiṟ porutu paṭṭa yāṉiyiṉ kompukaḷālāṉatu. ataṉ iru muṉikaḷilum uṟikaḷ uṇṭu. avarkaḷ anta uṟikaḷil pala paṭṭikaḷi (kaṭakaṅkaḷi) vittuḷḷārkaḷ; avaṟṟil malittēṉiyum, kiḻaṅkukaḷiyum, paṉṉi iṟicci mutaliya palavaki iṟiccikaḷiyum koṇṭu varukiṉṟārkaḷ. acciṟukuṭi vaḷaviya pala putuvaruvāyiṉiyuṭiyatu. iṅṅaṉam maliccāralil ciṟukuṭi amintiruttalpōlavē, maliyil pala uyaraṅkaḷil cīṟūrkaḷ palaamintirukkum (malipaṭu. aṭi, 151-162).
mali nāṭṭil antikkāṭcikaḷ
katiravaṉ mēṟṟiciyil maṟikiṟāṉ. māṉkaḷ marattaṭiyil tiraḷkiṉṟaṉa; pacukkaḷ kaṉṟukaḷi aḻittapaṭi maṉṟukaḷil nuḻikiṉṟaṉa; ūtukiṉṟa kompu pōṉṟa ōciyiyuṭiyatum vaḷinta vāyip peṟṟatumākiya aṉṟil, paṉiyiṉ uḷ maṭaliliruntu taṉ peṭiyi aḻikkiṉṟatu; pāmpu tāṉ mēytaṟ poruṭṭut taṉ māṇikkatti veḷiyē umiḻkiṉṟatu; kōvalar pala iṭaṅkaḷilum niṉṟu āmpaṟkuḻaliṟpaṇ icikkiṉṟaṉar; āmpaliṉ aḻakiya itaḻkaḷ muṟukku aviḻkiṉṟaṉa; pārppār antikkālattuc ceyyun toḻilkaḷi nikaḻttukiṉṟaṉar; celvamaṉikaḷil polivu peṟṟa toṭiyaṇinta makaḷir viḷakki ēṟṟi antikkālattut toḻili nikaḻttukiṉṟaṉar; kāṭṭil vāḻkiṉṟavar viṇṇit toṭum paraṇiṉ mītu tīkkaṭi kōlālē neruppip piṟappittu erikkiṉṟaṉar. mēkaṅkaḷ periya maliyiṭattic cūḻntu kaṟukkiṉṟaṉa; kāṭṭil uḷḷa vilaṅkukaḷ `kalleṉṉum ōci uṭiyaṉavāy oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu māṟi olikkiṉṟaṉa; paṟavikaḷ kūṭukaḷiliruntu āravārikkiṉṟaṉa (ku.pā.aṭi, 215-228)
iravil
mali nāṭṭil iravu nēraṅkaḷil (pakaliṟkukikaḷil patuṅkiyirunta) pulikaḷ iri tēṭi naṭamāṭum; yāḷikaḷ, karaṭikaḷ, kāṭṭu erutu, kaḷiṟu, malippāmpukaḷ mutaliya pala vakip pāmpukaḷ iriyit tēṭiyaliyum; āḻamāṉa nīr nilikaḷil vāḻum mutaliyum karāmum iṭaṅkarum nīrkkariyil varum; vaḻi paṟippavar, vaḻikaḷil kolik karuvikaḷuṭaṉ maṟintiruppar; āṅkāṅku vaḻukkunilam amintirukkum; vaḻi velvatu pōlat tōṉṟit tiṭīreṉa muṭivaṭiyum iṭaṅkaḷ cila pakutikaḷil amintirukkam. ātalāl, mali nāṭṭil iravu nēraṅkaḷil vaḻinaṭattal ētum taruvatākum (ku.pā. aṭi, 251-259).
kāṉavar uḻippu
kāṉavar, tōri nel mutaliyavaṟṟip payiriṭa nilamillāta pōtu naṟiya akil maraṅkaḷiyum cantaṉa maraṅkaḷiyum veṭṭi avi irunta nilattip patappaṭutti viḷinilamākkuvar; tōri nel, veṇciṟu kaṭuku, aivaṉa nel, veṇṇey, iñci, mañcaḷ, miḷaku ivaṟṟip payirākkuvar; tiṉippuṉaṅkaḷik kāval kāppar; avariyip payiriṭavar (ma. kā. aṭi, 286-293). kāṉavar yāṉiyālō puliyālō tākkappaṭāta periya marakkiḷikaḷi ṉiṭiyil paraṇi amippar; apparaṇil iruntukoṇṭu payirkaḷit tiṉṉa varum kiḷi, karaṭi, yāṉi, kāṭṭup paṉṟi mutaliyavaṟṟik kavaṇkal eṟintum, paṟiyaṭittu ōciyuṇṭākkiyum, erikoḷḷiyik kāṭṭiyum viraṭṭuvar; kiyāṟcuṟṟiṉa kālattut taṉṉiṭattup piṟakkum ōciyāl kiḷi mutaliya vaṟṟi ōṭṭuṅkaruvi `taḻal eṉappaṭum. ataṉik `kavaṇ eṉpārum uḷar. mūṅkilik kaṇṇukkuk kaṇ uḷḷāka naṟukkip palavākap piḷantu ōciyuṇṭāka oṉṟilē taṭṭuvatōr karuvi `taṭṭi eṉappaṭum. ivi pōṉṟa kiḷi kaṭi karuvi piṟitoṉṟu, kuḷir eṉappaṭum. kāṉavar ivaṟṟiṉ utaviyāl paṟavikaḷiyum piṟa vilaṅkukaḷiyum viraṭṭuvar. malivāṇar makaḷirē perumpālum pakaṟkālattil tiṉip puṉaṅkaḷik kāval kāppar (ku. pā. aṭi, 35-44).
kāṭṭuppaṉṟi payirkaḷi aḻippatil vallatu. ataṉāl, kāṉavar ataṉip piṭikkak kuḻikaḷit tōṇṭuvar; avaṟṟit taḻikaḷāl mūṭuvar. kuḻikaḷi aṟiyātu naṭakkum paṉṟi oru kuḻiyil viḻum. uṭaṉē kāṉavar ataṉit tākkik kolvar (ma. kā. aṭi, 294-295). muṟṟiṉa tiṉippuṉattip paṉṟi koḷḷi koḷvatu iyalpu. ātalāl, kāṉavar atu varum vaḻikaḷiṟ kaṟpoṟikaḷip porutti, ataṉ varukiyit taṭuppar. (malipaṭu. aṭi, 193-5). yāṉi tiṉippayirit tiṉṉum. ataṉāl kāṉavar villil nāṇ ēṟṟi ampi yāṉi mītu eyvar; kāṭellām `kal leṉṉum ōci uṇṭākumpaṭi vāyi maṭittu viṭukiṉṟa cīḻkkiyāl mikka ōciyi uṇṭākki, akkaḷiṟṟit tiṉippuṉittiṉiṉṟum ōṭṭuvar (ku.pā. aṭi, 156-161).
iṅṅaṉam kāṉavarāl viraṭṭappaṭṭa yāṉi ciṉam viḷaṅkuvataṟkuk kāraṇamākiya matattālē maṉam cerukkik kār kāla iṭiyip pōla muḻakkatti uṇṭākkit taṉ tutikkiyic curuṭṭi nilattē eṟintu kūṟṟuvaṉip pōlak kaṭukip pāyntōṭum; vaḻiyiṟkāṇpaṉavaṟṟi aḻikkum (ku. pā. aṭi, 161-166): kāṉavar paṉṟikaḷip piṭikkak kuḻi tōṇṭuvatu pōlavē periya paḷḷaṅkaḷit tōṇṭi yāṉiyip piṭippatu vaḻakkam (pa. pāli, aṭi, 221-4)
mali nāṭṭil kāṉavar uḻippiṉāl eḷ, tiṉi, avari, varaku, mūṅkil nel, veṇciṟukaṭuku, iñci, mañcaḷ, vāḻi, kūvikkiḻaṅku, vaḷḷikkiḻaṅku, āciṉippalā, aivaṉanel, veṇṇil  mutaliyaṉa vaḷamuṟap payirāyiṉa (malipaṭu. aṭi, 102-117). naṉṉaṉatu mali ucciyil akilum cantaṉa maraṅkaḷum vaḷarntaṉa; poṉ, maṇi mutaliyaṉavum kiṭittaṉa (kṣa, aṭi, 170,  uri).
kāṉavar kaṇṇēṇi cārttit tēṉ eṭuppar. `kaṇṇēṇi eṉpatu kaṇukkaḷil aṭi vittu ēṟic cellumpaṭi amintuḷḷa mūṅkil. maliyucciyil ōṅki vaḷarnta marattiṉucciyil uḷḷa tēṉiṟāli aḻikkumporuṭṭuc ceṅkuttāṉamaliyil ēṟuvataṟku ataṉ ayalil ivviru mūṅkilkaḷik kūṭṭi niṟuttiyamippatu vaḻakkam (malipaṭu. aṭi, 315-7, uriyum aṭikkuṟippum).
pulavar, pāṇar, kūttar, pōṉṟa kalvimāṉkaḷ, malippayaṇattil vaḻi teriyātu tikippuṟṟa poḻutu malivāṇarum mali kāvalarum avarkaṭku uṇavaḷittu upacarittu vaḻi kāṭṭutal vaḻakkam (malipaṭu. 425-7).
muṉpu vaḻiyaṟiyātu oru vaḻiyiṟceṉṟu mīṇṭavar, putiyavar tammip pōlac ceṉṟu iṭar uṟātapaṭi cantiyik kiyāl tuṭittu aṭiyāḷamāka ūkam pulli muṭintu vippar (malipaṭu. aṭi, 392-3).
makaḷir ceyalkaḷ
ilvāḻkkiyil īṭupaṭṭa makaḷir tam kaṇavarkkut tuṇiyāyp payirttoḻilil īṭupaṭṭaṉar; illaṟap paṇikaḷil īṭupaṭṭaṉar. maṇamākāta makaḷir tiṉip puṉattiyum piṟa payil nilaṅkaḷiyum kāval kāttaṉar; ōyvu nēraṅkaḷil veḷḷiya tukili okkum aḻakiya aruviyil nīrāṭiṉar; ceṟivuṇṭāṉa maliyil paḷiṅkic corinta vittāṟpōṉṟa paranta cuṉiyiṟ kuṭintu viḷiyāṭiṉar; poṉṉil aḻuttiṉa nīlamaṇi pōlattam mutukil tāḻntu kiṭanta piṉṉutal aminta kariya kūntalil irunta nīrip piḻintaṉar; īrattip pularttiṉar. cuṉiyil nīrāṉamiyiṉ avartam kaṇkaḷ civantaṉa.
ammakaḷir tamkūntali aivakiyāka oppaṉi ceytu koṇṭaṉar. avi (1) kuḻal (2) aḷakam, (3) koṇṭi, (4) paṉicci, (5) tuñci eṉpavi. orutti ceytukoḷḷum ivvimpāl oppaṉi aḻaki avaḷ kātalaṉ pukaḻtal uṇṭu. (ku.pā. aṭi, 138-9, uriyum aṭikkuṟippum ) vāḻippū vaṭivil muṭikkappaṭṭa kūntal, `paṉicci eṉappeyar peṟṟatu (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 21-2). ivvakik kūntal oppaṉi koṇṭum caṅkakālat tamiḻar nākarikatti naṉku uṇaralām.
piṉpu ammakaḷir ceṅkāntaḷ mutaliya toṇṇūṟṟukku mēṟpaṭṭa malināṭṭu malarkaḷip paṟittaṉar; paciya maṇamuḷḷa maḻikaḷip paṟittaṉar;1 avaṟṟi, maḻi peytu tūymiyākkappaṭṭa akaṉṟa pāṟiyiṟ kuvittaṉar; malarkaḷiṉ puṟavitarkaḷi nīkkiviṭṭu iṭiyil uṭukkattakum taḻiyuṭikaḷic ceytu koṇṭaṉar; pala vēṟu niṟaṅkaḷiyuṭiya mālikaḷit toṭuttut tamatu melliya kariya kūntalil aḻaku peṟac cuṟṟikkoṇṭaṉar (ku. pā. aṭi, 54-104).
naṉṉaṉuṭiya malikaḷiṉ uccikaḷil vāḻntirutta kāṉavar, naṟavi aruntit tam makaḷiroṭu māṉtōl pōrtta ciṟupaṟi olikkak kuravik kūttu nikaḻttiṉar. tiṉiyik kuṟṟiya makaḷir, tiṉiyik kuṟṟik koṇṭē vaḷḷippāṭṭip pāṭiṉar (malipaṭu. aṭi, 320-22; 342).
talivaṉ, kaḷavuppuṇarcci nikaḻum poḻutu, taliviyi maṇam ceytukoṇṭu vāḻvatākavum avaḷip piriyātiruppatākavum teyvaṅkaḷiṉmītu cūḷ ceytu aruvi nīrip parukuvāṉ (ka. pā. aṭi, 208-211); piṉṉar avaḷip palar aṟiya maṇappāṉ. atu `nāṭaṟi naṉmaṇam eṉappaṭṭatu. (ku. pā. aṭi, 231-234). malivāṇar, tam maliccāralkaḷil teyvaṅkaḷ vāḻntaṉa eṉṟu nampiṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 493-4).
pala vaki olikaḷ
naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭup pakutiyil pakaṟpoḻutil pala vaki olikaḷ eḻuntapaṭi iruntaṉa. avaṟṟuḷ,
1. taṉ iṉattip pirinta āṇ yāṉiyik kāṉavar piṭikka muyaṉṟa pōtu uṇṭāṉa āravāram oṉṟu;
2.	 ampu eyyappaṭṭa paṉṟiyāl kollappaṭṭa kāṉavarkkāka maṟṟavar aḻum ōci oṉṟu;
3. tam kaṇavar mārpil puli pāyntu uṇṭākkiya puṇṇi āṟṟuvataṟkākak koṭicciyar pāṭiya pāṭalōci oṉṟu;
