4. mutal nāḷilē pūtta poṉpōlum kottiṉi yuṭiya vēṅki malarkaḷip paṟittaṟku makaḷir `puli-puli eṉṟu kūviya ōci oṉṟu;
5. puli kaḷiṟṟiṉ mītu pāyntatik kaṇṭu ataṉ piṭi ceyta iṭiyōci pōṉṟa piḷiṟal oṉṟu;
6. taṉ kuṭṭi eṭuttaṟkariya āḻnta muḻiyil tavaṟi vīḻntu iṟantatik kaṇṭu manti alaṟiya ōci oṉṟu;
7. kāṉavar ēṟaviyalāta uyarattil kaṇṇēṉiyiṉ utaviyāl ēṟit tēṉīkkaḷi viraṭṭit tēṉ eṭutta pōtu uṇṭāṉa āravāram oṉṟu; 
8. naṉṉaṉuṭiya vīrar avaṉuṭiya pakivar kuṟumpukaḷi aḻittapōtu uṇṭāṉa makiḻcci āravāram oṉṟu;
9. naṟavi nāṭkāliyiṟkuṭitta kāṉavar tam peṇṭiruṭaṉ kūṭic ciṟupaṟi ōcikkēṟpak kuravik kūttāṭiya āravāram oṉṟu;
10. kāṭṭāṟṟu neṭiya cuḻiyil akappaṭṭa kaḷiṟṟiṉatu valiya ciṉattit taṇivittup periya kampattil piṇippataṟkut tamatu ēval toḻilic ceytaṟkuk kāraṇamāṉa pēccukaḷip pēci avaṟṟil payilappaṇṇum pākaratu āravāram oṉṟu;
11. olikkum mūṅkilāṟceyta taṭṭiyip puṭittup puṉantōṟum kiḷikaḷi ōṭṭum makaḷir ceyta āravāram oṉṟu;
12. kāṭṭu erutum pōril valla kali māṉum pōriṭuvatik kaṇṭavar ceyta āravāram oṉṟu;
13. erumikkaṭākkaḷ tammuṭporutalāl uṇṭāṉa āravāram oṉṟu;
14. palākkoṭṭikaḷiṉmītu kaṉṟukaḷip piṇittuk kāntaḷiṉatu tuṭuppup pōṉṟa maṭalāl aṭittuk kaṭā viṭṭup piḷḷikaḷ ceyta āravāram oṉṟu;
15. karumpāliyiṉ ōci oṉṟu;
16. tiṉiyik kuṟṟikkoṇṭē makaḷir pāṭiya vaḷḷippāṭṭu oli oṉṟu;
17. paṉṟi cēmpiṉ kiḻaṅkiyum mañcaṭkiḻaṅkiyum akaḻātirukkak kāṉavar ati viraṭṭak koṭṭiya paṟi ōci oṉṟu;
18. aruvikaḷil teyva makaḷir kuṭintāṭukiyil uṇṭāṉa ōci oṉṟu;
19. inta ōcikaḷāl maliyiṭatteḻunta etiroli oṉṟu. ivvolikaḷ aṉittiyum maṉattāl niṉittup pārppiṉ, malināṭṭup pakaṟkāṭcikaḷ ciṟanta ōviyaṅkaḷāy nam akakkaṇ muṉ kāṭciyaḷittu iṉpuṟuttum (malipaṭu. aṭi, 294-344).
kuṟiñcinilattukkuriya teyvam murukaṉ. kāṉavar apperumāṉi vaḻipaṭṭa muṟimi paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷ `camayam eṉṉun talippiṉkīḻ virivākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avartam uṇavup poruḷkaḷum viruntiṉarip pēṇiya muṟiyuṭ `uṇavu eṉṉuṟ talippiṉ kīḻ urikkappaṭṭuḷa.
naṉṉaṉukku vaḻaṅkappaṭṭa kuṟiñcinilap poruḷkaḷ
āmāṉiṉ kuḻavi, iḷiya yāṉikkaṉṟu, vāy tiṟavāta karaṭikkuṭṭi, maliyāṭṭukkiṭāy, kīrippiḷḷi, mariyāṉiṉ kuḻavi, āṇ uṭumpu, tōki mayil, kāṭṭukkōḻiyiṉ cēval, muḻavip pōṉṟa periya palāppaḻam, cāṟu muṟṟiṉa iṉiya māmpaḻaṅkaḷ, maṇakkum naṟikkoṭi, nūṟikkiḻaṅku, marattiliruntu citaṟiyutirnta paḷiṅku pōṉṟa karuppūram, vili matippuṭiya māṇikkakkaṟkaḷ, yāṉik kompukaḷ, kāntaḷ malarkaḷ, puṉṉip pūkkaḷ, tilakappūkkaḷ, cantaṉak kaṭṭikaḷ, miḷaku, mūṅkiṟkuḻiyil muṟṟaviṭṭa kaḷḷiṉ teḷivu, mūṅkiṟkuḻiyilē tōytta tayir, tēṉiṟālkaḷ, āciṉippalā ākiyavi naṉṉaṉuṭiya araṇmaṉi muṟṟattil malivāṇarāl koṇṭuvantu vikkappaṭṭaṉa (malipaṭu. aṭi, 498-529).
cēraṉ ceṅkuṭṭuvaṉ mali vaḷam kāṇac ceṉṟa pōtu malivāṇar avaṉukku etiril koṇṭuvantu vitta kāṇikkipporuḷkaḷōṭu (cilappatikāram, kāti 25; aṭi, 37-55) ivaṟṟi oppunōkki makiḻalām.
2. mulli nilam
muṉṉuri
kāṭum kāṭu cārnta iṭamum `mulli eṉappaṭum. iṅkukkāṭu eṉpatu kuṟiñci nilakkāṭu pōṉṟa marac ceṟivuṭiya kāṭaṉṟu; `iḷaṅkāṭu eṉṟu collat takum muṟiyil aminta nilappakutiyākum; iṅku āṭumāṭukaḷiṉ mēyccalukkuriya pul veḷikaḷ niṟintiruntaṉa; koṉṟi, kāyā, kuruntam mutaliya maraṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. malliki, mulli, piṭavu, taḷavam mutaliya ceṭi koṭikaḷ iruntaṉa. ivaṟṟuḷ mulliyē ciṟantu kāṇappaṭṭatu. iṅku vāḻnta āyarum āycciyarum mulli malarkaḷi mikavirumpic cūṭikkoṇṭaṉar. ātaliṉ, innilam `mulli eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. taṉṉip pirinta talivaṉ taṉṉiṭam varum variyil āṟṟiyirukkum taliviyiṉ oḻukkatti `mulli eṉṟu akapporuḷ ilakkaṇam kūṟukiṟatu.
mulli nilattalivaṉ aṇṇal, tōṉṟal, kuṟumpoṟi nāṭaṉ eṉap peyar peṟṟāṉ. talivi, maṉivi, kiḻatti eṉap peyar peṟṟāḷ. kuṭi makkaḷuḷ āṭavar āyar, kōvalar, iṭiyar, potuvar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avartam peṇṭir āycciyar, kōvicciyar, iṭicciyar, potuvicciyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avarkaḷ toḻil, āṭumāṭukaḷi mēyttalum, varaku cāmi mutaliyavaṟṟip payiriṭutalumākum. avarkaḷ ēṟukōṭpaṟiyi muḻakkiṉārkaḷ; mulli yāḻ icittārkaḷ; pullāṅkuḻal, āmpaṟ kuḻalkaḷi vācittārkaḷ. uḻi, pulvāy, muyal mutaliya vilaṅkukaḷ annilattukkuriyavi. kāṉakkōḻi, cival eṉṉum paṟavikaḷ aṅkuc ciṟappāṉavi.
pattuppāṭṭuḷ ovvoru nāṭṭu mulli nilattu vivaraṅkaḷum ovvoru pāṭṭil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟi muṟippaṭi iṅkuk kāṇalām.
ōymāṉāṭṭu mulli nilam
putiya arumpukaḷiyuṭiya avarik koṭikaḷ pavaḻam pōṉṟa pūkkaḷip pūttaṉa; kariya arumpiṉiyuṭiya kāyākkaḷ tiraṇṭa mayiliṉ kaḻuttup pōṉṟa pūkkaḷip pūttaṉa; mucuṭṭikkoṭi koṭṭam pōṉṟa pūkkaḷuṭaṉ viḷaṅkiyatu; vaḷaviya ,kuliyiṉiyuṭiya kāntaḷkaḷ, kiviralkaḷip pōlap pūttaṉa; kolliyiṭattu neṭiya vaḻikaḷil intira kōpam eṉṉum pūccikaḷ ūrntaṉa. ivi, kār kālatti uṇarttiṉa. mullikkoṭikaḷ mullippūkkaḷ malarvatāl pēraḻakuṭaṉ viḷaṅkiṉa (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 164-9). itu nāṭukaḷ eṉṉum pakutiyilum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
toṇṭi nāṭṭu mulli nilam
āyar kurampi: varakukkaṟṟi mutaliyavaṟṟāl vēyappeṟṟa kuṭici, kurampi eṉappaṭṭatu. ak kurampiyiṉ uḷ nuḻiyac ciṟiya vāyil iruntatu. avvāyilil kaḻikaḷāṟkaṭṭappaṭṭa katavu iruntatu. kuṭiciyiṉ kūriyit tāṅki niṉṟavi kuṟiya kālkaḷ. akkālkaḷil āṭṭu maṟikaḷ niṉṟu tiṉṉattakkapaṭi taḻikaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. āṭṭukkiṭāyiṉ tōlkaḷip pāyalākakkoṇṭu akkurampikkuk kāvalaṉāṉa vīṭṭu mutiyavaṉ paṭuttiruntāṉ. kurampikku etiril muṟṟam iruntatu. atil tāmpukaḷ kaṭṭiṉa kuṟiyamuḷikaḷ iruntaṉa. ammuḷikaḷil āṭumāṭukaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. ittakiya cila kurampikaḷiyuṭiyatē mulli nilac ciṟṟūrākum. acciṟṟūril vaḷinta mukattiṉiyuṭiya cemmaṟiyāṭu kaḷuṭaṉē veḷḷāṭukaḷum taṅki vāḻntaṉa. acciṟṟūr kaṭṭumuḷḷālākiya vēliyiṉiyuṭiyatu.
āyar makaḷ
āyar makaḷ vikaṟiyil eḻuntu, tayirik kaṭintu, veṇṇiy eṭuttāḷ; pūkkaḷāṟ ceyta cumaṭṭit1 taliyilē vittāḷ; ataṉmītu mōrppāṉiyi vittukkoṇṭu kuṟiñci nilam ceṉṟu, mōri viṟṟāḷ. avaḷ māmi niṟattiṉaḷ; mūṅkil pōṉṟa tōḷkaḷi yuṭiyavaḷ; karumaṇal pōṉṟa kūntaliyuṭiyavaḷ; tāḷuruvi eṉṉum naki aciyum kātiṉaḷ. avaḷ mōr viṟṟa mutalikkoṇṭu taṉ kuṭumpattukku vēṇṭiya nel mutaliyavaṟṟi vāṅkik koṇṭāḷ; ney viṟṟa vilikkup pālerumiyiyum nalla pacuviyum kariya erumi nākiṉiyum vāṅkiṉāḷ; avaṟṟōṭu taṉ maṉikku mīṇṭāḷ. avaḷum avaḷic cērntavarum tiṉiccōṟum pālum uṇṭaṉar.
āyaṉ
āyaṉ ceruppu viṭāmaṟkiṭanta vaṭuvaḻuntiṉa valiya aṭiyiṉiyuṭiyavaṉ; pacukkaḷi ōṭṭum taṭiyik kiyiṟ piṭittavaṉ; maraṅkaḷi veṭṭum kōṭari piṭittamiyāl, taḻumpu aminta valiya kiyiṉaṉ. avaṉ iraṇṭu talikaḷilum uṟiyiṉiyuṭiya kākkaḷ mēlē iruntamiyāl uṇṭāṉa taḻumpiṉit tōḷkaḷil uṭiyavaṉ; pacukkaṟanta pāṟkiyit taṭaviṉa tali mayiriyuṭiyavaṉ; maraṅkaḷiliruntum koṭikaḷiliruntum paṟitta malarkaḷi māliyāka uṭiyavaṉ; oṟṟiyāṭiyi uṭiyavaṉ; pāṟcōṟṟi uṇpavaṉ. avaṉ kaṉṟukaḷiyum pacukkaḷiyum kāṭṭil mēyaviṭṭāṉ; takka patattil veṭṭi oḻuṅka ceyyappaṭṭa mūṅkiṟkaḻiyil tīkkaṭi kōliṉ utavi koṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa tuḷiyil vāyi vittup pala vaki iṉiya ōcikaḷi eḻuppiṉāṉ; pālip paṇṇi vācittāṉ; piṉpu kumiḻiṉatu uṭpoyyākiya kompiṭattē vaḷittuk kaṭṭiṉa viralāl teṟittu vācikkum maraṟkayiṟākiya narampiṉiyuṭiya vil yāḻil kuṟiñcip paṇṇi vācittāṉ.
mulli nilac cīṟūrkaḷ
mulli nilattil payiriṭṭu vāḻnta kuṭimakkaḷ irunta cīṟūr cilavē. avarkaḷatu vīṭṭu muṟṟattil piṭikaḷ niṉṟālpōla varakiṉik koṇṭa kutirkaḷ niṉṟaṉa; vīṭṭup pantaril yāṉiyiṉ kāli otta varaku tiriki naṭap paṭṭiruntatu. vīṭṭiyaṭutta koṭṭilil kuṟiya vaṇṭi uruḷikaḷum kalappikaḷum cuvaril cārtti vikkappaṭ ṭiruntaṉa. vīṭu varaku vikkōlāl vēyappaṭṭiruntatu.
iccīṟūr makkaḷ uḻavut toḻiliṟpayiṉṟa periya erutukaḷik kalappiyil cērttu, uṭumpiṉ mukatti otta peruṅkoḻu nilattil maṟiya aḻutti, muṟpaṭi vaḷiya uḻutaṉar; piṉpu vitittaṉar; kaḷi eṭuttaṉar; payir viḷintatum aṟuvaṭi ceytaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 147-205).
mullippāṭṭil mulli nilam
kār kālattil nuṇmaṇaṟpāṅkāṉa nilattil irunta neruṅkiṉa ilikaḷiyuṭiya kāyā añcaṉam pōla malarntaṉa; taḷiriyum kottiṉiyumuṭiya koṉṟi, naṉṟākiya poṉṉic (poṉṉiṟap pūkkaḷi) corintaṉa. kōṭal marattiṉ kuvinta mukikaḷ akaṅki pōla virintaṉa; tiraṭci niṟinta tōṉṟi kurutipōlap pūttaṉa; kāṭu taḻitta civanta nilattup peruvaḻiyil muṉpaṉi toṭaṅkum tiṅkaḷil pōtiya maḻiyip peṟṟa varaku katirīṉṟatu. annilattil muṟukkuṇṭa kompiṉiyuṭiya kali māṉum ataṉ peṇ māṉam tuḷḷi viḷiyāṭiṉa. ( mu.pā. aṭi, 92-100).
pāṇṭi nāṭṭu mulli nilam
pāṇṭi nāṭṭu mulli nilattil ciṟiya tiṉi aṟuvaṭi ceyyappaṭṭatu; eḷḷiḷaṅkāy muṟṟiyatu; kariya tāḷiyuṭiya varakiṉatu karitākiya katir muṟṟiyatu; āḻnta kuḻikaḷil viliyuyarnta maṇikaḷ kiṭantu viḷaṅkiṉa; oḷiyiṉiyuṭiya pūkkaḷip peṟṟa koṉṟi maraniḻalil irunta pāṟimītu mucuṇṭi malarkaḷum mulli malarkaḷum utirntu kiṭantaṉa. teḷinta nīriyuṭiya paḷḷaṅkaḷil nīlamaṇi eṉṟu maruḷum neytal toyyiṟkoṭiyōṭē māṟupaṭa malarntaṉa (ma.kā. aṭi, 271-285). ic ceyti `nāṭukaḷ eṉṉum pakutiyilum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
kār kālattil mulli nilattil paruvamaḻi naṉku peytatu. veḷḷam kāl naṭikaḷiṉ mēyccalukku iṭiyūṟātaliṉ, vaḷinta kōliṉiyuṭiya kōvalar veḷḷatti veṟuttaṉar; tam kāl naṭikaḷi mēṭṭu nilattil mēyaviṭṭaṉar; kāntaḷiṉ nīṇṭa itaḻkaḷālāṉa tam kaṇṇiyil nīralittālē kalakkam eytiṉar; kuḷirāl naṭuṅkiṉar; avartam paṟkaḷ paṟi koṭṭiṉa. avarkaḷ kikaḷi neruppiṟkāṭṭic cūṭu uṇṭākkik koṇṭārkaḷ; akkikaḷit taṅkaḷ kavuḷil vittu amiti peṟṟārkaḷ.
maḻiyālum veḷḷapperukkiṉālum kāl naṭikaḷ mēytal toḻili maṟantaṉa; kuraṅkukaḷ kuḷirāl naṭuṅkiṉa; kāṟṟu mikutiyāl maraṅkaḷil taṅkiyirunta paṟavikaḷ nilattil vīḻntaṉa; pacukkaḷ kuḷiriṉ mikutiyāl pāl arunta vanta taṅkaḷ kaṉṟukaḷi utittaṉa; mucuṭṭi veḷḷip pūkkaḷiyum pīrkkup poṉṟip pūkkaḷiyum pūttaṉa; maḻinīr virintu pāykiyil kayalkaḷ ataṉpōkkiṉi etirttu nīntiṉa. appoḻutu avaṟṟip piṭikkak kokkukaḷum nārikaḷum kāttiruntaṉa (neṭunal. aṭi, 1-20).
naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭu mulli nilam
mulli nilam mulli mutaliya maṇamikka malarkaḷiyuṭiya koṭikaḷ mikuntatu. villiṉ ōcikku veruvic civanta kaṇṇiyuṭiya mariyēṟu, kuṟiñci nilatti aṭuttuḷḷa mullinilak kuṟuṅkāṭṭil virintōṭum. pacukkaḷ vēṟṟup pulaṅkaḷil ceṉṟu mēyntu varum. kōvalar avaṟṟiṉ pālikkaṟantu vaḷiyalkaḷi aṇinta tam makaḷir maṉam makiḻumpaṭi koṇṭu varuvar. mulli nilakkāṭukaḷil cemmaṟi āṭukaḷum veḷḷāṭukaḷum kalantu `kalleṉṉum ōciyuṭaṉ taṅkiyirukkum. aṅkuḷḷa mullinila makkaḷ pālum pāṟcōṟum uṇpārkaḷ; avaṟṟi viruntiṉarkkum uvappuṭaṉ aḷippārkaḷ; āṭukaḷiṉ tōlkaḷit tittup paṭukkiyākap payaṉpaṭuttuvārkaḷ; koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷ āṭukaḷi neruṅkātavāṟu tīmūṭṭi iravik kaḻippārkaḷ (malipaṭu. aṭi, 404-420). mulli nilamakkaḷ mūṅkiṟkuḻiyil erumittayirit tōyttārkaḷ (malipaṭu. aṭi, 523).


3. pāli nilam
pāliyiṉ iyalpu
kuṟiñci nilamum mulli nilamum aṭuttaṭuttu iruppavi. ivi mutuvēṉiṟkālattil tamakkuriya nīr vaḷattiṟkuṟintu makkaḷ nilittu vāḻa vacatiyaṟṟa mikka veppatti aṭiyum. akkālattil annilappakuti `pāli eṉap peyar peṟum.
kuṭikaḷik kāttōmpum kaṭamiyuṭiya aracaṉ, appoṟuppiṉip puṟakkaṇittuk kuṭi ōmpāta amiccarōṭu kūṭit taṉ koṭuṅkōlāṭciyāl nāṭṭi araciyal aṟṟa nāṭākkiṉāṟpōlak katiravaṉ mutirnta vēṉil eṉṉum amiccaṉōṭu kūṭik kuṟiñciyiyum mulliyiyum pocukkuvatāl, iru nilaṅkaḷum taṅkaḷ iyaṟki muṟimiyiliruntu māṟit taṅkaḷic cērntāmi vemmiyāl tuṉpuṟuttum `pāli eṉṉum vaṭivip peṟum. itaṉi iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷ,
``mulliyum kuṟiñciyum muṟimiyiṉ tirintu
nalliyal piḻantu naṭuṅkutuyar uṟuttup
pāli eṉpatōr paṭivaṅ koḷḷum1
eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār.
kuṟiñci nilam maṭṭum taṉiyē pāliyākat tiritalum uṇṭu.2 iṅṅaṉamē mulli nilam taṉiyē pāliyākat tiritalum uṇṭu.3 iṅṅaṉam pāliyāyt tirinta nilattiyum cērttu nilam aivakiyākak kōṭalum uṇṭu. eṉavē, `pāli eṉpatu kuṟiñci nilatti allatu mulli nilattic cārntatu; naṉcey puṉcey viḷivu aṟṟatu; nīr vaḷam mikak kuṟintatu; veppam mikuntatu; cemmiyāṉa pātiyaṟṟatu; makkaḷ nērmiyāka vāḻa vacatikkuṟiyuḷḷatu eṉpaṉavaṟṟi eḷitil aṟiyalām.
pāli nilat taṉmiyip paṟṟi nacciṉārkkiṉiyar (tol. akat. 9, uri), `pālit taṉmiyāvatu, kāliyum māliyum naṇpakalaṉṉa kaṭumikūrac cōli tēmpik kūval māṟi, nīrum niḻalum iṉṟi, nilam payaṉ tuṟantu, puḷḷum māvum pulampuṟṟu iṉpamiṉṟit tuṉpam peṟuvatu, eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷami kavaṉikkattakum.
ippālinilattil vēṭṭuvar vāḻntaṉar; vaḻippaṟi ceyvatip piḻippākak koṇṭa āṟali kaḷvar vāḻntaṉar. pāli nilat talivaṉ `viṭali, kāḷi, mīḷi eṉappaṭṭāṉ. talivi `eyiṟṟi eṉappaṭṭāḷ. kuṭi makkaḷuḷ āṭavar `eyiṉar, maṟavar eṉappaṭṭaṉar; peṇṭir `eyiṟṟiyar, maṟattiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. ivarkaḷ vāḻnta ūrkaḷ `paṟantali, kuṟumpu eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉa. ivarkaḷ toḻil vaḻippaṟi ceyvatum, pakivaruṭiya kāl naṭikaḷik kavarvatum, ūrkaḷukkuc ceṉṟu koḷḷiyaṭittu varuvatumākum. ivartam paṟi, cūṟikōṭpaṟiyum niri kōṭpaṟiyumākum. innilattukkuriya yāḻ, pāli yāḻ ākum; paṇ, pañcuram eṉpatu. marā, kurā, pātiri malarkaḷ iṅkuc ciṟantavi. iruppi, ōmi, uḻiñi, nemi, pāli, yā eṉṉum maraṅkaḷ iṅkuc ciṟantavi.
innilattukkuriya akavoḻukkam piritalum pirital nimittamum ākum. kalvi, poruḷīṭṭal mutaliya ceyalkaḷukkākat talivaṉ taliviyip pirital pāli oḻukkam eṉappaṭṭatu. ivarkaḷ koṟṟavi, aiyi eṉappaṭṭa turkkiyi vaḻipaṭṭārkaḷ.1
pattuppāṭṭuḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa pāli nilam paṟṟiya ceytikaḷi iṉikkāṇpōm:
toṇṭi nāṭṭup pāli nilam
eyiṟṟiyar
pāli nilattil īntiṉ iliyāl vēynta kuṭicikaḷil eyiṉar (vēṭṭuvar) vāḻntaṉar. piḷḷiyip peṟṟa eyiṟṟi māṉ tōlākiya paṭukkiyil muṭaṅkik kiṭantāḷ. eyiṟṟiyar uḷi pōṉṟa vāyiṉi yuṭiya kaṭappārikaḷāl karampi nilattik kiḷaṟip pullariciyic cērttukkoṇṭu ceṉṟaṉar. avartam kuṭicikaḷiṉ muṉ puṟattil viḷā maraṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. aṅku nilattil ural tōṇṭap paṭṭiruntatu. eyiṟṟiyar annilavuralil tām cērttuk koṇṭu vanta pullariciyic corintu, kuṟiya ulakkiyāl kuṟṟiṉar; ciṟiya aḷavu nīrik koṇṭa kiṇaṟṟiliruntu uvarnīri mukantu, uli vittaṉar; pullariciccōṟṟic camittaṉar; accōṟṟi uppukkaṇṭattōṭu uṇṭaṉar; tammi nāṭi vanta viruntiṉarkkut tēkkiliyil avaṟṟip paṭittaṉar.


eyiṉar
eyiṉar kuṭṭikaḷi aṭuttuk kuḻikaḷit tōṇṭiṉar; kuṭṭiyil irunta nīrip paruka vanta paṉṟiyi ampeytu vīḻttat tām tōṇṭiya kuḻikaḷil patuṅkiyiruntaṉar; paṉṉi vēṭṭi payaṉpaṭāta poḻutu muyalkaḷip piṭikkak kuṟuṅkāṭṭil vēlikaḷil valikaḷi virittaṉar; vēṭṭi nāykaḷuṭaṉ ceṉṟu tūṟukaḷi aṭittu, muyalkaḷi ōṭac ceytaṉar. avi añcit ticiyaṟiyātu ōṭi valiyil akappaṭṭaṉa. iṅṅaṉam eyiṉar pāli nilattil vēṭṭiyāṭiṉar.
eyiṉar araṇ
toṇṭi nāṭṭil mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa pāli nilatti aṭuttu eyiṉar araṇ amintiruntatu. aṅkup pala vīṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. avvīṭukaḷil vēlkaḷum viṟkaḷum ampukaḷum niṟintiruntaṉa. tiraṇṭa kālkaḷik koṇṭa pantariyuṭiya kāval mikunta vīṭu oṉṟu iruntatu. avvīṭṭil caṅkilikaḷāl piṇikkappaṭṭa nāykaḷ iruntaṉa. avi vēṭṭi nāykaḷ, avvīṭṭil ampukkaṭṭukaḷum tuṭi mutaliya vācciyaṅkaḷum vikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. antak kaṭimaṉiyic cūḻa ūkampullāl vēyappaṭṭa matil iruntatu. ammatilic cuṟṟilum muḷ vēli amintiruntatu. avvēliyic cūḻak kāvaṟkāṭu kāṇappaṭṭatu. matilil irunta vāyilil nīṇṭa muṉiyum uṟutiyum vāynta kuḻukkaḷ niṟuttappaṭṭiruntaṉa. araṇiṉ vāyil, valiya kaṇiya maram ēṟpaṭṭa uṭkataviṉi uṭiyatu. inta eyiṉar araṇ, toṇṭimāṉ āṭcikkuriyatu. eṉavē, nāṭṭik kākkum nilappaṭikaḷuḷ oṉṟu pāli nilattil vikkappaṭṭiruntatu pōlum! inta araṇil  irunta eyiṉar, villilum vēlilum payiṟci peṟṟavarāvar. ivar mēṟkūṟiya muyal vēṭṭiyāṭiya eḷiya eyiṉariṉam mēmpaṭṭa maṟavarāvar. āṟalikaḷ vari aṭakkavum nāṭṭu vāṇika vaḻikaḷip pāli nilattiṟ pātukākkavum ivarkaḷ maṉṉaṉāl amarttappaṭṭavarkaḷ eṉak karutalām.
pōr maṟavar
ikkuṭiyiṟpiṟanta cūl koṇṭa makaḷ, yāṉi taṉ etirē variṉum, pāmpu taṉmēl ūrntu celliṉum, vāṉattil iṭi tōṉṟiṉum añciyatilli. attakiya maṟavar kulamakaḷir peṟṟeṭutta maṟavarākiya eyiṉar, koḷḷi koṇṭu uṇṭaliyē urimiyākak koṇṭaṉar. avarkaḷ talivaṉ āṇ puli pōṉṟa vīramuṭiyavaṉ; pulleṉṟa tāṭiyi uṭiyavaṉ. avaṉ taṉ vīraruṭaṉ ceṉṟu, taṉ pakivar nāṭṭup pacukkaḷik kavarntu vantu, avaṟṟik kaḷḷukku viliyākap pōkkiṉāṉ; piṉpu taṉ illattiṟcamitta kaḷ  vakiyuḷ nellāṟcamitta kaḷḷip parukiṉāṉ; āṭṭiṟicciyi uṇṭāṉ. iṅṅaṉamē avaṉuṭiya vīrarum kaḷḷip paruki iṟicciyi uṇṭaṉar. piṉpu aṉivarum maṉṟiṟkūṭi mattaḷa muḻakkattiṟku ēṟpa iṭattōḷi valappakkattil vaḷittu, makiḻcciyuṭaṉ kūttāṭiṉar.1 avartam kuṭiyiruppukku appāl mulli nilam amintiruntatu(pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 83-147).
pāṇṭi nāṭṭup pāli nilam
pālinilattil āṟalikaḷvar maṟintu niṉṟu vaḻippōkkarit tuṉpuṟuttalum, koli puritalum, koli kaṇṭu makiḻtalum vaḻakkam. itaṉāl, tamiḻ maṉṉar eyiṉaruḷ takkavarip pōr vīrarākki nāṭu kāvaṟ paṇiyil amarttiṉar. pālinila vaḻikaḷil kuṭimakkaṭkut tīṅku nērāmal pārppatē avartam taliyāya kaṭami. pāṇṭi nāṭṭup pāli vaḻikaḷik kāval kāttavar iḷiñar. villēntiya kiyiṉar; kuḻiyāl vēynta kuṭilkaḷil vāḻntaṉar; taḻi viraviṉa kaṇṇiyiṉi aṇintaṉar; kaṭiya coṟkaḷi uṭiyavar; valimi mikuntavar (ma. kā. aṭi, 310-314).
pāli paṟṟiya piṟa ceytikaḷ
āṟalikaḷvar pāli nilavaḻiyē cellum pāṇariyō kūttariyō tākka muṉitalum vaḻakkam. appoḻutu avarkaḷ pāli yāḻi icittu, urukkamākap pāṭuvārkaḷ. yāḻōciyum miṭaṟṟōciyum vaṉṉeñcarākiya āṟalikaḷvar maṉattiyum kavarumām. avarkaḷ taṅkaḷ kolikkaruvikaḷiyum nekiḻa viṭṭut taṅkaḷi maṟantu niṟpārkaḷām ( po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 21-2). pāli eṉṉum paṇ mikavum iṉimi vāyntatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 180). talivaṉ pōr mutaliyavaṟṟuḷ oṉṟukkākat taliviyi viṭṭup piriyum oḻukkam `pāli eṉappaṭum (neṭunal. nac. uri). pāli eṉpatu oru maram. malināṭṭu makaḷir ataṉ malarip piṟa malarkaḷōṭu viravit taḻiyum māliyum amittu aṇintaṉar (ku.pā. aṭi, 77).
4. marutanilam
muṉṉuri
vayalum vayaliccārnta iṭamum marutam eṉappaṭum. āṟṟuppāyccal ērippāyccal uḷḷa nilappakutiyē marutanilamākum. innilattil maruta maraṅkaḷ mikutiyātaliṉ, itu marutam eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. inta nilam nīrvaḷattāl ciṟantatu; nel, karumpu, pukiyili mutaliya uyariya payirkaḷ naṉku payirākum nilam; uṇavukkuṟipāṭu illāta nilam. ātaliṉ, aivaki nilaṅkaḷilum marutamē uyarvākak karutappaṭukiṟatu. ulakattil pukaḻ peṟṟa paḻiya nākarikaṅkaḷ aṉittum āṟṟuppāyccal niṟinta maruta nilattilētāṉ tōṉṟiṉa eṉpatu varalāṟu kūṟum uṇmiyākum.
`veḷḷiya pūkkaḷiyuṭiya karumpukaḷuṭaṉē cen nellum vaḷarntu kuvaḷiyōṭē perumiyiyuṭiya itaḻkaḷiyuṭiya neytalum mayakkappaṭṭu mutalikaḷ cerukkit tirinta iṭamakaṉṟa poykikaḷi yuṭiya marutanilam eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār (pa. pāli. aṭi, 239-42 uri). itu marutanilac ciṟappi naṉku terivippatākum.
innilattut talimakaṉ, `makiḻnaṉ, ūraṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ; talimakaḷ, `maṉivi eṉappaṭṭāḷ. kuṭimakkaḷ uḻavar, kaḷamar, kaṭiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar; avartam peṇṭir, `uḻattiyar, kaṭiciyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. innilakkaṭavuḷ intiraṉ. ivarkaḷ nilatti uḻutal, vitittal, kaḷi eṭuttal, nīr pāyccutal, aṟuvaṭi ceytal, kaṭā viṭal, āṟukaḷilum poykikaḷilum nīrāṭal mutaliya toḻilkaḷil īṭupaṭṭārkaḷ. innilattiṟkuriyatu marutayāḻ; iṅkuc ciṟantirunta malarkaḷ tāmariyum kaḻunīrumākum. ittakiya ciṟappuṭiya marutanilam paṟṟip pattuppāṭṭuḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa ceytikaḷi iṅkuk kāṇpōm.
cōḻanāṭṭu marutanilam
vaṭaveḷḷāṟṟukkum teṉ veṟṟāṟṟukkum iṭippaṭṭa nilappakuti cōḻanāṭu. innāṭṭik kāviri taṉ naṉṉirāl pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷākak kāttu varukiṉṟatu. kañcakkulli tīyavum, marakkompukaḷi nerupputtiṉṉavum, mēkam kaṭal nīri mukattali maṟappavum nērum poḻutu nāṭṭil periya vaṟkaṭam tōṉṟum. akkoṭiya kālattilum kāviriyil nīr peruki varum. annīr nāṭṭic ceḻippākkum. (cōḻa nāṭṭu vaḷam `nāṭukaḷ eṉṉum talippil virivākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu).
ōymāṉāṭṭu marutanilam
ōymāṉāṭṭil peyar peṟṟa yāṟukaḷ illi. nāṭu maḻiyi nampiyiruntatu. āṅkāṅkup periya nīr nilikaḷ amikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ērippāyccaliyuṭiya nilappakutiyē marutavaḷattuṭaṉ kāṇappaṭṭatu. an nilappakuti vēlūriliruntu āmūr variyil paravi iruntatu. ataṉ nīr vaḷam `ōymāṉāṭu eṉṟa talippil virittuk kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu
toṇṭi nāṭṭu marutanilam
toṇṭi nāṭṭip paṉṉeṭuṅkālamāy vaḷappaṭutti varuvatu pālāṟu. atu perumpāṇaṉ putiya pāṇaṉi āṟṟuppaṭuttiya vaḻiyil avaṉ kālattil iruntiruppiṉ, ataṉip paṟṟik kūṟiyiruppāṉ. avaṉ kuṟitta tuṟimuka nakarattiṟkuc cella vēṇṭumāyiṉ, pālāṟṟik kaṭantutāṉ cella vēṇṭum. iḵtu iṉṟiya nilimi. pālāṟu māmallapurattiṟkut teṟkē ēṟattāḻap patiṉintu kal tolivil iṉṟu pāykiṉṟatu. āyiṉum. perumpāṇaṉ kālattil pālāṟu kāñcikku ēṟattāḻa eṭṭukkal vaṭakkil pāyntakoṇṭiruntatu. ki.pi. 13ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṟkup piṉpē ataṉ pōkku māṟṟappaṭṭatu. ataṉāl, appēriyāṟu kāñcikkut teṟkil pāyat toṭaṅki vāyalūr eṉṉum iṭattiṟku arukil kaṭaliṟ kalakkalāyiṟṟu. itu paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷi ippakutiyiṉ īṟṟil uḷḷa kuṟippiṟkāṇka. taṉ kālattil kāñcikkut teṟkē pālāṟu pāyātatālētāṉ perumpāṇaṉ appēri yāṟṟik kuṟikkavilli eṉpatu iṅku aṟiyattakum.
perumpāṇaṉ kuṟiñci, pāli, mulli nilappakutikaḷip paṟṟip pēciya piṉpu marutanilam paṟṟic cila vivaraṅkaḷik kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ; annilappakuti iṉṟuḷḷa māmallapurattiṟkum pālāṟṟiṉ vaṭakarikkum iṭippaṭṭa tākum. aṅku ērikaḷ amintuḷḷaṉa. māmallapurattiliruntu kaccikkuc ceṉṟa vaḻiyil tōppukaḷ iruntamiyip perumpāṇaṉ kuṟittuḷḷāṉ. ivaṟṟi nōkka, iṉṟuḷḷavāṟē caṅkakālat toṇṭi nāṭṭilum ērippāyccal peṟṟirunta nilappakutiyē marutanilamāyk kāṭciyaḷittatu eṉpati aṟiyalām. toṇṭi nāṭṭu marutanilam paṟṟiya ceytikaḷit `toṇṭi nāṭu, eṉṉum talippiṟ kāṇalām.
pāṇṭi nāṭṭu maruta nilam
pāṇṭi nāṭṭu yāṟukaḷuḷḷē peyar peṟṟavi `viyi, poruni eṉpaṉa. viyi pāṇṭi nāṭṭiṉ vaṭapakutiyiyum, poruni pāṇṭi nāṭṭiṉ teṉ pakutiyiyum nīṇṭa kālamāy vaḷappaṭutti varukiṉṟaṉa. āyiṉum, `maturi eṉṉum pāṇṭiyar talinakariyaṭuttup pāynta viyiyē caṅkanūlkaḷil ciṟappākap pēcappaṭṭuḷḷatu. pāṇṭi nāṭṭu marutanilam paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷ, `pāṇṭi nāṭu eṉṉun talippil virivākat tarappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
marutam
ūṭalum kūṭalumākiya oḻukkam marutanilattiṟku uriyateṉa ilakkaṇanūl kūṟum. avvoḻukkattiṟkē `marutam eṉpatu peyar.
`marutam cāṉṟa marutat taṇpaṉi eṉpatu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi (aṭi, 186). innilattiṟkuriyatu marutayāḻ eṉpatu. marutappaṇ eṉpatum vaḻakkil iruntatu. marutappaṇ kālippaṇ eṉappaṭṭatu. yāḻōr maturiyil kāliyil marutappaṇṇi vācittaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 657-8).
marutanilattil uṇavuppañcamilli. ātaliṉ, makkaḷ taṅkaḷ ōyvu nēraṅkaḷik kalviyilum kali vaḷarcciyilum celaviṭat toṭaṅkiṉārkaḷ. marutanila makkaḷālētāṉ ulakil nuṇkalikaḷum piṟa kalikaḷum cemmiyāy vaḷarcciyaṭintaṉa; āṭalum pāṭalum ōviyamum ciṟpamum vaḷarcci peṟṟaṉa. cōṟṟukkavali illātatāl nilakkiḻār palar parattiyarōṭu paḻakalāyiṉar. eṉavē, tamiḻ nūlkaḷil parattiyar pirivu ēṟpaṭṭatu. parattiyar poruṭṭut talivaṉ taliviyi viṭṭup pirintāṉ; talivi ūṭal koṇṭāḷ. talivaṉ, pāṇaṉ, viṟali mutaliyōrik koṇṭu taliviyiṉ ūṭalit tīrttut taliviyik kūṭiṉāṉ. itaṉālētāṉ `maruta nilattiṟku ūṭalum kūṭalum uriya, eṉṟu akapporuḷ ilakkaṇam aṟiyalāyiṟṟu.


5. neytal nilam
muṉṉuri
kaṭalum kaṭal cārnta iṭamum neytal eṉap peyar peṟum. iṅku neytal malar mikutiyātaliṉ, innilam ippeyar peṟṟatu eṉṉalām. kātalippirinta kātali taṉ taṉimiyi niṉintu iraṅkalum iraṅkal nimittamum ākiya oḻukkam paṟṟi innilam neytal eṉap peyar peṟṟatu eṉṟu kūṟappaṭutalum uṇṭu.
kaṭaṟkariyil vāḻnta paratavarē innilattukkuriya kuṭimakkaḷ. avarkaḷ paṭṭiṉam eṉṟa pērūrkaḷilum pākkam eṉṟa ciṟṟūrkaḷilum vāḻntārkaḷ. avaruḷ talivarāyiṉār `cērppaṉ, pulampaṉ; eṉappaṭṭaṉar; avartam peṇṭir `parattiyar, nuḷicciyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avartam kuṭimakkaḷuḷ āṭavar, `paratar, nuḷiyar, aḷavar, valiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avartam peṇṭir `parattiyar, nuḷicciyar, aḷattiyar, valicciyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar.
neytal nilamakkaḷ maḻikkaṭavuḷi (varuṇaṉi)t teyvamākak koṇṭāṭiṉārkaḷ. avarkaḷ kaṭaliṟceṉṟu valivīci mīṉ piṭittaṉar; avaṟṟi viṟṟaṉar; uppi viḷittaṉar; uppi viṟṟaṉar; vanta poruḷik koṇṭu vāḻntaṉar; ammakkaḷ mīṉkaḷip piṭittal, avaṟṟi ularttutal, uppu viḷittal, mīṉiyum uppiyum viṟṟal, paṟavikaḷi ōṭṭal, kaṭalāṭutal mutaliya toḻilkaḷil īṭupaṭṭiruntārkaḷ. avarkaḷ mīṉkōṭpaṟi, pampi, viḷari yāḻ eṉṉum icikkaruvikaḷip payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; cevvaḻi eṉṉum paṇ icittārkaḷ. avarkaḷ tāḻi, nīr muḷḷi, aṭampu puṉṉi, ñāḻal eṉṉum malarkaḷi aṇintārkaḷ.
cōḻanāṭṭu neytal nilam, ōymāṉāṭṭu neytal nilam, toṇṭi nāṭṭu neytal nilam, pāṇṭi nāṭṭu neytal nilam paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ `nāṭukaḷ eṉṉum aṭutta pakutiyil tarappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. neytal nila makkaḷiṉ ceyalkaḷ `viḷiyāṭṭukaḷ eṉṉun talippil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
neytal neṭuvaḻi
iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭiliruntu ōymāṉāṭṭuk kaṭaṟkari vaḻiyē ceṉṟa neṭuvaḻiyil eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam iruntatu. anneṭuvaḻi pala kālamāka vāṇi vaḻipāyum nāṭu viṭṭu nāṭu cellum peruvaḻiyāyum iruntatu pōlum! nallūr nattattaṉār ataṉip `pukaḻtal aminta neytal nilattu neṭiya vaḻi eṉṉum poruḷil,
``pāṭal cāṉṟa neytal neṭuvaḻi
(ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 151) eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār.
pālāṟṟiṉ pōkku
pālāṟṟiṉ tōṟṟam
micūr nāṭṭil peṅkaḷūr, kōlār, tumkūr, micūr, hācaṉ, kaṭūr, ṣimōkā, cittal turkkam eṉa eṭṭu māvaṭṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. ovvoru māvaṭṭattilum pala vaṭṭaṅkaḷ uṇṭu. kōlār māvaṭṭattil cikpallapūr eṉṉum peyar koṇṭa vaṭṭam oṉṟākum. avvaṭṭattil nanti turkka malittoṭar uḷḷatu. attoṭaril tippakiri, piramakiri, ceṉṉa kēcavamali, arikarēcuvara mali, kalavara turkkam, nanti turkkam eṉap pala malikaḷ uṇṭu.
ceṉṉakēcavamali kaṭalmaṭṭattiṟku mēl 4762 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatu. itaṉ ucciyil aṭarnta kāṭukaḷ uḷḷaṉa. immaliyiṉ  vaṭapakutiyil tōṉṟum yāṟu uttarappinākiṉi eṉpatu; teṉpakutiyil tōṉṟum yāṟu taṭciṇappinākiṉi eṉpatu. ivi muṟiyē vaṭapeṇṇiyāṟu, teṉpeṇṇiyāṟu eṉṟu tamiḻil peyar peṟum. inta iraṇṭu yāṟukaḷukkum iṭiyil pālāṟu tōṉṟukiṟatu.
pālāṟṟiṉ pōkku
kōlār māṭṭattil tōṉṟum pālāṟu kōlār vaṭṭam, mulpākal vaṭṭam, cīṉivācapuravaṭṭam, puriṅpēṭṭi vaṭṭam ākiyavi vaḻiyākat teṉkiḻakkil pāykiṉṟatu; puriṅpēṭṭi vaṭṭattiṉ kiḻakkil micūr nāṭṭik kaṭantu, vaṭavārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭattic cērnta paḻiya kaṅkuṇṭi camīṉ cīmiyi aṭikiṟatu.
kaṅkuṇṭic cīmiyi aṭinta pālāṟu muppatukal ceṉṟu kiḻakkut toṭarcci malikaḷiṉ vaḻiyē pāyntu vāṇiyampāṭip paḷḷattākki aṭikiṉṟatu. piṉpu atu cavvātu malikaḷiṉ kuṟukkīṭṭāl ciṟiya vaṭakkil ceṉṟu piṉpu kiḻakku nōkkip pāykiṟatu. ārkkāṭṭiṟkuk kiḻakkil aintukal tolivil pālāṟṟiṉ kuṟukkē ōr aṇi kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. kāvērip pākkattukku1 appāl inta yāṟu ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattuk kāñcīpura vaṭṭattuḷ nuḻikiṟatu; kāñcikkut teṉkiḻakkiṟ ceṉṟu, iṟutiyil kiḻakku nōkkip pāyntu, caturaṅkappaṭṭiṉattiṟkut2 teṟkil mūṉṟu kal tolivil kaṭaliṟkalakkiṉṟatu. ippālāṟṟiṉ nīḷam ēṟattāḻa 230 kal ākum.
kalveṭṭuc ceyti
kāvērippākkattukku arukil uḷḷa koṇṭāpuram eṉṉum ciṟṟūril uḷḷa kōvil kalveṭṭu oṉṟu, akkōvil pālāṟṟukkut teṟkil iruppateṉak kuṟittuḷḷatu. āyiṉum, iṉṟu akkōvil pālāṟṟukku vaṭakkil uḷḷatu.3 itaṉi nōkka, ekkāraṇattālō piṉ nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷil, kāvērip pākkattiṟku arukilirunta pālāṟṟiṉ pōkku vaṭakkiliruntu teṟku nōkki māṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu teḷivākiṟatu.
iṅṅaṉam pālāṟṟiṉ pōkku māṟak kāraṇam, pālāṟu kāñciyi aṭuttuc cella vēṇṭum eṉṟa nōkkattōṭu kāñci kāvalaṉuṭiya uyaraluvalaṉāṉa kaṇṭa kōpālaṉ eṉpavaṉ, aracaṉ viruppappaṭi āṟṟiṉ pōkki māṟṟiyatē eṉṟu cevivaḻic ceyti ceppukiṉṟatu.4
tirumuṟiccāṉṟukaḷ
kāvērippākkattu ēri mikap periyatu. anta ēriyiliruntu veḷippaṭum mikutiyāṉa nīrē korttaliyāṟu eṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ kiḻakkil pāykiṉṟatu. atu vaḻiyil tiruttaṇikiyāṟu, nakariyāṟu eṉpavaṟṟiṉ nīrip peṟṟuc ceṉṉikku vaṭakiḻakkil uḷḷa eṇṇūrukku arukil kaṭaliṟkalakkiṉṟatu. ikkottaliyāṟu pāyum kāvērippākkattup paḷḷattākkil oru kālattil pālāṟu pāyntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟu ārāycciyāḷar karutukiṉṟaṉar. pālāṟṟup paṭukiyum kottaliyāṟṟup paṭukiyiyum iṇikkum ciṟṟāṟu oṉṟu iṉṟum `paḻiya pālāṟu eṉṉum peyaril iruppatē iṅṅaṉam karutak kāraṇamākum.1 iḵtu uṇmiyāy irukkalām eṉpatit tirumuṟippāṭalkaḷum piṟapāṭalkaḷum tiruppācūrk kalveṭṭum meyppikkiṉṟaṉa.
1. kāñcikku vaṭamēṟkil ēṟattāḻa ēḻukal tolivil uḷḷa tirumāṟpēṟu eṉṉum civatalam pālāṟṟiṉ teṉkariyil iruntatu eṉṟu ki.pi. 7ām nūṟṟāṇṭil vāḻnta tiruñāṉa campantar tamatu patikattiṟ pāṭiyuḷḷār.
``tiriyār pāliyiṉ teṉkari māṟpēṟu2
ki.pi. 12ām nūṟṟāṇṭil (ki.pi. 1133-1150) tiruñāṉaca mpantar mutaliya civap periyārkaḷiṉ varalāṟukaḷip periya purāṇam eṉṉum peruṅkāppiyamākap pāṭiyaruḷiya cēkkiḻār perumāṉum itaṉiyē kūṟiyuḷḷār.3 tirumāṟ pēṟṟukku aṇmiyil uḷḷa kōvintavāṭi akaram eṉṉum ūril `paḻiya pālāṟueṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ yāṟu oṉṟu iṉṟum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu.4
2. kāñciyiliruntu kaliṅkattiṉmītu paṭiyeṭuttuc ceṉṟa mutaṟkulōttuṅkaṉ (ki.pi. 1070-1120) paṭittalivaṉāṉa karuṇākarat toṇṭimāṉ kāñcikkum kaliṅkattukkum iṭiyil pala yāṟukaḷi kaṭantāṉ. avaṟṟuḷ mutalyāṟu pālāṟu eṉṟu akkālattil pāṭappaṭṭa kaliṅkattup paraṇi kūṟukiṉṟatu.1 eṉavē, ki.pi. 11, 12ām nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷil pālāṟu kāñcikku vaṭakkil pāyntu koṇṭiruntatu eṉpatu teḷivākiṟataṉṟō?
3. ceṉṉikku mēṟkil ēṟattāḻap patiṉintu kal tolivil uḷḷa pūvirunta vallikku vaṭakkil iraṇṭu kal tolivil tiruvēṟkāṭu eṉṉum civatalam uḷḷatu. itu pālāṟṟiṉ vaṭakariyil iruntatu eṉṟu cēkkiḻār perumāṉ periya purāṇattiṟ pāṭiyuḷḷār.2 iṉṟu avyāṟu `paḻiya pālāṟueṉṟum `kāṭu veṭṭiyāṟu eṉṟum kūṟappaṭukiṟatu.3
4. tiruvēṟkāṭṭiṟku vaṭakiḻakkil ēṟattāḻa āṟu kal tolivil vaṭatirumullivāyil eṉṉum civatalam amintuḷḷatu. appati pālāṟṟiṉ vaṭakariyil iruntatu eṉṟu ki.pi. 9ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉarāṉa cuntarar attalam paṟṟiya patikattiṟpāṭiyuḷḷār. acceyyuḷ,
``cantaṉa vēruṅ kārakiṟ kuṟaṭun
	taṇmayiṟ pīliyuṅ kariyiṉ
tantamun taraḷak kuvikaḷum pavaḷak
	koṭikaḷuñ cumantukoṇ ṭunti

vantiḻi pāli vaṭakari mulli
	vāyilāy! mācilā maṇiyē!
pantaṉi keṭutteṉ paṭutuyar kaḷiyāy
	pācupa tāparañcuṭarē! 4
eṉpatu.
5. ceṉṉiyiliruntu arakkōṇam cellum iruppuppātiyi aṭuttuḷḷa ilampiyaṅkōṭṭūr tiruviṟkōlam (kūvam), tiruvūṟal (takkōlam) eṉṉam civatalaṅkaḷum pālāṟṟiṉ vaṭapāl iruntaṉa eṉṟu cēkkiḻār ceppiyuḷḷār.1
pācūrkkalveṭṭu
6. tiruppācūrc civaṉ kōvilil aimpattu mūṉṟu kalveṭṭukaḷ uḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟuḷ oṉṟu kaliṅkattup paraṇi koṇṭa mutaṟ kulōttuṅkaṉatu (ki.pi. 1070-1120) nāṟpattāṟām āṭci yāṇṭil (ki.pi. 1116 il) veṭṭappaṭṭatu.
``āmūrkkōṭṭattu mōntūr nāṭṭu mōntūrp pāṇṭippākkam oṟṟi koṇṭāṉukkuk kīḻmali mōkūr nāṭṭu irāca nārāyaṇa caturvēti maṅkalattu makācapiyār nilatti viṟṟaṉar. ammiyappar tirumañcaṉattukkup pālāṟṟu nīrik koṇṭu varavum nantavaṉam amikkavum annilam viṟkappaṭṭatu, eṉpatu akkalveṭṭuc ceytiyākum.2
tiruppācūrkku aṇmiyil pālāṟu pāyntu koṇṭiruntatu eṉpatu ikkalveṭṭāl naṉku viḷaṅkukiṟataṉṟō?
muṭivuri
iccāṉṟukaḷ aṉittiyum nōkkak ki.pi. 12ām nūṟṟāṇṭu variyil pālāṟu, kāñcikku vaṭakkil uḷḷa tirumāṟpēṟu, vaṭakiḻakkil uḷḷa tiruppācūr, tiruvēṟkāṭu, tirumullivāyil vaḻiyākac ceṉṟu eṇṇūrukku arukil kaṭaliṟkalantiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu teḷivātal kāṇka.
6. nāṭukaḷ
cōḻanāṭu
kāviriyiṉ ciṟappu
kañcaṅkulli tīytal, marakkompukaḷi nerupput tiṉṉutal, maliyaruvikaḷ vaṟṟutal, mēkam kaṭal nīri mukattali maṟattal ākiyavi. nērumpoḻutu nāṭṭil periya vaṟkaṭam tōṉṟum. akkoṭiya kālattilum kāviriyāṟṟu nīr perukivarum; naṟikkoṭi, narantampul, akil, cantaṉam ākiyavaṟṟic cumantu vantu tuṟitōṟum taḷḷic cellum; kuḷam mutaliya nīr nilikaḷiṟpukum. annīril makaḷirum mintarum nīrāṭuvar. nel viḷiccal, kāviri vaḷattāl mikutiyākum. uḻavar, nāṭōṟum kaṭā viṭṭuk kuṉṟu eṉṟu collumpaṭi kuvitta nellik kutirkaḷil nirappuvar. oru vēli nilam āyiraṅkalamākiya cennelli viḷikkum. ittakiya viḷiccalukkuk kāraṇam, kāviriyāṟēyākum. kāviri iṅṅaṉam taṉatu nīrāl cōḻanāṭṭip pātukākkiṟatu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 233-248).
veḷḷi eṉṉum mīṉ tāṉ niṟṟaṟkuriya vaṭaticiyil nillāmal teṉticiyiṟcelliṉum, maḻi tāṉ peyya vēṇṭum kālattup peyyātoḻiyiṉum, kuṭaku maliyil tōṉṟip pāyum kāviri poyyātu, kālantōṟum pāyntukoṇṭēyirukkum. kāviri nīr cōḻanāṭṭiṟ pāykiyil poṉṉik kariyil pōkaṭum. kāviri vaḷattāl cōḻanāṭṭu vayalkaḷil viḷital māṟātu naṭipeṟum (pa.pāli, aṭi, 1-7).
cōḻanāṭu
cōḻanāṭṭiṉ ovvoru `mā nilattilum tiṭar tōṟum neṟkūṭukaḷ poruntiyirukkum. tāḻnta teṉṉi maraṅkaḷiyuṭiya kuḷirnta maraccōlikaḷil kuṭiyiruppukaḷ irukkum. aṅkuḷḷa makkaḷ kuruti kalanta cōṟṟip paliyāka iṭuvārkaḷ. kākki appaliyi viḻuṅkum. atu āmiyiṉ pārppi eṭuttu vantu paci varumpōtu tiṉṉap pātukāttu vikkum. āṇmayilkaḷ vaḷivuṭiya kāñcimarattilum cevviya marutamarattilum taṅkum; pākaṟpaḻattiyum, palāp paḻattiyum tiṉṉum. appoḻutu avaṟṟiṉ peṇ mayilkaḷ avaṟṟi aḻikkum. āṇ mayilkaḷ avaṟṟip poruṭpaṭuttāmal, yāḻōci pōṉṟu vaṇṭukaḷ neytal nilattiṟpāṭuvatik kēṭṭu, aṅkuc ceṉṟu, pāṭaṟku ēṟpat taṅkaḷ tōkiyi virittu nilavu pōṉṟa .iṭumaṇalil āṭum.
mulli nilakkāṭukaḷil taḷavu, tōṉṟi, mulli, tēṟṟā, poṉ pōlum pūviṉiyuṭiya koṉṟi, nīlamaṇi pōlum pūviṉiyuṭiya kāyā eṉpavi malarum. mulli nila makkaḷ akkāṭukaḷil vāḻtali veṟukkiṉ, marutanilam ceṉṟu annilattip pukaḻvārkaḷ.
nārikaḷ kaṭal iṟavittiṉṟu puṉṉi marakkiḷikaḷil taṅkum; akkiḷikaḷiṉ mītu mōtum tirikku añciṉ, marutanilattup paṉi maṭaliṟceṉṟu taṅkum.
neytal nilamākiya kaṭaṟkariyi aṭutta pākkattil kulikaḷik koṇṭa teṉṉi maraṅkaḷum, vāḻi maraṅkaḷum, malarnta curapuṉṉi maraṅkaḷum, koḻuviya kāntaṭceṭikaḷum vaḷamuṟat tōṉṟum. aṅkut tuṭiyōci pōlum ōciyiyuṭiya pērānti vāḻum. paratavar appākkattu vāḻkkiyi veṟuppiṉ, kuṟiñciyiṟceṉṟu annilattip pukaḻvar.
kuṟavar tam kuṟiñci nilappūkkaḷi veṟuppiṉ, neytaṟpūkkaḷic cūṭuvar. mulli nila (kāṭṭu)k kōḻikaḷ (marutanilattu) nellit tiṉṉum; maruta nilattu vīṭṭukkōḻikaḷ (mullinilattut) tiṉiyit tiṉṉum; malināṭṭukkuriya mantikaḷ uppaṅkaḻiyil mūḻkum; uppaṅkaḻiyil tiriyum nārikaḷ maliyil taṅkum. cōḻanāṭu ittakiya nāṉilac ciṟappuṭiyatu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 180-226).
karumpiṉ pāku kāyccum poḻutu uṇṭākum puki cuṭutalāl, vayalil uḷḷa neytaṟpūkkaḷ vāṭum. erumikkaṉṟukaḷ kāytta cenneṟkatirkaḷit tiṉṟu neṭuṅkūṭṭiṉ niḻalil uṟaṅkum. cōḻanāṭṭil kulikaḷiyuṭiya teṉṉiyum, vāḻiyum, kamukum, maṇam nāṟum mañcaḷum, māvum, kulikaḷiyuṭiya paṉiyum, aṭi paranta cēmpum, muḷiyiṉiyuṭiya iñciyum mikuti. cōḻa nāṭṭu vaḷam mikunta ciṟṟūrkaḷ oṉṟukkoṉṟu aṇimiyil irukkum (pa. pāli, aṭi, 8-28).
poykiyiṉ kariyil vaḷarntuḷḷa kaṭampamarattu malarkaḷ kōti pōlak kāṇappaṭum. ammalarkaḷ intira kōpattiyotta tāti utirkkum. attātu nīr uṇṇum tuṟiyiṟpaṭiyum. anniliyil attuṟi ōviyaṉāl variyappeṟṟa ōviyam pōlak kāṭciyaḷikkum. mēl nōkki eḻukiṉṟa periya nakili otta centāmariyiṉ muki, aḻakiya mukam pōla malarum. kuṟṟamaṟṟa uḷḷaṅkiyic cātiliṅkam tōyntālaṉṉa civanta itaḻkaḷ attāmari malaril irukkum. avvaḻakiya itaḻkaḷ cūḻnta cempoṉṉāṟ ceytālotta (malarp) pīṭattilē āṇ tumpi taṉ uyirkkuk kāvalākiya iṉiya peṭiyit taḻuvikkoṇṭu uṟaṅkum; kāliyil tuyileḻuntu cīkāmaram eṉṉum paṇṇippāṭum. cōḻanāṭu ittakiya vaḷam mikunta nilam cūḻnta aciyāta kuṭiyiruppukaḷiyuṭiyatu. (ci.ā,paṭi, aṭi, 68-78).
ōymāṉāṭu
nallūriliruntu eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam variyil (neytal)
kaṭaṟkariyil uḷḷa veḷḷiya maṇalil tāḻi aṉṉampōlap pūkkum; iḷavēṉiṟkālam toṭaṅkum nāḷil cerunti malar poṉṉippōlap pūkkum; kaḻimuḷḷi nīlamaṇi pōla malarum. neṭiya tāḷiyuṭiya puṉṉi muttup pōla arumpum. kaṭaṟkari ōrattil ikkāṭciyip pārttukkoṇṭē vaṭakkiliruntu teṟku nōkki variṉ, anneytal nilattu neṭiya vaḻiyil nīlamaṇi pōlum uppaṅkaḻi cūḻnta ūrkaḷiyuṭiya eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam tōṉṟum. appaṭṭiṉattil kuḷirnta nīriyuṭiya kuḷaṅkaḷ uṇṭu (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 146-153).
eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiliruntu vēlūr variyil (mulli, pāli)
eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiliruntu vēlūr nōkkic cellum vaḻiyil avari, pavaḻam pōlap pūkkaḷik kāṭṭum; kariya arumpiṉiyuṭiya kāyāmalarkaḷ, mayiṟkaḻuttip pōlap pūkkum; mucuṭṭi, koṭṭam pōlum pūvi veḷippaṭuttum; kuliyiṉiyuṭiya kāntaḷ, kiviral pōlap pūkkum. kolli vaḻikaḷil intirakōpam eṉṉum tampalap pūccikaḷ ūrum. ittakiya mulli nilattil uḷḷatu vēlūr. aṅku eyiṉar kuṭicikaḷ irukkum. (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 164-173).
vēlūriliruntu āmūr variyil (marutam)
vēlūriliruntu āmūr nōkkic cellum vaḻiyil maruta nilakkāṭci tōṉṟum. kāñci maram ciṟiya kompukaḷiyum kuṟiya tāḷiyum uṭiyatu. ataṉkaṇ naṟiya pūkkaḷ kāṭciyaḷikkum. ciccilippaṟavi am marattaṭiyil nīr niliyiluḷḷa kayal mīṉippaṟṟa amayam pārkkum. appaṟaviyiṉ niṟam nīlamaṇi pōṉṟatu; ataṉ vāy poṉṉiṟam pōṉṟatu. atu kīḻē pāyntu kayal mīṉit taṉ alakāṟpaṟṟum poḻutu, ataṉkāl nakaṅkaḷ nīrniliyiluḷḷa tāmari ilikaḷik kiḻikkum. attāmari veṇṭāmari. avveṇṭāmari malaril uḷḷa tēṉi uṇṇak kariya vaṇṭukaḷ variciyākac cūḻum kāṭci, tiṅkaḷiccērum karumpāmpi oppattōṉṟum. ittakiya vaḷam poruntiya nilattil āmūr uḷḷatu. (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 178-188).
iṭikkaḻi nāṭu1
nāṭṭu amippu
ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi āciriyarāṉa nattattaṉār iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭiṉar. iṭikkaḻi nāṭu ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattic cērntatu; ceyyūrukkuk kiḻakkilum teṉkiḻakkilum teṟkilum kaṭaṟkariyōrattiṟparaviyuḷḷatu. innāṭṭiṉ vaṭakkut teṟku nīḷam ēṟattāḻap pattukkal kiḻakkut teṟkil akalam arikkal mutal nāṉku kal variyil uḷḷatu. iḵtu ēṟattāḻa irupattintu caturamil parappuṭiyatu. innāṭu kiḻakkil kaṭali elliyāy uṭiyatu. maṟṟa mūṉṟu pakkaṅkaḷilum paranta kaḻi veḷikaḷ amintuḷḷaṉa. innāṭṭiṉ iṭiyilum kaḻi veḷikaḷ nīṇṭu kiṭakkiṉṟaṉa. itu paṟṟiyē innāṭu iṭikkaḻi nāṭu eṉṉum peyar peṟṟatu pōlum!
iṭikkaḻi nāṭu muḻumiyum maṇal niṟintu kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. `cila āyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpu innāṭu kaṭaṟpakutiyāy iruntiruttal vēṇṭum. kaṭaliṟkontaḷippu ēṟpaṭṭu nilappakutikaḷ cila kaṭaluḷ amiḻntapōtu kaṭaṟpakutikaḷiṟcila nilamākavum māṟiyiruttal vēṇṭum. aṅṅaṉam māṟiya kaṭaṟpakutikaḷuḷ oṉṟāka ivviṭikkaḻi nāṭu iruttal kūṭum, eṉṟu aṟiñar karutukiṉṟaṉar.
maḻikkālattil innāṭṭiṉ vaṭakku, mēṟku, teṟku ellikaḷil uḷḷa kaḻi veḷikaḷ nīr nirampi innāṭu oru tīvu pōṉṟa kāṭciyi viḷikkiṉṟatu. pakkiṅkām turi ceṉṉi āḷunarāyiruntapōtu avar peyarāl kaṭalōramāka veṭṭappaṭṭa kālvāyē `pakkiṅkām kālvāy eṉpatu. atu veṭṭappaṭṭa piṉpu akkālvāy vaḻiyākap paṭakukaḷ ceṉṉikkum iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭiṟkum poruḷkaḷik koṇṭu celkiṉṟaṉa. makkaḷ celavum naṭipeṟukiṉṟatu.
cālikaḷ
iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭiṉ teṉmēṟkup pakutiyil uḷḷa kaḻiveḷiyil kālappōkkil maṇmēṭu amintu viṭṭatu. ammēṭṭup pakutiyil cāli amikkappaṭṭatu. accāli, iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭiṉuḷ iraṇṭu kal tolivu vari-iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭu veṇṇāṅkuppaṭṭu eṉṉum ciṟṟūr vari nīṭṭappaṭṭatu. maturāntakattiliruntu cūṉāmpēṭu vaḻiyāka innāṭṭiṟku mutaṉ mutal accāli virivākkappaṭṭatu. innāṭṭil ippoḻutu cālikaḷ pala amikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
ālamparikkōṭṭi
iṉṟu iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭiṉ talinakaram kaṭappākkam eṉpatu. ivvūriṉ ellikku uṭpaṭṭa kaṭaṟkari ōrattil mulīm maṉṉarāl periya kōṭṭi oṉṟu kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. kiḻakkukkariyōrattil irunta kaṭaṟ koḷḷikkārari aṭakkavē ikkōṭṭi kaṭṭappaṭṭateṉa vaḻivaḻic ceyti kūṟukiṟatu. iḵtu iṉṟu aḻinta niliyiluḷḷatu. cuṟṟuppuṟa araṇkaḷ maṭṭumē kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. cuvarkaḷ iṭintu maṇṭiya ceṭikaḷukkiṭiyil maṟintuḷḷaṉa. kutirikkoṭṭil, neṟkaḷañciyam mutaliya kaṭṭaṭaṅkaḷ pāḻaṭintuḷḷaṉa. ikkōṭṭiyiṉ parappu ēṟattāḻap patiṉintu ēkkar irukkalām. itaṉic cuṟṟilum akaḻi iruntatu. akaḻi kaṭaluṭaṉ iṇintavāṟu tōṇṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. ikkōṭṭikku arukiluḷḷa ciṟṟūr ālampari eṉpatu. ikkōṭṭi ālamparik kōṭṭi eṉṟē iṉṟu vaḻaṅkappaṭukiṟatu. itu 18ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṟ ciṟappuṟṟiruntatu. mucaparjaṅku eṉpavar tammi ātaritta pireñcukkārarkku itaṉip paricākat tantār. itu car ayarkūṭṭu eṉṟa āṅkilēyap paṭittalivarāl 1760il aḻikkappaṭṭatu. kōṭṭikkarukil taṅku viṭuti oṉṟu 1860 variyil iruntatu.1
kaḻi veḷi
iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭuk kariyōram kāñcikkuc cellum neṭuñcāli iruntamikkuriya aṭiyāḷaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. pirayāṇikaḷ taṅka vacatiyāka āṅkāṅkac cattiraṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. innāṭṭiṉ teṟkil kaṭal nīri uḷḷē koṇṭu varum kaḻi veḷi amintuḷḷatu. paṇṭikkālattil itaṉik kaṭakkap pālam oṉṟu iruntatu. aḵtu ippoḻutu iṭintu payaṉaṟṟu viṭṭatāl, makkaḷ paṭaku mūlamākavē kaḻi veḷiyik kaṭakkiṉṟārkaḷ.
viḷivum toḻilum
inta nāṭu maṇaṟpāṅkāṉa maṇ vaḷam peṟṟatu. ātalāl, iṅku mā, palā, teṉṉi, paṉi, muntiriki, cavukku maraṅkaḷē mikutiyāy vaḷarkiṉṟaṉa. nāṭṭiṉ naṭuvil uḷḷa cila iṭaṅkaḷil nel ciṟitaḷavu payirākiṟatu. puṉceyppayirkaḷuḷ kēḻvaraku maṭṭum payirākiṟatu.
innāṭṭiṉar teṉṉi paṉi ōlikaḷikkoṇṭu kīṟṟu muṭikiṉṟaṉar; taṭukkuc ceykiṉṟaṉar; teṉṉi nārikkoṇṭu kayiṟu tirikkiṉṟaṉar; patanīrik koṇṭu paṉi vellam tayārikkiṉṟaṉar; ili tikkum vēliyum ceykiṉṟaṉar; paṉiyōli maṭṭikaḷiliruntu narampukaḷi eṭuttuc ceppañceytu mēṉāṭukaṭku aṉuppukiṉṟaṉar.
innāṭṭu ūrkaḷ
iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭil pattoṉpatu ciṟṟūrkaḷ amintuḷḷaṉa. avi, muttukkāṭu, ōtiyūr, nayiṉār kuppam, mutaliyār kuppam, paṉiyūr, viḷampūr, kaṅkatēvaṉ kuppam, cēmpuli puram, kappivākkam, nallūr, karumpākkam, paḷḷampākkam, kaṭappākkam, ālampari, vēmpaṉūr, kōṭṭikkāṭu, veṇṇāṅkuppaṭṭu, tēṉpākkam, kuḷattūr eṉpaṉa. ivaṟṟuḷ ālampari eṉṉum ciṟṟūrē pakkiṅkām kālvāykkuk kiḻakkiluḷḷatu.
innāṭṭil patiṉintu toṭakka nilippaḷḷikaḷ uḷḷaṉa; uyartoṭakkappaḷḷikaḷ mūṉṟu uḷḷaṉa; kaṭappākkattil uyarnilippaḷḷi oṉṟum uḷḷatu. innāṭṭil ēṟattāḻa irupatiṉāyiravar makkaḷ vāḻkiṉṟārkaḷ.
iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭu ūrkaḷuḷ nallūr eṉpatu oṉṟu. atil vāḻntavar nattattaṉār eṉṟa pulavar. avar tam nāṭṭiṟkut teṟkilirunta ōymāṉāṭṭu aracaṉāṉa nalliyakkōṭaṉmītu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭiyip pāṭiṉār eṉpatu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭataṉṟō? avar kālam ēṟattāḻak ki.pi. 3ām nūṟṟāṇṭākum. iḵtu iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭup paḻamiyi iṉitu uṇarttuvatākumaṉṟō?
nattattaṉār piṟanta nallūril avar niṉivāka avaratu uruvaccili 18-6-1958il ceṉṉi mānila amiccar uyartiru paktavaccalam avarkaḷ talimiyil niṟuvappaṭṭatu. nattattaṉār tamatu pāṭalāl tamatu iṭikkaḻi nāṭṭukku aḻiyāppukaḻi nilipeṟac ceytuḷḷār. avar tiruppeyar vāḻka! avarip peṟṟa iṭikkaḻi nāṭu vāḻka!
cēranāṭu
periya vāyiyuṭiya erumi, mīṉkaḷ citaṟumpaṭi nīril naṭantu, vaḷaviya itaḻiyuṭiya ceṅkaḻunīrp pūvit tiṉṉum; paciya miḷakuppoṭi paṭarnta palāmara niḻalil paṭukkum. appoḻutu aṅku vaḷarntirukkum mañcaḷatu melliya ili erumiyiṉ mutukiṉit taṭavum. erumi aci pōṭumpōtu atu tiṉṟa ceṅkaḻunīrp pūviliruntu tēṉ maṇam ataṉ vāyiṟparavum. aciyiṭṭa piṉpu avverumi kāṭṭu malliki malarkaḷ paravikkiṭakkum iṭattil tuyil koḷḷum. cēranāṭu ittakiya vaḷamuṭiyatu. (ci. ā. paṭi, 41-47).
toṇṭi nāṭu
mulli nilac ciṟṟūrkaḷ
viṭattēr toṭari eṉṉum oruvaki muḷ maraṅkaḷ cūḻa vaḷarnta toḻukkaḷiyuṭiya mullinilac ciṟṟūrkaḷiṉ viṭṭu muṟṟaṅkaḷil varaku mutaliyaṉa koṭṭi vikkum kutirkaḷ irukkum. avi peṇ yāṉikaḷ niṉṟāṟpōṉṟa kāṭciyi nalkum. vīṭṭup pantaril yāṉiyiṉ kāli okkum varaku tiriki naṭappaṭṭirukkum. vēli oḻinta nāḷil vaṇṭi uruḷikaḷum kalappiyum koṭṭil cuvarmītu cārttappaṭum; erutukaḷum kaṭṭi vikkappaṭum. varaku vikkōl vēynta kūriyuṭiya vīṭukaḷ ciṟṟūrkaḷi aḻaku ceyyum (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 184-195).
neytal
toṇṭi nāṭṭu neytal nilattil uppu viḷikkappaṭṭatu; mīṉ piṭikkappaṭṭatu. kaṭaṟṟuṟippaṭṭiṉam kaṭal vāṇikattiṟ ciṟantu viḷaṅkiyatu. aṅku vāṇikattāṟciṟanta neytal nilamakkaḷ vāḻntārkaḷ (pe. ā. aṭi, 322-336)
marutam
yāḷi pāytalāl yāṉikaḷ palavum kalaṅki ōlamiṭal pōla marutanilattil karuppañcāṟṟippiḻiyum ālikaḷ oliyeḻuppum. aṅkukkaruppañcāṟṟik kaṭṭiyākak kāyccum koṭṭilkaḷ uṇṭu. pāṇar mutaliya putiyavar karuppañcāṟṟi mutalil parukalām; piṉpu karumpiṉ kaṭṭiyit tiṉṉalām. (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 207-262).
pāṇaruḷ iḻinta niliyil uḷḷavar mīṉ piṭippatu vaḻakkam. avarkaḷ tūṇṭiliṭṭu mīṉip piṭippārkaḷ. annīr nilikaḷil centāmari malarkaḷ pūkkum. avi kaṭavuḷukkuriyavi. pāṇar mutaliyavar avaṟṟip paṟittut cūṭār. cātiliṅkam pōṉṟa itaḻiyuṭiya kuvaḷimalarkaḷum nīlappūkkaḷum piṟamalarkaḷum ciṟu nīr nilikaḷil malarntu kāṇappaṭum. ūrār avaṟṟip paṟippar; vaḻippōkkarākiya pāṇar mutaliyōrkkum cūṭattaruvar (pe.ā. paṭi, aṭi, 283-296).
tōppukkuṭikaḷ
paṭṭiṉam piṟpaṭa mēlum kāñciyi nōkki vaḻi naṭappavar, vaḻiyil teṉṉantōppukaḷik kāṇpar. aṅku ural pōṉṟa yāṉiyiṉ uṭampi okkum caruccariyiyuṭiya teṅkiṉ uyarnta ōlikaḷi muṭintu vēynta maṉikaḷ irukkum. avaṟṟiṉ muṟṟaṅkaḷil mañcaḷ payirākum; vīṭṭiṟkup piṉṉē maṇam nāṟum pūntōṭṭaṅkaḷ uṇṭu. aṅku palāppaḻam, iḷanīr, vāḻippaḻam, paṉi nuṅku, vaḷḷikkiḻaṅku mutaliyaṉa uṇṇavum parukavum kiṭikkum.
cila tōppukaḷil pākku maraṅkaḷum teṉṉi maraṅkaḷum aṭarntu kāṇappaṭum. aṅkuḷḷa kuṭimakkaḷ kuṭilukku veḷiyē aṭuppu vittuc camippārkaḷ. cōṟṟiyākkum aṭuppil uḷḷa pāṉi acintu viḻumpaṭi marattiṉ mītiruntu muṟṟiya periya tēṅkāykaḷ nilattil viḻum. ittakiya tōppukaḷiyuṭiya iṭam pākkam eṉappaṭum.
pērūrkaḷum ciṟṟūrkaḷum
tōppu ūrkaḷukku appāl matil cūḻnta ūrkaḷ āṅkāṅku irukkum. avaṟṟil viṇṇiyaḷāvum māṭaṅkaḷ viḷakkamuṟṟirukkum. appāl, vaḷḷikkūttic ciṟappāka āṭum ciṟṟūrkaḷ kāṇappaṭum. (vaḷḷikkūttu eṉpatu, vaḷḷi tirumaṇam paṟṟiya naṭaṉak kaḷiyāṭṭam. itu āṇpāṟkum peṇpāṟkum potuvāy varuvatu).
tiruveḵkā uḷḷa iṭam
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa ciṟṟūrkaḷukku appāl kāñcikku arukil katiravaṉ oḷikkatirkaḷ uṭpuka iyalāta nerukkamuṭiya iḷamarac cōlikaḷ uṇṭu. aṅku ili nerukkattil kuyilkaḷ nuḻintu cellum. kurukattikkoṭi (kuṟukiya aṭimarattiyuṭiya kāñci marattic) cūḻntu paṭarum. aṅku maṇal mikuti.ammaṇaṟparappil vaṭṭamāṉa paḷḷaṅkaḷil nīr tēṅkiyirukkum. annīril kurukkatti malarkaḷ viḻuntu kiṭakkum kāṭci - appavaṇikar kariya caṭṭiyil pāluṭaṉē vēṇṭuvaṉa kūṭṭiccērtta appam pālilē kiṭappatu pōṉṟirukkum. (iṅṅaṉam pāl eṉpatu kuḻiyiluḷḷa teḷinta nīrukkum, appam eṉpatu kurukkatti malarukkum uvamiyākum).
cōliyil taṅki nīrāṭip poḻuti iṉpamākak kaḻikka virumpum āṭavarum peṇṭirum paccik kuppikaḷil uḷḷa kaḷḷip parukuvar. mātar makaravāy vaṭiviṟceyta talikkōlatti aṇivar; kuḷirnta pārviyuṭiyavar. āṭavar ammātaruṭaṉ pakaṟpoḻutu viḷiyāṭi, tuṟakkatti okkum pūmalinīrttuṟiyil iḷavēṉiṟkālattu iṉpatti nukarvar. aṅku aḻakiya pakkamaliyil yāṉi kiṭantāṟpōla pāmpaṇiyākiya paṭukkiyil perumāḷ paḷḷi koṇṭuḷḷār. (vaḻippōkkarāṉa pāṇar . attirumāli vāḻtti yāḻic ciṟitu vācittu avviṭattiṉiṉṟu celvar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 352-392).
pāṇṭi nāṭu
marutanilam
maḻi nīr pala yāṟukaḷākap perukkeṭuttuk kaḻaṉikaḷiyum maṭukkaḷiyum poykikaḷiyum piṟa nīr nilikaḷiyum nirappum. nīr nilikaḷil tāmarippū, neytaṟpū, nilappū, āmpaṟpū, mutaliya pūkkaḷ malarntu maṇam parappum. kampuṭkōḻi tāmari ilikaḷil uṟaṅkum mīṉ piṭippavar appaṟaviyiṉ uṟakkam keṭumpaṭi vaḷḷik koṭikaḷit taḷḷi vali vīci mīṉkaḷip piṭippar; avaṟṟik koṉṟu kuvittalāl, ōciyeḻum. karumpālikaḷ vēli ceyvatāl ōciyeḻum. kaḻaṉikaḷil uḻattiyar kaḷikaḷip paṟippatil ōciyuṇṭākum. mūttu valiyaṟṟa erutu cēṟṟil akappaṭum. kaḷḷuṇṭa maḷḷar ataṉic cēṟṟiliruntu appuṟappaṭuttum muyaṟciyil ōciyeḻum. nelli aṟuvaṭi ceyyum poḻutu tāḷi ariyum ōci eḻum. tirupparaṅkuṉṟattil (murukaṉukku) viḻā eṭukkum ōci eḻum. āṟukaḷil putunīr varumpoḻutu kaṇavarum maṉiviyarum cērntu nīrāṭum ōci uṇṭākum. pāṇarvīṭukaḷil mīṉkaḷ ularttappaṭum; pāṇar cilar vīṭukaḷil āṭal pāṭal oli eḻum. ivvōcikaḷ yāvum maruta nilatticcērntavi (ma. kā. aṭi, 238-270).
mulli nilam
kāṭum kāṭu cūḻnta nilamumākiya mulliyil tiṉi, eḷḷiḷaṅkāy, varaku mutaliyaṉa payirākum. kāṭṭil nuvi māṉ taṉ piṇiyōṭē tuḷḷi viḷiyāṭum. koṉṟi maraniḻalil pāṟi irukkum. paciya payirkaḷ uḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷil mucuṇṭippūkkaḷum mulli malarkaḷum utirntu parantu kiṭakkum. nīruḷḷa paḷḷaṅkaḷil nīlamaṇi pōṉṟa neytal malarkaḷ toyyiṟkoṭiyōṭu kāṇappaṭum. (ma. kā. aṭi, 271-285).
kuṟiñci nilam
malināṭṭār mēṭṭu nilattu akil cantaṉam ākiya maraṅkaḷi veṭṭi nilattip patappaṭuttit tōri nelli vitittu aṟuvaṭi ceyvar; aivaṉanel eṉṉum veṇṇilliyum payirākki aṟuvaṭi ceyvar; ivaṟṟiyum iñci mañcaḷ miḷaku mutaliya paṇṭaṅkaḷiyum kal tariyil kuvittu vippar.
ittakiya mali vaḷam ceṟinta kuṟiñci nilattil tiṉikkatirik kotta varum kiḷikaḷi ōṭṭum ōci orupāl kēṭkum; avarittaḷirit tiṉṉum āmāvi ōṭṭakkāṉavar ceyyum āravāram orupālkēṭkum. kuṟavaṉāl tōṇṭappaṭṭa mūṭiṉa vāyiyuṭiya poyk kuḻiyilē viḻum āṇ paṉṟiyik koṉṟatāl uṇṭāṉa āravāram maṟṟoru pāl kēṭkum. vēṅkip pūkkaḷip paṟikkum kuṟappeṇkaḷ `puli-puli eṉṟu kūṟum āravāram piṟitorupāl kēṭkum. puli paṉṟiyit tākkik kollum ōci vēṟorupāl kēṭkum. ivvōcikaḷ ellām nīrōṭum kālkaḷiyuṭiya pakka malikaḷiṟcūḻntu maliyiṭattē māṟimāṟi olikkum. (ma. kā. aṭi, 281-301).
vēṉiṟkuṉṟam (kōṭi mali)
mūṅkiliṟpiṟanta neruppup paciya tūṟukaḷic cuṭum. ataṉāl, yāṉikaḷ avviṭatti viṭṭu akalum. neruppiṉāl tuḷiyuṇṭa mūṅkilkaḷ kāṟṟuppukuvatāl vācciyakkārar vācciyatti vācittāṟpōṉṟa ōciyi uṇṭākkum. malippiḷavukaḷil ūkampul nirampa vaḷarntirukkum. kukikaḷil cūṟāvaḷikkāṟṟup pukunta kāṟṟu mikunta kaṭal pōla olikkum. innilikaḷiyuṭiyatu vēṉiṟkuṉṟam.
pāli nilam
nīr vaḷamaṟṟatu pāli nilam. pāli nilamakkaḷ vaḻippaṟiceytu piḻippavarkaḷ. avarkaḷāl annila vaḻiyē cellum nāṭṭu makkaḷiṉ uṭimikkum uyirukkum tīṅku nēriṭum. ātaṉāl, aracaṉ āṟali kaḷvarālēṟpaṭum tuṉpattip pōkka nāṭu kāvalari niyamippatu vaḻakkam. (ma. kā. aṭi, 302-310).
neytal nilam
pāṇṭi nāṭṭu neytal nilam kaṭal vāṇikacciṟappuṭiyatu. kaṭal kaṭanta nāṭukaṭku muttu, caṅku, palavēṟu paṇṭaṅkaḷ, veḷḷuppu, karumpiṉ vellam kūṭṭip poritta puḷi, mīṉ uṇakkal,pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ ākiyavaṟṟik kappalkaḷ pāṇṭi nāṭṭiliruntu ēṟṟic cellum. akkappalkaḷ kutirikaḷi iṅku iṟakkumati ceyyum. ikkaṭal vāṇikattāl nāṭu vaḷam peṟṟirukkum. (ma. kā. aṭi, 315-325).
pāṇṭi nāṭṭil mēlē collappaṭṭa kuṟiñci, pāli, mulli, marutam, neytal eṉṉum aintu kūṟukaḷiyuṭiya nilaṅkaḷum uṇṭu. vācciyaṅkaḷ muḻaṅkum tirunāḷ nilipeṟṟa terukkaḷiyum, tuṇaṅkik kūttiyum kuravikkūttiyum maṇam vīcukiṉṟa parattiyar cēriyiyum putu varuvāyiyum uṭiya akaṉṟa ūril paḻaṅkuṭimakkaḷ neruṅki vāḻvārkaḷ. ittakiya ūrkaḷ pala pāṇṭi nāṭṭil uṇṭu (ma. kā. aṭi, 326-331).


naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭu
maliyaṭivāram
`naṉṉaṉukkuriya malināṭṭi (cavvātu malit toṭari)c cērnta aṭivārappakutiyil kolli nilaṅkaḷ mikuti. akkollikaḷil mucuṇṭik koṭiyil malarkaḷ vāṉattiluḷḷa kārttiki mīṉ pōla veṇmiyāka malarum. eḷḷukkāykaḷ uḷḷē ney koḷḷumpaṭi vaḷarum. tammil viḷiyāṭipporukiṉṟa yāṉikkaṉṟukaḷiṉ oṉṟōṭu oṉṟu cērnta kikakaḷip pōlat tammiṟpiṇiyum katirkaḷiyuṭiya tiṉi muṟṟum. avarikaḷ muṟṟiṉa tayiriṉatu pitircci pōlum pūkkaḷ utirntu arivāḷip pōṉṟa vaḷinta kāykaḷik koḷḷum. varakukaḷ, tarukkam ceyvōṉ kiyiṭattu iṇinta viralkaḷiyotta iraṭṭitta katirkaḷ muṟṟum. malarkaḷ mikunta kāṭṭil maḻiyāl vaḷam peṟṟa mūṅkil nel aval iṭikkum paruvatti aṭiyum. nilatti uḻāmal kaḷikkoṭṭāl paṇpaṭuttappaṭṭa nilattil vitikkappaṭṭa veṇciṟukaṭuku neruṅki viḷiyum. oruvarāl paṇṇappaṭāta iñcippāvikaḷ (pommi pōlum kiḻaṅkukaḷ) naṉku vaḷarntu mutirntu uṟippik koḷḷum. koḻumi vāynta koṭiyiṉiyuṭiya kavali, valiya peṇyāṉiyiṉ maṭitta muḻantāḷiyokkumpaṭi, kuḻikaḷil cemmiyāy vaḷarntu muṟṟum.
maliyi vēlkuttutal pōla- maliccāralil vaḷarntu vāḻiyiṉ pūkkaḷ maliyik kuttiṉāṟpōla vaḷarntirukkum. vāḻikkāy neruṅkiṉa kulikaḷ paḻuttuk kaṉiyum. perumūṅkil nel muṟṟip payaṉpaṭattakka niliyil irukkum. kālamallāk kālattilum nilacciṟappāl payaṉit tarum maraṅkaḷ payaṉik koṭukkum. kāṟṟu vīciṉ nāval maraṅkaḷ tammaṭiyilē kiṭakkum pāṟikaḷiṉ mītu nāvaṟpaḻaṅkaḷi utirkkum. viṭāytta kālattil vāynīr ūṟutaṟkuk kāraṇamāṉa uyavik koṭinīr tēṭa vēṇṭātapaṭi mikutiyākap paṭarum. kūvikkiḻaṅkukaḷ poṭiyākum niliyil muṟṟittiraḷum. māmpaḻaṅkaḷiṉ cāṟumikuntu uṇpāri vēṟoṉṟiṟ cellavoṭṭāṭal taṭukkum. āciṉip palāppaḻaṅkaḷ veṭittu vitikaḷi veḷiyiṟcintum. pērāntikaḷ ciṟupaṟi muḻakkamiṭutal pōla muḻakkamiṭum neṭiya malippakkattil, mikka maḻiyip peṟṟu vaḷam peṟṟa palāmaraṅkaḷil paḻukkum palāppaḻaṅkaḷ vaḻiccellum kūttaruṭiya mattaḷaṅkaḷ pōlat toṅkit tāḻntirukkum.
vayalkaḷil aivaṉa nellum veṇṇellum pālkaṭṭic ciṟitu muṟṟik kāṟṟum aṭittamiyāl naṉṟāka viḷintirukkum. iṉiya kōlākiya karumpu, tōṭu kaviḻtalōṭu taṇṭu tiraṇṭu naṉku vaḷarntu, kāṟṟiṉāṟ cāyntu, karumpāliyiṟ ceṉṟu payaṉpaṭattakka paruvattil irukkum. neytal, karumiyē vaṭivu koṇṭāṟpōla malarntirukkum. tīyiyotta ceṅkāntaḷ malariṉatu muki maḻiyāl vaḷamuṟa vaḷarum. paruntu ataṉic catiyeṉṟeṇṇi eṭuttuc ceṉṟu, alakāl kīṟippārttuk kīḻē pōṭṭuviṭum. ammalariṉ itaḻkaḷ pāṟitōṟum cintikkiṭattal veṟiyāṭukaḷatti niṉivūṭṭum. ittakiya cūḻniliyaminta malippakkam maṇam ceyta maṉi pōlak kāṭciyaḷikkum. ammalippakkatil ciṟukuṭi (ciṟṟūr) irukkum. (malipaṭu. aṭi, 97-151).
ariya vaḻi
malimītu palarum pōkum paḻakkamāṉa pātiyum, paḻakkamaṟṟa pātiyum uṇṭu. paḻakkamaṟṟa pātiyil nilappiḷavukaḷ kāṇappaṭum. appiḷavukaḷ cilavaṟṟil pāmpukaḷ irukkum. vaḻiccelvōr appāmpukaḷi maṉattāṟkuṟittal ceyvar; koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷ variṉ, marattil ēṟik koḷvar. viṟaliyar pāmpukaḷit toḻuvar; vilaṅkukaḷ kiṭakkum neṟiyi viṭṭu vilaki valappakka vaḻiyi vaḻiyākac ceytukoḷvar. mali mītuḷḷa tiṉippuṉaṅkaḷi yāṉikaḷ cūṟiyāṭum. uyarnta paraṇil uḷḷa kāṉavaṉ, kiyik koṭṭik kavaṇ kaṟkaḷi vīcuvāṉ. akkaṟkaḷ paṟavikaḷ uyiriyum vilaṅkukaḷ uyiriyum pōkka vallavi ātaliṉ, yamaṉi oppavi. avi ōciyuṭaṉ kuṟitavaṟātu virinta varum. vaḻippōkkar akkaṟkaḷukkut tappa maraṅkaḷiṉ piṉ niṟpārkaḷ.
vaḻiyil kāvaṟkāṭukaḷ irukkum. akkāṭṭic cūḻnta akaḻiyil yāṉiyi viḻuṅkum mutalikaḷ irukkum. oruvar akaḻiyil iṟaṅkutal aritu; akaḻiyiliruntu karikku ēṟutalum aritu. appātiyil maraṅkaḷiṟ cuṟṟikkiṭakkiṉṟa koṭikaḷip paṟṟupkōṭākak koṇṭu kāl vaḻukkalit tavirntu tappa vēṇṭum; oruvari oruvar pātukāttuc cella vēṇṭum. maliyarukku aṭarntu vaḷarnta pakkamaliyil vīḻntōri maṟikkum āḻamuṭiya kuḷaṅkaḷukka arukil pāci paṭarntirukkum. ataṉmītu kāl vippavar vaḻukki viḻuvar. avvaḻi pōtaṟka arumiyuṭiyatu. mēlum tuṇintu celpavar, vaḻi muḻumiyilum piṉṉi vaḷarnta nuṇṇiya kōlkaḷiyuṭiya ciṟumūṅkilōṭu vēḻattiṉ melliya kōlkaḷiyum paṟṟukkōṭākap piṭittuc cella vēṇṭum.
naviramali-kāriyuṇṭikkaṭavuḷ
aṅṅaṉam ceṉṟa piṉpu naviramaliyi aṭiyalām.aṅkup paḻiya kōṭṭiyuṇṭu. tūcip paṭiyiṉar maḻi pōlap poḻiyum ampukaḷiyuṭiyavar. aṅku maṭuvuḷḷa āṟṟaṅkariyil ōr ūr uṇṭu. ammaliyil oru kōvil uṇṭu. akkōvilil kāriyuṇṭikkaṭavuḷ (civaperumāṉ) uḷḷār. aṅku eppoḻutum maḻi peyvatāl kūttar tam icikkaruvikaḷi uṟikaḷiliruntu veḷiyē eṭuttu icikkāmal, iṟivaṉi vaḻipaṭṭuc cella vēṇṭum. aṅṅaṉam cellukiyil mayilkaḷ tōkiyi virittu āṭikkoṇṭirukkum; mūṅkil marakkiḷikaḷil āṇ kuraṅkukaḷ pāyntu viḷiyāṭum; tēruruḷ pōlat tēṉ iṟālkaḷ āṅkāṅkuk kāṇappaṭum. vaḻippōkkar ivaṟṟip pārppiṉ, avar pōkum kuṟukiya pāti tavaṟiviṭum; ātalāl, vaḻimēl viḻi vittuc cellavēṇṭum (malipaṭu. aṭi, 193-241).
kāṭṭu vaḻi
aṅṅaṉam cellumvaḻi kāṭṭiṉuḷ celvatu. aṅku uyarnta marakkiḷikaḷil paraṇ amittukkoṇṭu kāṉavar kavaṇ kalluṭaṉ iruppar; villiyum ampiyum koṇṭiruppar. avaruḷ oruvaṉ eyta ampiṉāl tākkuṇṭa kāṭṭuppaṉṟi, ciṟitu tolivu ōṭi iṟakkum. atu kiḻaṅkukaḷi akaḻntu tiṉṟamiyāl ataṉ kompukaḷil aḻukkup paṭintirukkum.
vaḻiyil viḻuntukiṭakkum periya maraṅkaḷi otta malippāmpukaḷ kiṭakkum. vaḻippōkkar avvaḻiyi viṭṭu vēṟu vaḻiyiṟcella vēṇṭum. mēlum, vaḻiyil āṅkāṅkē neṭuñtolivu maṇam vīcum malarkaḷum paḻaṅkaḷum kāṇappaṭum. avi teyvaṅkaḷukku uriyavi. avaṟṟi aṇukalākātu. vaḻiyil ālamarattil pala vakip paṟavikaḷ kūṭi iṭum ōci pala icikkaruvikaḷ icippatupōla irukkum. attakiya iṭaṅkaḷi ellām kaṇṭukoṇṭē cellalām.
vaḻiyil maraṅkaḷ aṭarnta kuṟuṅkāṭu uṇṭu. ñāyiṟṟiṉ veḷiccam ataṉkaṇ paṭutal aritu. tici teriyāmal mayaṅkum irākkālamāyiṉum, villiyēntic cuḻaṉṟu tiriyum iyalpuṭiya kuṟavarum mayaṅkum kuṉṟam aṅku uṇṭu. avvaḻiyiṟcellāmal tavirtal vēṇṭum. ucci maliyiliruntu iṉiya ōciyuṭaṉ aruvikaḷ iḻiyum. kāṭukaḷik kāttu varum kāṉavar ammalimītu iruppar. avarkaḷ vaḻippōkkariṉ iṭarittīrkka virivar; uṇpataṟku iṉiya paḻaṅkaḷiyum cūṭuvataṟku iṉiya pūkkaḷiyum kāṭṭuvar; iṭiyūṟu mikka vaḻikaḷil muṉ naṭantu ceṉṟu vaḻikāṭṭuvar; avarkaḷ mēlum kūṟum vaḻiyi uṭkoṇṭu vaḻippōkkar pōvatu nalam payakkum.
pala vaki ōcikaḷ
pakkamalikaḷ putiya vaḻippōkkarkkut tali mayakkatti uṇṭākkum. aṅkuk kuṟiyavum neṭiyavumāṉa kuvaṭukaḷ kāṇappaṭum. avaṟṟil muṟippaṭi iṟaṅka vēṇṭum; avaṟṟiṉ iṟakkattil malarkaḷ kiṭakkum iṭattil taṅki iḷip pāṟalām. aṅku iḷippāṟum pōtu malippakutikaḷi liruntu pala vaki ōcikaḷ kēṭkum.
naṉṉaṉatu akaṉṟa iṭattiyuṭiya mali, makaḷir āṭutaṟkēṟṟatum muḻavu kaṇṇuṟakkam aṟiyātatum ākiya akaṉṟa ūriṭattiṟkoṇṭa tirunāḷip pōlac ciṟantirukkum. ittakiya ciṟappukaḷiyuṭiya periya mali vaḻiccellum viṟaliyar, kuṟiñcippaṇṇip pāṭuvar; kūttar aṅkuṟiyum teyvaṅkaḷi vēṇṭik koṇṭu mēlum vaḻinaṭappar. (malipaṭu. aṭi, 242-360)
mēlum mali vaḻi
vaḻiyil maḻittuḷikaḷ paṭalām. uṭaṉē pāṇar kūttar mutaliya vaḻippōkkar pakkattil uḷḷa malikkukikaḷuḷ ceṉṟu otuṅkuvar. vaḻikaḷil nīr tēṅkiya paḷḷaṅkaḷ irukkum. kōli ūṉṟik koṇṭu paḷḷattil kāl aḻuntātapaṭi viḻippuṭaṉ vaḻi naṭattal vēṇṭum. cila iṭaṅkaḷil kāynta vēl pōlak kūrmiyum cūṭum poruntiya kaṟkaḷikkoṇṭa pāṟikaḷ irukkum. avviṭaṅkaḷil māli nērattil cella vēṇṭum.
vaḻiyil naṉṉaṉuṭiya yāṉit tiraḷiyuṭiya araṇkaḷ irukkum. avvaraṇkaḷiṟ piṉṉi vittāṟ pōṉṟa koṭikaḷ neruṅkiya ciṟukāṭukaḷ uṇṭu. acciṟukāṭukaḷil ciṟiya vaḻikaḷ uṇṭu. avvaḻikaḷil irumaruṅkum vaḷarntuḷḷa marakkiḷikaḷ, vaḻiccelpavar mukattil aṭippaṉapōla vaḻiyi maṟittuk koṇṭirukkum. avaṟṟi nīkki muṉ celpavaṉip piṉpaṟṟi ovvoruvarum muṟiyākac cella vēṇṭum. yāṉikaḷ tammuṭ cērntu porutāṟpōṉṟa tōṟṟattuṭaṉ pāṟikaḷ oṉṟōṭoṉṟu piṇintu kāṇappaṭum. avviṭattup periya kāṭukaḷ uṇṭu. apperiya kāṭukaḷil pakivaruṭaṉ pōriṭṭu uyir tuṟanta naṉṉaṉuṭiya vīrarkaṭku naṭappaṭṭa kaṟkaḷ uṇṭu. ovvoru kallilum vīraṉuṭiya peyarum pukaḻum poṟikkappaṭṭirukkum. avvaḻic cellum kūttarum pāṇarum annaṭukalliṉ teyvaṅkaḷ makiḻa yāḻi vācittup pāṭiccelvar.
cilar vaḻiyaṟiyāmal tavaṟāka naṭattaṟkariya nilattiṟ ceṉṟu mīṇṭu vantu, piṉ varum putiyavarum avvāṟu ceṉṟu mīḷātapaṭi pala vaḻikaḷum kūṭiṉa cantiyik kiyāl tuṭittu aṭiyāḷamāka ūkampulli muṭintiṭṭu vippar. vaḻiyil marāmara niḻalil vīrarporuṭṭu naṭappaṭṭa kaṟkaḷ irukkum. naṉṉaṉuṭaṉ poruntāta pakivar irukkum nilaṅkaḷum mikappalavākum. tattam ūrkaḷiliruntu niṉippiṉum tali naṭuṅkavikkum curamum aṅku uṇṭu. `tēṉ corikiṉṟa kaṇṇiyiṉiyum poruḷ koṭuttuk kavinta kiyiyum uṭiya taṉakkeṉṟu oru poruḷum pēṇāta naṉṉaṉik kāṇac celkiṉṟōm. eṉṟu kūṟum pāṇar mutaliya putiyavarkaḷ, pakivar ūrkaḷilum naṉmatippiyum upacarippiyum peṟuvar. puliyāṟkollappaṭṭa taṉ peṇ māli niṉittu varunti āṇ māṉ kūppiṭum. kāṭṭik kaṭappiṉ mullinilam kāṇappaṭum. (malipaṭu. aṭi, 361-405).
iṭiyar kuṭiyiruppukaḷik kaṭantu maṟunāṭ kāliyil vaḻi naṭakkumpoḻutu kūriya ampiṉiyum koṭiya villiṉiyum uṭiya nāṭu kākkum vēṭarkaḷ etirppaṭuvārkaḷ; naṉṉaṉiṭam cellataṟkuriya vaḻiyik kāṭṭuvārkaḷ. putiyavar avvaḻiyē celvatu nallatu.
avvaḻiyil tēṉuṇṭāka malarnta marāviṉ pūṅkottukaḷum yām pūkkaḷum kāṇappaṭum. avaṟṟi ularnta maral nārilē taḷirkaḷōṭu neruṅkak kaṭṭip putiyavar cūṭikkoḷvar; parukkik kaṟkaḷiyuṭiya mēṭṭu nilattil uḷḷa paḷḷaṅkaḷil maḻi nīr taṅkiyirukkum. putiyavarannīrik kuṭittu, vaḻikkup payaṉpaṭa mukantu celvar. ammēṭṭu nilattil cila ūrkaḷ uṇṭu. ovvōr ūrilum pullāl vēynta kuṭilkaḷ irukkum. aṅku uṇṭu uṟaṅkiya putiyavar viṭiyaṟkālattil puḷ nimittam pārttut tam celaviṉi mēṟkoḷvar (malipaṭu. aṭi, 405-448).
maruta nilam
naṉṉaṉatu kuḷirnta maruta nilattiyuṭiya nāṭu, kāñci maraṅkaḷ, melliya viḷinilaṅkaḷ, poḻilkaḷ, paḷḷikaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟiyuṭiyatu. annāṭṭu ūrkaḷ kuṭi nīṅkātavi; pāṇar mutaliya muttamiḻ vāṇarip pala nāḷum pātukākka vallavi.
nelliyaṟukkum uḻavar, payirkaḷukkiṭiyē maṟintuvāḻum paṟavikaḷi veruṭṭappaṟi muḻakkuvar. avvōciyik kēṭṭa āṇ erumi veruvit taṉ iṉattiṉiṉṟum pirinta vaḻippōkkarmītu pāyum. cēyāṟṟu nīr paḷḷamāṉa iṭattil viḻumpōtu nīril pala kumiḻikaḷ tōṉṟum. avyāṟu oḻiviṉṟi ōṭikkoṇṭirukkum. atu kāṇpavar kaṇṇukku iṉiya kāṭciyi nalkuvatu. `makkaḷ ataṉ oru kariyi vaḻiyākak koṇṭu ceṉṟu, naṉṉaṉatu talinakarāṉa ceṅkaṇmāvi aṭivar (malipaṭu. aṭi, 449-477).
naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭu
kūttari āṟṟuppaṭuttum kūttar talivaṉ mutalil naṉṉaṉ cēy naṉṉaṉatu koṭic ciṟappik kūṟukiṟāṉ; piṉpu naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭil ciṟanta kāvali uṭiya naviram eṉṉum maliyiyum aṅkuk kōyil koṇṭu kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷi (nīlakaṇṭaṉ eṉṉum peyarkoṇṭa civaperumāṉip) paṟṟiyum kūṟukiṟāṉ; piṉṉar naṉṉaṉuṭiya muṉṉōr ciṟappik kuṟikkiṉṟāṉ. ivi aṉittiyum muṉṉuriyākak kūṟiya attalivaṉ, piṉpu muṟiyē tari vaḻiyiyum mali vaḻiyiyum kūṟukiṟāṉ; iṟutiyil, `mali vaḻiyē cellumpōtu naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭil tōṉṟi varum cēyāṟu etirppaṭum. ataṉ oru kari vaḻiyē ceṉṟu naṉṉaṉatu talinakari aṭika, eṉṟu kūṟukiṟāṉ.


naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭu etu?
naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭu etu eṉpati aṟiya malipaṭu kaṭāttil iraṇṭē kuṟippukaḷ irukkiṉṟaṉa. oṉṟu, cēyāṟu; maṟṟoṉṟu, naviramali. cēyāṟu naṉṉaṉuṭiya malikaḷil tōṉṟippāyvateṉak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. `cēyāṟu eṉpatu iṉṟu `ceyyāṟu eṉṟu vaḻaṅkappaṭukiṟatu. atu vaṭavārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭattiluḷḷa cavvātu malittoṭariṉ vaṭakkil tōṉṟit teṟku nōkki malikaḷilēyē pāyntu varuvatu. cēyāṟu cavvātu malikaḷiliruntu tali vaḻiyē ēṟattāḻa āṟu allatu ēḻukal tolivil varum vaḻiyil ataṉ teṉ kariyil ceṅkam (ceṅkammā) eṉṉum ūr amintuḷḷatu. avvūrc civaṉ kōvilil patiṉoru kalveṭṭukaḷ irukkiṉṟaṉa. avi ki.pi. patiṉōrām nūṟṟāṇṭu mutal patiṉāṟām nūṟṟāṇṭu variyil appakutiyi āṇṭu vantu cōḻar, pāṇṭiyar, vicaya nakara maṉṉar kālattuk kalveṭṭukaḷākum. avaṟṟuḷ oru kalveṭṭu naviramali eṉṉum peyari mikat teḷivākak kuṟikkiṉṟatu. ataṉik kīḻē kāṇalām.
`āṭiyūr nāṭṭu eliyūṟṟukku mēṟkum.... uḷḷiṭṭa nāṭum maliyum aṭivāramum teṉkari nāṭu mūvari veṉṟa nallūrkku mēṟkum ciṟṟiṅkikkuk kiḻakku uṭpaṭṭa nāṭum maliyuṭ uṭpaṭṭuṭ nāṭum inta iraṇṭu kari nāṭṭukku uṭpaṭṭa nāṭṭavaruṭ nāṭṭu nāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum maṉṟāṭuvārkaḷum piḷḷi mutalikaḷum (taṉi) yāḷkaḷum paṭi nāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum taṉiyāḷ mutalikaḷum..... kūvic cēvakarum konta viccātirarum naviramalit teṉpaṟṟu nāṭṭavarum nāṭṭu mutalikaḷum vaṭamali nāṭṭavarum nāṭṭu mutalikaḷum vaṭamali nāṭṭavarum nāṭṭu mutalikaḷum uḷḷuppaṭṭa pala caṉattōmum aṭivārattu maliyāḷarum maliyāḷa mutalikaḷum mutunīr maliyāḷamum maliyaraṇ mutalikaḷum ceṭṭikaḷum vāṇikarum kaṇakkarum karumapperumpaṉṉāṭṭavarum paṉṉāṭṭu mutalikaḷum poṟko(ṟṟa) kikku (kāḷarum āṇ) ṭārkaḷum civappiramāṇarum maṉṟāṭikaḷum uvaccarum teṉkari nāṭṭu vaṭatali nāṭṭavarum teṉmali1 nāṭṭārum uṭpaṭṭa nāṭṭavarum tella ... pulava(ru)m paṇṇuvārum niyāyattārum paṉṉiraṇṭu paṇimakkaḷumuḷḷiṭṭa perum vēṭarum pāṇarum paṟiyarum paṟi mutalikaḷum cakkiliyarum iruḷarum uḷḷiṭṭa aṉittuc cātikaḷum.2
malipaṭukaṭāttukku uri eḻutiya nacciṉārkkiṉiyar avvuriyiṉ iṟutiyil,
`iraṇiya muṭṭattup peruṅkuṉṟūrp peruṅ kucikaṉār palkuṉṟak kōṭṭattuc ceṅkaṇmāttu vēḷ naṉṉaṉ cēy naṉṉaṉip pāṭiya malipaṭukaṭām eṉṟu kuṟittuḷḷār.
tañcic cōḻar, maturi nāyakkar eṉṟārpōla, ceṅkaṇmāttu naṉṉaṉ eṉpatil varum `ceṅkaṇmā eṉpatu naṉṉaṉatu talinakaram eṉap poruḷpaṭum. `kaṇmāy eṉpatu `kammāy eṉṟu maruvi vaḻaṅkutal pōlac `ceṅkaṇmā eṉpatu `ceṅkammā eṉṟu kālappōkkil vaḻaṅkalāyiṟṟu eṉpati aṟiyalām. atu piṉṉum `ceṅkammā eṉṟum, `ceṅkimā eṉṟum ceṅkam eṉṟum civaṉ kōyil kalveṭṭukaḷil poṟikkap paṭṭuḷḷatu.
``ceṅkamā uṭiyar tiruiṭavattuṟi
nāyaṉārkkuc ceṅkimā teṉpiṭāki1
āraṇ vaṭṭattiluḷḷa tēvikāpuram mutal pōḷūr vaṭṭamum ceṅkam vaṭṭamum palkuṉṟak kōṭṭattic cērnta pakutikaḷ eṉpatit tēvikāpuram kalveṭṭukaḷum2 kalacappākkam kalveṭṭukaḷum3 naviramaliyi aṭutta paḷḷattākkiluḷḷa vīralūrk kalveṭṭukaḷum4 piṟavum5 uṇarttukiṉṟaṉa.
itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa pala vakic cāṉṟukaḷāl cavvātu malikaḷ naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭic cērntavi eṉpatum, ammalit toṭariṉ teṟkil cēyāṟṟiṉ teṉkariyil amintuḷḷa iṉṟiya ceṅkam allatu ceṅkammā eṉṉum ūrē paḻiya ceṅkaṇmā eṉpatum, ivaṟṟic cūḻavuḷḷa nilappakutiyē naṉṉaṉatu nāṭu eṉpatum teḷivātal kāṇka.
cavvātu malikaḷ
cavvātu malittoṭar vēlūrukkut teṉmēṟkil ēṟattāḻa ēḻu kal tolivil toṭaṅkit tirupputtūr vaṭṭattiṉ teṉkiḻakkuk kōṭi variyil (ciṅkāram pēṭṭik kaṇavāy eṉṉum iṭam variyil) nāṟpatu kal nīḷam paraviyuḷḷatu; kiḻakku mēṟkil ēṟattāḻap pattukkal nīḷam amintuḷḷatu. immalit toṭar vēlūr, pōḷūr, ceṅkam, tirupputtūr ākiya nāṉku vaṭṭaṅkaḷil paraviyuḷḷatu. immalit toṭar pala nilikaḷi uṭiyatu. ovvoru niliyilum malivāṇar vāḻum cīṟūrkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. cavvātu malikaḷiṉmītu 138 cīṟūrkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. immalittoṭaric cuṟṟilum aṭivārattil cila āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ vari aṭarnta kāṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. kālappōkkil pātikaḷ amikkavum ūrkaḷ amikkavum kāṭukaḷ aḻikkappaṭṭaṉa. āyiṉum, kuṟuṅkāṭukaḷ cila iṉṟum āṅkāṅku irukkiṉṟaṉa. nīṇṭa maliyaṭivārap pakutiyil āṅkāṅkuc ciṟṟūrkaḷum irukkiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟuṭ cila, pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷāy iruntu varupavi eṉpatu appakutiyiluḷḷa kalveṭṭukaḷāl1 aṟiyappaṭum uṇmiyākum.
malivaḻi
paricu peṟṟa kūttaṉ, putiya kūttaṉukku mutalil tari vaḻiyik kūṟukiṟāṉ; piṉpu malimītu cellum vaḻiyik kūṟukiṟāṉ; aṅkup palarum pōkāta vaḻiyiyum kuṟippiṭukiṟāṉ. piṉṉar, naviramaliyil2 irunta tūcip paṭiyiyum kōṭṭiyiyum kuṟippiṭukiṉṟāṉ;3 aṅku irunta kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷ (civaperumāṉ) kōvilik kuṟippiṭukiṉṟāṉ; piṉpu maliyiluḷḷa kāṭṭu vaḻiyik kuṟikkiṉṟāḷ. avaṉ mēlum mali vaḻiyik kūṟum poḻutu mulli nilak kōvalar vāḻum ciṟṟūrkaḷiyum avarkaḷ viruntu pōṟṟutaliyum viḷakkamākak kūṟukiṉṟāṉ;4 ataṉ piṉṉar marutanilac ceḻumiyik kūṟi appakutiyil cellum cēyāṟu eṉṉum āṟṟik kuṟippiṭukiṉṟāṉ;2 ataṉ oru kariyi vaḻiyākak koṇṭu ciṟitu tolivu celliṉ naṉṉaṉatu talinakari aṭiyalām eṉṟu vaḻi kūṟi muṭikkiṉṟāṉ.
naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭup paṭattikkoṇṭu (vaṭa ārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭap paṭattik koṇṭu) kūttar talivaṉ kūṟum vivaraṅkaḷ poruntumāṟṟi ārāyiṉ, ēṟattāḻa oru vaḻiyik kaṇṭaṟiyalām. avaṉ kuṟippiṭum mutal maliyē parvatamali eṉṉum naviramali. atu mūlikkāṭṭu maliyiliruntu vaṭakkilum kiḻakkilum teṟkilum veḷiyē taṉippaṭa amintuḷḷatu. mēṟkil ataṉ oru ciṟupakuti mūlikkāṭṭu maliyuṭaṉ oṭṭikkoṇṭu irukkiṟatu. acciṟu pakuti vaḻiyākavē evarum naviramaliyiliruntu mēl ticiyil cavvātu malikaḷukkup pōtal iyalum.
naviramalikku vaṭakkil ēṟattāḻa nāṉkukal tolivil `periya mali irukkiṉṟatu. ataṟku mēṟkil toṭaṅkum mūlikkāṭṭu mali teṟkāka vaḷintu piṟaku teṉkiḻakkākat tirumpip parvatamaliyōṭu poruntiyuḷḷatu. immūlikkāṭṭu malikku mēṟkil cēyāṟu variyil irukkum malippakuti teṉmali eṉṟa peyar peṟum. atil ūrkaḷ pala uṇṭu.
periyamalikkum parvatamalikkum iṭippaṭṭa nilappakutiyil pala ciṟṟūrkaḷ1 irukkiṉṟaṉa; kuṟuṅkāṭukaḷum uṇṭu. muṉpu aṭarnta kāṭukaḷ iruntaṉa eṉṟum piṉpu avi kālappōkkil aḻikkappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟum, avviṭaṅkaḷil putiya ūrkaḷ amikkappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟum avvūrkaḷil uḷḷa mutiyavar urikkiṉṟaṉar. iṅṅaṉam ippakutiyil amintirunta kuṟuṅkāṭukaḷuḷ oṉṟil nam kūttar talivaṉ kūttar kuḻuvik kaṇṭirukkalām. kūttarkuḻu, avaṉ coṟpaṭi, aṅkiruntu tari vaḻiyē pala ūrkaḷik kaṭantu parvatamalimītu ēṟik kāriyuṇṭikkaṭavuḷi vaḻipaṭṭu, ammali mītē mēṟku nōkkic ceṉṟu, mūlikkāṭṭu malippakutiyi aṭintu, piṉpu teṉmalippakuti ūrkaḷ vaḻiyē ceṉṟu, cēyāṟṟiṉ kariyi aṭintirukkalām. piṉṉar ataṉ oru kari vaḻiyē ēṟattāḻap pattukkal tolivu naṭantu, naṉṉaṉatu kōnakaramāṉa ceṅkaṇmā eṉṉum ūric cērntirukkalām.2
7. toṇṭi nāṭṭu ūrkaḷ
ciṟṟūrkaḷ
pāli nilattil eyiṉar vāḻnta kuṭikaḷik koṇṭa ciṟṟūrkaḷ iruntaṉa. nāṭu kāval puriyum eyiṉar vāḻnta araṇkaḷ āṅkāṅku iruntaṉa. mulli nilattil varaku vikkōlāl vēyappaṭṭa kuṭilkaḷik koṇṭa āyartam ciṟṟūrkaḷ amintiruntaṉa. marutatti aṭutta mulli nilac cīṟūrkaḷ vaḷattuṭaṉ kāṇappaṭṭaṉa. marutanilattil uḻuvittuṇṇum vēḷāḷar vāḻnta vaḷamaṉikaḷiyum uḻutuṇṇum vēḷāḷar vāḻnta illaṅkaḷiyum koṇṭa ūrkaḷ aṅkaṅku amintiruntaṉa. marutanilattuk kuḷaṅkaḷilum ērikaḷilum mīṉ piṭittu vāḻnta valiyar, kuṭicikaḷil vāḻntaṉar. avartam ciṟṟūrkaḷ cila iruntaṉa. teṉṉantōppu māntōppukaḷukku iṭiyil cīṟūrkaḷ pala iruntaṉa. aṅkirunta vīṭukaḷiṉ muṟṟaṅkaḷil mañcaḷ payir ceyyappaṭṭatu. vīṭukaḷukkup piṉ puṟam maṇam nāṟum pūntōṭṭaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. aṅkup palāvum, vāḻiyum, paṉi maraṅkaḷum iruntaṉa. cila cīṟūrkaḷil pākku maraṅkaḷum teṉṉi maraṅkaḷum vaḷarntaṉa.
maṟiyavar uṟipati
toṇṭi nāṭṭut tuṟimukanakaramāṉa paṭṭiṉattukkuc ciṟitu tolivil maṟiyavar vāḻnta ūr oṉṟu iruntatu. appatiyil maṟiyavar maṉikaḷ iruntaṉa. vīṭṭiṉ muṉ puṟattil pantal iṭappaṭṭiruntatu. appantaliṉ kālkaḷuḷ oṉṟil pacukkaṉṟu kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntatu. avvīṭu pacuviṉ cāṇattāl meḻukappaṭṭiruntatu. avvīṭṭiṉar tam vīṭṭukkiḷikku vēta ōciyik kaṟpittaṉar.aṅku vāḻnta maṟiyavar vētamantiraṅkaḷi ōtiṉar. avartam illakkiḻattiyar aruntatiyip pōṉṟa kaṟpuṭiyavar; nalla tōṟṟatti uṭiyavar.
`nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉṉum ūr
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa maṟiyavar patikku appāl nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉṉum ūr iruntatu. aṅku irunta nīruṇṇum tuṟiyil makaḷil nīrāṭiṉar. ammakaḷir pōkaṭṭuppōṉa poṉṉāṟcoyta makarak kuḻiyic ciccilippaṟavi taṉakkuriya iriyeṉa eṇṇip paṟavikaḷ niṟintuḷḷa paṉimarattukkup pōkāmal, antaṇaratu yākacāliyil naṭattappaṭṭa vēḷvik kampattiṉ mītu taṅkiyatu.
kaṭaṟṟuṟippaṭṭiṉam
`nīrppeyaṟṟu eṉṉum ūriṉ elliyil tuṟimukam1 amin tiruntatu. aṅku mēṟṟici nāṭukaḷiliruntu pāl pōlum veḷḷiya niṟattiṉiyuṭiya kutirikaḷ kappalkaḷiliruntu iṟakkumatiyāyiṉa; vaṭa ticiyiliruntu nukarappaṭum poruḷkaḷ iṟakkumatiyāyiṉa. attuṟimuttil pala kappalkaḷ kuḻumiyiruntaṉa.
attuṟimukatti aṭuttup paṭṭiṉam oṉṟu iruntatu. aṅkup paṇṭa cāli iruntatu. atu mikka kāvali uṭiyatu. pala terukkaḷil paratavar vāḻum uyarnta māṭaṅkaḷiyuṭiya illaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. appaṭṭiṉattil āṭṭukkiṭāyuṭaṉ cuḻaṉṟu tiriyum timilar illaṅkaḷum iruntaṉa. vāṉattittoṭum uyaramāṉa māṭaṅkaḷik koṇṭa maṉikaḷum iruntaṉa. avi vaṇikar vaḷa maṉikaḷ. ammāṭattu makaḷir pēraṇikaḷi aṇintavar; paciya maṇikaḷ kōtta vaṭaṅkaḷiyuṭiyavar; melliya tukili uṭuttavar. ammakaḷir, malimītu maṉaveḻucciyuṭaṉ āravārikkum tōki mayilkaḷ pōla ulāviṉar; poṟcilampukaḷ āravārippa nūlāl varitaliyuṭiya panti aṭittu viḷiyāṭiṉar. ittakiya celvanakarattil kaḷ viṟkum iṭaṅkaḷil paciya koṭikaḷ aṭiyāḷamākak kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. muṟṟattil teyvattiṟku malarkaḷ tūvappaṭṭiruntaṉa. kaḷḷic camikkum makaḷir vaṭṭilkaḷik kaḻuviṉa nīr orupāl paravik kuḻampāyiruntatu. accēṟṟil peṇ paṉṟikaḷum avaṟṟiṉ kuṭṭikaḷum kiṭantaṉa.
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa tuṟimukattil kalaṅkari viḷakkam kāṇappaṭṭatu. atu tēvar ulakukku muṭṭukkālāka ūṉṟi vitta paṟṟukkōṭu pōla viṇṇittoṭum aḷavu ōṅkiyiruntatu. ataṉmītu cāntiṭṭa māṭam amintiruntatu. ataṉmītu ēṟuvataṟku vacatiyāka ēṇi cārttappaṭṭiruntatu. am māṭattil irākkālattil viḷakkuk koḷuttappaṭṭatu. tuṟi teriyātu nekiḻntu vēṟu tuṟikku ōṭum kalaṅkaḷi `itu nam tuṟi eṉṟu aḻikkum muṟiyil viḷakku erintu koṇṭiruntatu.


kacci mānakaram
kacci mānakaram tāmari malar pōṉṟa amippuṭiyatu. ataṉic cuṟṟilum akaḻi iruntatu. akaḻiyiccūḻak kāvaṟkāṭu iruntatu. kacciyil cōlikaḷ iruntaṉa. tērkaḷ palakāl ōṭikkuḻitta kāṭciyiyuṭiya neṭiya terukkaḷum vēṟupala terukkaḷum iruntaṉa. paṇṭaṅkaḷi viṟkavum vāṅkavum aminta periya kaṭitteru iruntatu. valimiyum pukaḻum mikunta paṭikaḷ iruntaṉa. annakaril pala camayattārum toḻattakka kōvilkaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil viḻākkaḷ naṭipeṟṟaṉa. annakaram, paḻattiṉ iṉimiyāl uyarttic collum palā marattip pōla, pala camayattārum naṭattum viḻākkaḷāl ulakattu nakaraṅkaḷuḷ ciṟantu viḷaṅkiṉatu. annakarattilirunta tiriyaṉatu araṇmaṉi vāyil, paricilarkku aṭiyātatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 393-411).
naṉṉaṉ talinakar-ceṅkaṇmā
naṉṉaṉatu nāṭu toṇṭināṭṭic cērntatu. vaṭavārkkāṭṭu māvaṭṭattil uḷḷa cavvātu malittoṭarē naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭu. ammaliyiṉ teṟkil iṉṟuḷḷa `ceṅkam eṉṉum ūrē naṉṉaṉ kālattil `ceṅkaṇmā eṉappaṭṭatu. atu naṉṉaṉ kālattil periya nakaramāyiruntatu; kuḷirnta neṭiya poḻilkaḷiyuṭiyatum; mika ōṅkiya matilik koṇṭatu; tirunāḷ eṉṟu kūṟumpaṭi āravārattōṭu makkaḷ pōvatum varuvatumāy irunta ciṟanta periya kaṭitteruviṉi uṭiyatu; mali eṉṟu collumpaṭi uyarntu akaṉṟa māṭaṅkaḷip peṟṟatu; yāṟu eṉṟu collumpaṭi aminta periya terukkaḷi uṭiyatu; pala kuṟun terukkaḷiyum uṭiyatu; celvam mikkatu.
annakaril naṉṉaṉ araṇmaṉi ciṟantu viḷaṅkiyatu; araṇmaṉi vāyil, vēlēntiya vīrarāl kākkappaṭṭatu; avvaraṇmaṉiyil periya muṟṟam iruntatu. ammuṟṟattil malivāṇarāl naṉṉaṉukkuk kāṇikkip poruḷkaḷākak koṇṭuvarappaṭṭa uyiriṉaṅkaḷum paḻam kiḻaṅku mutaliyaṉavum vikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. naṉṉaṉ, taṉatu nāḷōlakka maṇṭapattil cāṉṟōruṭaṉum amiccar paṭittalivar mutaliyōruṭaṉum iruntu aracu celuttiṉāṉ; pulavar mutaliyōrkkup paricil nalkiṉāṉ (malipaṭu. aṭi, 477-531).
caṅkakālak kacci mānakar
veḵkāvum cōlikaḷum
paricil peṟṟa perumpāṇaṉ vaṟiya pāṇaṉukkuk kacci nakarattiṟkuc cellum vaḻiyip piṉ varumāṟu kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ:
``pala ūrkaḷiyum kaṭanta piṉpu aḻakiya pakka maliyil kaḷiṟu paṭuttiruppatu pōlap pāmpaṇiyākiya paṭukkiyil tirumāl paḷḷikoṇṭuḷḷāṉ. anta iṭattil katiravaṉ oḷikkatirkaḷ uṭpuka muṭiyāta nerukkamuṭiya iḷamarac cōlikaḷ uṇṭu. aṅku ili nerukkattāl kuyilkaḷ nuḻintu cellum. kuṟukkattikkoṭi, kuṟukiya aṭimarattiyuṭiya kāñci marattic cūḻntu paṭarum. aṅkē maṇal mikuti. am maṇaṟparappil vaṭṭamāṉa paḷḷaṅkaḷil nīr tēṅkiyirukkum. annīril kurukkatti malarkaḷ viḻuntu kiṭakkum kāṭci, appavaṇikar kariyacaṭṭiyilē pāluṭaṉē vēṇṭuvaṉa kūṭṭic cērtta appam pālilē kiṭappatu pōṉṟirukkum.
``cōlikaḷil taṅki nīrāṭip poḻuti iṉpamākak kaḻikka virumpum āṭavarum peṇṭirum paccik kuppikaḷil uḷḷa kaḷḷip parukuvar. mātarār makaravāy vaṭiviṟceyta talikkōlatti aṇintavar; kuḷirnta pārviyi uṭiyavar āṭavar ammātarāruṭaṉ pakaṟpoḻutu viḷiyāṭi, tuṟakkatti okkum tappāmal nīr varum muṟimiyiṉiyuṭiya pūmali nīrttuṟiyil iḷavēṉiṟkālattu iṉpatti nukarvar. vaḻippōkkarāṉa nīṅkaḷ aṅkuḷḷa tirumāli vāḻtti, yāḻic ciṟitu vācittu avviṭattiṉiṉṟu celluṅkaḷ.
``ataṉik kaṭantavuṭaṉ kāvaṟkāṭu teriyum. ataṟku appāl kacci mānakarattuk kōṭṭi matil amintirukkum. (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 371-405).
perumāḷ paḷḷikkoṇṭiruppatākap perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiya kōvil tiruveḵkā eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār.
icceytikaḷ tiruveḵkā eṉṉum iṭam vēṟu kacci mānakaram vēṟu eṉpatit teḷivākat terivikkiṉṟaṉa eṉpatu kavaṉikkattakkatu. mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa vivaraṅkaḷi vittukkoṇṭu, veḵkāviyum caṅka kālak kāñciyiyum kaṇṭaṟivatu namatu kaṭamiyākum


veḵkā
nacciṉārkkiṉiyar tiruveḵkā eṉṟu colvatu. iṉṟuḷḷa yatōttakāri eṉṉum perumāḷ kōvilākum. aṅkup perumāḷ paḷḷikkoṇṭa kōlattil uḷḷār.
``pāmpaṇip paḷḷi amarntōṉ āṅkaṇ
eṉpatu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi (aṭi, 373).
``pāntaṉ pāḻiyil paḷḷi virumpiya
vēntaṉic ceṉṟu kāṇṭumveḵkāvuḷē
eṉpatu ki.pi. 8ām nūṟṟāṇṭil vāḻnta tirumaṅki maṉṉaṉ pāṭal (periya tirumoḻi, 10-1-7) ākum.
ipperumāḷ kōvilukkarukil veḵkā eṉṟa vēkavati āṟu1 pāyntu koṇṭiruntatu. avyāṟu ippoḻutu teṟkil mūṉṟarip parlāṅku tūram taḷḷip pāykiṟatu. āṟṟiṉ peyar avyāṟu pāynta iṭattil aminta kōvilukkup peyarākiyatu pōlum! veḵkāk kōvil paṟṟiya kīḻ varum varalāṟu kūṟappaṭukiṟatu:
piramaṉ, iṉṟu tiruveḵkā eṉṉum kōviluḷḷa iṭattukkarukil tavam ceytukoṇṭiruntāṉ. attavattik keṭukka virumpiya avaṉ maṉiviyāṉa kalimakaḷ, veḵkā eṉṉum āṟṟu vaṭivattil vantu tōṉṟiṉāḷ. āṟṟu veḷḷattik kaṇṭu kavali koṇṭa piramaṉ, avveḷḷattit taṭukkumpaṭi tirumāli vēṇṭiṉāṉ. tirumāl āṭiyaṟṟa kōlattil aṅkut tōṉṟi aṇiyip pōlap paḷḷi koṇṭār. taṉ māmaṉāriṉ ceyalikkaṇṭa kalimakaḷ, nāṇit taṉ pōkki māṟṟikkoṇṭāḷ. aṉṟu tirumāl paḷḷi koṇṭa iṭamē iṉṟu kōvilāy iruppatu. ikkati kāñcittala varalāṟṟil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.2
muṟkālattil veḵkā āṟu iṉṟuḷḷa viḷakkoḷip perumāḷ kōvil teru vaḻiyākak kiḻakku nōkkip pāyntu yatōttakāri kōvilukkut teṟkil ceṉṟatākak kūṟappaṭukiṟatu. atteruppakkam uḷḷa kiṇaṟukaḷil uḷḷa nīr maṭṭum veḵkā eṉṟa vēkavati āṟṟunīriṉ cuviyip peṟṟuḷḷatu eṉṟu appakuti makkaḷ iṉṟum kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ. atteruviṟku vaṭakkilum teṟkilum peyyum maḻi nīr muḻumiyum atteruviṉ vaṭaciṟakiṉ piṉpakkam vaḻiyākavē kiḻakku nōkki ōṭi yatōttakāri kōvilukkut teṟkiluḷḷa ōṭiyil kalantuviṭuvati iṉṟum kāṇalām.1 ituvē paḻiya vēkavati pāynta vaḻi eṉṟu ūrār urikkiṉṟaṉar. ippakutiyil tōṇṭum iṭameṅkam maṇalik kāṇalām. perumpāṇaṉ, `iṭiviṭātu nīr vantu koṇṭirukkum pūmali peruntuṟi eṉṟatu vēkavatiyāṟṟiṉ kariyil aminta nīrttuṟiyiyātal vēṇṭum.2
yatōtkāri perumāḷ kōvilukku mēṟkil uḷḷa viḷakkoḷip perumāḷ kōvil terup pakutiyiyum vaṭamēṟkil uḷḷa irācāci mārkkeṭṭu, ataṉi aṭuttuḷḷa tumpivaṉatteru mutaliya pakuti kaḷiyum koṇṭa nilam, eṇpatāṇṭukaḷukku muṉpuvariyil maraṅkaḷ aṭarnta pakutiyāy iruntatu. perum pāṇaṉ cila cōlikaḷi varuṇittu aṅkup paḷḷi koṇṭa perumāḷ kōviliyum kuṟittiruppatāl, avaṉ kuṟitta cōlikaḷ ippakutiyilētāṉ iruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu teḷivu.
kaccippēṭu
tiruveḵkāk kōviluḷḷa iṭam mutaṟparāntakaṉ kālattil (ki.pi. 907-953) kaccippēṭu eṉa vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu.3 `pēṭu eṉpatu nakarattiṉ veḷip pakutiyi (puṟanakari)k kuṟippatākum. pēṭu eṉṉum iccollē kālappōkkil pēṭṭi eṉa māṟiyatu pōlum! iṉṟuḷḷa putuccēri nakarattiṟku veḷiyil iraṇṭu pakkaṅkaḷilum uḷḷa ciṟṟūrkaḷ `muttiyāluppēṭṭi eṉṟum `mutaliyār pēṭṭi eṉṟum peyar koṇṭiruttal itaṟkēṟṟa cāṉṟākum. iṅṅaṉamē tirunelvēli nakarattiṟku veḷiyil `pēṭṭi eṉṉum puṟanakar amintiruttalum nōkkattakum. ceṉṉik kōṭṭikku veḷiyil cintātirippēṭṭi, muttiyālupēṭṭi, cukārpēṭṭi, pettunāyakkaṉ pēṭṭi, vaṇṇārappēṭṭi, taṇṭiyār pēṭṭi eṉṉum pakutikaḷ amintuḷḷamiyum iṅku niṉikkattakum. iṉṟuḷḷa ciṟiya kāñcīpurattiṟkuk kiḻakkil nācarattuppēṭṭi, aiyaṉ pēṭṭi, nāyakkaṉ pēṭṭi eṉṉum ciṟṟūrkaḷum, periya kāñcīpurattiṟku vaṭakkilum vaṭa mēṟkilum pañcuppēṭṭi, oli mukammatu pēṭṭi mutaliya pēṭṭikaḷum iruttal kavaṉikkattakum.
kaccippēṭu eṉpatu kacci nakarattiṟkup puṟanakar eṉṟu poruḷpaṭum. ikkaccippēṭu, perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭi pāṭappaṭṭa caṅka kālattilum iruntatu eṉpatik kaccippēṭṭu naṉṉākiyār, kaccippēṭṭu iḷantaccaṉār, kaccippēṭṭup peruntaccaṉār eṉṉum vaḻakkāṟu koṇṭu naṉkaṟiyalām. ivaṟṟikkoṇṭu kacci vēṟu kaccippēṭu vēṟu eṉpatu aṟiyattakum.
iṉṟuḷḷa kāñcīpuram - periya kāñcīpuram, piḷḷiyār pāḷiyam, aṭkṣaṉ (Hudgson) pēṭṭi, ciṟiya kāñcīpuram eṉap pala pirivukaḷāyp pirintuḷḷatu. aṭksaṉ pēṭṭip pakutiyilētāṉ tiruveḵkā amintuḷḷatu. periya kāñcipurattiluḷḷa ēkāmparēcuvarar kōvil, mutalām ātitta cōḻaṉ kālattil (ki.pi. 880-907) kaccippēṭṭil amintiruntatu.1 periya kāñcīpurattup puttērit teruvil uḷḷa kaccapēcuvarar kōvil, kaccippēṭṭic cērntateṉṟu mutalām irācarācaṉ kālattuk (ki.pi. 985-1012) kalveṭṭu oṉṟu terivikkiṉṟatu.2 ataṟkuc ciṟitu vaṭakiḻakkil uḷḷa ulakaḷanta perumāḷ kōvil (ūrakam) eṉpatum kaccippēṭṭic cērntatu eṉpatum uttama cōḻaṉ (ki.pi. 969-985) kalveṭṭil kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.3 mutaṟparāntakaṉ kālattil (ki.pi. 907-955) kayilācanātar kōvil kaccippēṭṭup periya tirukkaṟṟaḷi eṉappaṭṭatu.4 mutalām irācarācaṉ makaṉāṉa mutalām irācēntiraṉ (ki.pi. 1012-1044) veḷiyiṭṭa tiruvālaṅkāṭṭuc ceppēṭukaḷil ikkaccippēṭu, `eyiṟkōṭṭattu eyil nāṭṭu nakaram kaccippēṭu eṉṟu kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.1
`kacci neṟik kārikkāṭu eṉpatu tiruveḵkāvukku vaṭakiḻakkil kolli veḷiyiluḷḷamēṭṭup pakutiyākum. aḵtu iṉṟu `tirukkāli mēṭu eṉa vaḻaṅkappaṭukiṟatu. appakutiyum kaccippēṭṭic cērntatē eṉṟu mutalām irācēntiraṉ kālattuk kalveṭṭuk kūṟukiṉṟatu.2 uttama cōḻaṉ kālattil cōḻar araṇmaṉi kaccippēṭṭilētāṉ iruntatu.3 ciṟiya kāñcīpuram cōḻar kālattil `attiyūr eṉa vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu. aḵtu, `eyiṟkōṭṭattu eyil nāṭṭu attiyūr eṉa vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu.4 aḵtu akkālattil kāñci nakarattiṉ pakutiyaṉṟu eṉpatu itaṉāl teḷivākum.
kacciyip paṟṟip perumpāṇaṉ coṉṉa vivaraṅkaḷiyum, kāñci nakarappaṭattiṉ utaviyāl mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa kaccippēṭṭic cērnta kōvilkaḷ uḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷiyum niṉiviṟkoṇṭu pārttāl, perumpāṇaṉ kālattuk kacci mānakaram ēkāmparēcuvar kōvil  kaccapēcar kōvil, ulakaḷanta perumāḷ kōvil ākiya kōvilkaḷukkuk kiḻakkilum, yatōttakāri kōviluḷḷa pakutikkum tirukkāli mēṭṭukkum vaṭakkilum amintiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟu karutuvatu poruttamākum.
ikkarutti uṟutippaṭutta mēlum cāṉṟukaḷ uṇṭā?
nakarattukku veḷiyil iliṅkaṅkaḷ
kāñciyiliruntu arakkōṇam cellum iruppup pātikku vaṭakkilum kiḻakkilum ūraṟṟa veḷiyiṭattil civaṉ kōvilum iliṅkaṅkaḷum iruppati iṉṟum kāṇalām. puki vaṇṭi niliyattiṟku vaṭamēṟkil uruttira kōṭīcuvarar kōvil uḷḷatu. appuki vaṇṭi niliyattukku vaṭakiḻakkil mallikit tōṭṭattil āṟaṭi uyaramuḷḷa iliṅkam uḷḷatu. ataṟkut teṉkiḻakkil uḷḷa iṭukāṭṭil periya iliṅkam oṉṟu uḷḷatu. inta iliṅkattiṟkut teṉkiḻakkil ēṟattāḻa arikkal tolivil kāñci ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu iruppuppātiyi aṭuttu vaṭakkil irukkum karumput tōṭṭattil oru periya iliṅkam uḷḷatu. ataṟku nērkkiḻakkil ēṟattāḻa munnūṟu aṭit tolivil iraṇṭu iliṅkaṅkaḷum, cilikaḷ cilavum, kōvil aṭippaṭiyum uḷḷaṉa. innilappakuti iṉṟu nel vayalkaḷāyum karumput tōṭṭaṅkaḷāyum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu. ippakutikku vaṭakkil vayalkaḷum paṉantōppum irukkiṉṟaṉa. ivaṟṟukkuk kiḻakkil periya ēri oṉṟu amintuḷḷatu. atu `toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapurattu ēri eṉṟu collappaṭukiṟatu. ipparanta iṭam toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapuram eṉappaṭukiṟatu.1 āyiṉum, iṅku ūr illi.2 ippakutiyil uḷḷa nel vayalkaḷ paḷḷattil uḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟi aṭuttu āṟaṭi uyarattil karumpu payirākiṟatu. ippakuti mēṭṭup pakuti; patiṉintu āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ iluppit tōppāy iruntatu. piṉṉarē immēṭṭiṉ oru pakuti paṭippaṭiyāyk karikkappaṭṭu nel viḷinilamākkappaṭṭatu.
toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapuram
kāñci-ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu irayil pātikkut teṟkil vayalkaḷum, āṅkāṅku mēṭukaḷum, ammēṭukaḷukkiṭiyil nāṉku periya nīrnilikaḷum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. iraṇṭu nīr nilikaḷukku iṭippaṭṭa mēṭṭuppakuti `tirukkāli mēṭu eṉṉum peyar peṟṟuḷḷatu. immēṭṭil oru ciṟṟūr amintuḷḷatu. ataṉ naṭuvil periya civaṉ kōvil irukkiṉṟatu. atu ki.pi. 7ām nūṟṟāṇṭil `kacci neṟik kārikkāṭu eṉṟu tēvārattiṟkūṟappaṭṭaḷḷatu. appakuti kāric ceṭikaḷ mikuntirunta kāṭṭup pakutiyāy iruntataṉāl ippeyar peṟṟatu.1 muṉ coṉṉa nāṉku nīr nilikaḷuḷ mūṉṟu, tirukkāli mēṭṭuc ciṟṟūric cērntavi. eñciya `tāmarik kuḷam eṉṉum nīr nili, muṉpu kūṟappaṭṭa toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapurattic cērntatākum.
ēṟattāḻap pukivaṇṭi niliyattiliruntu kāñci ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu iruppuppātiyi vaṭakkut teṟkāka oṭṭiyuḷḷa pakutikaḷ aṟamaṇañcēri eṉṟu vaḻaṅkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. aṟamaṇaṉ cēri eṉpatu caṅkakāla `aṟavaṇaṉ eṉṟa puttat tuṟaviyiṉ peyarāl aminta cēri eṉṉalām.2 appakutikkuk kiḻakkiluḷḷa muṉ coṉṉa akaṉṟa veḷi muḻumiyum toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapuram eṉṟa ūr mutiyavar urikkiṉṟaṉar. annilappakutiyil mikap paḻiya kālattil ūr iruntu, kālappōkkil aḻintu viṭṭatu eṉṟu urikkiṉṟaṉar. āyiṉum, aḵtu eppoḻutu aḻintatu eṉpatu evarālum kūṟu iyalavilli.
aṟamaṇañcērik kaṇakkappiḷḷi, ``ippakuti muḻumiyum aṟamaṇañcēriyic cērntatē ākum. itaṉ kiḻakkiluḷḷa ēriyiṉ peyar, `toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapuram ēri eṉpatu,  eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟār.3 ivviru kūṟṟukkaḷiyum nōkka, aṟamaṇañcēriyi aṭuttut toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapuram iruntu, avvūr aḻinta piṟaku avvūrppakutiyum ataṉic cārnta viḷi nilaṅkaḷum toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapuram eṉṟē iṉṟaḷavum potumakkaḷāl vaḻaṅkappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉa. avvūr iṉṟu illāmiyāl ataṟkuriya nilappakutiyi makkaḷ vāḻum aṟamaṇañcēriyōṭu cērttu araciṉar piṟkālattil oṉṟākavē amittuk koṇṭaṉar eṉpavaṟṟi eḷitil aṟiyalām.
iṉṟu iliṅkaṅkaḷ uḷḷa tōṭṭaṅkaḷum vayal veḷikaḷum paṇṭikkālattil kacci mānakarattup pakutiyāy iruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatit teḷivāka uṇaralām. puki vaṇṭi niliyattilum toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapuram eṉṉum nilappakutiyilum paṇṭikkāla maṭpāṇṭac citivukaḷ iruppati iṉṟum kāṇalām. aṟamaṇañcēri eṉpatu, iṉṟuḷḷa aracāṅka maruttuva niliyam, mātā kōvil, marāmattu ilākkāvic cērnta taṅku viṭuti ivaṟṟic cērnta nilappakuti mutal, muṉpu kūṟappaṭṭa toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapurattu ēri variyil uḷḷa nilappakutiyākum. iḵtu ēṟattāḻa oṉṟarikkal cama caturamāṉatu eṉṟu aṟamaṇañcērik kaṇakkappiḷḷi kūṟukiṟār.
caṅkakālak kacci mānakaram
innilap pakutikkut teṟkil yatōttakāri kōvil amintuḷḷatu. aṅkuḷḷa, ``perumāḷi vaḻipaṭṭuc celliṉ, kacci nakarkkōṭṭiyiṉ kāvaṟkāṭu teriyum; appāl kōṭṭi matil amintuḷḷatu. matiluḷ kacci nakaram amintuḷḷatu,  eṉṟu perumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. eṉavē, avaṉ kuṟippiṭṭa nakaram muṉpu collappaṭṭatu pōla ulakaḷanta perumāḷ kōvilukkuk kiḻakkil toṭaṅki, mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapurattu ērivariyil paraviyiruntirukkalām; ataṉ teṉpakuti iṉṟuḷḷa tirukkāli mēṭṭiṟka vaṭakkil amintirukkalām eṉṟu karutuvatu poruttamākum. intac cāṉṟukaḷ aṉittum caṅkakālak kacci nakaram evviṭattil iruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpati naṉku meyppikkiṉṟaṉa eṉṟu karutalām. toṇṭimāṉ cōḻapuram eṉṉum peyarum immuṭiviṟku araṇ ceyvatākak koḷḷalām.1
mātaviyiṉ makaḷāṉa maṇimēkali kacci akanakarik kaṇṭu, iḷaṅkiḷḷi amitta puttar kōvilip paṇintu nakarattiṟkuk teṉmēṟkil irunta pūmpoḻiliṟ ceṉṟu taṅkiṉāḷ. ``avaḷ kacciyil taṅkātu, tarumatavaṉattil taṅkiyuḷḷāḷ, eṉṟu araciyal aluvalaṉ maṉṉaṉiṭam urittāṉ.1
iṅṅaṉam avaṉ kuṟitta iṭam itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa caṅkakālak kacci mānakarkkat teṉmēṟkil irunta (perumpāṇaṉ kuṟippiṭṭa) cōlikaḷuḷ oṉṟākalām. itu poruntuvatāyiṉ, `caṅkakālak kacci eṉṟu mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa iṭatti maṇimēkali eṉṉum kāviyamum uṟutippaṭuttukiṟateṉṟu kūṟalām.


veḵkā nati
iṉṟuḷḷa pōkku
caṅka kālattilum pallavar kālattilum veḵkā eṉap peyar peṟṟa nati piṟkālattil vēkavati eṉappaṭṭatu. inta vēkavati āṟu iṉṟuḷḷa kāñcīpurattiṉ teṉmēṟku vaḻiyāka vantu nakarattiṉ teṉṉelliyāy amintuḷḷatu. iṉṟuḷḷa itaṉ pōkku nīṇṭa kālamāy iruntu vantatā eṉpatu iṅka āyvukkuriyatu.
