6. naḷḷi
`naḷḷi pōril ciṟantavaṉ; neṭiya koṭumuṭikaḷip peṟṟa mali nāṭṭi uṭiyavaṉ; paricilar nāṭōṟum illaṟam naṭattap poruḷutavi purintavaṉ, eṉṟu naḷḷi eṉṉum vaḷḷalippaṟṟic ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi ceppukiṉṟatu (aṭi, 103-107).
pāṭiya pulavar
vaṉparaṇar eṉṟa pulavar ivvaḷḷaliṉmītu pāṭiya mūṉṟu pākkaḷ puṟanāṉūṟṟil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. akanāṉūṟṟil paraṇar (152), kapilar (238) eṉṉum pulavar iruvar ivaṉip pāṭiyuḷḷaṉar. kuṟuntokiyil kākki pāṭiṉiyār nacceḷḷiyār ivvaḷḷalatu mulli nilattip pāṭiyuḷḷār (210).
naḷḷi nāṭu
maturikkut teṟkiluḷḷa mali nāṭṭil oru pakuti ivvaḷḷalukku uriyatāy iruntatu eṉṟu koḷḷalām. annāṭṭil naḷḷi eṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ ōr ūr iṉṟum uḷḷatu. ivaṉatu nāṭu `kaṇṭīra nāṭu eṉappaṭṭatu. ataṉāl, ivaṉ `kaṇṭīrakkō eṉappaṭṭāṉ. ivaṉatu nāṭṭu malittoṭaril aruvikaḷ ōciyuṭaṉ kīḻ nōkki vantukoṇṭirukkum. (puṟam. 148).
ivaṉatu nāṭṭu mulli nilattil iṭiyar ney urukkiṉar. kākki pāṭiṉiyār nacceḷḷiyār anta neyyip pukaḻntu parāṭṭiyuḷḷār (kuṟun. 210). ivaṉatu maliccarivil cōlikaḷ mikkiruntaṉa. am maliccarivil kāntaḷ malarkaḷ piṟa malarkaḷum nalla maṇatti nalkiṉa (akam. 152).
koṭic ciṟappu
vaṉparaṇar eṉṟa pulavar vaṟumiyāl vāṭiṉār. avar, tam cuṟṟattuṭaṉ puṟappaṭṭu naḷḷiyiṉ kaṇṭīra nāṭṭil naṭantu ceṉṟār; oru nāḷ vaḻinaṭi varuttattāl oru palāmarattaṭiyil amarntiruntār. appoḻutu naḷḷi akkāṭṭiṟku māṉ vēṭṭikku vantiruntāṉ. avaṉ kālil kaḻalum taliyil maṇikaḷ patitta oru nakiyum aṇin tiruntāṉ. avaṉik kaṇṭa pulavarum uṭaṉ ceṉṟōrum eḻuntu niṉṟaṉar. avaṉ avarkaḷi irukkumpaṭi ki kavittāṉ; taṉ kiyilirunta tīkkaṭi kōlāl tī mūṭṭiṉāṉ; attīyil tāṉ vēṭṭiyil koṉṟa vilaṅkiṉ ūṉi vatakkiṉāṉ; ataṉip pulavarkkum avaruṭaṉ vantavarkkum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ. avarkaḷ uṇṭu, maliccāralil oḻukiya aruvi nīrip paruki ayarvu nīṅkiṉārkaḷ.
`naḷḷi eṉṟa avvaḷḷal, pulavari nōkki, yām kāṭṭu nāṭṭiṭattēm. empāl vili matippuṭiya naṉkalam vēṟu illi, eṉṟu kūṟit taṉ mārpil aṇintirunta muttumāliyiyum kiyil aṇintirunta kaṭakattiyum koṭuttāṉ. pulavar avaṉatu vaḷḷaṉmiyi viyantu, aiyaṉē, nīvir yār? namatu nāṭu etu? eṉṟu viṉaviṉār. avaṉ patil collātu ceṉṟu viṭṭāṉ. avvaḻiyil vantōr pēcikkoṇṭē coṟkaḷāl, avaṉ tōṭṭi mali nāṭṭiṟku uriya talivaṉ naḷḷi eṉpatip pulavar uṇarntār; tām avaṉik kaṇṭu paricil peṟṟa nikaḻcciyi oru ceyyuḷākap pāṭi makiḻntār (puṟam. 150).
ippulavar perumāṉ naḷḷiyiṉ koṭit taṉmiyil uḷḷattip paṟikoṭuttār; naḷḷi, niṉatu taḷarcci illāta valiya muyaṟciyāl ākiya naccappaṭum celvatti yām vāḻttuvōm. nī, nāḷ tōṟum nalla aṇikaḷiyum kaḷiṟukaḷiyum niṉṉi nāṭi varum paricilarkku aḷippavaṉ. uṉatu vaḷḷaṉmiyik kaṇṭu viyanta ematu nā, piṟarkku vaḻaṅkum perumiyillāta aracarip poyyākap pukaḻum puṉmiyi aṟiyavilli (puṟam. 148).
ippulavar, naḷḷi, nī vāḻvāyāka! kāliyil marutap paṇṇum māliyil cevvaḻippaṇṇum icittaṟkuriyavi. niṉṉāl utavappaṭṭa pāṇar, inta ici marapi maṟantu, cevvaḻiyik kāliyilum marutatti māliyilum muṟi piṟaḻntu icikkiṉṟaṉar. niṉatu koṭitiṟam avari ammuṟimiyi maṟakkac ceytatu! (puṟam. 149) eṉṟu naḷḷiyiṉ koṭit taṉmiyip palapaṭap pārāṭṭi makiḻntār.
naḷḷi iḻikkappaṭṭa poṉ nakikaḷiyum neṭiya tērkaḷiyum kaḷiṟukaḷiyum paricilarkku vaḻaṅkupavaṉ eṉṟu kapilar pārāṭṭiyuḷḷār (akam. 238).
`Ú® ah®? eṉṟu vaṉparaṇar kēṭṭa kēḷvikkut tāṉ iṉṉavaṉ eṉṟu collātu ceṉṟa avaṉatu aṭakkamum, yām kāṭṭu nāṭṭiṭattōm; emmāl viliyuyarnta aṇikaḷit tara iyalātu, eṉṟu kūṟit tāṉ aṇintirunta aṇikaḷik koṭutta avaṉatu taṉṉalamaṟṟa ceykiyum avaṉi vaḷḷalkaḷ eḻuvaruḷ oruvaṉākkiṉa. apperumakaṉ taṉatu koṭicciṟappāl pulavar ulakil aḻiyāc ciṟappip peṟṟāṉ.
vaḷḷalkaḷ eḻuvarkkum piṉ vanta kumaṇaṉip pāṭiya peruñcittiraṉār, naḷḷi, ācippaṭṭut taṉṉi niṉintu varuvāratu vaṟumi toliya vaḻaṅkiyavaṉ; taṉ pakivarit turattiyavaṉ, eṉṟu naḷḷiyiṉ vaṇmiyiyum vīrattiyum pārāṭṭiyuḷḷār (puṟam. 158).
7. ōri
muṉṉuri
ōri eṉpavaṉ curapuṉṉi maraṅkaḷiyum kuṟiya maraṅkaḷiyum koṇṭa nalla nāṭukaḷik kūttarkku vaḻaṅkiyavaṉ; kāri eṉṟa kutiriyiyuṭiya kāriyuṭaṉ ōri eṉṟa kutiriyik koṇṭu malintavaṉ. itu ōriyip paṟṟic ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi kūṟum ceytiyākum (aṭi, 107-111).
ikkūṟṟikkoṇṭu ivaṉ enta nāṭṭi āṇṭu vantāṉ eṉpatum, ivaṉuṭiya koṭittaṉmiyum vīramum piṟavum aṟiyak kūṭavilli. āyiṉ, ivaṉ iyalpukaḷip paṟṟik kaḻitiṉ yāṉiyār (puṟam.204), vaṉparaṇar (puṟam. 152, 153) eṉpavar pāṭiyuḷḷaṉar. ivaṉip paṟṟiya kuṟippukaḷ akanāṉūṟu naṟṟiṇi, kuṟuntokip pāṭalkaḷil (paraṇar, kapilar, pālattaṉār, kallāṭaṉār eṉpavar pāṭalkaḷ) kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivi aṉittiyum koṇṭu ivaṉatu varalāṟṟi iṅkuk kāṇpōm.
ōri
ivaṉ ātaṉ ōri (puṟam.153) eṉṟum, valvil ōri (puṟam. 152) eṉṟum peyar peṟṟavaṉ. ivaṉ eyta ampu mutalil yāṉiyik koṉṟu vīḻttiyatu; piṉpu puliyik koṉṟatu; piṟaku puḷḷimāṉ kaliyi maṭiyac ceytatu; ataṉ piṉṉar āṇ paṉṟiyi vīḻttiyatu; ataṟku appāl uṭumpiṉ uṭaliṟceṉṟu tittatu. iṅṅaṉam orē ampil pala uyirkaḷi vīḻttum āṟṟal peṟṟa ivaṉ, `valvil ōri eṉap paṭṭāṉ (puṟam. 152). ipperumakaṉ pacumpoṉṉāṟ ceyta aṇiyiṉiyum vaḷinta kaṭakam aminta muṉ kiyiṉiyum uṭiyavaṉ; pōriṟpaṭṭavaṉ (puṟam. 153). ivaṉuṭiya vīrar `maḻavar eṉappaṭṭaṉar (naṟṟiṇi, 52).
kolli mali nāṭu
naḷḷi eṉṟa vaḷḷalip pāṭiya vaṉparaṇar eṉṟa pulavar perumāṉ, ōri kolli mali nāṭṭut talivaṉ eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār. (puṟam. 152). kolli mali eṉpatu tiruccirāppaḷḷi māvaṭṭattiṟkum cēlam māvaṭṭattiṟkum elliyāy amintuḷḷa niṇṭa malittoṭarākum. itu, pala vaḷaṅkaḷum niṟinta malittoṭar. immalit toṭariliruntu aruvikaḷ pāynta vaṇṇamirukkum. mali nāṭṭār mali nelli vitittup payirākkuvar; vayalkaḷiṟ kaḷiyāy muḷitta mali mallikiyōṭu paciya maralik kaḷintu eṟivar. avarkaḷ ciṟṟūrkaḷil, kāntaḷē iyaṟki vēliyāy amintirukkum. acciṟṟūrkaḷil irukkum makkaḷ uṇavillāta pōtu yāṉiyiṉ kompi viṟṟu uṇavup poruḷkaḷi vāṅki uṇpārkaḷ. avar nāṭṭuk kolli maliyiṉ mēṟpakkattil kaṇṇiyum karuttiyum kavarum pāvi oṉṟu amintiruntatu (kuṟun. 100) eṉṟu kapilar kūṟiyuḷḷār. pulavarkaḷ taṅkaḷ ceyyuḷukkuriya talimakaḷik `kollip pāvi pōṉṟa talimakaḷ eṉṟu varuṇippatu akkāla vaḻakkam. ōriyiṉ nāṭṭil peruṅkāṭu oṉṟu iruntatu. akkāṭṭil malar maṇam mikkiruntatu. ataṉāl, akkāṭṭu vaḻiyē vīciya kāṟṟu, maṇikkiṉṟa kūntaliyuṭiya talivi eṉṟu paraṇar pāṭiyuḷḷār (kuṟun. 199).
ōriyiṉ kolli maliyil mayilkaḷ cerukkuṭaṉ tiriyum (naṟṟiṇi, 265). ōrikku uriya kāṭṭil kumiḻa maraṅkaḷ mikuti. avaṟṟiṉ vaḷinta mūkkiṉiyuṭiya muṟṟiṉa kaṉikaḷ kīḻē viḻuntu kiṭakkum. avi iḷamāṉkaḷukku nalla uṇavākum eṉṟu paraṇar pakarntuḷḷār (naṟ. 6). kolli mali nāṭṭil palā maraṅkaḷ mikuti. ammali nāṭṭil kār kālattup pūkkum malar, mikka maṇatti uṭiyatu eṉṟu paraṇar oru ceyyuḷil (akam. 208) kūṟiyuḷḷār.
koṭic ciṟappu
vaṉparaṇar, viṟali mutaliyōr ōriyik kaṇṭu pāṭi āṭiṉ, apperumakaṉ tāṉ vēṭṭiyāṭiya māṉiṉ iṟicciyiyum neyyi urukkiṉāṟpōṉṟa matuviyum taruvāṉ; taṉ maliyil piṟanta poṉṉip pala maṇikaḷōṭu kalantu taruvāṉ (puṟam. 152); paṭṭam mutalākiya pūṇkaḷi aṇinta yāṉikaḷi irappōrkku vaḻaṅkuvāṉ; veḷḷi nārāl toṭukkappaṭṭa poṉṉari māliyiyum piṟa aṇikaḷiyum vaḻaṅkuvāṉ (puṟam. 153), eṉṟu vēṉ koṭittaṉmiyip pārāṭṭiyuḷḷar.
kaḻi tiṉ yāṉiyār eṉṟa pulavar, vāṉattil miṉ mutalāya tokutiyiyuṭiya maḻiyip pōla yāvarkkum eppōtum variyātu vaḻaṅkum vaṇmiyi yuṭiyavaṉ ōri, eṉṟu pārāṭṭiyuḷḷār (puṟam. 204). paraṇar, ōri, maḻi pōṉṟa koṭiyiyuṭiyava;ṉaṉ, eṉṟu pukaḻntuḷḷār (naṟṟiṇi, 261).
poruḷ vaḻippiriyum talimakaṉ piritaṟku uḷḷam eḻāṉāyt taṉ neñci nōkki, neñcamē, koṭiya pōr ceyya valla pōr vīrar talivaṉākiya ciṟanta koṭiyiyuṭiya ōri eṉpavaṉatu ki vaṇmikkup poruntiya celvamē nī īṭṭum poruḷāka niṉikkuk kiṭippatāyiṉum, apporuḷ taliviyiṉ muyakkattiṉi viṭac ciṟantataṉṟu, eṉṟu kūṟiyatākap pālattaṉār kuṟittuḷḷār (naṟṟiṇi, 52).
ōriyiṉ iṟuti
muḷḷūr maliyamāṉāṉa kāri eṉpavaṉ, cēramāṉ viruppattiṉpaṭi īkittaṉmiyāl mikka pukaḻi nili nāṭṭiya valvil ōriyip pōril koṉṟāṉ; avaṉatu kollimali nāṭṭic cēramāṉukku urimiyāk kiṉāṉ. itu kallāṭaṉār kūṟṟu (akam. 209). iṅṅaṉam ōriyik koṉṟa kāri, avaṉatu tali nakaril pukuntavuṭaṉ annakarattār avaṉi etirttup pēririccaliṭṭaṉar eṉṟu kapilar kūṟiyuḷḷār (naṟṟiṇi, 230).
vaḷḷalkaḷ eḻuvarukkum piṉ vanta kumaṇaṉip pāṭiya peruñcittiraṉār eṉṟa pintamiḻppulavar, uyarnta ucciyiyuṭiya kollimali nāṭṭi āṇṭa valiya villiyuṭiya ōri eṉṟu ūriyip paṟṟik kūṟiyuḷḷār (puṟam. 158).
kolli malittoṭarkku ēṟattāḻap pattukkal tolivil cēlam māvaṭṭattiluḷḷa irācipuram eṉṉum ūril vicuvanātar kōvil uḷḷatu. akkōvilil valvil ōriyiṉ uruvaccili niṟuttap paṭṭuḷḷatu. acciliyiṉ kiyil nīṇṭa periya vil kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. accili caṅkakāla valvil ōriyi iṉṟum niṉivuṟuttikoṇṭu niṟkiṉṟatu.
maḻavar perumakaṉāṉa ōri maṟiyiṉum, avaṉ marapiṉar toṭarntu kolli mali nāṭṭi āṇṭu vantaṉar. ivarkaḷip paṟṟi `maḻavar eṉṉum pakutiyil virittuk kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. āṇṭuk kāṇka.
18. araciyal
1. araciyal
araṇmaṉi
nāṭṭiyum nāṭṭiluḷḷa kuṭikaḷiyum kāttu vantavaṉ kāvalaṉ eṉap peyar peṟṟāṉ. avaṉ vāḻnta maṉi pātukāval mikkatāy iruntatu. ataṉāl, aḵtu araṇmaṉi eṉappaṭṭatu. cilappatikāram araṇmaṉiyik `kōvil eṉṟē kuṟittuḷḷatu. kaṭavuḷ maṉikkum kōvil eṉpatē peyar. maṉṉaṉik kaṭavuṭ kūṟāka matitta caṅkakālac camutāyam, avaṉatu illattiyum `kōvil eṉṟē vaḻaṅkiyatil viyapvilli.
maṉṉaṉatu araṇmaṉi paranta nilattil māṭamāḷikikaḷōṭum kūṭakōpuraṅkaḷōṭum kaṭṭappaṭṭa mikap periya illamākum. araṇmaṉiyil eḻunili māṭam amintiruttalum uṇṭu (mullip pāṭṭu, aṭi 86). araṇmaṉi vāyil kōvil vāyilip pōla uyarntum akaṉṟum iruntatu. yāṉi taṉmītu oru koṭiyi uyarttikkoṇṭu avvāyilil eḷitil nuḻiyalām. araṇmaṉi pala maṉikaḷiyum vāyilkaḷiyum maṇṭapaṅkaḷiyum peṟṟiruntatu. nilā muṟṟaṅkaḷik koṇṭa uyarnta māṭaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. araṇmaṉi muṟṟattil kavari māṉkaḷum aṉṉappaṟavikaḷum tāvit tirintaṉa. aracaṉukku eṉṟu taṉi maṉiyum aracikku eṉṟu taṉi maṉiyum amintiruntaṉa. araci vāḻnta pakuti `antappuram eṉappaṭṭatu. aḵtu āṭavarkaḷ pukaviyalāta ariya kāvali uṭiyatu. araṇmaṉic cuvarkaḷil pala ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. aracamātēvi paṭukkum kaṭṭiliṉ ciṟappu neṭunalvāṭiyil mikat teḷivākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (neṭunalvāṭi, aṭi, 78-114).
pāṇṭimātēviyiṉ kaṭṭil tantattālākiyatu; ciṟanta vēlippāṭu koṇṭatu. ataṉ mēṟkūri ōviyaṅkaḷ eḻutappaṭṭatu. aṉṉap peṭiyiṉ tūvi koṇṭu amikkappaṭṭa mettiyum taliyaṇikaḷum akkaṭṭilil iruntaṉa. ammetti mītu kañciyiṭṭuc calavi ceyyappeṟṟa tukil virikkappaṭṭiruntatu. ataṉmītu ceṅkaḻunīr malariṉ itaḻkaḷ parappappaṭṭiruntaṉa (neṭunal. aṭi, 117-135).
araca makaḷir anti nērattil viḷaṅkum kiraṇaṅkaḷiṉ iḷaveyil tōṉṟiṉāṟpōṉṟa niṟatti uṭiyavar; mayil pōṉṟa cāyaliṉiyum māntaḷir pōṉṟa mēṉiyiyum uṭiyavar; ciṟanta kaṟpuṭiyavar; kal patitta nakikaḷi aṇintavar; neruppup pōlum itaḻkaḷi uṭiyavar; tāmari pōṉṟa oḷiyuṭiya mukattiṉiyuṭiyavar; iṉiya coṟkaḷiyuṭiyavar (ma. kā. aṭi, 702-712).
kāliyil aracaṉ ceyalkaḷ
vikaṟiyil araṇmaṉiyuḷ muracu olikkam. atu `paḷḷiyeḻucci muracam eṉappaṭum. appōtu cūtar niṉṟu aracaṉi vāḻttuvar; mākatar eṉpavar iruntu aracaṉ pukaḻic colluvar; vitāḷikar eṉpavar icikkaruviḷi iyakkuvar; nāḻikik kaṇakkar nēratti aṟivippar (ma. kā. 670-672).
aracaṉuṭiya meykāppāḷar `perumūtāḷar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avarkaḷ caṭṭi aṇintiruntaṉar; ciṟanta oḻukkamuṭiyavar (mu. pā. 53-54). aracaṉukku utavi ceyyap paṇippeṇṭir palar iruntaṉar. avarkaḷ ciṟanta aḻakikaḷ; niṟinta nakikaḷi aṇintavar; tam pāṭṭālum collālum kūttālum aracaṉi makiḻvippavar. avarkaḷ maṉṉaṉukkum avaṉ ēvaṟpaṭi pulavar pāṇar mutaliyōrkkum poṟkiṇṇaṅkaḷil matuvi vārttut taruvatu vaḻakkam (po. ā. paṭi, 84-87), (ma. kā. 779-81).
pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ kāliyil eḻuntu nīrāṭit taṉ vaḻipaṭu teyvatti vaṇaṅkiṉāṉ. appoḻutu avaṉuṭiya mukattil paṇpaṭṭa ōviyaṉāl tīṭṭap peṟṟa pāviyiṭattē kāṇappaṭum kaḷi kāṇappaṭṭatu. avaṉ taṉ uṭampil cantaṉattip pūcik koṇṭāṉ. avaṉatu mārpil muttu māliyum aṉṟalarnta pūmāliyum viḷaṅkiṉa. avaṉatu tōḷil vīravaḷi viḷakkamuṟṟatu; ki viralkaḷil maṇikaḷ aḻuttiṉa mōtiraṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. avi taṉ iṭiyil kañciyiṭṭuc calavi ceyyappaṭṭa tukili uṭuttiruntāṉ. uṭikku mēl cila aṇikaḷ polivu peṟṟu viḷaṅkiṉa. avaṉ kālil vīrakkaḻal aṇi ceytatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 715-722).
aimperuṅkuḻu
aracaṉukku āṭciyil utavi puriyum kuḻukkaḷuḷ ciṟappuṭiyatu `aimperuṅkuḻu eṉpatu. amiccar, purōkitar (ācāṉ), paṭittalivar, tūtuvar, cāraṇar eṉpavarē aimperuṅkuḻuviṉar eṉṟu cilappatikārattiṟku uri vakutta aṭiyārkku nallār kūṟiyuḷḷār. mācaṉam, pirōkitar, maruttavar, kaṇiyar, amiccar eṉpavar aimperuṅkuḻuviṉar eṉṟu cilappatikāra arum patavuriyāciriyar kūṟiyuḷḷār. ivaruḷ `mācaṉam eṉpatu kuṭimakkaḷāl terinteṭukkappaṭṭa piratinitikaḷik kuṟippatu. ivarkaḷ kuṭikaḷiṉ nalaṉkaḷiyum tēvikaḷiyum aracaṉiṭam eṭuttuk kūṟip pātukākkap payaṉpaṭṭārkaḷ; nāṭṭil camayat toṭarpāṉa ceyalkaḷip purōkitar kavaṉittaṉar. ivarkaḷic `camayap piratinitikaḷ eṉṟum kūṟulām. maruttuvar nāṭṭuc cukātārattik kavaṉittu vantaṉar. kaṇiyar nāṭṭil naṭipeṟa vēṇṭiya nalla ceyalkaḷit toṭaṅkuvataṟkuriya nāḷiyum nērattiyum kuṟikkavum, varuvatu urikkavum payaṉpaṭṭaṉar. nāṭṭiṉ varuvāyiyum, aracāṅkac celaviyum, nīti muṟiyiyum amiccar kavaṉittaṉar.1 avarkaḷ ekkālamum meyyiyē pēcuvatāl pukaḻ vāyntavarkaḷ; talimi aminta kāvitippaṭṭam1 aracaṉāl vaḻaṅkappaṭṭavarkaḷ (ma. kā. aṭi, 19, 20, 499).
eṇpērāyam
karaṇattiyalavar, karumavitikaḷ, kaṉakaccuṟṟam, kaṭi kāppāḷar, nakaramāntar, paṭittalivar, yāṉi vīrar, ivuḷi maṟavar eṉpavar eṇpērāyat tārāvar.2 ivaruḷ 1. kāraṇat tiyalavar-aracāṅkap peruṅkaṇakkar; 2. karumavitikaḷ-aracāṅka vēlikaḷi naṭattum talivarkaḷ; 3. kaṉakaccuṟṟam-aracāṅkap poruṭkāppu atikārikaḷ; 4. kaṭi kāppāḷar-nāṭu kākkum atikārikaḷ; 5. nakaramāntar-nāṭṭil irunta pala nakaraṅkaḷiṉ piratinitikaḷ; 6.paṭittalivar-kālāṭ paṭittalivar; 7.yāṉi vīrar-yāṉippaṭittalivar; 8. ivuḷi maṟavar-kutirip paṭittalivar.
maṉṉaṉ aimperuṅkuḻuviṉariyum eṇpērāyat tāriyum kalantē āṭci purintāṉ. ipperumakkaḷ naṟkuṭip piṟappu, kalvi, nalloḻukkam, uṇmiyuṭimi, tūyavuḷḷam, naṭuvu nilimi mutaliya naṟpaṇpukaḷ peṟṟiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟu maṉṉar etirpārttaṉar; nāṭṭup peruviḻākkaḷilum nāṭṭup peruñceyalkaḷilum ikkuḻuviṉar paṅku koṇṭaṉar eṉpatu cilappatikāram-intira viḻavūreṭutta kātiyāl aṟiyalām.
nāḷōlakkam
aracaṉatu kolu maṇṭapam `nāḷōlakkamaṇṭapam eṉappaṭum. aracaṉ ovvoru nāḷum ammaṇṭapattiliruntu araciyaṟceytikaḷik kavaṉippatu vaḻakkam. aṅku avaṉukku utaviyāka aimperuṅkuḻuviṉar, eṇ pērāyattiṉar, maṇṭila mākkaḷ mutaliyōr kūṭiyiruppar. maṉṉaṉ pala mīṉkaḷukku iṭiyil viḷaṅkum mati pōla avarkaṭku iṭiyil viḷaṅkuvāṉ. aṅṅaṉam iruntu pōril veṟṟi peṟṟa taṉ vīrarkaḷukkup paṭṭamum1 paricilum nalkuvāṉ; tam pulamiyik kāṭṭip paricil peṟa vanta pulavar, pāṇar, kūttar mutaliyōrkkum paricil vaḻaṅkuvāṉ; piṉpu taṉ amiccar kaḷuṭaṉ aracāṅkattiṉ naṭimuṟikaḷik kavaṉippāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 725-778). kōti eṉṉum cēra aracaṉatu nāḷōlakka iruppil ellāk kalikaḷiyum uṇarnta cīriyōr tiraṇṭu avaṉ kēṭpat tarukkaṅkaḷik kūṟikkoṇṭiruntaṉar. (maturi antik kaṭit teruviṉ āravāram mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa cēraṉatu amikkaḷa āravāratti ottiruntatu eṉṟu māṅku marutaṉār kūṟiyuḷḷār. ma. kā. aṭi, 511-526). naṉṉaṉatu avikkaḷattil tām kaṟṟavi nāviṉiṭattē payiṉṟa nalla aṟiviṉiyuṭiyōr tiraṇṭiruntaṉar.2 (malippaṭu. aṭi, 77-80); aracaṉiṭam nālvakip paṭikaḷ iruntaṉa. kutirikaḷip paṟṟiya nūl iruntatu. annūlil vallavarum iruntaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 487-9).
aṟavuriyum aṟivuriyum
ācāṉ eṉpavaṉ irājakuru. avaṉ purōkitaṉ eṉṟu kūṟappaṭṭāṉ. avaṉ ciṟanta nūlkaḷiluḷḷa aṟavurikaḷiyum,  eṭuttukkūṟi maṉṉaṉi nalvaḻippaṭuttupavaṉ. nāṭṭil pukaḻ peṟṟa pulavarkaḷum aracaṉukku aṟivurikaḷ kūṟutal vaḻakkam. pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉukku avaṉatu avikkaḷat talimip pulavarāṉa māṅkuṭi marutaṉār eṉpavar aṟakkaḷa vēḷvi ceytu nalam peṟumpaṭi aṟivuri kūṟiyati maturik kāñciyāl aṟiyalām. (ma. kā. aṭi, 759-781).
aracāṭci
caṅka kālattil ovvōr ūrilum potumakkaḷāl tērnteṭukkappaṭṭa periyōr iruntu ūrāṭciyik kavaṉittu vantaṉar. nāṭṭiṉ tali nakaril periya nītimaṉṟam iruntatu. aḵtu `aṟakkaḷam eṉṟum `aṟaṅkūṟu aviyam eṉṟum peyar peṟṟatu. cila vaḻakkukaḷi maṉṉaṉē vicārittu nīti vaḻaṅkuvatum uṇṭu. iḷiñaṉāṉa karikālaṉ mutiyavaṉip pōla vēṭam pūṇṭu nīti vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ eṉṟu porunarāṟṟuppaṭi pēcukiṟatu (aṭi, 187-8). kāñciyi āṇṭa iḷantiriyaṉ taṉ mantirac cuṟṟattōṭē iruntu muṟi vēṇṭiyavarkku muṟiyum, makkaḷ kuṟikaḷi vicārittu vēṇṭiyaṉavum ceytāṉ eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭi pakarkiṉṟatu (aṭi, 443-450). maturiyil irunta aṟaṅkūṟu aviyattār accam, tuṉpam, avā ākiyavaṟṟi nīkkiyavar; oru cārāriṭam ciṉamum maṟṟoru cārāriṭam makiḻvum kāṭṭātavar; tammit tulākkōlip pōla naṭuvu niliyilē niṟuttikkoṇṭavar uyarnta koḷki uṭiyavar (ma. kā. aṭi, 489-492).
iḷantiriyaṉ āṭciyil toṇṭi nāṭṭup peru vaḻikaḷ vīrarkaḷāl kākkappaṭṭaṉa. tuṟimuka nakarattil iṟakkumatiyāṉa poruḷkaḷ vāṇikattiṉ poruṭṭuk koṇṭu cellappaṭṭa vaḻikaḷ pātukākkappaṭṭaṉa. kariyōrattil āyattuṟikaḷ iruntaṉa. cila iṭaṅkaḷil vīrarkaḷ araṇamittukkoṇṭu vāḻntārkaḷ. anta araṇukkuḷ pōrkkaruvikaḷ iruntaṉa. vēṭṭi nāykaḷ iruntaṉa (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 70-82; 117-129). tiriyaṉ āṭciyil toṇṭi nāṭṭil vaḻip pōvārik kollum āṟalikaḷvar illi; iṭi iṭiyātu; pāmpukaḷum kollutalic ceyyā. kāṭṭil vāḻum puli mutaliyaṉavum tuṉpam ceyyā; ātalāl, nīṅkaḷ niṉitta iṭattē iḷippāṟik kavaliyiṉṟic cellalām, eṉṟu paricil peṟṟa perumpāṇaṉ vaṟiya pāṇaṉiṭam kūṟiyatu, tiriyaṉatu aṟam malinta āṭcikkuc ciṟanta eṭuttukkāṭṭākum (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 39-45). avaṉ aṟattiṟku māṟāṉavaṟṟi nīkkupavaṉ; aṟam purikiṉṟa ceṅkōlaṉ; nītimuṟi vēṇṭi varuvōriyum, tam kuṟiyip pōkkikkoḷḷa virumpi varuvōriyum varavēṟpāṉ; iṉcol kūṟuvāṉ; avarkaḷ vēṇṭuvaṉavaṟṟi vēṇṭiyavāṟē koṭuppāṉ; naṭuvu niliyil iruntu uṇmiyik kaṇṭaṟiyum kuṟṟamaṟṟa nuṇṇaṟivu uṭiyavaṉ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 443-7).
iṅṅaṉamē pāṇṭi nāṭṭilum pālinila makkaḷāṉa āṟalikaḷvarāl kuṭimakkaḷukkut tīṅku nērātapaṭi nāṭu kāval vīrarkaḷ amarttappaṭṭirun tārkaḷ. (ma. kā. aṭi, 310-312). avvīrarkaḷ vilnēntiyavarkaḷāy nāṭṭu vaḻikaḷik kāval kāttārkaḷ. ivvāṟē naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭi āṅkāṅku irunta vēṭarkaḷ kāttu vantārkaḷ. avarkaḷ koṭiya villiyum kūriya ampukaḷiyum koṇṭiruntārkaḷ. ammakkaḷ vaḻippōkkarkku vēṇṭiya vacatikaḷic ceytārkaḷ (mali. aṭi, 421-427).
aracaṉatu ceṅkōlāṭciyiṉkīḻ avaṉiṭam paṇi purintavar nērmiyāyp paṇi purintaṉar. karikālaṉ āṭciyil kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattuc cuṅka atikārikaḷ iravilum pakalilum cōmpaliṉṟit taṅkaḷ kaṭamikaḷic ceytu vantārkaḷ. (pa. pāli, aṭi, 120-125). karikālaṉ āṭciyil cōḻanāṭṭil puli mutaliya koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷiṉ tuṉpam uṇṭē tavirak kuṭikaḷik kalaṅkac ceyyum paki vēṟu illi (pa. pāli, aṭi, 26, 28). `ivaṉ taṉatu iḷamipparuvattikkoṇṭu muṟi vaḻaṅka māṭuvaṉō!  eṉṟu aiyuṟṟa mutiyavar iravarit tāṉ mutiya nītipati pōla vēṭam puṉintu vaḻakkik kēṭṭu uvakkac ceytavaṉ karikālaṉ eṉṟu porunakarāṟṟuppaṭi pukalkiṉṟatu (aṭi, 187-8). iṅṅaṉam avaṉ nīti vaḻaṅkiya ciṟappiṉip piṟkālattil tōṉṟiya paḻamoḻip pāṭalum kīḻ varumāṟu pārāṭṭukiṉṟatu.
	urimuṭivu kāṇāṉ iḷamiyōṉ eṉṟa
narimutu makkaḷ uvappa-narimuṭittuc
collāl muṟiceytāṉ cōḻaṉ kulavicci
kallāmal pākam paṭum.
aracaṉ pakivari veṉṟu avar tiṟiyākat tanta nakikaḷip pulavarkku vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (mali. aṭi, 70-72) nalliyakkōṭaṉ taṉ paṭittalivarkaḷ koṇṭu vanta pakivar nāṭṭup poruḷkaḷit taṉṉiṭam vanta ēḻi kaṭkum pāṇar mutaliyōrkkum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 248-249). karikālaṉ pulavarkkup piṉ ēḻaṭi naṭantu ceṉṟu avarkku viṭi tarutal marapu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 166).
pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ oru poyyālē amiḻtuṭaṉ tēvar ulakam kiṭippatāyiṉum poy pēcātavaṉ; ulaka maṉṉavaruṭaṉ tēvarkaḷ cērntu pōrukku variṉum, pakivarkku añcip paṇiyātavaṉ; teṉṟiciyil malikaḷ niṟiyumpaṭi vāṇaṉ eṉṟa cūraṉ vitta cīriya poruṭkuviyalē kiṭippatāyiṉum, piṟar kūṟum paḻiyi veṟuppavaṉ; vaṟiyarkkup poruḷi utavum neñciṉaṉ (ma. ka. aṭi, 197-205). ipperumakaṉ āṭci ceṅkōlāṭciyaṉṟō? māṅkuṭi marutaṉār neṭuñceḻiyaṉukku muṉpu āṇṭa pāṇṭiya maṉṉar eṅṅaṉam nāṭāṇṭaṉar eṉpati araciyal nuṇṇaṟivōṭu kūṟiyuḷḷatu pārāṭṭattakum. ataṉik kīḻē kāṇka.
pāṇṭi nāṭṭil maḻivaḷam mikkiruntatu; yāṟukaḷ iṭiyaṟātu nīrperukkeṭuttu oḻukiya vaṇṇam iruntaṉa. āṅkāṅkup pūmpoḻilkaḷum iḷamarak kākkaḷum ceḻittōṅkik kāṭci iṉpam nalkiṉa; uyirkaḷ paciyum piṇiyum iṉṟi uṭaluram peṟṟu eḻiluṭaṉ viḷaṅkiṉa. avar āṭciyil vāḻnta makkaḷ taṅkaḷ vāḻkkikku oru kuṟiviyum kāṇātavarkaḷ; poy, kaḷavu mutaliya tīyavaṟṟi aṟiyātavarkaḷāy vāḻntārkaḷ. apperumakkaḷ āṇṭa ūḻi nallūḻi ākum. avvaḻiyil vāḻnta makkaḷ naṉmakkaḷ. ivaṟṟuk kellām kāraṇamāy aminta pāṇṭiya maṉṉar uyarntōr āvar (ma. kā. aṭi, 5-23).
oru nāṭṭiṉ ceḻippum kuṭimakkaḷiṉ nalvāḻvumē aracaṉatu ceṅkōṟciṟappi uṇarttum aṭiyāḷaṅkaḷākum  eṉpatē māṅkuṭi marutaṉāratu araciyaṟ paṭṭaṟivu kaṇṭa uṇmiyākum.
ōviyam, ciṟpam, ici, naṭaṉam, nāṭakam eṉpavi `nuṇkalikaḷ eṉappaṭum. ivaṟṟōṭu ilakkiyakkali neruṅkiya toṭarpuṭiyatu. avaṟṟil vallavar pulavar; icikkaliyil vallavar paraṇar; naṭaṉak kaliyilum nāṭakak kaliyilum vallavar kūttar. ikkalivāṇar vaṟumi iṉṟi vāḻntāltāṉ nāṭṭil ilakkiyam mutaliya kalikaḷ vāḻum. kalikaḷ nāṭṭu makkaḷi iṉpuṟutti naṟpaṇpukaḷi vaḷarppavi; nākarikattiyum paṇpāṭṭiyum vaḷarppavi. eṉavē, kalivāṇar kavaliyiṉṟi vāḻntāltāṉ nāṭṭumakkaḷ nallaṟivu peṟṟu vāḻtal iyalum. tamiḻp pēraracarum ciṟṟaracarum ivvuṇmiyi naṉku uṇarntavar ātaliṉ, kalivāṇari mukamalarcciyuṭaṉ varavēṟṟu vēṇṭum utavikaḷip purintaṉar. ivvivaraṅkaḷi aṭuttuk kāṇpōm:
2. pōr
pattuppāṭṭuḷ mullippāṭṭu, maturikkāñci, paṭṭiṉappāli eṉṉum mūṉṟu pāṭṭukaḷilētāṉ pōr paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ mikutiyāyuḷḷaṉa. ēṉiyavaṟṟil pōrippaṟṟiya cila kuṟippukaḷē uḷḷaṉa.


eyiṉar araṇ
toṇṭimāṉ tiriyaṉatu āṭcikku uṭpaṭṭa toṇṭi nāṭṭil eyiṉaratu araṇ ciṟappuk kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. pāli nilattil eyiṉar (vēṭṭuvar) vāḻntaṉar. avarkaḷ kuṭiyiruppukku appāl eyiṉar araṇ iruntatu. ataṉuḷ vīṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil pakivarik kuttikkutti muṉi maḻuṅkiṉa vēlkaḷ paḻutu pārkkappaṭṭu variciyāyp palakikaḷiṟceruki vikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa; viṟkaḷ cārtti vikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ampaṟāttūṇikaḷil ampukaḷ vikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. avvillaṅkaḷukku etiril oru pantal iruntatu. atil ampum kaṭṭukaḷum kaṭiya ōciyi uṇṭākkum `tuṭi eṉṟa icikkaruvikaḷum vikkap paṭṭiruntaṉa. illaṅkaḷik kākkak kāval illam oṉṟu iruntatu. avvillattut tūṇkaḷil vēṭṭi nāykaḷ caṅkilikaḷāl piṇikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ittuṇi illaṅkaḷiyum cuṟṟi muḷvēli amikkappaṭṭiruntatu. ataṉic cuṟṟilum kāvaṟkāṭu iruntatu. eyiṉar araṇukku aminta vāyil kaṇiya maratti uṭiyatu; vāyil nili cevvitu. vāyiliṉ muṉpuṟam neṭiya kūriya kaḻukkaḷ variciyāka niṟuttappaṭṭiruntaṉa (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 117-128).
viricci kēṭṭal
vēntaṉ oruvaṉ maṟṟoru vēntaṉ nāṭṭiṉmītu paṭiyeṭukkak karutiṉ, mutaṟkaṇ pakivar nāṭṭu āṉiriyik kavarat taṉ paṭittalivari ēvuvāṉ; avarkaḷ ēvalāl, naṟcol kēṭṭaṟkuriyavar ceṉṟu oru pākkattil taṅkit tam aracaṟku mēl varum ākkatti aṟiya naṟcol (viricci) kēṭpar. avarkaḷ kātil viḻuvatu naṟcollāyiṉ, uṭaṉē āṉiriyik kavarum muyaṟci mēṟkoḷḷappaṭum. naṟcol kēṭpataṟkuriyavar ūri aṭutta pākkattuk kōvilil teyvattiṉ muṉṉiliyil mulli malarkaḷiyum neṉ maṇikaḷiyum kalantu tūvip paṇintuniṟpar. appoḻutu akkōviliyaṭutta toḻuvattil irunta kaṉṟukaḷi nōkki āymakaḷ orutti, uṅkaḷ tāymār iṉṉē varukuvar, eṉṟu kūṟuvaḷ (mullippāṭṭu, aṭi, 8-14).
pācaṟi amittal
oru nāṭṭiṉ mītu pōr toṭukkac cellum aracaṉ tāṉum taṉ paṭikaḷum taṅkiyirukkat taṉ nāṭṭu ellip puṟattil pācaṟi amittal iyalpu. caṅka kālattiṟ pācaṟi eppaṭi amikkappaṭṭatu eṉpatu mullippāṭṭil kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
kāṭṭāṟu cūḻnta akaṉṟa neṭiya kāṭṭil irunta paciya tūṟukaḷ veṭṭappaṭṭaṉa; pakippulattukkuk kāvalāy irunta vēṭṭuvaruṭiya ciṟiya vāyilkaḷiyuṭiya araṇkaḷ aḻikkappaṭṭaṉa; kaṭal pōlap paranta avviṭattil muḷḷāl āṉa vēliyik kāvaluṟumpaṭi vaḷittup pōṭappaṭṭatu. vīrarkaḷ irukkat taḻikkūriyuṭiya illaṅkaḷ amikkappaṭṭaṉa; pala terukkaḷ amintaṉa. nāṟcantiyāṉa muṟṟattil kāvalāka yāṉikaḷ niṟuttappaṭṭaṉa. paṭit talivarkaṭkuk kūṭāraṅkaḷ amikkappaṭṭaṉa. avaṟṟil viṟkaḷic cōvūṉṟi eṟikōlkaḷiyum ūṉṟik kiṭukukaḷiyum niriyākak kutti araṇ amikkappaṭṭatu. nīṇṭa kuttukkōlkaḷ variciyāka naṭappaṭṭaṉa. avaṟṟic cuṟṟi matil tiri vaḷittuk kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. illattuc cuvart tuṇiyil puli caṅkiliyāl piṇikkappaṭṭatik kuṟittum ōviyam tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntatu. anta illattiṉuṟ puṟavaṟiyum uḷḷaṟiyum amikkappaṭṭaṉa. uḷḷaṟiyil aracaṉ tuyila vacati ceyyappaṭṭatu (mullippāṭṭu, aṭi, 24-44).
pācaṟiyil paruntum paṟakka muṭiyāta uyarcciyiyuṭiya araṇkaḷ irukkum. anta araṇil iruntu cēymikkaṇ varum pakivarik kāṇalām. pācaṟiyil kāliyil paḷḷiyeḻucci muracam muḻaṅkum (maturikkāñci, aṭi, 231).
iravil pācaṟi
aracaṉatu illattic caṭṭiyiṭṭa meykāppāḷar kāvalākac cūḻntu niṉṟaṉar. kuṟuntoṭiyiyum kūntal acintu kiṭakkiṉṟa aḻakiṉiyu muṭiya maṅkiyar oḷivīcum vāḷi iṭuppiṟcerukiyiruntaṉar. avarkaḷ iravil viḷakkukaḷukku eṇṇey vārttuk koṇṭum avinta viḷakkukaḷi ēṟṟikkoṇṭum cuṟu cuṟuppāy iruntārkaḷ. nāḻiki vaṭṭilik koṇṭu nāḻikiyik kaṇakkiṭum makkaḷ iravu muḻumiyum uṟaṅkāmal paṇi purintārkaḷ. maṉṉaṉ uḷḷaṟiyic cuṟṟilum caṭṭiyiṭṭa yavaṉa ūmikaḷ kāval purintārkaḷ.
pakalil naṭipeṟṟa pōril puṇpaṭṭuk kaḷitta yāṉikaḷ karumpiyum neṟkatir iṭiyē neruṅkappaṭṭuk kaṭṭippōkaṭṭa cāviyiyum atimaturattaḻiyiyum tiṉṉātu avaṟṟāl tam neṟṟiyit tuṭittuk koṇṭaṉa. yāṉip pēccāṉa vaṭamoḻikaḷik kaṟṟa pākar, palakāṟ collik kavaḷattit tiṉṉumpaṭi kavitta muḷḷiyuṭiya parikkōlāl kuttiṉar.
maṉṉaṉ pōrippaṟṟiya niṉivāl uṟakkam varāmal tavittāṉ; vāḷ veṭṭup paṭṭu varuntum kaḷiṟukaḷi eṇṇi varuntiṉāṉ; tiṟampaṭap pōriṭṭut taṅkaḷ ceñcōṟṟuk kaṭaṉik kaḻittu iṟanta vīrarkaḷi eṇṇiṉāṉ; puṇpaṭṭa uṭampuṭaṉ pul uṇṇātu tavitta kutirikaḷi niṉintāṉ; oru kiyip paṭukkiyiṉmītu vittuk kaṭakam aṇinta oru kiyi muṭiyōṭē cēravittu, maṟunāṭpōrip paṟṟi eṇṇalāṉāṉ (mullippāṭṭu, aṭi, 45-76).
paṭiyeṭuppu
aracaṉ pakivar nāṭṭik kippaṟṟa allatu pakiyaracaṉatu valimiyi oṭukka avaṉatu nāṭṭiṉmītu paṭiyeṭuppāṉ. paṭittalivar, vañci māli cūṭik kaḷḷuṇṭu mārpil cantaṉam pūcip pōrukku eḻuvar. atikamāṉ koṅku nāṭṭuc ciṟṟaracaṉ. avaṉ muṭimaṉṉaṉ allaṉ. aṅṅaṉamiruntum, avaṉiṭam kaṭal pōṉṟa paṭi iruntatu (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 102-103) eṉiṉ, karikālaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ pōṉṟa muṭimaṉṉariṭam peruṅkaṭal pōṉṟa tāṉi iruntatu eṉak kōṭalē poruttamākum. paṭiyeṭukkum aracaṉ malikaḷiyum kāṭukaḷiyum kaṭappāṉ; taṉ paṭikaḷuṭaṉ ceṉṟu pakivar araṇkaḷik kavarvāṉ; uḷnāṭukaḷiṟ pukuvāṉ; maḻiyōṭē māṟupaṭa ampukaḷit tūvip pōr purivāṉ. avaṉ kutirikaḷ ōṭum viciyāl tukaḷkaḷi eḻuppum; caṅkam muḻaṅkum; kompu olikkum; pōr muracam muḻaṅkum; pakivar tam perumi keṭumpaṭi kollappaṭuvar (maturikkāñci, aṭi, 147-149, 180-185). pōr puriyum virar (tumpip pōrāyiṉ) poṉṉāṟ ceyyappaṭṭa tumpippūvic cūṭuvar; vēl, vil, vāḷ, ampukaḷik koṇṭu pōrāṭuvar. appaṭik karuvikaḷil koṟṟavi iruppatāka vīrar nampiṉar (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 102-103).1 pōr kaṭumiyāy naṭipeṟiṉ, pakivar tākkutalukku āṟṟāta paṭi piṉ cariyum. appoḻutu accarinta paṭiyit tāṅki vīraṉ oruvaṉ kallaṇipōla niṉṟu pakivarit tākkuvāṉ. ammuyaṟciyil avaṉ veṟṟi peṟiṉ, aracaṉ avaṉukku ēṉāti eṉṟa paṭṭam vaḻaṅkuvāṉ; `ēṉāti mōtiram eṉṟa peyaruṭiya mōtirattiyum aṇivippāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 719-740, uri viḷakkam).
muṉṉaṇippaṭi tūci eṉappaṭum; aṇi eṉpatu piṉṉaṇippaṭi; kūḻi-piṉ paṭi (puṟam. 88).
vēntar mayirkkaṇ muracip peṟṟiruntaṉar. puliyip porutu koṉṟu niṉṟu cilittuk kōṭṭu maṇ koṇṭa erutu iṟantatum ataṉ tōli mayil cīvāmal pōrtta murucu `mayirkkaṇ muracu eṉappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 732-3).
kōṭṭiyi muṟṟukiyiṭum vīrar uḻiñippū māliyi aṇivar; yāṉikaḷi ēvik kōṭṭik katavukaḷi uṭikkac ceyvar. yāṉikaḷ taṅkaḷ kompu kaḷāṟkuttik katavi uṭikkum (pa. pāli, aṭi, 228-231).
pōrkkaḷak kāṭci
pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ cēra cōḻariyum aimperuvēḷiriyum taṉ nālvakip paṭikaḷuṭaṉ pōrkkaḷattil cantikkiṟāṉ. avaṉuṭiya yāṉikaḷ kaṇṭōr `ivi malikaḷō! eṉṟu maruḷutaṟkuk kāraṇamāṉa pēruṭal paṭittavi. avi aṇi vakuttu niṟkiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ mukattil aṇiyappaṭṭa poṉṉāl iyaṉṟa neṟṟippaṭṭaṅkaḷ paḷapaḷaveṉṟu miṉṉukiṉṟaṉa. avi tam etirē pakippaṭi varutalik kaṇṭatum ciṉam koḷkiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ viḻikaḷiliruntu neruppu veḷippaṭukiṟatu. pākar avaṟṟip pōrttoḻilil ēvukiṉṟaṉar. uṭaṉē avi pakip paṭiyuḷ pukuntu pōr puriyat toṭaṅkukiṉṟaṉa.
maṟṟoru pakkam pōr puriyum puravikaḷ virintu pāykiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ iyakkattāl eḻunta tukaḷ vāṉam muḻumiyum paravi iruḷ cūḻacceykiṉṟatu. aḵtāvatu, ñāyiṟṟu maṇṭilam tukaḷkaḷāl maṟikkappaṭukiṟatu.
vēṟoru pakkam, tērkaḷ tam urutteriyātapaṭi virintu cuḻalkiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟi iḻukkum kutirikaḷ tāvittāvip pāykiṉṟaṉa. itaṉāl cūṟikkāṟṟu aṭippaṭu pōṉṟa tōṟṟam pōrkkaḷattiṉ oru pakutiyil kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu.
vēṟoru pakkam kālāṭpaṭiyiṉar kaṭumpōr purikiṉṟaṉar; tam tōḷ valiyāl pakivar paṭiyic citaṟaṭikkiṉṟaṉar; muṭivil veṟṟi muḻakkam ceykiṉṟaṉar 
(ma. kā. aṭi, 43-56).
paṭiyeṭuppiṉ payaṉ
paṭiyeṭuppavaṉ, tēvippaṭiṉ, pakivar ūrkaḷiyum payirkaḷiyum nīr nilikaḷiyum aḻippāṉ;1 `nāṭu eṉṟa peyariyiḻantu `kāṭu eṉṉum peyarip peṟumāṟu ceyvāṉ. acceyalāl pacukkaḷ taṅkiyirunta iṭaṅkaḷil pulikaḷ mutaliyaṉa taṅkum; ūrāyirunta iṭaṅkaḷ pāḻāykkiṭakkum. cāṉṟōrkaḷ irunta ampalaṅkaḷ pēykaḷ vāḻiṭamākum. ūrkaḷ aḻitalāl ūrār uṇaviṉṟit tuṉpuṟuvar. avartam uṟaviṉar tam ūrkaḷiliruntu ceṉṟu avarkaṭkup pātu kāvalāka amivar. periya māḷikikaḷil irunta neṟ kutirkaḷ ventu aḻiyum. avviṭaṅkaḷil kūkic cēval pēṭṭuṭaṉ iruntu kuḻaṟum. kuḷaṅkaḷil nīr eṭuppāriṉmiyāl, yāṉi niṉṟāl maṟiyum aḷaviṟku vāṭkōriyum caṇpaṅkōriyum neruṅki vaḷarum. pakivarāl aḻikkappaṭṭa vayalkaḷil peṇ paṉṟikaḷuṭaṉ āṇpaṉṟikaḷ ōṭittiriyum (ma. kā. aṭi, 150-180, 225-258).
paṭṭiṉappāliyil karikālaṉatu paṭiyeṭuppāl naṭi peṟṟa aḻivukaḷ kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa:
karumpum cennellum vaḷarntu kuvaḷiyum neytalum malarntu viḷaṅkiya marutanilam, iṭamakaṉṟa poyki kaḷiyuṭiyatu. karikālaṉatu paṭiyeṭuppu ammaruta nilakkuṭikaḷi ōṭṭiyatu. paṭiyeṭuppāl ceykaḷum vāvikaḷum nīraṟṟaṉa. avaṟṟil aṟukum kōrikaḷum vaḷarntaṉa. makaḷir nīruṇṇum tuṟiyiṟ ceṉṟu muḻukik kantu niṟuttappaṭṭuḷḷa ampalatti meḻuki, antikkālattil viḷakkēṟṟuvar. (avvampalattil irunta kantiṉik karikālaṉ yāṉikaḷ cāyttu viṭṭaṉa. avi avvampalattilēyē taṅkiviṭṭaṉa). maṉṟattil viḻā naṭipeṟum. yāḻ mutaliya icik karuvikaḷ icikkappaṭum. karikālaṉ paṭiyeṭuppāl ūr viḻā naṭipeṟavilli; maṉṟattil accam kuṭikoṇ ṭiruntatu. tali vāyil, māṭam, aṭukkaḷi mutaliyavaṟṟik koṇṭa periya vīṭukaḷ makkaḷiṉṟi iruntaṉa. avvīṭukaḷ cāntiṭṭa cuvarkaḷiyuṭiyavi. avvīṭṭut tiṇṇikaḷil kiḷikkūṇṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. paṭiyeṭuppāl avvillaṅkaḷ pāḻpaṭṭaṉa. aṅkuk kūkikaḷum āṇṭalip puṭkaḷum alaṟik koṇṭiruntaṉa. āṇ pēykaḷuṭaṉ peṇ pēykaḷ alintu koṇṭiruntaṉa. periya maṉikaḷil neṟkūṭukaḷ niṟiya nel iruntatu. paṭiyeṭuppil akkūṭukaḷ koḷḷi yiṭappaṭṭaṉa. vaṟuviya akkūṭukaḷiṉ uḷḷiruntu kūkikaḷ alaṟiṉa. karikālaṉ pakivaruṭiya matilkaḷi aḻittāṉ; paṭi vīṭukaḷi aḻittāṉ; ūrkaḷip pāḻākkiṉāṉ (pa. pāli, aṭi, 239-270). pōril pakivaruṭiya maṉiviyariyum ēṉiya makaḷiriyum piṭittu vantu paṇi makaḷirākkik koḷḷutal paṇṭi marapu; ammakaḷir nīruṇṇum tuṟiyilē ceṉṟu muḻuki ampalatti meḻukuvar; aṅku viḷakkiṉi ēṟṟuvar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 241-9).
pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ pakivar nāṭṭiṉmītu paṭiyeṭuttuc ceṉṟu, avartam kāvaliyuṭiya poḻilkaḷi aḻittāṉ; ekkālattum vaḷam kuṉṟāta maruta nilaṅkaḷi neruppuṇṇac ceytāṉ; nāṭu eṉṉum peyar maṟintu kāṭu eṉṉum peyar peṟacceytāṉ; ataṉāl, āṭu māṭukaḷ taṅkiyirunta iṭaṅkaḷil puli mutaliya koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷ taṅkalāyiṉa; ūrāy irunta iṭaṅkaḷ pāḻāyiṉa; annāṭṭu makaḷir tuṇaṅkik kūttiṉiyum kuravik kūttiṉiyum maṟantaṉar; cāṉṟōr irunta periya avikaḷil pēy makaḷir āṭi ulāviṉar; illuṟi teyvaṅkaḷ ulāvi akaṉṟa ūril vīṭṭu vāyilil iruntu peṇṭir varunti aḻutaṉar; avar tam uṟaviṉar irunta vēṟṟu nāṭukaṭṭuc ceṉṟaṉar; periya māḷikikaḷ ventu vīḻntaṉa; ammāḷikiyil irunta karinta kutirkaḷil āntikaḷ iruntu alaṟiṉa; ceṅkaḻunīr irunta poykikaḷil yāṉiyi maṟikkum vāṭkōriyum caṇpaṅkōriyum neruṅki vaḷarntaṉa; erutukaḷ uḻuta vayalkaḷil paṉṟikaḷ ōṭittirintaṉa. iṅṅaṉam, neṭuñceḻiyaṉ paṭiyeṭuppāl pakivar nāṭukaḷ pāḻāyiṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 152-176).
toṇṭimāṉ iḷantiriyaṉ veḷḷiya kompiṉiyuṭiya kariya yāṉip piṇattik kurutiyākiya āṟu iḻuttukkoṇṭu pōkumpaṭi porutavaṉ; turiyōtaṉaṉ mutaliya nūṟṟuvarum kaḷattilēyē iṟakkumpaṭi periya pōri veṉṟa tarumaṉ mutaliyōrippōla, eṇṇil aṭaṅkāta paṭiyuṭaṉē kōpittut taṉmēl vanta pakivari veṉṟavaṉ; avveṟṟik kaḷippiṉāl āravāram ceytavaṉ; taṉṉuṭaṉ pōriṭṭavar kaḷiṉ nāṭṭu ūr maṉṟaṅkaḷ pāḻākumpaṭi aḻittavaṉ; taṉakku aṭaṅki naṭantavar nāṭṭi vaḷamākkiyavaṉ (pe. ā. paṭi, 414-425). iḷantiriyaṉ, ciṅkakkuruḷi yāṉi mītu pāyntu ataṉ mattakattik koḷḷa virumpiṉāṟpōlap pakivariṉ kāvaliyuṭiya matili aḻittu aṅku irunta aracaruṭiya muṭikkalam mutaliyavaṟṟi vāṅki vīramuṭi puṉiyum iyalpu paṭittavaṉ; ammatilaracaṉ cantu ceytaṟku uṭaṉpaṭṭālum, taṉ uṭaṉpaṭātavaṉ (pa. pāli, aṭi, 448-454).
naṭukal
pōril viḻuppuṇ paṭṭu iṟanta vīrarkkuk kal eṭuttu viḻāc ceytal marapu. atuvē tamiḻakattuḷ ciṟappuṟṟa vīrar vaṇakkamāy iruntateṉpatu tolkāppiyar virivākak kūṟalāl naṉku viḷaṅkum. 1.kaṟkāṇṭal, 2.kālkōḷ, 3.kalli nīrppaṭuttal, 4.kalli naṭutal, 5.vīraṉ peyar ceyal mutaliyavaṟṟik kalliṉmītu poṟittal, 6 kāl koṇṭa teyvattiṟkuc ciṟappuc ceytu vāḻttal eṉa ikkal eṭuppu viḻā āṟuvakippaṭum eṉpar tolkāppiyar.1 naṭukallip pīliyālum malarālum aṇi ceytu, palliyam olikka viḻavu ceytal tamiḻar marapu. iṅṅaṉam nāṭṭappaṭum kalliṟkuk kōvilum matilum vāyilum ēṉic ciṟappukaḷum ceytalum paḻantamiḻar marapu. itaṉic ceṅkuṭṭuvaṉ kaṇṇakikkuk kōyil eṭuttataṉik koṇṭu viḷakkamāka aṟiyalām.
iṅṅaṉam vīrarkkuk kal naṭṭami-naṭṭu vaḻipaṭṭami paṇṭittamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷil palaviṭattum parakkak kāṇalām.
oru nāṭṭiṉmēl paṭiyeṭukka virumpum aracaṉ mutalil taṉ vīrari ēvip pakivaruṭiya kālnaṭikaḷik kavarvāṉ. itu veṭcittiṇi eṉappaṭum. immuyaṟciyil īṭupaṭṭavar veṭci malarkaḷic cūṭuvar. im muyaṟciyi etirttu niṟpatu `karantittiṇi eṉappaṭum. avarkaḷ karanti malarkaḷic cūṭikkoḷvārkaḷ. piṉpu annāṭṭiṉ mītu paṭiyeṭuppu naṭipeṟum. atu `vañcittiṇi eṉappaṭum. appayeṭuppi etirttu niṟl `kāñcittiṇi eṉappaṭum. kōṭṭiyi muṟṟukiyiṭal `uḻiñit tiṇi eṉappaṭum. kōṭṭiyuḷ iruntu etirttal `noccittiṇi eṉappaṭum. kōṭṭikkappāl veṭṭaveḷiyil naṭipeṟum kaṭumpōr `tumpittiṇi eṉappaṭum. pōril veṟṟi peṟutal `vākittiṇi eṉappaṭum. ovvoru tiṇicceyalilum īṭupaṭṭa vīrarkaḷ avvat tiṇikkuriya malarkaḷi aṇintukoḷḷutal marapu.
ippōrkaḷil tam vīrattikkāṭṭic ciṟanta vīrar pārāṭṭukkuriyavarāvar. oru paṭi citaṟi ōṭukiṉṟatu. uṭaṉē oru vīraṉ tōṉṟi appaṭikku muṉ niṉṟu, pakivarit tākki alikkaḻittu, iṟutiyil pakivar tākkutalāl maṭikiṟāṉ. ittakiya vīratti avaṉic cērnta aracaṉum maṟṟa vīrarum pārāṭṭuvar. avaṉ iṟanta iṭattil allatu avaṉ uṭali eritta iṭattil avaṉatu vīrattiṟku aṟikuṟiyāka oru kalli naṭuvar. akkallil avaṉatu uruvam poṟikkappaṭum. avvuvattiṉ kīḻ avaṉ peyarum vīracciṟappum kuṟikkappaṭum. iṅṅaṉam naṭappeṟum kal, muṉpu kūṟiyapaṭi naṉku tērnteṭukkappaṭṭum, nīrāṭṭappaṭṭum irukkum. akkalliṉmītu mayiṟpīli cūṭṭappaṭum. kal naṭappaṭṭa aṉṟu akkallic cuṟṟilum mēlē tuṇippantal amikkappaṭum.
	uyarici veṟuppat tōṉṟiya peyarē
maṭañcāl maññi aṇimayir cūṭṭi
iṭampiṟar koḷḷāc ciṟuvaḻip
paṭañcey pantark kaṉmici yatuvē
eṉpatu puṟanāṉūṟu (ce. 260).
naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭil ittakiya naṭukaṟkaḷ iraṇṭu iṭaṅkaḷil iruntaṉa. akkaṟkaḷiṉmītu iṟanta vīrar peyarkaḷum pīṭum poṟikkap paṭṭiruntaṉa. avaṟṟuṭcila, marāmaraṅkaḷiṉ niḻalilē naṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. avvaḻic ceṉṟa kūttar viṟaliyar mutaliyōr tam yāḻi vācittu, anneṭukaṟkaḷil uṟinta teyvaṅkaḷi vaḻipaṭṭuc ceṉṟaṉar (malipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 386-396).
3. aracar vaḷḷaṉmi
muṉṉuri
tamiḻakatti āṇṭu vanta cēra cōḻa pāṇṭiyar eṉṟa muṭipuṭi mūvēntarum pāri, kāri, atikaṉ pōṉṟa ciṟṟaracarum paḻutta maraṅkaḷi nāṭic cellum paṟavikaḷip pōlat tammi nāṭi vanta iyaṟṟamiḻil valla pulavariyum, icittamiḻil valla pāṇariyum, nāṭakattamiḻil valla kūttariyum malarnta mukattuṭaṉ varavēṟṟaṉar; arukiliruntu uṇavu aruntiṉar; uyarnta āṭikaḷi vaḻaṅkiṉar; araṇmaṉiyilēyē pala nāḷ irukkac ceytaṉar; iṟutiyil vēṇṭiya paricili nalki viṭiyaḷittaṉar.
iṅṅaṉam maṉṉarāl matippuppeṟṟa pulavar perumakkaḷ avarkaḷip pārāṭṭip pāṭiya pāṭalkaḷ pala. avaṟṟuṭcila, puṟanāṉūṟṟilum patiṟṟuppattilum iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. nūṟu aṭikaḷukku mēṟpaṭṭa neṭum pāṭalkaḷ cila, pattuppāṭṭuḷ iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. karikālaṉi viyantu pāṭiya porunar āṟṟuppaṭi, paṭṭiṉappāli, nalliyakkōṭaṉi viyantu pāṭiya ciṟu pāṇāṟṟuppaṭi, toṇṭimāṉ iḷantiri yaṉip pārāṭṭip pāṭiya perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi, neṭuñceḻiyaṉip pārāṭṭip pāṭiya maturik kāñci, naṉṉaṉip pōṟṟip pāṭiya kūttarāṟṟuppaṭi eṉpaṉa, aracar muttamiḻvāṇari varavēṟṟu upacaritta muṟiṟi naṉku pulappaṭuttavaṉavākum. iṉi ivaṟṟuḷ ovvoṉṟiyum taṉittaṉiyē kāṇpōm:
karikālaṉ upacarippu
porunar eṉpavar, taṭāri eṉṉum icikkaruvi koṭṭip pāṭum icivāṇar. avaruḷ oruvaṉ taṉ vaṟumiyip pōkka viḻintu, karikālaṉ araṇmaṉiyi vikaṟiyilē aṭintāṉ; taṉatu taṭāriyik koṭṭik karikālaṉi vāḻttiṉāṉ. avvaḷavil karikālaṉ avaṉmuṉ tōṉṟiṉāṉ; muṉṉarē taṉṉōṭu paḻakiya naṇpaṉi varavēṟpatu pōlap porunaṉi varavēṟṟāṉ; upacāra moḻikaḷik kūṟiṉāṉ; taṉakkuc ciṟitu tolivil avaṉi irukkac ceytāṉ; avaṉi aruḷ uṇarcciyōṭu nōkkiṉāṉ; īrum pēṉum kuṭiyiruntu aracāṇṭa porunaṉatu kantalāṭiyi akaṟṟiṉāṉ; `iḻi pōṉa vaḻi itu, eṉṟu kaṇṭaṟiya iyalāta nuṇṇiya nūlāl neyyappaṭṭa pūttoḻil aminta tukilik koṭuttu uṭukkac ceytāṉ. avvaḷavil pāṭṭālum kūttālum collālum aracaṉi makiḻvikkum aḻakiya paṇippeṇṭir, porunaṉatu kaḷippi, nīkkattakka matuvip poṉ vaṭṭilil vārttuk koṭuttuk kuṭikkac ceytaṉar.
piṉpu porunaṉ uṟaṅkik kaṇ viḻittāṉ. vaṟutta āṭṭiṟiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷum, cuṭṭa iṟiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷum, mulli arumpiṉi otta ariciccōṟum paṭikkappaṭṭaṉa. avaṟṟōṭu, paralip poṭitta ataṉōṭē kūṭṭiya porikkaṟikaḷum paṭikkappaṭṭaṉa. karikālaṉ, uṭaṉ iruntu, ivaṟṟiyellām uṇṇumpaṭi porunaṉi upacarittāṉ. iṅṅaṉam nāḷkaḷ kaḻintaṉa. oru nāḷ apporunaṉ taṉatu ūr cella viṭi kēṭṭāṉ. avvaḷavil karikālaṉ, eṉatu kūṭṭatti viṭṭuppōka virumpukiṉṟāyō? eṉṟu ciṉantavaṉ pōlac collik kaḷiṟṟōṭu kaṉṟiyum piṭiyiyum avaṉukku vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; avaṉukkup poṟṟāmari malari vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; vēṇṭum paricili nalkiṉāṉ; taṉ kālālē ēḻaṭi piṉṉē vantu vaḻiyaṉuppiṉāṉ (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 73-168).
nalliyakkōṭaṉ upacarippu
ōymāṉāṭṭi āṇṭa nalliyakkōṭaṉatu araṇmaṉi vāyil pulavarkkum porunarkkum pāṇarkkum kūttarkkum antaṇarkkum taṭiyiṉṟit tiṟantu viṭappaṭṭatu. avarkaḷ enta nērattilum avvāyiluḷ taṭiyiṉṟic cella vacatiyaḷikkappaṭṭatu (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 203-206). nalliyakkōṭaṉ icikkaliyil vallavaṉ. avaṉ taṉṉiṭam paricil peṟa virumpi vanta pāṇaṉi makiḻvuṭaṉ varavēṟṟāṉ; mūṅkil āṭiyi urittālotta mācillāta uṭiyiṉi vaḻaṅki, uṭukkac ceytāṉ; kaḷ teḷivit tantu avaṉatu vaḻi naṭanta kaḷippip pōkkiṉāṉ; vīmapākattil ciṟanta camiyaṟ kāraṉ camittu vitta uṇavup poruḷkaḷip piḷḷikaḷukkuc ciṟiya poṟkalaṅkaḷil uṇavip paṭittāṉ. tāṉ niṉṟapaṭi iruntu avarkaḷi upacarittu uṇpittāṉ; tāṉ taṉ pakivaṉi veṉṟu koṇṭu vanta poṉṉiyum poruḷiyum pāṇaṉukku vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; kutirikaḷit tēril pūṭṭi attērmītu pāṇaṉi amaracceytu vaḻi kūṭṭi aṉuppiṉāṉ (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 235-261).
iḷantiriyaṉ upacarippu
kāñci nakarattu araṇmaṉiyil vāḻnta iḷantiriyaṉ, taṉṉi aṭinta perumpāṇaṉatu kantalāṭiyi akaṟṟiṉāṉ; pālāviyi otta nūlāṟ ceyta tukiliṉi uṭukkac ceytāṉ; paṇpaṭṭa maṭiyaṉ tayāritta pala vaki iṟiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷiyum cennel ariccōṟṟiyum paṭittu uṇpittāṉ; pāṇaṉuṭiya piḷḷikaḷukkuc ciṟiya veḷḷik kalaṅkaḷil uṇavip paṭittāṉ; mukamalarcci yuṭaṉ tāṉ niṉṟapaṭi iruntu uṇpittāṉ; pāṇaṉatu talimuṭiyil poṟṟāmariyic cūṭṭiṉāṉ; poṉṉari māliyi viṟaliyarkku vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; nāṉku kutirikaḷ pūṭṭiya tēril perumpāṇaṉi amarac ceytu, vēṇṭum paricili īntu vaḻiyaṉuppiṉāṉ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 467-493).
neṭuñceḻiyaṉ upacarippu
pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ taṉṉi nāṭivanta porunarkkuk kaḷiṟum, piṭiyum, kaṉṟum koṭuttāṉ; poṉṉāṟceyta tāmarippūvic cūṭṭiṉāṉ; vili uyarnta vēṟu aṇikalaṉkaḷi vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 100-105); pāṇarkkup palavaki iṟiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷiyum, pala vakippaṭṭa cōṟṟiyum, iṉiya matuviyum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; viṟaliyarkkut toṭikaḷi aṇivittāṉ; pāṇar makiḻumpaṭi yāṉikaḷi vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; tāṉ pakivar araṇkaḷiṟ koṇṭa pala poruḷkaḷiyum koṭuttāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 211-220); appāṇṭiyaṉ taṉatu araṇmaṉiyil vikaṟiyil vantu tiraṇṭa akavarkkut (aḻittup pukaḻpavar) tēriyum kutirikaḷiyum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 223-224).
pāṇṭiyaṉ nāḷtōṟum taṉatu nāḷōlakka maṇṭapattiliruntu, pulavar varuka, pāṇar varuka, pāṇicciyar varuka, kūttar varuka, eṉṟu ovvoruvarāka aḻittu, avarkkum avarāl pātukākkap peṟṟa avar kuṭumpat tiṉarkkum tērkaḷiyum yāṉikaḷiyum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; iṟicci, matu, porikkaṟikaḷ mutaliya uṇavupporuḷkaḷi viruntāka vittāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 749-756). ammaṉṉatu araṇmaṉi vāyil muttamiḻvāṇarkku eṉṟum aṭiyāta vāyilāy iruntatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 747-748).
naṉṉaṉ upacarippu
naṉṉaṉ pakivari veṉṟu, avar tiṟamiyākat tanta pēraṇikalaṅkaḷip pulavar, pāṇar, kūttar, cūtar, mākatar mutaliyōrkku vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; maḻi pōlap poṉṉi vāri vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ. paruvam poyyāta mēkam piṉṉarum peyyumāṟupōla mēṉmēlum kuṟiyāmal vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (malipaṭukaṭām; 70-76). apperumakaṉ taṉṉi nāṭi vanta kūttari, nīvir eṉmītuḷḷa aṉpiṉāl iṅka vantatē cālum! eṉṟu upacarittāṉ; mukamalarntu avarkaḷi aṉpōṭu pārttāṉ; iḻi pōṉa iṭam aṟiyāta nuṇṇiya nūlāṟceyta kaliṅkatti uṭukkac ceytāṉ; avarkaḷip pala nāḷ taṉṉuṭaṉ iruttiṉāṉ; mutal nāḷ pōṉṟa viruppattōṭē avarkaḷi naṉku naṭattiṉāṉ; kūttar talivaṉukkup poṟṟāmariyic cūṭṭiṉāṉ. avaṉuṭaṉ ceṉṟa viṟaliyarkkup pēraṇikalaṉkaḷi vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ. tērkaḷ, yāṉikaḷ, ēṟukaḷi uṭiya pacukkaḷ, kutirikaḷ, peruñcelvam ivaṟṟi vaḻaṅki makiḻacciyōṭu vaḻiyaṉuppiṉāṉ (malipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 545-575).
aracar kalivāṇari upacarittatiliruntu nām aṟiyattakuvaṉa yāvi? aracar mutaṉmutalil vaṟumi vaṭivāy irunta kaliñarkaḷiṉ kantalāṭiyik kaḷintu, uyarnta putiya āṭiyik koṭuppatiyē mutaṟkaṭamiyākak koṇṭaṉar. `āṭiyaṟṟa maṉitaṉ ari maṉitaṉ, eṉpati avvaracar naṉku uṇarttiruntaṉar. ataṉāl, kaliñariṉ māṉattikkākka mutalil āṭiyi vaḻaṅkiṉar; ataṟkup piṉṉarē avartam kaḷippip pōkka iṉiya kuṭinīri vaḻaṅkiṉar; kaḷippu nīṅkiya piṉpu aṟucuvi uṇṭiyit tām niṉṟu uṇpittaṉar; avarkaḷit tam cuṟṟattāreṉak karuti upacarittaṉar; nāṭṭiṉ uyir nāṭi kaliyē eṉpatiyum, kali vāḻntāltāṉ kuṭimakkaḷiṉ uḷḷam paṇpaṭum eṉpatiyum, akkalikkut kāvalarkaḷāṉa pulavar, pāṇar, kūttar eṉpār vaṟumiyiṉṟi vāḻntāltāṉ kali vāḻum eṉpatiyum tamiḻakattu aracar teḷivuṟa uṇarntiruntaṉar; ākavē, kalivāṇari ollum vakiyālellām ōmpu vantaṉar.
kuṭi makkaḷ upacarippu
iṅṅaṉam muttamiḻvāṇarit tamiḻaracar maṭṭum upacarikkavilli; avar tam kuṭimakkaḷum upacarittārkaḷ. naṉṉaṉik kāṇac ceṉṟa kūttarkku avaṉatu mali nāṭṭu mulli nilattil iṭiyar makaḷir maṉamakiḻcciyōṭu pāli vaḻaṅkiṉar; tamakkeṉṟu camittirunta pāṟcōṟṟi vaḻaṅkiṉar; āṭṭut tōṟpaṭukkiyil paṭukka vittaṉar. kūttar, naṉṉaṉatu nāṭu kākkum kāvarikkaṇṭu tām naṉṉaṉik kāṇappōvatākak kūṟiṉar. uṭaṉē akkāvalar avarkaḷukkup pala vaki iṟiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷiyum kiḻaṅkukaḷiyum vaḻaṅki uṇpittaṉar; avarkaḷ cella vēṇṭiya vaḻiyi viḷakkik kūṟiṉar (malipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 407-427). ivvivaraṅkaḷ, akkāla aracarkaḷum potumakkaḷum muttamiḻvāṇariṭam koṇṭirunta perumatippi naṉku viḷakkuvaṉavākum.
19. toḻilum vāṇikamum
1. toḻilkaḷ
uḻavum vāṇikamum ulakattut toḻilkaḷil mikuttuc collat takuvaṉa. avviraṇṭāltāṉ celva vaḷattittiraṭṭal kūṭum, (ma. kā. 120-3) eṉpatu māṅkuṭi marutaṉār karuttu.
aivaki nilattuc ciṟapput toḻilkaḷ
kuṟiñci nilattu makkaḷ maliccarivup pakutikaḷiyum malimītu camanilamāyuḷḷa pakutiyiyum viḷinilamākkutal, mali nel tiṉi mutaliya kūla vakikaḷi vitittal, tiṉippuṉaṅkaḷik kāttal, tēṉeṭuttal, kiḻaṅku vakikaḷip payirākkutal, vēṭṭiyāṭutal mutaliya toḻilkaḷil īṭupaṭṭiruntārkaḷ.
pālinila makkaḷ, piṟa nilaṅkaḷiluḷḷa āṉirikaḷik kavartal, vaḻippaṟi ceytal ākiya toḻilkaḷic ceytārkaḷ. mulli nila makkaḷ cāmi vitittal, varaku vitittal, kālnaṭikaḷi mēyttal, pāl tayir mōr veṇṇey ney ivaṟṟi viṟṟal mutaliya toḻilkaḷil īṭupaṭṭārkaḷ.
marutanila makkaḷ, vayalkaḷi uḻutal, nel vitittal, nāṟṟu naṭutal, kaḷi eṭuttal, vayalkaḷukku nīr pāyccutal, aṟuvaṭi ceytal, kaṭā viṭutal mutaliya payirttoḻil toṭarpāṉa toḻilkaḷil īṭupaṭṭiruntārkaḷ.
neytal nila makkaḷ, ōṭam, mitavi, paṭaku mutaliyavaṟṟi amittal, mīṉ piṭittal, uppi viḷittal, mīṉ viṟṟal, mīṉkaḷi uppiṭṭup patappaṭuttutal, avaṟṟi viṟṟal mutaliya toḻilkaḷil muṉintiruntārkaḷ.
inta aintu nila makkaḷum taṅkaḷukkuriya vīṭukaḷi amikkum toḻiliyum ceytu vantārkaḷ; maṇcuvar eḻupputal, vikkōl mutaliyavaṟṟikkoṇṭu kūriyamittal, maṇṇikkoṇṭu ceṅkal ceytu ularttutal, ularntavaṟṟic cūḷiyiṭṭuc cuṭutal mutaliya toḻilkaḷiyum aṟintiruntārkaḷ. ovvoru nilattilum paṟi, tuṭi, muḻavu, pampi mutaliya karuvikaḷic ceyyum toḻilum naṭipeṟṟatu. curuṅkakkūṟiṉ, ovvoru nilattilum avvannila makkaḷuṭiya cūḻnilikku ēṟpat toḻilkaḷ amintiruntaṉa eṉalām. ittoḻilkaḷil āṭavarum peṇṭirum tattamakkuriya pakutiyic ceytaṉar eṉṟu kūṟutal poruttamākum.
potut toḻilkaḷ
pattuppāṭṭuḷ pala toḻilkaḷukkuriya karuvikaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa; pala toḻilkaḷ peyarkaḷum kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivi iraṇṭiyum oṉṟu cērppiṉ, annūliṟkuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷa toḻilkaḷ iṉṉavi eṉpati eḷitil aṟiyalām.
1. kuḻici (pāṉi), aṭuppu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 99) eṉṉum peyarkaḷik koṇṭu maṭpāṇṭat toḻil iruntamiyi eḷitil aṟiyalām.
2. tēr, pāṇṭil, uḷi (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 52, 258-260), ulakki (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 97), nukam, accu, pār, uruḷi (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 63-66) eṉṉum poruḷkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ akkālat taccut toḻili niṉivūṭṭukiṉṟaṉa. taccar `karuntoḻil viṉiñar eṉṟu kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉar (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 257).
3. uḻukoḻu, kuyam (arivāḷ), kattiriki (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 29, 117, 242), yāṉiyi aṭakkum tōṭṭi (tirumuruku. aṭi, 78), tōl, turutti (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 206, 207), irumputtakaṭu (aṭi, 222), kavimuṭkaruvi, muttiki (cammaṭṭi) (mul. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 35, 59), nilam akaḻum uḷi, vaḷivukkatti, toṭalivāḷ (ma. kā. aṭi, 635, 636, 637) eṉṉum karuvikaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ kollat toḻil naṉku naṭipeṟṟatit terivikkiṉṟaṉa. ivi allāmal pōrkkaruvikaḷāṉa vāḷ, vēl, īṭṭi, cūlam mutaliyaṉavum kollaṉāl uruvākkappaṭṭaṉavē ākum.
4. ammi, kuḻavi, tiriki (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 229) eṉpavi, kal taccar toḻili niṉivūṭṭukiṉṟaṉa.
5. `vāri eṉṉum collum `tottoḷippāy eṉṉum uriyum (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 50), pāy piṉṉum toḻil iruntamiyip pulappaṭuttum.
6. toṭutōl-ceruppu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 169; ma. kā. aṭi, 636) tōl toḻil iruntamiyi uṇarttum.
7. pāṇṭimātēviyiṉ tantakkaṭṭiliṉmītu kañciyiṭṭuc calavi ceyyappaṭṭa tukil virikkappaṭṭiruntatu eṉpataṉāl (neṭunalvāṭi, aṭi, 134-135) calavit toḻil naṭipeṟṟu vantatu eṉpatu naṉku tuṇiyappaṭum.
8. tukil, kaliṅkam mutaliya uyarnta āṭikaḷum, cātāraṇa āṭikaḷum vaḻakkil iruntamiyi nōkka, necavut toḻil mikac ciṟanta toḻilāy iruntami aṟiyappaṭum. `uṭi eṉṉum pakutiyil itu paṟṟiya viḷakkam kāṇka. kūṭārattuṇi eṉṉum oru vaki muraṭṭuttuṇiyum akkālattil neyyappaṭṭatu.
ituvariyiṟ kūṟappaṭṭa toḻilkaḷ ikkālattil kirāmak kittoḻilkaḷ eṉṟu vaḻaṅkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
9. uppaṅkaḻikaḷukku arukil uppeṭukkum toḻil naṭipeṟṟatu. uppeṭukkum nilappakuti `aḷam eṉappaṭum. attoḻil īṭupaṭṭavar `aḷavar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. upput tayārikkappaṭṭa iṭattilēyē uppu viṟkappaṭṭatu. kaṭalōra pakutikaḷil-uppaṅ kaḻiyuḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷil ittoḻil naṉku naṭipeṟṟatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 117).
10. kuṭṭam, vayal, ilañci, poyki mutaliya nīr nilikaḷil tūṇṭil, vali mutaliyavaṟṟikkoṇṭu mīṉ piṭikkum toḻil naṭipeṟṟatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 270-274, 283-85 ma. kā. 247-255). kaṭaṟkarip pakutiyil periya valikaḷi vīci mīṉ piṭikkum toḻil naṭipeṟṟatu. mīṉkaḷi uppiṭṭu uṇakkum toḻilum naṭipeṟṟatu. (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 163, ma. kā. aṭi, 319-20).
11. celvar vāḻum vaḷamaṉikaḷilum araṇmaṉikaḷilum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭa viciṟi, ālavaṭṭam eṉappaṭṭatu. ataṉit tayārittavaṉ `kival kammiyaṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ. aḵtu uṟiyil iṭṭup pātukākkappaṭṭatu (ne. vāṭi, aṭi, 57, 58). itu `viciṟi ceyyum toḻil eṉappaṭum.
12. periya nakaraṅkaḷil nūlāl varintu pantum pāviyum ceyyum toḻilum (tirumuruku. aṭi, 68), nūlēṇi mutaliyaṉa ceyyum toḻilum (ma. kā. aṭi, 640) naṭipeṟṟaṉa. ivi `nūl toḻil eṉappaṭum.
13. neṭṭiyikkoṇṭu pala vaki malar mālikaḷ pommikaḷ mutaliyaṉa ceyyum toḻil vaḻakkiliruntatu (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 54).
14. araciyal aluvalar, uyarkuṭip peṇṭir mutaliyōr caṭṭiyum kaccum aṇintiruntaṉar eṉpati nōkkat tiyal toḻil ciṟappuṟṟiruntami aṟiyalām (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 69). itu paṟṟiya piṟa vivaraṅkaḷi `uṭi eṉṉum pakutiyiṟ kāṇka.
15. mikak kūriya ciṟṟuḷi koṇṭu yāṉit tantattāl aracamātēvikkuriya vaṭṭakkaṭṭil amikkappaṭṭiruntatu. ciṅkam mutaliyavaṟṟi vēṭṭiyāṭutal pōṉṟa pala kāṭcikaḷ nuṇṇiya takaṭukaḷiṉmītu poṟikkappaṭṭaṉa. (neṭunal vāṭi, aṭi, 116-123) eṉṉum vivaraṅkaḷi nōkka, mika nuṭpamāṉa taccut toḻil vaḻakkil iruntami aṟiyappaṭum.
16. aracamātēvikkuriya aṇikaḷ aṉṉap pēṭṭiṉ tūviyāl āṉavi. kaṭṭiliṉmītu, paṭukki (metti) virikkappaṭṭiruntatu eṉṉum ceytikaḷ, akkālattil uyarnta muṟiyil mettikaḷum taliyaṇikaḷum tayārikkum toḻil uyarniliyil iruntatip pulappaṭuttum (neṭunal vāṭi, aṭi, 131-135).
17. maturi mānakaril caṅku aṟuttal, aṟutta caṅki vaḷi mutaliyaṉavākak kaṭital, aḻakiya maṇikaḷit tuḷiyiṭutal, poṉ nakikaḷic ceytal, palavaki āṭikaḷi neytal, pūmālikaḷit tayārittal, palavakic cāntukaḷit tayārittal pōṉṟa pala toḻilkaḷ naṭipeṟṟaṉa eṉṟu maturik kāñci (aṭi, 511-518) moḻikiṉṟatu. maṇiceyyum toḻilum naṭipeṟṟatu (pa. pāli, aṭi, 232).
18. muṉpu kūṟappaṭṭa aracamātēviyiṉatu kaṭṭiliṉ mēṟkūṟiyil ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ, urōkiṇi mutaliya kōḷkaḷiṉ ōviyaṅkaḷ variyappaṭṭiruntaṉa (ne. vāṭi, aṭi, 159-163) eṉṉum ceyti akkāla ōviyat toḻili uṇarttuvatākum.
19. poṉṉi aṭittuk kāppu mutaliyavaṟṟic ceyyum taṭṭārat toḻilum, kalluppatitta nakikaḷic ceyyum irattiṉappaṇit taṭṭārat toḻilum ciṟappuṟa naṭipeṟṟaṉa. pala vaki taliyaṇikaḷ, kātaṇikaḷ, kaḻuttaṇikaḷ, tōḷaṇikaḷ, kiyaṇikaḷ, viralaṇikaḷ, iṭiyaṇikaḷ, kālaṇikaḷ pattuppāṭṭuḷ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avi mikavuyarnta vēlippāṭu koṇṭavi. avi paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷi `aṇikaḷ eṉṉum pakutiyil kāṇalām. appalavaki aṇikaḷum iruntamiyi nōkka, akkālap poṟkollat toḻil mikavuyarnat niliyi aṭin tiruntami teḷivākum.
20. neytal nila makkaḷākiya paratavar tamatu mīṉ piṭikkum toḻilukku ōṭam, paṭaku, mitavi mutaliyavaṟṟip payaṉpaṭuttiṉar. avar avaṟṟi amikkum toḻililum vallunarāyiruntaṉar. tamiḻakam caṅkakālak kaṭal vāṇikattil kīḻi nāṭukaḷuṭaṉum, mēli nāṭukaḷuṭaṉum neruṅkiya toṭarpu koṇṭiruntamiyi nōkkat tamiḻar kappal kaṭṭum toḻilil tērntavarāyiruntiruttal kūṭumeṉṟu karutul poruttamākum.
21. uṭalukku aḻakik koṭukkum karuṅkāliyic cīvik kāycci ataṉip paciya pākkuṭaṉ kalantu cāyap pākkit tayārikkum toḻil naṭipeṟṟatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 400-401).
22. caṅkakālat tamiḻakattil nūṟṟukkaṇakkāṉa pulavarkaḷ iruntamiyik kāṇkiṟōm; appulavarkaḷ ciṟṟūrkaḷic cērntavarkaḷ eṉpati aṟikiṟōm. itaṉāl akkālac ciṟṟūrkaḷilum pērūrkaḷilum kalvi kaṟpikkum toḻil uyarnta muṟiyil iruntiruttal vēṇṭumeṉṟu karutul tavaṟākātu.
2. payirttoḻil
kuṟiñci nilappayirkaḷ
maliyic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa aṭivārap pakutiyil eḷ, tiṉi, avari, varaku, mūṅkil nel, veṇiciṟukaṭuku, iñcikkiḻaṅku, kavalikkiḻaṅku, mali vāḻi, mā, palā eṉpavi viḷintaṉa (malipaṭu. aṭi, 102-139).
malimītu ciṟappākat tiṉi payir ceyyappaṭṭatu. cila kiḻaṅku vakikaḷum payir ceyyappaṭṭaṉa.
mulli nilappayirkaḷ
avari ciṟappākap payir ceyyappaṭṭatu (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 164) tiṉi, eḷ, varaku mutaliyaṉa payirāyiṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 271-272). mulli nilattil aṟuvaṭiyāṉa varaku mutaliya vaṟṟikkoṇṭa kutirkaḷ mulli nilac cīṟūrkaḷil peṇ yāṉikaḷ niṉṟāṟpōla niṉṟaṉa (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 186). varakuppayir muṉ paṇi toṭaṅkum paruvattil katir piṭikkumām (mul. pā. aṭi, 98-100).
maruta nilappayirkaḷ
kāviriyāṟum ataṉ kiḷiyāṟukaḷum cōḻanāṭṭil toṉṟu toṭṭup pāyntu varukiṉṟaṉa. karikālaṉ mutaliya cōḻamaṉṉarkaḷ āṟṟaṅ karikaḷi uyarttiṉārkaḷ; aṇikaḷik kaṭṭiṉārkaḷ; vāykkālkaḷi veṭṭiṉār kaḷ  ivaṟṟāl cōḻanāṭu cōṟṟuvaḷam mikanta nāṭāyiṟṟu. aṅku oru mā nilattil tiṭar tōṟum neṟkūṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. oru vēli nilattil āyiram kalam cennel viḷintatu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 246-248). itaṉālētāṉ `cōḻavaḷanāṭu cōṟuṭittu, eṉṉum paḻamoḻi vaḻaṅkalāyiṟṟu. iṉṟum cōḻanāṭu `tamiḻakattiṉ neṟkaḷañciyam eṉṟu kūṟappaṭukiṟatu.
uḻavar uḻavuttoḻiliṟ payiṉṟa periya erutukaḷip pūṭṭi ēri uḻutaṉar; kalappiyiṉ koḻu nilattil maṟiya amukki uḻutaṉar eṉṟu perum pāṇāṟṟuppaṭi uḻavip paṟṟip pēcukiṟatu (aṭi, 198-200). ceṟu, cey eṉṟu vayal peyar peṟṟiruntatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 210). cennel, tōppi nel (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 230, 142), mūṅkil nel (malipaṭu. aṭi, 121) eṉa nel pala vakippaṭum. veṟṟilik koṭikaḷi vaḷarttu veṟṟili payir ceyyappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. mo, 400-401) nghY«!1
3. vāṇikam
uḷ nāṭṭu vāṇikam
kuṟiñci nilamakkaḷ, tēṉ, kiḻaṅku, māṉ taci, matu mutaliyavaṟṟip piṟa nilamakkaḷukku viṟṟut taṅkaḷukku vēṇṭiya uṇavup poruḷkaḷi vāṅkik koṇṭārkaḷ. ivvāṟē neytal nilamakkaḷ mīṉ, ney, naṟavu mutaliyavaṟṟip piṟanilamakkaḷukku viṟṟut taṅkaḷukku vēṇṭiya uṇavup poruḷkaḷip peṟṟārkaḷ. marutanilamakkaḷ, aval, nel, karumpu mutaliyavaṟṟi viṟṟup piṟa nilattup paṇṭaṅkaḷip peṟṟārkaḷ. (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 214-217). mulli nilamakkaḷ pāl, tayir, mōr, veṇṇey mutaliyavaṟṟip piṟa nilaṅkaḷil viṟṟut taṅkaḷukku vēṇṭiya paṇṭaṅkaḷip peṟṟārkaḷ. iṅṅaṉam paṇṭaṅkaḷik koṭuttup paṇṭaṅkaḷip peṟutal `paṇṭamāṟṟu eṉappaṭum. nāṇayaṅkaḷ tōṉṟuvataṟku muṉpu ippaṇṭamāṟṟu muṟiyē ulakil neṭuṅkālam iruntu vantatu.
uṇavupporuḷkaḷuḷ mikacciṟantatu uppu. uppu vāṇikar uppaḷaṅkaḷiliruntu uppi vāṅki, vaṇṭikaḷil ēṟṟikkoṇṭu, ūrūrāyc ceṉṟu viṟṟaṉar. uppu vaṇṭiyē avartam vīṭākavum payaṉpaṭṭatu. uppu vāṇikaṉ maṉiviyum cila camayaṅkaḷil vaṇṭiyōṭṭiṉāḷ. avaḷ kaṇavaṉ, vaṇṭiyiḻukkum erutukaḷ kaḷippuṟṟāl vēṟu urutukaḷi vaṇṭiyil pūṭṭuvataṟkut tayārākat taṉṉuṭaṉ iraṇṭu erutukaḷi ōṭṭik koṇṭu uppu vaṇṭiyōṭu celvatu vaḻakkam (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 55-59).
miḷaku, cēranāṭṭil viḷintatu. atu piṟa nāṭukaḷukkuk koṇṭu cellappaṭṭatu. vaṇikar miḷakup potikaḷik kaḻutikaḷiṉmītu ēṟṟi ūrūrāyc ceṉṟu viṟṟaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 80-81).
kappalkaḷil vantu tuṟimuka nakaraṅkaḷil iṟakkumatiyāṉa muttu, pavaḷam, māṇikkam, cantaṉam mutaliya poruḷkaḷ uḷ nāṭṭu vaṇikarāl viṟkappaṭṭaṉa (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 67-76).
tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉar payirttoḻilip pōlavē uḷ nāṭṭu vāṇikattiyum veḷi nāṭṭu vāṇikattiyum vaḷam peṟa vaḷarttaṉar; tam nāṭu muḻumiyum vaṇṭikaḷ cellakkūṭiya nalla pātikaḷi amittiruntaṉar; vāṇikap poruḷkaḷip pātukākka āṅkāṅkuk kāvalari vittiruntaṉar; peruvaḻikaḷilum kavartta vaḻikaḷilum viṟpaṭi vīrar iruntu kāval kāttaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 78-81, ma. kā. aṭi, 310-312). pātikaḷil cellum vaṇikap poruḷkaḷukku ulku (vari) vacūlikkappaṭṭatu; āṅkāṅkuc cuṅkac cāvaṭikaḷ iruntaṉa (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 80-81).
nāḻi eṉpatu mukattalaḷaviyiṉ peyar (mullip pāṭṭu aṭi, 10). pīṭu mikka māṭa maturiyil makaḷirum vāṇikam ceytaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 621-623).
akanāṉūṟu mutaliya akapporuḷ toki nūlkaḷil tamiḻvāṇikar tamiḻakattukku vaṭakkēyum ceṉṟu vāṇikam ceytaṉar eṉpati uṟutippaṭuttum kuṟippukaḷ pala kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivvuḷ nāṭṭu vāṇikam pāṭalipurattit talinakarāykkoṇṭu makata nāṭṭi nantarkaḷ āṇṭa kālam mutaṟkoṇṭu toṭarntu naṭipeṟṟu vantatu eṉpatu akkuṟippukaḷiliruntu terikiṟatu. eṉavē, tamiḻ vaṇikar vaṭavintiyāvilum vāṇikam ceytu vantaṉar eṉpatu iṅku aṟiyappaṭum.
kaṭal vāṇikam
ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. āyirattil vāḻnta cālamaṉ aracar kālattiliruntē tamiḻar kaṭal vāṇikam ceytu vantaṉar eṉpatu ārāycciyil aṟiyappaṭukiṉṟatu. kaṭal vāṇikattiṟkuk kappalkaḷ tēvi. kappalkaḷ vantu taṅkavum, poruḷkaḷi ēṟṟavum iṟakkavum vacatiyāṉa tuṟimukaṅkaḷ tēvi. caṅkakālat tamiḻakattil ittakiya tuṟimukaṅkaḷ paṟpala iruntaṉa eṉpatip perippuḷū āciriyar, piḷiṉi, tālami pōṉṟa mēṉāṭṭu yāttirikar eḻutiyuḷḷa kuṟippukaḷiliruntu aṟiyalām.1
pattuppāṭṭuḷ cila tuṟimuka nakaraṅkaḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avi eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam, paṭṭiṉam (māmallapuram), koṟki, kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉam eṉpaṉa. eyiṟpaṭṭiṉam ōymāṉāṭṭut tuṟimukanakaram; paṭṭiṉam eṉpatu, toṇṭi nāṭṭut tuṟimukanakaram; koṟki eṉpatu, pāṇṭi nāṭṭut tuṟimukanakaram; kāvirip pūmpaṭṭiṉam eṉpatu cōḻa nāṭṭut tuṟimuka nakaram.
eyiṟpaṭṭiṉattiṟku akil mutaliya maṇapporuḷkaḷ vantaṉa (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 155). toṇṭināṭṭup paṭṭiṉam eṉṟa tuṟimukattil vaṭa nāṭṭup poruḷkaḷum mēli nāṭṭukkutirikaḷum piṟavum iṟakkumatiyāyiṉa. aṅku vāḻnta paratavar celva vaḷam peṟṟut tikaḻntaṉar. vaṇikar periya vaḷamaṉikaḷil vāḻntaṉar. avartam makaḷir melliya tukiliyum paciya vaṭaṅkaḷ kōtta maṇikaḷiyum piṟa aṇikaḷiyum aṇintu celvac ceḻippōṭu kāṇappaṭṭaṉar. avar tam kālkaḷil poṟcilampukaḷ olittaṉa. avarkaḷ poṉṉāṟceyta kaḻaṟcik kāykaḷikkoṇṭu maṇalil viḷiyāṭiṉārkaḷ. attuṟimukanakaril mikavuyarnta kalaṅkari viḷakkam iruntatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 319-336, 346-348).
koṟki nakarattil mutteṭuppār cēri, caṅku kuḷippār cēri eṉṉum pala cērikaḷiruntaṉa. aṅkuc ciṟappāka mutteṭukkum toḻilum, caṅkeṭukkum toḻilum naṭipeṟṟaṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 133-136). veṇmiyāṉa uppu, karuppukkaṭṭi kūṭṭip poritta puḷi, uppiṭṭu ularttappaṭṭa mīṉ tuṇṭaṅkaḷ, pēraṇi karaṅkaḷ mutaliya poruḷkaḷ koṟkiyiliruntu ēṟṟumatiyāyiṉa. kutirikaḷ, yavaṉanāṭṭup pāvi viḷakkukaḷ, matuvakikaḷ mutaliyaṉa iṟakkumati ceyyappaṭṭaṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 318-324).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil periya tuṟimukam amintiruntatu. aṅku ariya kāvaliyuṭiya paṇṭacāli iruntatu. ēṟṟumatip poruḷkaḷum iṟakkumatip poruḷkaḷum appaṇṭacāliyil kuvintiruntaṉa. ovvoru paṇṭappotiyiṉ mītum cōḻa aracāṅka muttiriyākiya puli muttiri poṟikkappaṭṭiruntatu. pakkattil cuṅkaccāvaṭiyum iruntatu. aṅkirunta tuṟimuka aluvalar iravu pakal iḷippiṉṟi vēli ceytaṉar. kutirikaḷ mikutiyāy iṟakkumatiyāyiṉa; cēranāṭṭiliruntu kaṭal vaḻiyē miḷakup potikaḷ vantaṉa; tamiḻakattiṟku vaṭapāliruntu māṇikkak kaṟkaḷum, cāmpūnatam eṉṉum poṉṉum, pāṇṭināṭṭu muttukaḷum, kuṭaku malic cantaṉak kaṭṭikaḷum akiṟ kaṭṭikaḷum, kīḻtticik kaṭaliliruntu pavaḻamum, kaṅkic camaveḷiyil uṇṭāṉa poruḷkaḷum, kaṭārattil (malāyā) uṇṭāṉa poruḷkaḷum, cīṉam mutaliya nāṭukaḷiliruntu vanta karuppūram paṉinīr kuṅkumam mutaliyaṉavum iṟakkumatiyāyiṉa (pa. pāli. aṭi, 118-125, 185-192 uri).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil vāṇikattiṉporuṭṭup palanāṭṭu makkaḷ kuṭiyēṟiyiruntārkaḷ (pa. pāli. aṭi, 214-217). poruḷkaḷi ēṟṟikkoṇṭu vanta marak kalam `vaṅkam eṉap peyar peṟṟatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 536).
caṅkakālattil tamiḻakattōṭu vāṇikam ceytu vanta airōppiyar yavaṉar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avarkaḷ caṭṭi aṇintiruntārkaḷ; kaṇṇāṭip poruḷkaḷ, maṇap poruḷkaḷ, iyantirap poṟikaḷ, matu vakikaḷ mutaliya vaṟṟit tamiḻnāṭṭil iṟakkumati ceytārkaḷ. avarkaḷ pāvi viḷakkuc ceyvatil paṇpaṭṭavarkaḷ.
