pūmpukār vaṇikar
`pūmpukār eṉpatu kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattukkuriya peyarkaḷuḷ oṉṟu. aṅkuk karikālaṉ kālattil vāḻnta vaṇikar tam paṇṭaṅkaḷiyum piṟapaṇṭaṅkaḷiyum viṟkumpōtum vāṅkumpōtum nērmiyāka naṭantu koṇṭaṉar; tām koḷḷum paṇṭattit tām koṭukkum poruḷukku mikiyākak koḷḷavilli; tām koṭukkum paṇṭattiyum tām vāṅkum paṇṭattiṟkuk kuṟivākak koṭukkavilli; ilāpatti veḷippaṭiyākac colli viṟṟaṉar; aṟavaḻiyilēyē naṭantaṉar; uyirkkoliyit tavirttaṉar; uyirkkoli purivōriyum akkoṭun toḻililiruntu vilakkamuṟpaṭṭaṉar; pacukkaḷik kāttaṉar; vēḷvikaḷic ceytaṉar; tāṉaṅkaḷic ceytaṉar; ēḻikaḷ poruṭṭum tāṉaṅkaḷ ceytaṉar (pa. pāli. aṭi, 196-211).
20. illaṅkaḷum pāttiraṅkaḷum
1. illaṅkaḷ
kuṟiñci nila illaṅkaḷ
kuṟiñci, pāli, mulli, marutam, neytal ākiya aivaki nilaṅkaḷilum ciṟṟūrkaḷilum pērūrkaḷilum caṅkakālattil illaṅkaḷ evvāṟu amintiruntaṉa eṉpati innūlāl ōraḷavu aṟiyalām.
maliyum malicārnta iṭamumākiya kuṟiñci nilattil tiṉi mutaliya payirkaḷit tiṉṉa varum yāṉi, paṉṟi mutaliya vilaṅkuḷiyum kiḷi mutaliya paṟavikaḷiyum viraṭṭu vataṟkākak kāṉavar uyarnta marakkiḷikaḷil paraṇ kaṭṭiṉar. (pe. ā. paṭi, 51-52. kuṟiñci nilamakkaḷ kuṟiya kālkaḷi naṭṭut tiṇiyarintatāḷāl vēynta kuṭilil vāḻntaṉar (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 153-4). kaḻikaḷi naṭṭup pullāl vēynta kuṭilkaḷil cavvātu mali makkaḷ vāḻntārkaḷ (malipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 438-9).
pāli nila illaṅkaḷ
uṇavup poruḷkaḷip payir ceyya iyalāta nīr vaḷamaṟṟa nilam pāliyākum.
	mulliyum kuṟiñciyum muṟimiyiṉ tirintu
nalliyal piḻantu naṭuṅkutuyar uṟuttup
pāli yeṉpatōr paṭivam koḷḷum
								-cilampu, kāti, 11, aṭi, 64-66.
ātalāl, pāli nilam perumpālum kuṟiñcikkum mullikkum iṭiyil amintirukkum. aṅku veppam mikuti; naṉṉīr kiṭittal aritu. viḷivu iṉmiyāl pāli nila makkaḷuṭcilar pāli nila vilaṅkukaḷiyum paṟavikaḷiyum vēṭṭiyāṭuvar; cilar, āṟalikaḷvarākip piḻippar. avartam illaṅkaḷ ciṟukuṭilkaḷēyākum. veyiṟkālattil avvillaṅkaḷil iruppōr veyilāl tuṉpuṟuvar (ciṟu. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 174) akkuṭilkaḷ vēliṉ muṉiyi otta kūrmiyiṉiyuṭiya muṉikoṇṭa īntiṉuṭiya iliyāl vēyappaṭṭavi. akkuṭilkaḷil māṉ tōliyē paṭukkiyākak koṇṭu piḷḷiyip peṟṟa eyiṉamakaḷ muṭaṅkikkiṭantāḷ eṉṟu perum pāṇāṟṟuppaṭi pēcukiṟatu (aṭi, 86-90). nāṭṭup peruvaḻikaḷik kāval purinta eyiṉar vāḻnta illaṅkaḷum kuṭilkaḷēyākum. avi kuḻiyāl vēyappaṭṭavi; avaṟṟil vāḻntavar māṉ tōliyē paṭukkiyākak koṇṭaṉar (ma. kā. 310-311).
mulli nila illaṅkaḷ
kāṭum kāṭu cārnta iṭamum mulliyākum. innilattil āṭumāṭukaḷi mēytta āyar vāḻntaṉar. avarkaḷ vāḻnta kuṭilkaḷ varakuttaṭṭiyāl vēyappaṭṭavi; avaṟṟiṉ kālkaḷil āṭṭumaṟikaḷ niṉṟu tiṉṉattakka taḻikaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. kuṭiliṉ katavu kaḻikaḷāl kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. kuṭiliṉ vāyil ciṟiyatu. akkuṭilil varakukkaṟṟikaḷāl vēynta cēkki iruntatu. āṭṭuk kiṭāyiṉ tōlkaḷē pāyalākap payaṉpaṭṭaṉa. kuṭiliṉ muṟṟattil kuṟiya muḷikaḷ patikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. avaṟṟil neṭiya tāmpukaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. avi āṭumāṭukaḷik kaṭṭap payaṉpaṭṭaṉa. iṅṅaṉam āyar vāḻnta illaṅkaḷik koṇṭa ciṟṟūr, kaṭṭu muḷ vēliyiṉi uṭiyatāyiruntatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 147-154). cavvātu maliyil vāḻnta āyar, āṭṭut tōlkaḷi oṉṟākat tittup paṭukkiyākap payaṉpaṭuttiṉar; iravil koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷ tam kuṭilkaḷiṭam vārātapaṭi neruppi erittaṉar (mali, aṭi, 419-20).
mulli nilattuc cīṟūrkaḷil uḻutuṇpār vāḻntaṉar. aṅku irunta ilalaṅkaḷ varaku vikkōlāl vēyappaṭṭavi; aḻakiyavi. illattiṉ muṟṟattil piṭi niṉṟāṟpōṉṟa varaku mutaliya kūla vakikaḷ vikkappeṟum kutirkaḷ iruntaṉa; muṟṟattup pantaril pāṉiyiṉ kāli otta varaku tiriki naṭappaṭṭiruntatu. kalappiyum uruḷikaḷum vikkappaṭṭa koṭṭil iruntatu. akkoṭṭiliṉ orupāl erutukaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 186-191).
marutanila illaṅkaḷ
vayalum vayal cārnta iṭamum marutamākum. marutam, nīrum pacumiyāṉa vayalkaḷum tōṭṭaṅkaḷum tōppukaḷum cōlikaḷum niṟintuḷḷa iṭam. uḻavar vayal varappil taṅkip payirkaḷik kāval kākkap putiya vikkōlāl vēynta kavinta kuṭili amittuk koṇṭaṉar. ataṉ muṟṟattil uḻattiyar aval iṭittaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 224-6).
vaḷamuṭiya ūrkaḷil uḻavar vīṭukaḷiṉ muṟṟattil kaṉṟukaḷik kaṭṭa neṭiya tāmpukaḷik koṇṭa muḷikaḷ naṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. nīṇṭa ēṇikku eṭṭāta neṭiya vaṭiviṉiyuṭiya kutirkaḷ iruntaṉa. piḷḷikaḷ anta muṟṟattil ciṟutēr uruṭṭi viḷiyāṭiṉārkaḷ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 243-249). muṟṟattiṉ ittaku ciṟappik koṇṭu illam naṉmuṟiyil amintiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟu nām niṉikkalām.
teṉṉantōppukaḷukku iṭiyil marutanilac cīṟūrkaḷ pala amintiruntaṉa. muṭiyappaṭṭa teṉṉi ōlikaḷ vēynta vīṭukaḷ avvūrkaḷil iruntaṉa. vīṭṭu muṟṟattil mañcaḷ payirāyiruntatu; maṇam nāṟiya pūntōṭṭam piṉṉē iruntatu (pe. ā, paṭi, aṭi, 351-356).
marutanilap pakutiyilētāṉ maṟiyavar vāḻntu vantaṉar. toṇṭi nāṭṭil avarkaḷ illam oṉṟu irunta niliyip perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭi kūṟukiṟatu. vīṭṭiṉ muṉ puṟam pantal amintiruntatu. ataṉ ciṟiya kālkaḷuḷ oṉṟil pacukkaṉṟu kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntatu. avvīṭṭik kōḻiyum nāyum neruṅkavilli. vīṭṭil kiḷi vaḷarkkappaṭṭatu. ataṟku vēta ōci kaṟpikkappaṭṭatu. (aṭi, 297-300).
maruta nilattil vali vīci mīṉ piṭittu vāḻntavar `valiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avarkaḷ vañci marak kompukaḷiyum kāñci marak kompukaḷiyum kalantu naṭṭu vēḻakkōli variccāka nirittut tāḻinārāl kaṭṭit taruppip pullālē vēyappaṭṭa kuṟiya iṟappiyuṭiya kuṭilkaḷil vāḻntārkaḷ. avarkaḷ kuṭiliṉ muṟṟattil mīṉi vāri eṭukkum paṟikaḷ iruntaṉa. kuṭiliyaṭuttu vaḷinta kāliyuṭiya puṉṉi marak kompukaḷ amitta pantar iruntatu. appantaṉmītu curikkoṭi mutaliya paṭarkoṭikaḷ paṭarntu kāykaḷōṭu viḷaṅkiṉa (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 263-267).
neytal nila illaṅkaḷ
kaṭalum kaṭal cārnta iṭamum `neytal eṉappaṭum. innilattu makkaḷ mīṉ piṭittu vāḻntārkaḷ. kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattuk kaṭaṟkariyil vāḻnta paratavar, tāḻnta kūriyik koṇṭa kuṭilkaḷil vāḻntaṉar. kūriyil tūṇṭiṟkampukaḷ ceruki vikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. kuṭiliṉ muṟṟattil mīṉ paṭikka utaviya valikaḷ kāya vikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa.
nakarattu illaṅkaḷ
nakaraṅkaḷil irunta pala vaki illaṅkaḷip paṟṟiya kuṟippukaḷi aṭuttuk kāṇpōm:
toṇṭi nāṭṭut tuṟimukappaṭṭiṉam piṟkālattil māmallapuram eṉappeyar koṇṭatākum. atu caṅka kālattil `nīrppeyṟṟu eṉṉum pērūriṉ oru pakutiyāyiruntatu. atu vāṇikat talamāy iruntamiyiṉ, celvac ceḻumiyōṭiruntatu. eṉavē, aṅkup pala terukkaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil irunta vīṭukaḷ māṭaṅkaḷip peṟṟu uyarntiruntaṉa. `tēvar ulakattit tīṇṭum māṭaṅkaḷ eṉṟu perum pāṇāṟṟuppaṭi āciriyar avvillaṅkaḷik kuṟittuḷḷār. ammāṭaṅkaḷil pēraṇi kalaṅkaḷi yuṭiya makaḷir vāḻntaṉar; ammāṭaṅkaḷil pantaṭittu viḷiyāṭiṉar. ammāḷikikaḷiṉ muṉ irunta maṇalil ammāṭaṅkaḷukkuriya celva makaḷir amarntu kaḻaṅkāṭiṉar (aṭi, 325-335).
pāṇṭiyaṉ talinakarāṉa maturiyil irunta cila illaṅkaḷ pala kūṟupāṭukaḷip peṟṟu vāṉaḷāviyiruntaṉa; teṉṟaṟkāṟṟu olikkum pala cāḷaraṅkaḷiyuṭi7yaṉa vāyiruntaṉa. `pala kūṟupāṭukaḷ-maṇṭapam, kūṭam, tāykkaṭṭu, aṭukkaḷi eṉṟāṟpōlum peyarkaḷik koṇṭa illappakutikaḷ eṉpatu, nacciṉārkkiṉiyar tarum viḷakkamākum (ma. kā. aṭi, 357-58). periya māṭaṅkaḷil nilā muṟṟaṅkaḷ amintiruntaṉa. ammāṭaṅkaḷil koṭikaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa (avi avarkaḷ camayatti uṇarttiya koṭikaḷāyirukkalām). maṅkiyar ammāṭaṅkaḷil irunta nilā muṟṟaṅkaḷil niṉṟu kōvil viḻākkaḷik kavaṉittaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 444-452).
celvar illaṅkaḷil iḷavēṉiṟkālattut tuyilum paṭukkikkut teṉṟaṟkāṟṟit tarum cālēkam (cāḷaram) iruntatu. celvamakaḷir aṅku niṉṟu ulavuvatu vaḻakkam (neṭunalvāṭi, aṭi, 61-62). piḷḷikaḷ mūṉṟu uruḷi kaḷik koṇṭa ciṟu tēri uruṭṭi viḷiyāṭuvataṟkēṟṟapaṭi celvar vīṭukaḷil akaṉṟa muṟṟam iruntatu (pa. pāli, aṭi, 20-25). maturi nakarattuc celvar illaṅkaḷ akaṉṟiruntaṉa; kāvalarip peṟṟiruntaṉa; kuṟṟēval iḷiñariyum peṟṟiruntaṉa (neṭunal, 49-50).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattu maruvūrppākkattil kaṭaṟkarikku aṇmiyil uyarnta māṭaṅkaḷik koṇṭa vaḷamaṉikaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil viḷakkukaḷ iravu muḻumiyum erintukoṇṭiruntaṉa. viṭiyaṟkāliyil kaṭalil mīṉ piṭikkac ceṉṟa pūmpukārp paratavarukku avviḷakkukaḷ ōraḷavu tuṇi purintaṉa (pa. pāli, aṭi, 112-115).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattup periya māḷikikaḷil māṭattiṟkuc cellattakka aṇukiṉa paṭikaḷiyuṭiya neṭiya ēṇikaḷ iruntaṉa; pala kaṭṭukaḷ iruntaṉa; periyavāyilum ciṟiyavāyilum iruntaṉa; periya iṭi kaḻikaḷ iruntaṉa. ivvamippukaḷiyuṭiya vaḷamaṉi `maḻi tōyum uyar māṭatti uṭiyatu eṉṟu āciriyar kūṟiyuḷḷār (pa. pāli, aṭi, 142-145).
ittakiya vaḷamaṉikaḷil viruntiṟku vantavar mutalil māṭattut tali vāyilil neruṅkiyiruntaṉar; piṉpu uḷḷē ceṉṟu viruntuṇṭaṉar. ammāṭaṅkaḷiṉ cuvarkaḷ cāntiṭap peṟṟavi; uyarnta tiṇṇikaḷi uṭiyavi. attiṇṇi kaḷil kiḷikaḷ kūṇṭukaḷil iruntu vārttikaḷ pēcikkoṇṭiruntaṉa (pa. pāli, aṭi, 261-264).
aracaṉ kōvil
(maturiyil) pāṇṭiyarkku araṇmaṉi kaṭṭappaṭṭa viravaṅkaḷ neṭunalvāṭiyil kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa:
kaṭṭaṭam kaṭṭaṟkuriya iṭattil iraṇṭu kōlkaḷ naṭappaṭṭaṉa. akkōlkaḷiṭattuñ cāyā niḻalāl tāri pōka ōṭukiṉṟa niliyik kuṟittukkoḷḷum taṉmi tappātapaṭi cūriyaṉ niḻal oru pakkattic cārap pōkāta cittirittiṅkaḷ naṭuvil pattiṉiṉṟa oru nāḷil patiṉintām nāḻikiyil kaṭṭaṭattiṟkuriya aṅkurārppaṇam paṇṇap paṭṭatu. ciṟpācāriyar kūritāka nūli nērē piṭittut ticikaḷik kuṟittuk koṇṭārkaḷ. atticikaḷil niṟkum teyvaṅkaḷiyum kuṟivaṟap pārttārkaḷ; aracarkkēṟṟa maṉikaḷiyum vāyilkaḷiyum maṇṭapaṅkaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟiyum kūṟupaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; vaḷinta uyarnta matili eḻuppa ēṟpāṭu ceytārkaḷ. matilukku vāyil amikkappaṭṭatu. avvāyilukku iraṇṭu katavukaḷ poruttappaṭṭaṉa. akkatavukaḷukkuc cevvarakkup pūcappaṭṭatu. vāyiliṉ mēl niliyil ilakkumiyiṉ uruvam cetukkappaṭṭiruntatu. avvuruvattiṉ iraṇṭu pakkaṅkaḷilum pakkattiṟkoṉṟāka iṇṭu peṇ yāṉikaḷ kuvaḷi malarkaḷi ilakkumimītu corital pōṉṟa vāyil niliyil ciṟpaṅkaḷ amikkappaṭṭaṉa. niliyil teyvam uṟivatākat tamiḻar nampiṉarātaliṉ, anniliyil veṇciṟu kaṭukum neyyum taṭavi vittaṉar; avvāyil, koṭikaḷōṭu yāṉikaḷ ceṉṟu pukumpaṭi uyarntiruntatu, maliyi naṭuvē veḷiyākat tiṟantāṟpōṉṟiruntatu.
araṇmaṉi muṉṟiliṟparappaṭṭa maṇalil kavari māṉkaḷum aṉṉaṅkaḷum iyaṅkiṉa. nilāviṉ payaṉi araṇmaṉiyiṉar nukarum neṭiya veḷḷiya nilā muṟṟam iruntatu. mēl māṭattil viḻum maḻinīr vantu viḻa makaravāyākap pakutta vāyiṉiyuṭiya pantam aṅku iruntatu. ammuṟṟattil mayilkaḷum iruntaṉa. araṇmaṉiyil yavaṉar tanta pāvi viḷakkukaḷ iravil erintaṉa. antappurattil pala kaṭṭukaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil pāṇṭiyaṉ nīṅkalāka vēṟu āṭavar nuḻiyāta niliyil ariya kāval iruntatu.
antappurattut tūṇkaḷ nīlamaṇiyik kaṇṭāṟ pōṉṟa karumiyiṉiyum tiraṭciyiyum uṭiyavi. cuvarkaḷ cempiṉāl ceytāṟpōṉṟa vēlippāṭu niṟintavi. accuvarkaḷmītu vaṭivaḻakiṉiyuṭiya pala pūkkaḷikkoṇṭa vallikkoṭikaḷ ōviyaṅkaḷāy variyappaṭṭirunṉa (neṭunalvāṭi, aṭi, 72-114).
mullippāṭṭil aracaṉatu eḻunilimāṭam iṭattāl ciṟantu uyarntiruntatu eṉpatu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 86). iṉṟu tañcāvūr araṇmaṉiyil uḷḷa eḻunili māṭattik koṇṭu, caṅkakāla eḻunilimāṭam eṅṅaṉam iruntiruttal kūṭum eṉpati nām oruvāṟu uṇaralām.
ivvivaraṅkaḷ aṉittum caṅkakālat tamiḻariṉ kaṭṭaṭakkaliyaṟivi uṇarttuvaṉavākum. nakaric cūḻntirunta kōṭṭiccuvariṉ amippum akaḻiyiṉ amippum avartam kaṭṭaṭakkaliyaṟivi mēlum mikuttuk kāṭṭuvaṉavākum.
maturik kōṭṭiyic cūḻntirunta akaḻi, maṇ irunta aḷavum āḻamākat tōṇṭappaṭṭatu; nīlamaṇi pōṉṟa nīr nirampiyatu. kōṭṭi matil, vāṉit toṭumpaṭi pala kaṟpaṭikaḷōṭu amintiruntatu. matiliṉ vāyilil valimi mikunta teyva uruvaṅkaḷ aminta uyarnta nili iruntatu. iṭukku illāmal iṇikkappaṭṭa katavukaḷ poruttappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ak kōṭṭi vāyiliṉmītu mali pōla uyarnta māṭam amintiruntatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 351-6).
2. ulōkaṅkaḷ
caṅkakālat tamiḻar, irumpu, cempu, poṉ, veḷḷi ākiya nāṉku ulōkaṅkaḷik koṇṭu pala poruḷkaḷic ceytu payaṉpaṭuttiṉar eṉpatu terikiṟatu. ivi ittamiḻ nāṭṭiṟ paṇṭutoṭṭē kiṭittu vantaṉa eṉpatu pallava puram (pallāvaram), āticcanallūr mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷiṟkiṭitta puti poruḷkaḷikkoṇṭu naṉkaṟiyalām.1 iṉi ivi paṟṟip pattuppāṭṭuḷ kāṇappaṭum ceytikaḷik kāṇpōm:
irumpu
toṇṭi nāṭṭil irumpaṭikkum kollaṉ iruntāṉ. avaṉatu ulikkūṭam iruntatu. avaṉ vikaṟiyiyal taṉ ulikkūṭattil vēli ceytāṉ. avaṉ irumpaṭitta ōci kēṭṭu māṭattu uṟaṅkiya puṟaviṉ cēval añci uṟakkattiliruntu viḻittatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 436-40). arivāḷ, irumpu eṉappeyar peṟṟatu (malipaṭu. aṭi, 113). irumpiṉāl ceyyappaṭṭa viḷakkil eṇṇeyum tiriyum iṭṭu viḷakkēṟṟappaṭṭatu (neṭunal. aṭi, 42-3). irumpu melliya takaṭākkappaṭṭatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 222).
cempu
maturip puṟañcēriyil irunta camaṇap paḷḷiyiṉ cuvarkaḷ cempiṉāṟceytāṟpōla uṟuti peṟṟu viḷaṅkiṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 485). maturik kaṭit teruvil cempu niṟuttu vāṅkappaṭṭatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 514). pāṇṭiyaṉ araṇmaṉi, antappurattu neṭuñcuvarkaḷ cempiṭṭuc ceytāṟpōṉṟa uṟutiyum vēlippāṭum peṟṟiruntaṉa (neṭunal. aṭi, 112).
poṉ
poṉ eṉṉum col `polam eṉṟu māṟutaṟkut tolkāppiyattilēyē viti (puḷḷi mayaṅkiyal, nūṟpā, 61) kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatiliruntu poṉṉiṉ paḻimiyi naṉkaṟiyalām. poṉṉil pala vaki uṇṭu. araṇmaṉiyil poṉṉālāṉa kalaṅkaḷ (pāttiraṅkaḷ) iruntaṉa. polaṅkalaṅkaḷil matu vārttut tarappaṭṭatu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 85-7; ma. kā. aṭi, 779-80). poṟkalattil uṇavu paṭikkappaṭṭatu (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 244-5). maṉṉar poṉ māliyik kaḻuttil aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 61). tirumāl poṉ māliyi aṇintiruntāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 590-1). celvamakaḷir tali, kaḻuttu, tōḷ, ki, kātu, iṭi ākiya uṟuppukaḷil aṇinta pala vaki aṇikaḷum kal patitta nakikaḷum uyarāṭavar aṇinta māli, kaṭakam pōṉṟa aṇikaḷum poṉṉāl iyaṉṟaṉavēyākum. poṉkoṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa nakikaḷiṉ peyarkaḷum poṉṉiṉ vakiyum `aṇikaḷ eṉṉum pakutiyil virivāyk kāṇalām.
mullippāṭṭip pāṭiya pulavar kāvirip pūmpaṭṭiṉattup poṉ vāṇikaṉār makaṉār nappūtaṉār eṉpavar. poṉṉiṉ vēṟupāṭṭip pakuttaṟintavar poṉ vāṇikar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avar maturiyil vāḻntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 513). poṉ nakikaḷic ceytavar `poṟkollar eṉappaṭṭaṉar.
veḷḷi
veḷḷiyālāṉa kalam (pāttiram), uṇkalamākavum payaṉpaṭṭatu. atu ciṟiyatāyum iruntatu; periyatāyum iruntatu. ciṟiya veḷḷikkalaṅkaḷ piḷḷikaḷ uṇavuṇṇap payaṉpaṭṭaṉa. periya veḷḷikalaṅkaḷ periyavarkaḷ uṇavuṇṇap payaṉpaṭṭaṉa. tiriyaṉ araṇmaṉiyil ivveḷḷik kalaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 477-80). mulli malarkaḷ veḷḷiyiṉ niṟatti ottavi (ma. kā. aṭi, 280). pāṇṭiyaṉatu araṇmaṉic cuvaril veḷḷiyi otta cāntu pūcappaṭṭatu (neṭunal. aṭi, 110).
3. pāttiraṅkaḷ
potumakkaḷ taṅkaḷ illaṅkaḷiṟ payaṉpaṭuttiya pāttiraṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ palavākap pattuppāṭṭiṟ kāṇappaṭavilli; araṇmaṉiyil payaṉpaṭuttiya pāttiraṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷum mikutiyākak kāṇappaṭavilli. ciṟcila pāttiraṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷē kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟiyum vīṭṭup poruḷkaḷ vēṟu cilavaṟṟiyum iṅkuk kāṇpōm.
puḷiyaṅkāy, nellikkāy mutaliya ūṟukāykaḷ vikkappaṭṭa miṭā, `kāṭi vitta kalaṉ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 56-7) eṉappaṭṭatu. cōṟu camikkum pāṉi kuḻici eṉap peyar peṟṟatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 98, 366). tayirppāṉikkum ippeyar  vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 159); appam cuṭap payaṉpaṭṭa caṭṭi, akal (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 377) eṉappaṭṭatu. nīṇṭavuruvamum ciṟutta vāyumuṭiya pāttiram, kuppi eṉappaṭṭatu. pacci niṟakkuppi piṅkuṭam eṉappaṭṭatu. ataṉuḷ kaḷ vippatu vaḻakkam (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 380-82).
kuvinta vāyiyuṭiya nīruṇṇum pāttiram `tokuvāyk kaṉṉal eṉap peyar peṟṟatu (neṭu. aṭi, 64-66). nīr peytu vikkum oru vakip pāttiram `kuṟunīrkkaṉṉal eṉappaṭṭatu (mul. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 57).
karikālaṉ araṇmaṉiyil irunta aḻakiya paṇip peṇṭir aracaṉukkum avaṉuṭiya viruntiṉarkkum poṟkalattil makiḻi (kaḷḷi) ūṟṟik kuṭikkak koṭuttaṉar (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 84-87). `poṟkalam-poṉvaṭṭil eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri.
toṇṭimāṉ araṇmaṉiyil pāṇarkkum avar tam piḷḷikaṭkum viṇmīṉkaḷip pōṉṟa ciṟiya veḷḷip pāttiraṅkaḷiyum tiṅkaḷip pōṉṟa periya veḷḷippāttiraṅkaḷiyum parappi viruntu vittaṉar eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭiyiṟ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 477-480). `talivarāyiṉārkkup poṟkalam parappuvar eṉṟār eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār.
pāṇṭiyaṉ taliyālaṅkāṉattuc ceruveṉṟa neṭuñceḻiyaṉ polaṅkalattil maṇaṅkamaḻ tēṟalip parukiṉāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 779-80).
`polaṅkalam-poṉ vaṭṭil eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri. itē kalam `peṟalaruṅkalam (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 155-57) eṉṟum peyar peṟṟatu. `peṟutaṟkariya poṟkalam eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri.
nalliyakkōṭaṉ araṇmaṉiyil pāṇar pōṉṟa viruntiṉarkkum poṟkalam uṇkalamākap payaṉpaṭṭatu (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 241-44).
vāyakaṉṟa tāmpāḷam `malarvāyp piḻā eṉappaṭṭatu. ariciyik koṇṭu kaḷ tayārittavar ataṉip payaṉpaṭuttiṉar (pe. ā. paṭi. aṭi, 276). naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭil kaḻiyil (mūṅkiṟkuḻiyil) erumiyiṉ pāl tayirukkākat tōykkappaṭṭatu (mali. aṭi, 523).
kaṭṭiliṉ kāl, pakkam uruṇṭirunta kuṭatti uṭiya aṭiyip peṟṟiruntatu (neṭunal. aṭi, 120-2). itaṉāl pakkam uruṇṭirunta kuṭam eṉṉum pāttiram akkālattil iruntami veḷippaṭi.
nel, varaku mutaliya kūlaṅkaḷi vikkak kutirkaḷ iruntaṉa (pe. ā,. paṭi, aṭi, 187). irumpu viḷakkum, cantaṉak kallum, ālavaṭṭamum (viciṟiyum) iruntaṉa. (neṭunal. aṭi, 42, 51, 58).
nelliyum ariciyiyum cēmittu vikkap payaṉpaṭṭa poruḷ, mañciki eṉappaṭṭatu. atu `koṭṭakāram eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār. ippeyar iṉṟu maliyāḷattil koṭṭāram eṉa maruvi vaḻaṅkukiṟatu.
21. uṇavum uṭiyum
1. uṇavu
muṉṉuri
maṉitaṉ uyir vāḻa iṉṟiyamiyāta poruḷ uṇavākum. paṇṭi maṉitaṉatu mutal toḻilē uṇavu tēṭalāyiruntatu. avaṉ iyaṟkiyāyk kiṭitta kāykaḷiyum vitikaḷiyum kiḻaṅkukaḷiyum uṇṭāṉ; piṉṉarp paṟavikaḷiyum vilaṅkukaḷiyum vēṭṭiyāṭi avaṟṟiṉ iṟicciyip patappaṭuttāmalē uṇṭu vantāṉ; aṟivum ārāycciyum perukapperukat tīyi uṇṭākka aṟintāṉ; ataṉ piṉṉarētāṉ atukāṟum pacciyāy uṇṭu vanta poruḷkaḷip pakkuvappaṭutti uṇṇat toṭaṅkiṉāṉ. uṇavu vāyilākavē camutāya uṇarcciyum vaḷarntatu. kuṭumpattiṉar cērntu payirt toḻilic ceyyalāyiṉar. immuyaṟciyāl ciṟṟūrkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa. uṇavupporuḷkaḷi uṇṭākki uṇṇum muṟikaḷ māṟa māṟa, uṇavuṭaṉ cuviyum nākarikamum piṟavum vaḷarat toṭaṅkiṉa. camiyal toḻil oru kaliyāy māṟiyatu eṉpataṟku `naḷa pākam, `vīmapākam eṉṉum toṭarkaḷē ēṟṟa cāṉṟākum. `vīmapākam pakaṟṟiya kuṟippuc ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭiyil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷatu. iṉip pattuppāṭṭuḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa uṇavup poruḷkaḷik kāṇpōm:
porunar, pāṇar, kūttar eṉṉum kalivāṇar pēraracariyum ciṟṟaracariyum kaṇṭu tam kalikaḷi viḷakkip paricil peṟṟu vāḻntaṉar. maṉṉarkaḷ avarkaḷi iṉiya mukattuṭaṉ varavēṟṟu nalluṭikaḷiyum pala vaki uṇṭi vakikaḷiyum vaḻaṅki upacarittārkaḷ; vēṇṭiya poruḷutavi purintārkaḷ. kuṟiñci, pāli, mulli, marutam, neytal nilap potumakkaḷum akkalivāṇarit tammāl iyaṉṟa vari uṇavu tantu upacarittaṉar. ivvivaraṅkaḷ varum iṭaṅkaḷil akkālat tamiḻar uṇavu vakikaḷ kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. maturiyil ātular cāli iruntatu. aṅku vaḻaṅkappaṭṭa uṇavu vakikaḷ maturikkāñciyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟuṭaṉ pala kuṭi vakikaḷum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. iṉi ivi paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷik kīḻē kāṇpōm:
kuṟiñci nilattār uṇavu
cōḻanāṭṭuk kuṟiñcinila makkaḷ tēṉiyum kiḻaṅkiyum uṇṭārkaḷ; piṟa nilattārkkum viṟṟu mīṉ neyyiyum naṟaviyum vāṅkic ceṉṟārkaḷ (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 214-215). ciṟappu nāḷkaḷil ney mikka uṇavu uṭkoḷḷappaṭṭatu (ku. pāṭṭu. aṭi, 304).
naṉṉaṉukkuriya cavvātu maliyiṉ aṭivārattil irunta ciṟṟūrkaḷil vāḻnta makkaḷ tiṉiccōṟum neyyil venta iṟicciyum uṇṭārkaḷ (malipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 168-169).
naṉṉaṉuṭiya malikaḷic cērnta kuṟiñci nilattār, peṇ nāy kaṭitta uṭumpiṉ iṟicciyiyum kaṭamāṉ iṟicciyiyum paṉṟi iṟicciyiyum uṇṭaṉar; nellāṟcamitta kaḷḷiyum tēṉāṟceytu mūṅkiṟ kuḻiyuḷ muṟṟiya kaḷḷiyum parukiṉar; palākkoṭṭi, mā, puḷinīr, mōr ākiya ivaṟṟik koṇṭu tayāritta kuḻampiyum, mūṅkil aricic cōṟṟiyum uṇṭaṉar (malipaṭukaṭām, aṭi, 171-183); mali nāṭṭik kāval purinta vīrar iṟicciyiyum kiḻaṅkiyum uṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 425-426). malimītu naṭantu ceṉṟa kūttar, tiṉippuṉattuk kāvalaṉāl kollappaṭṭa kāṭṭup paṉṟiyiṉ mayirip pōkki mūṅkil paṟṟiyeriyum neruppil vatakki, appaṉṟiyiṉ iṟicciyit tiṉṟaṉar; tiṉṟu, eñciya pakutiyi vaḻiyuṇaviṟkāka eṭuttuc ceṉṟaṉar (aṭi, 243-249).
pāli nilattār uṇavu
ōymāṉāṭṭup pāli nila makkaḷāṉa vēṭṭuvar, iṉiya puḷiṅkaṟiyiṭappaṭṭa cōṟṟiyum āmāviṉ cūṭṭiṟicciyiyum uṇṭaṉar (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 175-177). toṇṭi nāṭṭup pālinila makkaḷ pullariciyic cērttu nilavuraliṟ kuṟṟic camitta uṇavi uppukkaṇṭattōṭu uṇṭārkaḷ; viruntiṉarkkut tēkkiliyil uṇavu paṭittārkaḷ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 95-100); mēṭṭu nilattil viḷinta īccaṅkoṭṭi pōṉṟa nellaricic cōṟṟiyum uṭumpiṉ poriyaliyum uṇṭārkaḷ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 130-133).
mulli nilattār uṇavu
toṇṭi nāṭṭu mulli nilattār pāliyum tiṉiyaricic cōṟṟiyum uṇṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 167-168); mulli nilac cīṟūrkaḷil iruntavar varakaricic cōṟum avarip paruppum kalantu ceyta `kummāyam eṉap peyar peṟṟa uṇavi uṇṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 192-195).
naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭu mulli nilattār civanta avari vitikaḷiyum mūṅkil ariciyiyum mēṭṭu nilattil viḷinta nelliṉ ariciyiyum puḷi karikkappaṭṭa uliyiṟpeytu, kuḻinta puḷiyaṅkūḻākki uṭkoṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 434-436). poṉṉi naṟukkiṉāṟpōṉṟa nuṇṇiya orē aḷavuṭiya ariciyi veḷḷāṭṭu iṟicciyuṭaṉ kūṭṭi ākkiya cōṟṟiyum tiṉimāviyum uṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 440-445).
maruta nilattār uṇavu
cōḻanāṭu cōṟṟu vaḷam mikuntatu; nalla kāy kaṟikaḷ mikkatu. ātaliṉ, cōṇāṭṭār nalla aricic cōṟṟiyum kāykaṟikaḷiyum nirampa uṇṭiruttal vēṇṭum. āyiṉum, cilavē innūluḷ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. marutanila makkaḷ karumpum avalum kuṟiñci nilattārkkuk koṭuttu, māṉ taciyiyum kaḷḷiyum peṟṟukkoṇṭaṉar eṉpatu porunar āṟṟuppaṭiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 216-217).
ōymāṉāṭṭu marutanilattār veṇcōṟṟiyum naṇṭum pīrkkaṅkāyum kalanta kalaviyi (kūṭṭi)yum uṇṭaṉar (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 193-195). toṇṭi nāṭṭu maruta nilattuc ciṟu piḷḷikaḷ (kāliyil) paḻiya cōṟṟi uṇṭaṉar; avali iṭittu uṇṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 223-226); toṇṭi nāṭṭu marutanilattār neṟcōṟṟip peṭṭikkōḻip poriyalōṭu uṇṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 254-256). toṇṭi nāṭṭut tōppukkuṭikaḷ palāppaḻam, iḷanīr, vāḻippaḻam, nuṅku, vaḷḷikkiḻaṅku, cōṟu mutaliyavaṟṟi uṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 356-366).
neytal nilattār uṇavu
ōymāṉāṭṭu neytal nilattār nuḷicci aritta kaḷḷiyum ularnta kuḻal mīṉiṉ cūṭṭiṟicciyiyum uṭkoṇṭaṉar (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 156-163). toṇṭi nāṭṭup paṭṭiṉattil (ikkāla māmalla purattil) nelliyiṭitta māvākiya uṇavi āṇ paṉṟikku iṭṭuk koḻukka vittaṉar; aṅṅaṉam koḻutta āṇ paṉṟiyik koṉṟu ataṉ iṟicciyic camittu uṇṭaṉar; kaḷippu mikunta kaḷḷipparukiṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, 339-345).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattu mīṉavar kaṭal iṟā, vayal āmi ākiya iraṇṭiyum pakkuvam ceytu uṇṭaṉar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 63-64); paṉaṅkaḷḷi uṭkoṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 89); nellaricik kaḷḷiyum parukiṉar (aṭi, 93). kaḷḷukkaṭiyil mīṉ iṟicciyum vilaṅku iṟicciyum porikkappaṭṭu viṟkappaṭṭaṉa (aṭi, 176-178).
maṟiyavar uṇavu
pāṟcōṟu, paruppuccōṟu, ākuti paṇṇutaṟku ēṟṟa irācāṉṉam eṉṉum nelliṉcōṟu, miḷakiṉ poṭiyuṭaṉ kalakkappaṭṭuk karuvēppili iṭappaṭṭup pacuneyyiṟ kiṭantu venta kommaṭṭi mātuḷaṅkāy, māvaṭu ūṟukāy eṉpavaṟṟit toṇṭi nāṭṭu maṟiyavar uṇṭaṉar 
(pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 304-310).
araṇmaṉikaḷil viruntu
cōḻanāṭṭu maṉṉaṉāṉa karikālaṉ taṉṉi nāṭi vanta porunaṉukkum avaṉic cērntavarkkum uṇavaḷitta tiṟam porunar āṟṟuppaṭiyil piṉ varumāṟu pēcappaṭṭuḷḷatu:
porunar araṇmaṉiyi aṭintavuṭaṉ paṇip peṇṭir, parukiyavari mayaṅkac ceyyum makiḻi (kaḷḷi)p poṟkalaṅkaḷil vārttut tantaṉar (aṭi, 84-88). porunar ataṉi uṇṭu, vanta kaḷippip pōkkikkoṇṭaṉar. koḻutta cemmaṟikkiṭāyiṉ iṟiccittuṇṭaṅkaḷ cila, irumpuk kampiyil kōttuc cuṭappaṭṭaṉa; vēṟu cila iṟicci vakikaḷ, vēkavikkappaṭṭaṉa; pala vaṭivaṅkaḷil amitta palvēṟu iṉippuc cuviyuṭiya paṇṇiyāraṅkaḷ (tiṉpaṇṭaṅkaḷ) vikkappaṭṭaṉa. mulli arumpi otta melliya ariciccōṟum paṭikkappaṭṭatu. pālikkāycci ataṉōṭu kūṭṭiṉa porikkaṟikaḷum vikkappaṭṭaṉa (aṭi, 103-116). piriyā viṭi peṟumpoḻutu iṉiyapū (kuṅkumappū) maṇakkiṉṟa tēṟal (kaḷ teḷivu) parukat tarappaṭṭatu (aṭi, 157).
ōymāṉāṭṭut talivaṉāṉa nalliyakkōṭaṉ araṇmaṉiyil pāṇarkkup pāmpu viṭam ēṟi mayakkiṉāṟpōla mayakkatti uṇṭākkum tēṟal (kaḷ teḷivu) tarappaṭṭatu; vīmacēṉaṉ varinta camiyaṟkali nūliṟkaṇṭapaṭi uṇavup poruḷkaḷ tayārikkappaṭṭup poṟkalaṅkaḷil paṭikkappaṭṭaṉa (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 237-244).
toṇṭi nāṭṭut talivaṉāṉa iḷantiriyaṉ eṉpāṉatu kāñci mānakarattu araṇmaṉiyil camiyalil vallōṉ pala iṟicci vakikaḷit tayārittāṉ; cenceṟcōṟṟi vaṭittāṉ; kaṇṭa carukkariyōṭu aṭicili (carukkarip poṅkal?) ākkiṉāṉ. iṅṅaṉam vallōṉāl ākkappaṭṭa palavaki uṇavupporuḷkaḷ pāṇar piḷḷikaḷukkuc ciṟiya veḷḷikkalaṅkaḷilum periyavarkaḷukkup periya veḷḷikkalaṅkaḷilum paṭikkappaṭṭaṉa. (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 471-480).
naṉṉaṉ talinakarāṉa ceṅkaṇmāttu araṇmaṉiyil, peṇ nāy kaṭittuk koṇarnta paciya niṇattiyuṭiya tacikaḷum veṇṇey aricic cōṟum kūttarkkup paṭikkappaṭṭaṉa (mali, 563-566).
maturiyil uṇavu
`pīṭu māṭamaturiyil vāḻnta pāṇar koḻuviya iṟicci vakikaḷit tiṉṟaṉar; pala vakic cōṟṟi veṟuttuk kaḷḷi mikutiyākap parukiṉar. eṉpatu maturikkāñciyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 210-213). maturiyil pala vakic cōṟukaḷ tayārikkappaṭṭaṉa eṉpatu itaṉāl terikiṟataṉṟō? ikkālattil veṇcōṟu, ūṉ cōṟu (ikkālap pulāl piriyāṇi pōṉṟatu), puḷiccōṟu, tayirccōṟu, carukkarip poṅkal, veṇpoṅkal eṉappaṭum cōṟṟu vakikaḷ akkālattilum iruntaṉa eṉṟu karutalām.
teṉpāṇṭi nāṭṭup paratavar (mīṉavar), koḻutta iṟicciyuṭṭuc camikkappaṭṭa cōṟṟic ciṟappāka uṇṭaṉar eṉṟu maturikkāñci kūṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 141).
pāṇṭiyar talinakarāṉa maturiyil ēḻikaḷukkuc cōṟiṭum cālikaḷ (ātular cālikaḷ) iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil irunta eḷiyarvarkkup palāccuḷi, māmpaḻam, vāḻippaḻam, muntirikippaḻam, pākaṟkāy, vāḻikkāy, vaḻutuṇaṅkāy (nīṇṭa kattarikkāy) mutaliya (camitta) kāykaḷ, pala vaki ilikkaṟikaḷ, iṉippup paṇṭaṅkaḷ, iṟicci kalanta cōṟu, (pakkuvappaṭuttappaṭṭa) palavakik kiḻaṅkukaḷ, pāṟcōṟu, pāl eṉpavi paṭikkappaṭṭaṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 527-535).
pāṇṭi nāṭṭil viḻā naṭipeṟṟa iṭaṅkaḷil viḻākkāṇa vantavarkkellām cōṟu paṭittal akkāla vaḻakkam (ma. kā. aṭi, 201-203).
pulāl aṟṟa uṇavu
perumpāṇaṉ toṇṭi nāṭṭil vētiyar vīṭṭil irācāṉṉam, mātuḷampiñcip piḷantu miḷakup poṭiyum karuvēppiliyum kalantu pacu veṇṇeyilē vēkavitta poriyal mutaliyaṉa kiṭikkum eṉṟu kūṟiṉāṉē tavirap pulāl kiṭikkum eṉṟu kūṟavilli (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 304-310). eṉavē, caṅkakāla vētiyar illaṅkaḷil pulāl uṇavu camikkappaṭavilli eṉṟu karutalām.
kaṭaṟkarippaṭṭiṉattiliruntu kaccikkuc cellum vaḻiyil irunta tōppukaḷil vāḻnta uḻavar illaṅkaḷil palāppaḻam, vāḻippaḻam, iḷanīr, nuṅku, kiḻaṅkukaḷ ākiyavi uṇavākak kiṭikkum eṉṟē apperumpāṇaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ. iṅkum avaṉ pulāl uṇavik kuṟikkavilli eṉpatu kavaṉikkattakum (aṭi, 351-362). itaṉāl pulāl uṇṇāta vēḷāḷarum toṇṭi nāṭṭil iruntaṉar eṉṟu karutalām.
iṅṅaṉamē kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil vāḻnta vēḷāḷar, koli ceyyātavar; kaḷavu ceyyātavar; tēvarkaḷi vaṇaṅkiṉar; avarkaḷukku vēḷviyil āvuti koṭuttaṉar; pacukkaḷiyum erutukaḷiyum pātukāttaṉar; vētiyar pukaḻip paravac ceytaṉar; ēḻikaḷukkup pala paṇṭaṅkaḷik koṭuttaṉar; ciṟanta nalloḻukkattip piṉpaṟṟi naṭantaṉar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 109-205).
ūṟukaṟi
kuṭumpattuṭaṉ uppi vaṇṭikaḷil ēṟṟi ūr ūrāyc ceṉṟu vāṇikam ceytuvanta umaṇar, ūṟukāyppāṉi kaḷit tam vaṇṭikaḷil kaṭṭiyiruntaṉar. ūṟukāy, `kāṭi eṉappaṭṭatu. atu vikkappaṭṭirunta pāttiram `kāṭi vitta kalam eṉappaṭṭatu. `puḷiyaṅ kāy, nellikkāy mutaliyaṉa ūṟaviṭṭu vittataṉik `kāṭi eṉṟār, eṉpatu nacciṉārk kiṉiyar viḷakkam.
ciṟṟuṇṭi
kūviyar (appavāṇikar) `kariya caṭṭiyil pākuṭaṉē vēṇṭuvaṉa kūṭṭi nūlpōla amittavaṭṭam (ikkāla iṭiyāppam pōṉṟatu) oru vakic ciṟṟuṇṭiyeṉap perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. (aṭi, 377-378). maturi nakarak kaṭitteruvil ciṟṟuṇṭik kaṭikaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟiṟ pākil camittal aminta nalla varikaḷiyuṭiya tēṉiṟālip pōṉṟa melliya aṭikaḷ ceyyappaṭṭaṉa; paruppiyum tēṅkāyiyum uḷḷīṭāyk koṇṭa kaṇṭa carukkari kūṭṭipiṭitta `mōtakam1 eṉṟa oru vakit tiṉpaṇṭamum ceyyappaṭṭatu. iṉiya pākōṭu cērttuk karitta māvik koṇṭu kūviyar pala ciṟṟuṇṭi vakikaḷic ceytaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 624-627).
kuṭi vaki
aracaṉ mutal āṇṭi īṟāka aṉivarumē akkālattil kuṭippaḻakkam uṭiyavarāyiruntaṉar. āyiṉ, avaravar tarattiṟkut takkapaṭi kuṭi vaki vēṟupaṭṭiruntatu. pūntēṉik koṇṭu oru vakik kuṭi ceyyappaṭṭatu; vēṟu vakit tēṉik koṇṭum kuṭi vaki tayārikkappaṭṭatu. iḵtu ikkāla `carpattup pōṉṟateṉṉalām. teṉṉaṅkaḷ, paṉaṅkaḷ, aricik kaḷ eṉappalavakik kuṭivakikaḷ vaḻakkil iruntaṉa. kaḷ mūṅkiṟ kuḻiyil ūṟṟi muṟṟacceytum parukappaṭṭatu. mēṉāṭukaḷiliruntu yavaṉarāl iṟakkumati ceyyappaṭṭa kuṭi vakiyum iruntatu. eḷiya makkaḷ mutal, nāṭāṇṭa maṉṉaṉ variyil ikkuṭiyil īṭupaṭṭiruntamiyāl, avarkaḷ uṇavil ikkuṭi vaki ciṟappiṭam peṟṟiruntatu eṉṉalām. ovvoru kuṭivakiyum pulavarāl taṉittaṉiyē ciṟappikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
kuṟiñci nilattār, neṭiya mūṅkilarici koṇṭu tayārikkappaṭṭa kaḷḷiṉ teḷivip parukiṉar; tēṉik koṇṭu tayāritta kaḷḷi mūṅkiṟkuḻiyuḷ iṭṭu muṟṟac ceytu parukiṉar. ikkaḷ tēkkaḷ tēṟal eṉappaṭṭatu (muruku. aṭi, 195).
illaṅkaḷil nellikkoṇṭum piṟaporuḷkaḷik koṇṭum kaḷ camikkappaṭṭatu.
illaṭu kaḷiṉ tōppi 2 paruki
eṉpatu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭiyil uḷḷa (aṭi, 142) toṭarākum. itaṟku, `tamatu illiṟ camitta kaḷḷukaḷil iṉitākiya nellāṟceyta kaḷḷiyuṇṭu eṉṟu nacciṉārk kiṉiyar uri varintuḷḷār (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 142). maturi māvaṭṭattil toppi (tōppi) nel eṉa oru vakiyuṇṭu. ittōpappi ariciyik koṇṭu tayārikkappaṭṭa kaḷ `tōppi eṉap peyar peṟṟatu pōlum!
toṇṭi nāṭṭu valiyar kaḷḷi eṅṅaṉam tayārittaṉar eṉpatip perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi kīḻvarumāṟu kūṟukiṟatu:
valiyar mutalil kuṟṟāta koḻiyal ariciyik kaḷiyākat tuḻāvik kūḻit tayārittu, ataṉi vāykaṉṟa taṭṭuppiḻāyil (tāmpāḷattil) ulara āṟṟuvar; nelmuṉiyi iṭittu akkūḻiṟ kalappar; akkalaviyi iraṇṭu pakalum iraṇṭu iravum ariyāmal cāṭiyil vippar; atu naṉku muṟṟiya piṉpu viralālē alittu arippar; aṅṅaṉam arikkappaṭum kaḷ vevviya nīrmiyi uṭiyatāka irukkum. iṅṅaṉam tayārikkappaṭṭa kaḷ `naṟumpiḻi eṉappaṭṭatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 275-281).
maturi nakaril vāḻnta milēccar (yavaṉar mutaliya veḷi nāṭṭavar) vaṇṭukaḷ moykkum kaḷḷip paruki makiḻntaṉar. akkaḷ `vaṇṭu mūcutēṟal eṉappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 33).
cōḻanāṭṭut tuṟimukanakaramāṉa kāvirip pūmpaṭṭiṉattup paratavar paṉaṅkaḷḷip parukiṉar. atu `peṇṇip piḻi eṉap peyar peṟṟatu (pa. pāli, aṭi, 89). peṇṇi-paṉimaram, kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattuc celva makaḷir maṭṭu eṉṉum peyar koṇṭa oruvakik kaḷḷiyum parukiṉar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 108). `maṭṭu-kaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkakkiṉiyar uri. āyiṉ, piṉṉūlāṉa cintāmaṇiyil `maṭṭu-kāmapāṉam eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyarē (ce. 98 uri) poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. mēlē kūṟappeṟṟa celva makaḷir `matu eṉap peyar koṇṭa oru vakik kaḷḷiyum parukiṉar. `matu-kāmapāṉam eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri (pa. pāli, 108). accelva makaḷir irākkālattil kaṇavarōṭu iṉpuṟap paṭṭāṭikaḷi nīkkip parutti yāṭikaḷi aṇintaṉar; `maṭṭu nīkki matu makiḻntaṉar, eṉṟu paṭṭiṉappāli āciriyar kūṟutalikkāṇa, `maṭṭu eṉpatu cātāraṇa iṉcuvippāṉam1 eṉṟum, ataṉāl ataṉi nīkki, vēṭkiyit tūṇṭum `matu eṉṉum kāmapāṉatti2 uṭkoṇṭaṉar eṉṟum koḷvatu poruttamākum.
naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭu makkaḷ, tēṉāl tayārikkappaṭṭa kaḷḷi mūṅkiṟkuḻiyuḷ viṭṭu muṟṟa viṭṭup piṉpu ataṉ teḷivip parukiṉārkaḷ eṉṟu malipaṭu kaṭām kūṟukiṉṟatu. akkaḷḷiṉ teḷivu `tēkkaḷ tēṟal eṉappaṭṭatu (aṭi, 171, 522), iṅṅaṉam tēṉāṟceyta kaḷḷiṉ teḷivi mūṅkiṟ kuḻiyil muṟṟa viṭṭup parukutal malināṭṭār paḻakkam eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyum
nī kaṭami viḷinta tēkkaḷ tēṟal (aṭi, 195)
eṉat terivikkiṟatu.
naṉṉaṉatu malināṭṭār vikkum viruntil kalantu koḷpavar uṭumpu, kaṭamāṉ, paṉṟi ākiyavaṟṟiṉ patappaṭuttappaṭṭa iṟiccit tuṇṭaṅkaḷi uṇṭu koṇṭē iṭiyil mēlē collappaṭṭa tēkkaḷ tēṟalip parukuvar; iṟutiyil naṟavu eṉṉum oru vakik kaḷḷiyum parukuvar eṉṟu āciriyar nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟiyuḷḷār (mali. aṭi, 171-177). eṉavē, tēkkaḷ tēṟal vēṟu, naṟavu vēṟu eṉpatu teḷivākiṟatu. `naṟavu-nellāṟ camitta kaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri. malipaṭukaṭām ceyyappaṭṭu ēṟattāḻat toḷḷāyiram āṇṭukaṭkup piṉpu tōṉṟiya takkayākap paraṇiyil, naṟavukoḷ makaḷir-kāmapāṉam ceyyum vāmamārkkap peṇkaḷ eṉpatu variyap peṭṭuḷḷatu (kaṇṇi, 24, uri). kampar tamatu irāmāyaṇattuḷ,
	kāmam varuntiya payirkku nīrpōl
arunaṟa(vu) aruntu vāri
			(ūrtēṭupaṭalam, ce. 107)
eṉṟu kuṟittuḷḷār. iṅkum naṟavu eṉpatu kāma pāṉattiyē kuṟikkiṟatu eṉṉalām.
eṉavē, mēlē collappaṭṭa matu eṉpatum iṅkuc collappaṭṭa naṟavu eṉpatum kāmapāṉam eṉpatu iṅku aṟiyattakum.
karikālaṉ araṇmaṉiyil parukappaṭṭa kaḷ `makiḻ1 (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 84) eṉavum, `makiḻ patam (makiḻcci viḷikkum kaḷ) eṉavum peyar peṟṟatu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 111); kuṅkumappū maṇattiyuṭiya kaḷḷiṉ teḷivu `pūkkamaḻ tēṟal eṉappaṭṭatu (aṭi, 157); pāṇṭiyaṉ taṉ araṇ maṉiyil parukiyatu `maṇam kamaḻ tēṟal (aṭi, 780) eṉappaṭṭatu. atu poṉ vaṭṭilil tarappaṭṭatu. `maṇaṅkamaḻ tēṟal eṉṟataṉāṟ kāmapāṉamāyiṟṟu eṉpatu nacciṉārk kiṉiyar viḷakkam.
itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa pala kuṭi vakikaḷi nōkka, kaḷ eṉpatu maṭṭu, matu, naṟavu, tēṟal eṉappala vakippaṭṭatu eṉpatum, ivi tēṉ koṇṭum, nellaricikoṇṭum, paḻaṅkaḷ koṇṭum, teṉṉi, paṉi maraṅkaḷiṉ cāṟukoṇṭum tayārikkappaṭṭaṉa eṉpatum, ivaṟṟuṭcila mūṅkiṟkuḻiyilum piṟa pāttiraṅkaḷilum iṭṭu muṟṟac ceytu parukappaṭṭaṉa eṉpatum, araṇmaṉi viruntukaḷil kuṅkumappū iṭṭu maṇamēṟiya pūṅkamaḻ tēṟal parukappaṭṭatu eṉpatum, ikkuṭi vakikaḷ makkaḷ vāḻkkittarattiṟku ēṟpa vēṟupaṭṭaṉa eṉpatum teḷiyalām.
teṉṉi marattiliruntum paṉimarattiliruntum iṟakkappaṭṭup patappaṭuttappaṭum nīr ikkālattil `patanīr eṉṉum peyaril viṟkappaṭukiṟataṉṟō? annīr uṭampil kuḷircciyi uṇṭupaṇṇukiṟatu; kaḷippip pōkkukiṟatu; cuṟucuṟuppi uṇṭākkukiṟatu eṉṟu nāṭṭu maruttuvarum ataṉip parukuvōrum kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. ippatanīrkkut `tēṟal (kaḷḷiṉ teḷivu) eṉṉum peyar poruttamēyākum. itaṉi evarum kuṟinta celavil parukalām; celvar itiṟ kuṅkumappū mutaliya maṇapporuḷkaḷik kalantu maṇam mikac ceytu parukuvatum uṇṭu. ittakiya tēṟalē caṅka kālap pulavar - pāṇar - kūttar - aracar - celvar mutaliyōr cātāraṇamākap parukiṉar eṉpatu poruntum.
ittēṟal, `pūkkamaḻ tēṟal, `maṇaṅkamaḻ tēṟal eṉṟu ciṟappikkappaṭṭatu. iḵtu araṇmaṉi aḻakikaḷāl poṟkalaṅkaḷil nirappu maṉṉaṉukkum viruntiṉarkkum tarappaṭṭatu. māṅkuṭi marutaṉār eṉṟa pulavar perumāṉ pāṇṭiyaṉi nōkki,
	viḷaṅkiḻi makaḷir polaṅkalat tēntiya
maṇaṅkamaḻ tēṟal maṭuppa nāḷum
makiḻntiṉi tuṟimati peruma!
varintunī peṟṟa nallū ḻiyiyē.
									(ma. kā. aṭi, 779-783).
eṉṟu uḷamāra vāḻttiṉar eṉpati nōkka, it tēṟal tīmiyic ceyyātatu eṉpatum, itu maṉṉarkku iṉṟiyamiyāta kuṭivaki eṉpatum naṉku pulaṉākum.
cila āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpu vari kaḷḷukkaṭikaḷil viṟkappaṭṭa mayakkantarum kaḷ vakiyum caṅkakālattil uḻippāḷikaḷāl uṭkoḷḷappaṭṭatu eṉpatum poruttamākum. ikkāla `pirānti, viki, pōṉṟa mayakkantarum uyarnta kuṭivakikaḷē kāmapāṉam eṉṟu karutappaṭṭa `matu, naṟavu eṉap peyar koṇṭavi eṉṉalām.


2. uṭi
muṉṉuri
makkaḷ paṇṭikkālattil mutaṉmutal āṭiyiṉṟi iruntārkaḷ; piṉpu kālappōkkil taḻikaḷiyum marappaṭṭikaḷiyum uṭikaḷāka uṭukkat toṭaṅkiṉārkaḷ; vilaṅkukaḷiṉ tōlkaḷiyum payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; necavuttoḻilik kaṇṭaṟinta piṉpē parutti āṭikaḷiyum paṭṭāṭikaḷiyum neyyat toṭaṅki ṉārkaḷ. makkaḷatu aṟivu vaḷara vaḷara, vacatikaḷ perukap peruka, avarkaḷuṭiya vāḻkki-vīṭu mutaliya palavaṟṟilum uyarntāṟpōlavē, uṭi vakiyilum uyaralāyiṟṟu.
necavuttoḻil naṭipeṟāta iṭaṅkaḷil iṉṟum taḻikaḷum marappaṭṭikaḷum tōlkaḷum āṭikaḷākap payaṉpaṭukiṉṟaṉa. āppirikkāvil nilanaṭukkōṭṭiyaṭutta iṭaṅkaḷil āṭavar, maravuriyi uṭukkiṉṟaṉar. peṇṭir, paṉi ōlikaḷālākiya ciṟu pāvāṭiyi aṇikiṉṟaṉar. pāliṉīciyāvil āṭavar, maravuriyi uṭukkiṉṟaṉar; peṇṭir, marappaṭṭiyālākiya pāvāṭi allatu vakirntu piṉṉiya iliyālākiya āṭikaḷi aṇikiṉṟaṉar. ātirēliyap paḻaṅkuṭikaḷ marappaṭṭiyālākiya oru kacciyi uṭukkiṉṟārkaḷ. āppirikkāvi luḷḷa putar makkaḷ, mukkōṇa vaṭivamāṉa oru tōli kālkaḷukkiṭiyil kōttu, iṭuppic cuṟṟi muṭintukoḷkiṉṟārkaḷ. avarkaḷuṭiya peṇṭir oru kacciyi aṇikiṉṟaṉar. vaṭivamerikka intiyar āṭṭuttōlkaḷiyum māṭṭuttōlkaḷiyum uṭukkiṉṟaṉar.
mucukkaṭṭi, atti, īrappalāvip pōṉṟa cila maraṅkaḷiṉ uṭpaṭṭikaḷ taṇṇīril ūṟavittu, maraccuttiyāl taṭṭi mirutuvākkappaṭum. appaṭṭi takaṭu pōṉṟu irukkum. ataṟku niṟam koṭukkappaṭum; allatu ōviyattāl aḻakupaṭuttappaṭum. atu pārvikku neyta tuṇi pōla irukkum. pāliṉīciyāvil ittakiya maravurikaḷ ciṟappiṭam peṟukiṉṟaṉa. aṅkup paḻaṅkuṭikaḷ ciṟappuc caṭaṅkukaḷiṉ pōtu ataṉi iṉṟum uṭukkiṉṟārkaḷ. pōrṉiyōvil uḷḷa kāyāṉkaḷum peljiyaṉ kāṅkōviluḷḷa nīkirōp peṇkaḷum varuttak kālaṅkaḷil maravuriyi aṇikiṉṟārkaḷ.1
ciṟpaccāṉṟu
caṅka kālattil taḻiyuṭi, maravuri, paruttiyālum paṭṭālumākiya āṭikaḷ, kacci eṉpaṉa vaḻakkiliruntaṉa eṉpatu piṉ varum pattuppāṭṭuc cāṉṟukaḷik koṇṭu aṟiyalām. pattuppāṭṭiṉ kālam ēṟattāḻak kiṟituvukkup piṟpaṭṭa mutal mūṉṟu nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷ eṉpatu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭataṉṟō? akkālattil potuvāka intiyāvilum ciṟappākat takkaṇattilum irunta āṭi vakikaḷi akkālac ciṟpaṅkaḷikkoṇṭu ōraḷavu aṟiyalām.
āntira nāṭṭu amarāvatiyilum jakkayyapēṭṭiyilum kiṭitta ciṟpaṅkaḷ cila, akkāla āṭavar talippāki, muḻaṅkāl vari toṅkum curukkaṅkaḷuḷḷa āṭi, pūvēli koṇṭa iṭikkacci, atiliruntu toṅkum titta ciṟu tuṇṭu ākiyavaṟṟi aṇintiruntaṉar eṉpatu acciṟpaṅkaḷāl terikiṟatu. peṇṭir muḻaṅkāl variyil toṅkum puṭivikaḷi uṭuttaṉar; talikku nāṟcaturamāṉa tuṇikaḷāl palavaki muṭiccukaḷic ceytu aṇintu vantaṉar eṉpati acciṟpaṅkaḷ uṇarttukiṉṟaṉa. ciṟpaṅkaḷiṉ kālam ki. mu. 200-ki. pi. 100 ākum.
ki. pi. 100 mutal ki. pi. 400 variyil eṉṟu kaṇikkappaṭṭa kālattic cērnta ciṟpaṅkaḷum kiṭittuḷḷaṉa. akkāla āṭavar, vēṭṭiyum, mēlāṭiyum, talippākiyum aṇintiruntaṉar. makaḷir, ariyil puṭiviyiyum mēlē cila camayaṅkaḷilē ciṟiya tuṇṭiyum aṇintaṉar; taliyil talippākipōlavum vēṟu vakiyilum tuṇi kaṭṭiṉar. muṟukkiṭṭa āṭikaḷ iraṇṭu mūṉṟu varicikaḷil iṭuppukkukkīḻē valappakkamāka muṭintu toṅkaviṭappaṭṭaṉa. peṇ mārpi maṟittuḷḷa muṟiyil orē oru ciṟpamē kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. peṇṭir mārpil āṭiyaṟṟē iruntaṉar eṉṟu karutattakum muṟiyil ciṟpaṅkaḷ kāṇkiṉṟaṉa. titta āṭikaḷum, caṭṭikaḷum, kullāykaḷum cila camayaṅkaḷil aṇiyappaṭṭu vantaṉa. tuṟavikaḷ marappaṭṭi, pul, paḻattōl ivaṟṟikkoṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa uṭikaḷi uṭuttārkaḷ.
teṉpāṇṭi nāṭṭil vāḻnta nākar, ulakap pukaḻ peṟṟa melliya āṭikaḷi neytu ayal nāṭukaḷukku aṉuppiṉar. aracarkaḷ muḻaṅkāl variyil `laṅkōṭu pōṉṟa uṭiyaṇintaṉar. itu `vaṭṭuṭi eṉappaṭṭatu. naṭuttara vakuppiṉar iṭuppic cuṟṟi ōr āṭiyum, taliyic cuṟṟi maṟṟoṉṟum kaṭṭiṉar. peṇṭir, iṭuppiliruntu kāl variyil toṅkumpaṭi puṭavi uṭuttaṉar. mali nāṭṭup peṇṭir, ilikaḷik kōtta taḻiyuṭiyi uṭuttaṉar. perumpālum akkālap peṇṭir, iṭuppiṟkumēl evvita āṭiyum aṇintatākac ciṟpaṅkaḷik koṇṭu kūṟa iyalavilli.1
caṅkakāla makkaḷ eṉṉeṉṉa uṭikaḷi aṇintiruntārkaḷ eṉpatit tiṭṭamāka aṟiya iyalavilli. āyiṉum, pattuppāṭṭil āṅkāṅkuk kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa vivaraṅkaḷiliruntu akkāla makkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttiya palavaki uṭikaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟi iṅkuk kāṇpōm.
taḻi uṭi
kuṟamakaḷ marāmarak kottukaḷi naṭuvē vittu, iliyiyuṭiya naṟiya pūṅkottukaḷic cuṟṟilum vittut toṭutta periya-aḻakiya taḻiyuṭiyi uṭuttiṉāḷ (tirumuruku, aṭi. 201-203). neytal nilamakaḷ taḷirkaḷ, taḻikaḷ, malarkaḷ ivaṟṟālākiya taḻiyuṭiyi aṇintiruntāḷ. kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattup paratavar cērippeṇṭir ittaḻi yuṭiyi aṇintiruntaṉar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 91).
tukil-kaliṅkam
aracaṉ kañciyiṭṭuc calavi ceyyappaṭṭa tukili (āṭiyi) aṇintiruntāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 721). araci kaṇavaṉ taṉṉip piriyā tirukkiyil pūttoḻiliyuṭiyatu kiliuṭuttiṉāḷ; kaṇavaṉip pirintirunta kālattil mācēṟiya nūlāṟ ceyta kaliṅkatti (āṭiyi) aṇintiruntāḷ. pūntukilmarīiya .........avir nūlkaliṅkam” (neṭu,145-6) eṉa varutalāl. ,tukil eṉpatu oruvika āiṭa eṉpatum, kaliṅkam eṉpatu maṟṟeru vikāiṭa eṉpatum terikiṉṟaṉa.
