kacci-kaccu
kuṟiñci nilattalimakaṉ (kātalaṉ) nuṇṇiya vēlip pāṭaminta kacciyik kaṭṭiyiruntāṉ (kuṟiñci. aṭi, 125). maturiyi iravil kāval kāttavar nīlak kacciyi aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 639).
aruccuṉaṉ pūttoḻil paranta kacciyi aṇintiruntāṉ eṉṟu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi ceppukiṟatu (aṭi, 239). nallūr nattattaṉār aruccuṉaṉi nēriṟ kaṇṭavarallar; avaṉ kālattiṟkup paṉṉūṟu āṇṭukaṭkup piṟpaṭṭavar. avar vīmaṉip paṟṟic colla vanta iṭattil,
pūviri kaccip pukaḻōṉ taṉmuṉ
eṉṟu aruccuṉaṟku muṉṉavaṉ eṉṟu cuṭṭiyuḷḷār; aruccuṉaṉip `pūviri kaccip pukaḻōṉ eṉṟu pukaḻntuḷḷār. avar avaṉatu kaccikkuc ciṟapput tantuḷḷatik kūrntu kavaṉippiṉ, aruccuṉaṉip pōṉṟa ciṟanta pōr vīrar tamiḻakattil `pūviri kacciyi aṇintiruntaṉar pōlum eṉak karuta vēṇṭuvatāyuḷḷatu. aracamātēvi mārpil vampu (kaccu) valittuk kaṭṭiyiruntāḷ eṉṟu neṭunalvāṭi kūṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 149-150).
paṭam-moyppi
ikkālattil `caṭṭi eṉappaṭuvatu akkālattil `paṭam eṉappaṭṭatu. toṇṭi nāṭṭup peruvaḻikaḷik kāval kātta vīrar caṭṭi aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi kūṟukiṟatu. `paṭampukku-caṭṭiyiṭṭu eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri (aṭi, 69).
`paṭampukum milēccar eṉpatu mullippāṭut toṭar (aṭi, 66). milēccar ayal nāṭṭār; avaruṭ cilar pācaṟiyil aracaṉatu irukkiyik kāttu vantavar; ūmiyar; caṭṭi aṇintiruntaṉar.
caṅka kālattil yavaṉar tamiḻakattuṭaṉ vāṇkam ceytaṉar. avaruṭ cilar, maturi, pūmpukār, vañci pōṉṟa tamiḻaracar talinakaraṅkaḷilum tuṟimukap paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷilum vāṇikattiṉporuṭṭut tiṅkiyiruntaṉar. anta yavaṉar vaṭimpu tāḻntu perukkuñ ceṟitaliyuṭiya puṭivi1 yuṭiyi ariyil aṇintiruntaṉar; arikku mēl `meyppi (caṭṭi)yi aṇintiruntaṉar (mullippāṭṭu, aṭi, 59-61).
kaḷḷip paruki maturit terukkaḷil irākkālattil tirinta milēccar, muṉṉum piṉṉum toṅkalāka aṟuviyit toṅkaviṭṭuc ceṉṟaṉar eṉpatu neṭunalvāṭiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 33-35).
aḻukkēṟiya kantalāṭi citāar (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 154) eṉavum, citarvi (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 468). eṉavum vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu.
vēṟu āṭikaḷ
murukapperumāṉ `nalampeṟu kaliṅkam uṭuttiruntāṉ eṉpatu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu (aṭi, 109). murukaṉ uṭuttiruntatu cemmi niṟam peṟṟa āṭi eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kuṟittuḷḷār. apperumāṉ iṭiyil utara pantattiṉmēl uṭuttut toṅkaviṭṭa meṉmiyuṭiya tukil avaṉ kuṟamakaḷiroṭu kuravik kūttāṭukiyil nilattiṟ poruntiyatu (aṭi, 213-214).
tirupparaṅkuṉṟattuc cōliyil murukaṉatu ciṟappip pāṭi viḷiyāṭiya cūraramakaḷir, intira kōpatti otta niṟam piṭiyāta (cāyam vaṟṟāta) iyalpāṉa cippākiya pūvēlippāṭaminta tukili uṭuttiruntaṉar.
kōpat taṉṉa tōyāp pūntukil (muruku. aṭi. 15).
`tuṇaṅkik kūttāṭiya pūtaṅkaḷ tukili uṭuttaṉa pōla (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 234-235) eṉpatu uvamiyākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. `iṅkuk `tukil eṉpatu veḷḷiyāṭiyi eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri.
tiruvāvi naṉkuṭiyil murukaṉi vaḻipaṭṭa muṉivar marappaṭṭikkoṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa uṭiyi (maravuri uṭiyi) uṭuttiruntaṉar. (aṭi, 126).
kantaruvar (icivāṇar) pukiyi mukantāl otta (mika melliya) aḻukkēṟāta tūyavuṭiyiṉi aṇintiruntaṉar.
pukimukan taṉṉa mācil tūvuṭi (aṭi, 138).
ērakattu murukaṉ kōvil aruccakar ariyil kāḻakam uṭuttiruntaṉar.
pularāk kāḻakam pulara vuṭīi (aṭi, 184).
`kāḻakam-kaliṅkam eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri. neṭiya kariyiyuṭiya nīla niṟap puṭivi kāḻakam eṉappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 598).
pācaṟiyil aracaṟkuk kūṭāram amikkappaṭṭatu. kūṭārattic cuṟṟilum matil pōla vaḷittuk kaṭṭap payaṉpaṭṭa muraṭṭut tuṇi kaṇṭam eṉappaṭṭatu. (mulli, 44). `kaṇṭam-matiḷ tiri eṉpar nacciṉārkkiṉiyar. atu `kaṇṭattiri, palvaṇṇattiri eṉavum peyar peṟum eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar cintāmaṇiyil (ce. 647, 873 uri) kūṟiyuḷḷār.
uṭikkuriya peyarkaḷ
itukāṟum kaṇṭa cāṉṟukaḷāl nām aṟiyattakuvaṉa yāvi?
`tukil, aṟuvi, kaliṅkam eṉpavi mikavuyarnta melliya vēlippāṭaminta āṭikaḷ, avaṟṟi aracarum celvarum uṭuttaṉar; mēlāṭiyākavum payaṉpaṭuttiṉar; kaṭavuḷar tiruvuruvaṅkaḷukkum aṇivittaṉar. kāḻakam eṉpatu oru vaki āṭi. ataṉi aruccakar aṇintiruntaṉar. muṉivar maravuri tarittiruntaṉar; kāṉavar, vīrar, kāvalar ākiyōr kacci aṇintiruntaṉar; avaṟṟuḷ nīlakkacci kuṟippiṭattakkatu, aracamātēvi mārpil kaccuk kaṭṭiyiruntāḷ; paṭṭāṭikaḷum vaḻakkil iruntaṉa; kūṭāra matil tirittuṇi `kaṇṭam eṉappaṭṭatu; araciyal aluvalar caṭṭi aṇiyum vaḻakkam iruntatu; aḻukkēṟiya kiḻinta kantalāṭi `citā ar eṉṟum `citarvi eṉṟum peyar peṟṟatu, eṉṉum vivaraṅkaḷ itukāṟum kaṇṭa cāṉṟukaḷ koṇṭu aṟiyappaṭum.
kāḻakam
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattiṟkup pala nāṭukaḷiliruntu aṉuppappaṭṭa poruḷkaḷ vāṇikattiṟku vantiruntaṉa. avaṟṟuḷ kāḻakattup poruḷkaḷum iruntaṉa (pa. pāli. aṭi, 191). `kāḻakam-kaṭāram eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar kūṟṟu. malāy nāṭṭil mēlkari ōramāyuḷḷa `kaṭē eṉṉum iṭamē paṇṭikkālattil `kaṭāram eṉappaṭṭatu. ataṉi veṉṟa mutalām irācēntira cōḻaṉ (ki. pi. 1012-1044) taṉṉik `kaṭāram koṇṭāṉ eṉṟu vaḻaṅkikkoṇṭāṉ.1 kaṭāram eṉṟa kāḻakattiliruntu neytu aṉuppappaṭṭa āṭi `kāḻakam eṉappaṭṭatu pōlum! ērakattu aruccakar itaṉi aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi kūṟukiṟatu. itu tamiḻ nāṭṭu āṭi vakikaḷuḷ kūṟappaṭātatu kavaṉikkattakum.
kaliṅkam
iṉṟiya orisā mānilam paṇṭik kālattil kaliṅkam eṉṟa nāṭāyiruntatu. ki. mu. iraṇṭām nūṟṟāṇṭil tamiḻaracar kūṭṭaṇiyi aḻittatākat taṉṉik kūṟikkoṇṭa kāravēlaṉ kaliṅkanāṭṭup pēraracaṉāvaṉ. kaliṅkanāṭu uyarnta melliya āṭikaḷukkup paṇṭu toṭṭē peyar peṟṟatu. kaliṅkar kaṭal vāṇikattilum peyar peṟṟavar. `koḷḷē kāl eṉṉum ūril neyyappaṭum āṭi `koḷḷē kāl eṉṟē kūṟappaṭutal pōlak kaliṅkanāṭṭu āṭi `kaliṅkam eṉṟē peyar peṟṟirukkalām.
22. aṇikaḷ
I
aṇikaḷiṉ tōṟṟam
paṇṭikkāla makkaḷ toṭakkakālattil āṭiyō aṇiyō illātavarāyirunta nili oṉṟiruntatu. piṉpu ammakkaḷ kaṇṇukkiṉiya kāṭciyi nalkiya pala niṟattaḷir (kuḻi)kaḷik kātil cerukiṉārkaḷ; pala vaki vitikaḷiyum koṭṭikaḷiyum kātukaḷil kaṭṭit toṅkaviṭṭārkaḷ; patappaṭuttappaṭṭa puṟkaḷiyum nārkaḷiyum muṟukkik kiyilum kaḻuttilum aṇintārkaḷ; ilikaḷōṭu kūṭiya koṭikaḷik kaḻuttilum tōḷilum iṭiyilum muṉkiyilum cuṟṟikkoṇṭārkaḷ; palavaki malarkaḷiyum ilittaḷirkaḷiyum māliyākat toṭuttu mārpilum iṭiyilum aṇintu koṇṭārkaḷ; pala vaki maṇikaḷiyum payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ.
kālam cellac cellak kātukaḷil cerukappaṭṭa kuḻi (taḷir), kātukaḷil tuḷi ceyyappaṭṭu aṇiyappaṭṭatu; paṉiyōli, curuḷākkap paṭṭuk kātil tuḷiyil iṭappaṭṭatu. atu `kātōli eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. ariyil aḻakukkāka aṇinta nār (kayiṟu) arināṇ (ariñāṇ) eṉap peyar peṟṟatu; tōḷil cuṟṟit toṭuttuk koḷḷappaṭṭatu `toṭi eṉappaṭṭatu. kātiṉ pala iṭaṅkaḷil vittu oṭṭa vittukkoḷḷappaṭṭa pūkkaḷ-kattirippū, ilavaṅkappū, murukuppū eṉap palavāṟu peyar peṟṟaṉa.
tōṭu-pūvitaḻ. itu paṉiyōliyiyum kuṟikkum. ippeyar kālappōkkil `tōṭu eṉappaṭṭatu. murukuppū-maṇam nāṟum pū. itupōṉṟa aṇi ikkālattil `muruvūppū eṉappaṭukiṉṟatu. `kompuppū eṉpatu `koppū eṉa maruviṟṟu. paṇṭi makkaḷ marakkompil uḷḷa pūkkaḷi aṇintu vantārkaḷ eṉpati itu viḷakkukiṉṟatu. `tirukuppū eṉpatu muṟukkutaliyuṭiya pūvik kuṟikkum. paṇṭi makkaḷ muṟukkuṇṭa vaṭivuṭiya pūkkaḷi aṇintu vantārkaḷ eṉpatu itaṉāl terikiṉṟatu.
paṇṭi makkaḷ aṭuttapaṭi tāṅkaḷ aṇintu vanta nakikaḷi marattil cetukkiṉārkaḷ; piṉpu īyam allatu cempi urukki mara accil vārttārkaḷ; puṟkaḷiyum nārkaḷiyum muṟukkik ki, kaḻuttu, iṭi mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷil aṇintāṟpōlavē, poṉ veḷḷik kampikaḷi muṟukkip pala aṇikaḷic ceytārkaḷ; ulōkat takaṭukaḷ koṇṭu paḻaṅkaḷip pōlavum vitikaḷip pōlavum ilikaḷip pōlavum nakikaḷic ceytārkaḷ; āyiṉ, avaṟṟukku mutaṟ peyarkaḷiyē iṭṭu vaḻaṅkiṉārkaḷ. avi ariñāṇ, toṭi, kuḻi, māli, kattarippū, ilavaṅkappū, vaḷi eṉap palavāṟu peyar peṟṟaṉa. mika melliya aḻakiya koṭikaḷāl āṉa iṭiyaṇi kālappōkkil `cilkāḻ eṉavum `palkāḻ eṉavum peyar peṟṟatu; vaṭamoḻiyil `mēkali mutaliya pala peyarkaḷip peṟṟatu.
paṇṭi makkaḷuṭiya camayak karuttukaḷum vaḻi pāṭṭukkuriya aṭiyāḷaṅkaḷum avartam kaṟpaṉiyi vaḷarttut `tāyittu, aim paṭittāli pōṉṟa putiya nakikaḷic ceyyattūṇṭiṉa.
nakikaḷ toṭarpāṉa ittakiya paṭippaṭiyāṉa vaḷarcciyit teṉṉintiyāviṟ kāṇalām. iṅkuḷḷa paṇṭi makkaḷ muṟukkuṇṭa puṟkaḷiyum nārkaḷiyum kaṭakaṅkaḷākavum vaḷiyalkaḷākavum aṇikiṉṟārkaḷ. kaṇṇāṭi maṇikaḷiyum pavaḻaṅkaḷiyum kaḻuttaṇikaḷāka aṇikiṉṟārkaḷ. ciṟṟūrkaḷil uḷḷa ēḻi makkaḷ veḷḷi, poṉ, pittaḷi, cempu, īyam mutaliya ulōkaṅkaḷik koṇṭu paṇṭimakkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttiya nakikaḷ pōṟvaṟṟic ceytu aṇikiṉṟārkaḷ. avaṟṟuḷ nuṇṇiya vēlip pāṭaminta nakikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.1
paṇṭi intiya aṇikaḷ
moheñca-tarō, harappā eṉṉum paṇṭi nakarap paḻam poruḷkaḷiṉ kālam ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. 3500-ki. mu. 300 eṉṉalām. aṅkuk kiṭitta poruḷkaḷuḷ maṇ pommikaḷ ciṟappāṉavi. avaṟṟil akkāla naki vakikaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. akkālap peṇṭir, iṭattōḷi liruntu kaṇukkāl variyil vaḷiyalkaḷi aṇintiruntaṉar; valakkiyil mēṟpakutiyiṉ kīḻkkōṭiyil kaṭakattiyum, muṉ kiyil cila vaḷiyalkaḷiyum aṇintiruntaṉar; taliyil oppaṉi ceytiruntaṉar; kātaṇiyum kaḻuttaṇiyum aṇintiruntaṉar eṉpatu terikiṉṟatu.
kācumali-`kaṇṭi eṉṟa peyaruṭaṉ irukku vētattil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. `aruccuṉaṉ pēṭikkōlattil irunta poḻutu kātaṇikaḷ, kaḻuttaṇikaḷ, vaḷiyalkaḷ ākiyavaṟṟi aṇintiruntāṉ. tēvaṉ oruvaṉ avaṉukkup poṉ māliyum patakkamum aḷittāṉ, eṉṟu makāpāratam kūṟukiṉṟatu. `irāmaṉ taṉ maṇakkōlattil muttu muṭiyum kātaṇiyum muttu māliyum neṟṟiyil muttup paṭṭamum aṇintiruntāṉ. cīti palavaki naki aṇintiruntāḷ eṉṟu irāmāyaṇam moḻikiṉṟatu.1 kāpūl paḷḷattākkil jalapātiṉ arukil paḻiyaputtar kōviliṟkiṭitta poṟpeṭṭi māṇikkak kaṟkaḷ patittatu. ataṉuḷ muttukaḷum, pavaḻaṅkaḷum, maṇikaḷum, taṅka nakikaḷum iruntaṉa.
ki. mu. nāṉkām nūṟṟāṇṭil vāḻnta kuṭilyar, tamatu poruḷnūlil poṉ kiṭikkum iṭaṅkaḷiyum, poṉṉiṉ vakikaḷiyum, navamaṇikaḷiyum, naki vakikaḷiyum kuṟittuḷḷār. ivaṟṟit tokukkavum vāṇikam ceyyavum araciyal uyaraluvalaṉ oruvaṉ avar kālattil mōriya aracil paṇiyāṟṟiṉāṉ. ivaṟṟit tiruṭuvōrkku iṟappē taṇṭaṉiyāka vitikkappaṭavēṇṭum eṉpatu keṭilyar karuttākum. muttu māli, periya muttukaḷiyuṭiya māli, oṟṟi muttuvaṭam, naṭuvil oru maṇi kōtta muttu māli pōṉṟa aṇikaḷ kuṭilyarāṟ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.1
manutaruma cāttirattiṉ kālam ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. 200 eṉṉalām. ēṟakkuṟiya akkālattiṟ ceyyappaṭṭa `viḷiyāṭṭu vaṇṭi (Toy Cart) eṉṉum nāṭakanūlil nakikkaṭi oṉṟu ciṟappikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. akkaṭiyil poṉ, navarattiṉam mutaliyaṉa koṇṭu nakikaḷ ceyyappaṭṭaṉa. nakikaḷi;la pūvēli ceyvateppaṭi eṉpatum viḷakkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. cila nikaḻccikaḷiṉ pōtu nakikaḷ aṇiyavēṇṭum eṉṟu manu kūṟiyuḷḷar. camayattoṭarpāṉa ceyalkaḷiṉ pōtu nakiyaṇivatu vaḻakkam.2 paṇṭi makkaḷ, pala nimuḷḷa cātāraṇa maṇikaḷik koṇṭu kātaṇikaḷ, kaḻuttaṇikaḷ, kiyaṇikaḷ, iṭiyaṇikaḷ ākiyavaṟṟic ceytu koṇṭaṉar. muttu, poṉ mutaliya vili matippuḷḷa poruḷkaḷ kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭa piṉpu celvariṭam paḻiya maṇikaḷ arukiṉa. taṭcacīlattil kiṭitta ciṟpaṅkaḷik kāṇkiyil akkālattil (ki. mu. 500- ki. pi. 300) kaṇṇāṭi vaḷiyalkaḷ, caṅkavaḷikaḷ, āmi ōṭu pōṉṟavaṟṟālākiya vaḷikaḷ, tanta vaḷiyalkaḷ vaḻakkil iruntami pulaṉākum. vaṭavintiyāvil `ahichatrā (Ahichhatra) eṉṉum iṭattil maṇ pommikaḷil kāṇappaṭum aṇikaḷ pala. avaṟṟiṉ kālam ki. mu. 300-ki. pi. 100 eṉṉalām. taliyiliruntu muttuccaraṅkaḷ toṅkal, nākamuttiriyuṭiya taliyaṇi, ampu-koṭi-aṅkucam eṉpavi poṟitta kātaṇi, vāḷ-vaccirāyutam-srīvatam poṟitta kaḻuttaṇi eṉpaṉa cila pommikaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. vēṟu cila pommikaḷil kaṉatta kātu vaḷiyaṅkaḷum, vaḷiyalkaḷum, pūvēlippāṭu koṇṭa kāppukaḷum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.3
taṭcacīlam (ki. mu. 500-ki. pi. 300), pajāt (ki. mu. iraṇṭām nūṟṟāṇṭu), parhūt (ki. mu. 150), cāñci (ki. mu. 150), (vaṭa) maturi (ki. pi. 1,200), kāntāram (ki. pi. 50-200) ākiya iṭaṅkaḷiṟ kiṭitta ciṟpaṅkaḷiyum ajantāc ciṟpaṅkaḷiyum (ki. pi. 1-7 nuṟṟāṇṭukaḷ) kāṇkiyil, ki. mu. 500 mutal ki. pi. 600 variyil vaṭavintiyāvil irunta pala vaki aṇikaḷip paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷ pulaṉākiṉṟaṉa. vaṭa vintiya makkaḷ muṭi mutal aṭi variyil pala vaki aṇikaḷi aṇintiruntārkaḷ. avaṟṟuṭpala, kal patitta nakikaḷ; ellōrum taliyaṇi aṇintiruntaṉar; āṭavarum peṇṭirum nakikaḷit tarittiruntaṉar eṉṉum vivaraṅkaḷ terikiṉṟaṉa.
kāḷitācar eṉṟa vaṭamoḻip perumpulavar, ki. pi. aintām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ muṟpakutiyic cērntavar eṉṟu varalāṟṟaṟiñar kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. avar tam kālattu nakikaḷit tām ceyta nūlkaḷil kuṟittuḷḷār; poṉṉum maṇikaḷum koṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa pala vaki mēkalikiḷik kūṟiyuḷḷār. avi mēkalā, hēmamēkalā, kāñci, kiṇkiṇi, racaṉa eṉpavi. ivaṟṟuṭcila, oli eḻuppuvaṉavākum. oṉpatu vaki maṇikaḷalāl allatu muttukaḷāl ākiya muṭivali, muṭi, kūntal aṇikaḷ, karṇapūṣaṇam, karṇapūram, kuṇṭalam, maṇi kuṇṭalam eṉap pala vakippaṭṭa kātaṇikaḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. maṇi kuṇṭalam eṉpatu māṇikkak kaṟkaḷ patikkappaṭṭa toṅkal.1
teṉṉāṭṭu aṇikaḷ
āticca nallūr aṇikaḷ
ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. iraṇṭāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṟpaṭṭa āticcanallūrp putikuḻikaḷiliruntu eṭukkappaṭṭa nakikaḷum maṇpatumikaḷiṉ mītu kāṇappaṭum nakikaḷum appaḻaṅkālattu aṇivakikaḷi naṉku uṇarttukiṉṟaṉa. akkāla makkaḷ, cōḻi vakikaḷi aḻakupaṭak kōttuk kaḻuttilum ariyilum kikaḷilum kālkaḷilum kaṭṭikkoṇṭārkaḷ; caṅkukaḷi mikka tiṟamiyuṭaṉ ciṟiya vaṭṭaṅkaḷāka aṟuttuk kāppukaḷākavum kaṭakaṅkaḷākavum aṇintārkaḷ; viliyuyarnta pacci, civappuk kaṟkaḷiyum muttukaḷiyum pavaḻaṅkaḷiyum pala vaki nakikaḷākac ceytu payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; poṉṉāṟceyyappaṭṭa maṇikaḷiyum kōttu aṇintu vantārkaḷ.
ciṟpaccāṉṟu
tamiḻakattiṟku vaṭakkil uḷḷa āntira nāṭṭu amarāvati, jakkayyapēṭṭi, nākārccuṉamali eṉṉum iṭaṅkaḷiṟkiṭitta ciṟpaṅkaḷikkoṇṭu akkāla (ki. mu. 200-ki. pi. 400) makkaḷiṉ naki vakikaḷi ōraḷavu aṟiyalām.
akkālap peṇṭir pala vaḷivukaḷik koṇṭa vaḷiyalkaḷiyum kāppukaḷiyum kaṭakaṅkaḷiyum aṇintiruntaṉar; malarnta tāmari malarip pōṉṟa tirukik koṇṭa aṇiyāl kūntali oppaṉi ceytaṉar; taliyic cuṟṟilum poṉṉāṟceyyappaṭṭa paṭṭiyāṉa oru nakiyi aṇintaṉar. appaṭṭiyiliruntu toṅkalkaḷ cila neṟṟiyil toṅkaviṭappaṭṭaṉa. ammakaḷir tam kātukaḷil pū, ili, vaṭṭam, mīṉ pōṉṟa pala vaṭivaṅkaḷik koṇṭa aḻakiya kuṇṭalaṅkaḷi aṇintaṉar; cila kātaṇikaḷiliruntu muttuc caraṅkaḷ tōḷkaḷmītu puraṇṭaṉa. appeṇṭir, mēlē makarakkoṭi cetukkappaṭṭup pāmpukaḷ pōlac cuṟṟappaṭṭa kaṭakaṅkaḷit tarittaṉar; caṅkukaḷ, pavaḷaṅkaḷ, tantaṅkaḷ, irattiṉaṅkaḷ ākiyavaṟṟāl ceyyappaṭṭō, allatu orē keṭṭiyākavō, allatu pala vitamāṉa cantukaḷik koṇṭō uḷḷa accaṅkilikaḷiliruntu pala vakiyāṉa patakkaṅkaḷ toṅkiṉa. ammātaracikaḷ poṉṉālum veḷḷiyālum ceyyappaṭṭa iṭuppuppaṭṭi, utarapantam, oṭṭiyāṇam, caṉṉavīram eṉpavaṟṟi ariyil aṇintaṉar. āyiṉ, avarkaḷ viralkaḷil mōtiram kāṇappaṭavilli; mūkkaṇiyum illi.1
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa nakikaḷuṭpala, nam caṅkanūlkaḷiṟ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.


peyarkkāraṇam
nakikaḷ-aṇi, pūṇ, iḻi, kalam (kalaṉ) eṉap pala peyarkaḷip peṟum. ivaṟṟuḷ ovvoru peyarum ovvoru kāraṇam paṟṟiyē vantatākum. aṇi-aṇiyappeṟum kāraṇam paṟṟi vanta peyar. itu, caṭṭi aṇital, āṭi aṇital pōla eḷiya muṟiyil māli pōla aṇiyap peṟum kaḻuttaṇikaḷik kuṟikka vantatākalām; piṉṉark kālappōkkil ivvoru kuṟippi oḻittu ellā nakikaṭkum potuvāṉa peyarāy amintirukkalām.
pūṇ-ulakkip pūṇ, taṭippūṇ eṉpaṉa, ulakkiyiṉ taliyilum taṭiyiṉ taliyilum ceṟinta vaḷiyaṅkaḷi uṇarttum. avvāṟē kikaḷil ceṟinta muṟiyil aṇiyappaṭṭatu mutalil pūṇ eṉappaṭṭatu pōlum! kāppu, kolucu, kaṭakam, kaṅkaṇam, mōtiram eṉpavi ki, viral pōṉṟa uṟuppukaḷil iṟukiya niliyil aṇiyap peṟuvaṉa ātalāl, `pūṇkaḷ eṉa mutaliṟpeyar peṟṟirukkalām. piṉṉark kālappōkkil ikkāraṇac ciṟappup peyar, pala aṇikaḷiyum kāraṇap potup peyar niliyil niṉṟu kuṟikkat toṭaṅkiṉa pōlum!
iḻi-iḻippu vēlippāṭu koṇṭa naki, iḻi eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. poṉṉik kampiḷāka iḻittuc ceyyappaṭṭa naki iḻi eṉappaṭṭatu pōlum! `kalliḻitta naki eṉpatu ikkāla vaḻakkilum uḷḷatēyākum. eṉavē, poṉ vaṭavaṅkaḷum kal iḻittuc ceyyappaṭṭa nakikaḷum `iḻi eṉap peyar peṟṟirukkalām. piṉpu kālap pōkkil `iḻi eṉpatu ellā nakikaḷiyum kuṟikkalāyiṟṟup pōlum!
maṇikaḷip poṉṉil iḻittu aṇi (aḻaku) ceyyap peṟṟa `aṇiyiḻi eṉavum, oḷi poruntiya iḻi `oḷiyiḻi eṉavum, oḷi viḷaṅkit tōṉṟiya iḻi `ilaṅkiḻi eṉavum, cem poṉṉālum cemmaṇikaḷālum āṉa iḻi `cēyiḻi eṉavum, pacumpoṉṉālum paciya maṇikaḷālum āṉa iḻi `pāciḻi eṉavum, poṉṉālum maṇiyālum vēlippāṭṭālum māṇpuṟṟu viḷaṅkiya iḻi `māṇiḻi eṉavum, iḻikaḷuḷ ārāyntu eṭukkappaṭṭatu `āyiḻi eṉavum peyar peṟṟaṉa eṉak koḷvatu poruttamākum. ippala peyarkaḷum caṅkap pākkaḷil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
kalam (kalaṉ)-kalam allatu kalaṉ eṅṅaṉam nakiyik kuṟittatu eṉpatu ippōtu aṟiya iyalavilli. itu, `kal eṉṉum ōciyuṇṭākkum cataṅki, cilampu, pōṉṟa kālaṇikaḷukku mutaliṟpeyarākip piṉpu kālap pōkkil nakikaḷukkup potup peyarāyamintatō, eṉṉavō teriyavilli.
toṭi-kikaḷilum tōḷilum toṭuttukkoṇṭa aṇi `toṭi eṉappaṭṭateṉpatu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭataṉṟō? oḷi poruntiya toṭi `oṇṭoṭi eṉavum, toṭikaḷuḷ ciṟantatāka ārāyntu aṇiyappeṟṟatu āytoṭi eṉavum, ceṟintu iṟuka aṇiyappeṟṟatu `ceṟitoṭi eṉavum, pacumpoṉṉāl allatu paciya maṇikaḷāl ā ṉatoṭi `pintoṭi eṉavum peyar peṟṟaṉa. ippala peyarkaḷiyum caṅkanūlkaḷiṟ kāṇalām.
iṅṅaṉam pala peyarkaḷit tāṅkiya ittoṭi, kivaḷiyākavum, tōḷ vaḷiyākavum payaṉpaṭṭatu. aracar, vīrar pōṉṟavar aṇintatoṭi `vīravaḷi eṉappaṭṭatu. peṇkaḷ aṇinta muṉki vaḷi `toṭi eṉappaṭṭatu. iḷampeṇkaḷ aṇinta muṉki vaḷi `kuṟuntoṭi eṉappaṭṭatu. tōḷ vaḷiyum `toṭi eṉappeyar peṟṟatu.
kuḻi-itu taḷiriliruntu (kuḻiyiliruntu) piṟanta peyar. makaramīṉ vaṭivattil amintatu `makarakkuḻi eṉappaṭṭatu. poṉṉāṟceyyappaṭṭa kuḻi `polaṅkuḻi eṉṟum, oḷi poruntiya kuḻi `oṇkuḻi eṉṟum, poliviḷiyuṭiya kuḻi pūṅkuḻi eṉṟum, periya oḷi oḻukiṉa kuḻi `vār kuḻi eṉṟum, tāḷuruvi eṉṉam oru vakik kuḻi `ciṟukuḻi eṉṟum peyar peṟṟaṉa.
vaḷi-vaḷinta, kōṇalāṉa naki, `vaḷi eṉappaṭṭatu. itu caṅku, āmi ōṭu, pittaḷi, veḷḷi, poṉ mutaliyavaṟṟāl ceyyappaṭṭatu; iṉṟum ceyyappaṭukiṉṟatu. ikkālattil kaṇṇāṭi koṇṭum `piḷāṭikku eṉṉum kalavip poruḷ koṇṭum ceyyappaṭukiṉṟatu. kāppu eṉpatum ivvakiyic cērntatēyākum.1
iṅṅaṉam ovvoru nakiyum oru kāraṇam paṟṟiyē peyariṭappaṭṭatu. inta aṇikaḷ caṅkakālattil peru vaḻakkil iruntaṉa eṉṟu caṅka nūṟpāṭalkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. annūlkaḷiṟ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷa aṇikaḷuḷ kīḻ varuvaṉa kuṟikkattaruvaṉavākum.2
kuṟuntokiyil ariyār cilampu (7, 369), toku vaḷiyalkaḷ (tokutiyāṉa vaḷiyalkaḷ) (15), caṅka vaḷiyalkaḷ (11, 23), poṉṉālāṉa taliyaṇikaḷ (21), uruṇṭiyāṉa poṟkācukaḷ kōkkap peṟṟa kācu māli (67), pūttoḻil aminta kuḻikaḷ (159), toṭi (243), poṟkālaṇi (148), poṉṉālum maṇiyālum ceyyappaṭṭa iṭiyaṇi (mēkali allatu kāñci-264) eṉpavi aṇikaḷeṉak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. poṉṉi urittu ataṉ māṟṟi aṟitaṟkup payaṉ paṭṭa kal, `kaṭṭaḷikkal eṉappaṭṭatu (192).
naṟṟiṇiyil mēṟcollappaṭṭa aṇikaḷuṭaṉ vēṟu cilavum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. āṭavarum ciṟuvarum toṭi aṇintiruntaṉar (48, 166). viral iḻi (mōtiram, 85), vāḻippūppōlak kuvintuḷḷa oravaki mōtiram (188), curitakam eṉṉum taliyaṇi (86), piḷḷikaḷiṉ iṭiyaṇiyāṉa kiṇkiṇi (269), maṇikaḷ patitta poṉ nakikaḷ (304) mutaliyaṉa kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
akanāṉūṟṟil mēlē kūṟappaṭṭavaṟṟuḷ pala, iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. kalaṉ, pūṇ, iḻi eṉap porup peyarāl pala aṇikaḷ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivi ovvoru toki nūliṉ pākkaḷilum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
kalittokiyil kaṇṇi (32), poṟpū māli, taliyaṇi (54), kaṉaṅkuḻi, (57), polaṅkuḻi (58), pūkkuḻi (63), makarakkuḻi (92), varikkuḻi (104), nupuram (83), cataṅki, taṇṭi (74), iṭapak kuṟi poṟitta tāyittu (82), poṉmaṇivaṭam, pavaḷavaṭam, vayantakam (79), valliki, pulliki, kaṉṉacāmari, teyvavutti, mukkaṇṭaṉ kaṭṭuvaṭam, kaṇṭiki (96) ākiya aṇikaḷ putiyaṉavākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
paripāṭalil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa aṇikaḷuḷ toyyakam (talippāḷi), makara valayam eṉṟa talikkōlam (10), pavaḷavaḷi, poṟpū māli, muñcam (ciṟuvar taliyaṇi) (14), muttup paraliyuṭiya poṟcilampu (21) eṉpaṉa putiya aṇikaḷākum.
patiṟṟuppattu-aracaṉ, vīrakkaḻal, pōrttuṟikkuriya poṉ māli ākiyavaṟṟip piṟa aṇikaḷōṭu aṇintiruntāṉ (40, 56). poṉṉari mālikaḷip pāṭiṉiyarum viṟaliyarum paricilākap peṟṟaṉar (22, 54).
puṟanāṉūṟu-naḷḷi eṉṟa ciṟṟaracaṉ taliyil nīla maṇiḷiyum, kaḻuttil muttu māliyiyum, kiyiṟ kaṭakattiyum aṇintiruntāṉ (150). itaṉi nōkkap pēraracar mēlum pala aṇikaḷi aṇintirukkalām eṉṟu koḷḷutal poruttamākum. vēḷvikkuriya maṉivimār `cālakam eṉṟa aṇiyi aṇintiruntaṉar. poṉṉāṟceyyappaṭṭa talimāli iruntatu (353).
cilappatikāram-cilappatikārattil mātaviyiṉ aṇikaḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa (kāti 6; aṭi, 83-108) avi kāl viral aṇikaḷ, pariyakam-nupuram-pāṭakam, cataṅki-ariyakam eṉṉum kālaṇikaḷ, toṇṭiyaṇi, muppattiraṇṭu muttuk kōvikaḷik koṇṭa mēkali, māṇikkavaḷi muttu vaḷiyākiya tōḷ vaḷikaḷ, māṇikkamum vayiraṅkaḷum aḻuttappeṟṟa kaṭakam, cempoṉvaḷi-navarattiṉavaḷi-caṅkavaḷi-pavaḻavaḷi eṉṟa muṉki vaḷiyalkaḷ, māṇikkam-marakatam-vayiram ākiyavaṟṟāl amintu viralkaḷi maṟikkum kiyaṇi, vīraccaṅkili nērñcaṅkili-ñāṇ, vēlip pāṭaminta cavaṭi, carappaḷi muttu māli eṉṉum kaḻuttaṇikaḷ, mutuku maṟiya viṭum piṉ tāli, intira nīlak kaṟkaḷiṭiyē vayiraṅkaḷ patitta nīlakkutampi (kātaṇi), cītēviyār-valampuri caṅku-pūrappāḷi-teṉ palli-vaṭapalli eṉpavi koṇṭa talikkōlam eṉpaṉa.
iṉip pattuppāṭṭuḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa aṇikaḷip paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷik kāṇpōm:
II
pattuppāṭṭil aṇikaḷ
tali aṇikaḷ
muṭi : tāmam, mukuṭam, patumam, kōṭakam, kimpuri ākiya aintum muṭiyuṟuppukaḷ eṉat tivākaramum piṅkalantiyum kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. ivvintu uṟuppukaḷum oruṅkē amiyap peṟṟa vili matippaṟṟa-vēlippāṭu niṟinta-muṭiyi murukapperumāṉ aṇintiruntāṉ eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟup paṭi kūṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 83, 84, uri).
tamiḻaracaṉ pācaṟiyil irunta pōtum iravu nērattilum taliyil muṭi puṉintiruntāṉ eṉṟu mullippāṭṭu (aṭi, 76) moḻikiṉṟatu. itaṉāl cēra cōḻa pāṇṭiya maṉṉar muṭiyaṇintiruntaṉar eṉpatu terikiṟatu. tolkāppiyarum ittamiḻ neṭunila maṉṉarkku muṭi uriyateṉṟum, kuṟunila maṉṉarkku muṭi uriyataṉṟu eṉṟum kūṟiyuḷḷār (marapiyal, nūṟpā, 71, 83). maṉṉaṟku muṭimutaṟ kalaṅkaḷ camippēṉ (cilampu, kāti, 16; aṭi, 114) eṉṟu pāṇṭiyaṉuṭiya araṇmaṉip poṟkollaṉ kōvalaṉiṭam kūṟiyatum kāṇka.
talikkōlam: murukapperumāṉ eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷa tirupparaṅkuṉṟattuc cōliyil viḷiyāṭik koṇṭirunta cūrara makaḷir (teyvamakaḷir), cītēvi eṉṉum talikkōlattuṭaṉē valampuri vaṭivākac ceyta talikkōlattiyum taliyil vittu, neṟṟiyiṉkaṇ cuṟāviṉatu aṅkānta vāyākap paṇṇiṉa talikkōlam taṅkap paṇṇiṉar.
	teyva vuttiyoṭu valampuri vayiṉvittut
tilakan tiiya tēṅkamaḻ tirunutal
makarap pakuvāy tāḻamaṇ ṇuṟuttu
									(muruku. aṭi, 23-25)
viṟali, taṉ oppaṉi mikunta kūntal aḻaku peṟattakka muṟiyil poṉmāli aṇintiruntāḷ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 485-486).
kātaṇikaḷ
murukap perumāṉ polaṅkuḻiyi aṇintiruntāṉ (muruku. aṭi, 86). viṟali pūṅkuḻi (poliviṉiyuṭiya makarak kuḻiyi) aṇintiruntāḷ (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 30). āyar makaḷ kātukaḷil ciṟukuḻi (`tāḷuruvi eṉṉum kātaṇi) acintatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 161). marutanilattu makaḷir kātukaḷil polaṅkuḻi polintatu (aṭi, 311-312). maturi mānakarac celvamakaḷir oṇkuḻi aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. 448). pāṇṭimātēviyarum oṇkuḻi aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 709). pāṇṭi nāṭṭuc celvamakaḷir pūṅkuḻi (poliviṉiyuṭiya kuḻiyit) tarittiruntaṉar (ne. vāṭi, aṭi, 38). pāṇṭimātēvi `neṭunīr vārkuḻi (periya oḷi oḻukiṉa makarak kuḻiyi) aṇintiruntāḷ (aṭi, 139).
kiyaṇikaḷ
toṭi : āṭavar piṉ kiyil vīrattiṟku aṟikuṟiyāka aṇintatu toṭi (vīravaḷi) eṉappaṭṭatu. murukapperumāṉ `toṭiyaṇi tōḷaṉ (muruku. aṭi, 113-114, 212) eṉappaṭṭāṉ. cōḻaṉ oruvaṉ vāṉattil toṅkikkoṇṭirunta (mikavum uyaramāṉa) eyili aḻittāṉ. avaṉ vīravaḷiyi aṇintiruntāṉ. avaṉ tūṅkeyil eṟinta toṭittōṭ cempiyaṉ (ci. pā. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 81-82) eṉappaṭṭāṉ. tirukkōvalūri āṇṭa maliyamāṉ tirumuṭikkāri, kaḻal toṭit taṭakkik kāri eṉappaṭṭāṉ (aṭi, 95). pāṇṭiyaṉ taliyālaṅkāṉattuc ceruveṉṟa neṭuñceḻiyaṉ, valikeḻu taṭakkit toṭiyoṭu (ma. kā. aṭi, 34, 720) viḷaṅkiṉāṉ. ceṅkaṇmāttu vēḷ naṉṉaṉ cēy naṉṉaṉ eṉṟa kuṟunilamaṉṉaṉum toṭi aṇintiruntāṉ eṉṟu kūttarāṟṟuppaṭi kūṟukiṉṟatu (mali. aṭi, 577).
iṉi makaḷir toṭiyaṇintiruntami paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷik kāṇpōm:
pēymakaḷ toṭiyaṇintiruntāḷ (muruku. aṭi, 54). viṟali taṉ muṉ kiyil toṭi tarittiruntāḷ (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 14). ōymāṉāṭṭu uḻavar makaḷ toṭi aṇintiruntāḷ (aṭi, 192). toṇṭi nāṭṭup paṭṭiṉattu (māmalla purattu)c celvac ciṟumiyar kuṟuntoṭi tarittiruntaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 334). aracaṉ taṅkiyirunta pāṭi vīṭṭup paṇippeṇṭir muṉ kiyil kuṟuntoṭi aṇintiruntaṉar (mu. pā. aṭi, 45). viṟaliyar kuṟuntoṭi paricu peṟṟaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 217-218). maturi mānakarap parantiyar āykōl avirtoṭi viḷaṅka vīci (ma. kā. aṭi, 563) naṭantaṉar. itaṟku, `aḻakiya tiraṭciyiyuṭiya viḷaṅkukiṉṟa toṭi eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri. apparattiyar, `āypoṉ avirtoṭip pāciḻi makaḷir (ma. kā. aṭi, 579) eṉappaṭṭaṉar. pāṇṭimā tēviyar `aytoṭi-naṉku ārāyntu ceyyappaṭṭa toṭi eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri. `tskid¥ óªbjho kfË®’ v‹gJ F¿Šá¥gh£L¤ bjhluhF« (mo, 223-224)., `pūntoṭi-polivu peṟṟa toṭi eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri. naṉṉaṉik kaṇṭu paricil peṟac ceṉṟa viṟaliyar `ceṟitoṭi viṟaliyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar (mali. aṭi. 201).
cōḻap pēraracaṉāṉa karikālaṉuṭiya putalvar toṭi aṇintiruntaṉar. ciṟuvar aṇintirunta toṭi vīravaḷi aṉṟu. avarkaḷ `poṟṟoṭip putalvar eṉappaṭṭaṉar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 295).
kaṭakam : taṉ mātēviyip pirintu pōrkkaḷam ceṉṟirunta vēntaṉ kiyil kaṭakatti aṇintiruntāṉ eṉṟu mullippāṭṭu (aṭi, 76) moḻikiṉṟatu. kaṭakam-kaṅkaṇam (kṣacayunaṭanava) eṉpatu, `kaṭakam ceṟinta ki eṉavarum maṇimēkaliyaṭiyāl (kāti 6; aṭi, 114) aṟiyappaṭum.
vantiki :  itu kiyil tōḷiṉkīḻ aṇiyappaṭum aṇi vaki. itu `ki vanti eṉappaṭum. ippoḻutu `vaṅki eṉa maruvi vaḻaṅkukiṟatu. maturic celvamakaḷir itaṉi aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu maturik kāñci moḻikiṉṟatu (aṭi, 415).
vaḷi
kiṇimakaḷ, vaḷikkik kiṇimakaḷ eṉappaṭṭāḷ (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 136). toṇṭi nāṭṭu maṟiyavaṉ maṉivi `vaḷikki makaṭūu eṉappaṭṭāḷ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 304). pāṇṭimātēvi caṅkuvaḷi aṇintiruntāḷ.
	polampoṭi tiṉṟa mayirvār muṉki
valampuri vaḷi
				(neṭu. aṭi, 141-142)
`valampurivaḷi-valampuri caṅki aṟuttuc ceyyappaṭṭa vaḷi eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri. kuṟiñci nilattalivi elvaḷi (oḷiporuntiya vaḷi) tarittiruntāḷ (ku. pā. aṭi, 167). naṉṉaṉik kāṇac ceṉṟa kūttaruṭaṉ irunta viṟaliyar ilaṅkuvaḷi viṟaliyar (mali, aṭi, 46) eṉappaṭṭaṉar. ivviṟaliyarē mēl ceṟitoṭi viṟaliyar (mali, 201) eṉappaṭṭaṉar. eṉavē, ivviṟaliyar tam kikiḷil vaḷikaḷiyum toṭiyiyum aṇintiruntaṉar eṉpatu terikiṟatu. eṉavē, muṉpu kūṟiyavāṟu toṭi eṉpatu kiyiṟ ceṟintuḷḷa ikkālak kolucu pōṉṟa aṇi eṉak koḷvatē poruttamākum.
viralaṇi : taliyālaṅkāṉattuc ceruveṉṟa pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ,
polañceyap polinta nalampeṟu viḷakkam
					(ma. kā. aṭi, 719)
aṇintiruntāṉ. `poṉṉāṟ ceykiyiṉālē polivu peṟṟa maṇikaḷ aḻuttiṉa mōtiram eṉṟu ittoṭarkku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār pāṇṭimātēviṉ mōtiram,
vāḷip pakuvāy kaṭuppa vaṇakkuṟuttuc
cevviral koḷīiya ceṅkēḻ viḷakkam
eṉṟu neṭunalvāṭiyil (aṭi, 143-144) pēcappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itaṟku, `vāḷiyiṉatu pakutta vāyi okka muṭakkatti uṇṭākkic civanta viraliṭattēyiṭṭa civanta niṟattiyuṭiya `muṭakku eṉṉum mōtiram eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri varintuḷḷār.
vāḷip pakuvāy vaṇakkuṟu mōtiram
eṉa varum cilappatikāra aṭikku (kāti 6; aṭi, 95), `muṭakku-mōtiram eṉṟu arumpatavuriyāciriyar uri varintuḷḷamiyum, `neḷi eṉṟu aṭiyārkku nallār varintiruttalum iṅku niṉittaṟpālaṉ.
iṭi aṇikaḷ
kuṟumpoṟi: murukap perumāṉ kuṟamakaḷiroṭu kuravik kūṭuttāṭukiyil ariyil kuṟumpoṟi aṇintiruppaṉ eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi terivikkiṟatu.
kuṟumpoṟik koṇṭa naṟuntaṇ cāyal
maruṅku  (muruku. aṭi, 213-214).
`kuṟumpoṟi-utarapantam eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri. utaram-vayiṟu; utarapantam-vayiṟṟip poruntiyuḷḷa aṇi.
cilkāḻ: tirupparaṅkuṉṟattuc cōliyil viḷiyāṭiya cūrara makaḷir, palkācu niritta cilkāḻ aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi (aṭi, 16) kūṟukiṟatu. ittoṭarkku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `pala maṇikaḷ kōtta ēḻu vaṭamākiya mēkali eṉapporuḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. avarē, tam kūṟṟukkuk kīḻ varum veṇpāvi mēṟkōḷākak kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.
eṇkōvi kāñci, eḻukōvi mēkali,
paṇkoḷ kalāpam patiṉāṟu,-kaṇkoḷ
parumam patiṉeṭṭu, muppat tiraṇṭu
viriciki eṉṟuṇaraṟ pāṟṟu.
parumam: tiruvāvinaṉkuṭiyil murukaṉip pukaḻntēttiya kantaruva makaḷir (pāṭiṉiyar) `iṉṉakip parumam (muruku. aṭi, 145-146) eṉṉum aṇiyi ariyil aṇintiruntaṉar. itaṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiy, `kaṇṇukkiṉiya oḷiyiṉiyuṭiya patiṇeṉkōviyatākiya mēkali,1 eṉap poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār.
palkāḻ: viṟali, vaṇṭirup paṉṉa palkāḻ2 (po. ā. paṭi aṭi, 39) aṇintiruntāḷ. `pala vaṇṭiṉaṅkaḷiṉ iruppi otta pala maṇikaḷ kōtta vaṭaṅkaḷiyuṭiya mēkali eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri.
piṅkāḻ: toṇṭi nāṭṭup paṭṭiṉattip (piṟkāla māmallapuratti)c cērnta celvamakaḷir piṅkāḻ ariyil aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu perum pāṇāṟṟuppaṭi (aṭi, 329) kūṟukiṟatu. `piṅkāḻ-paciya maṇikaḷ kōtta vaṭaṅkaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri.
kālaṇikaḷ
cūrara maṅkiyar kālkaḷil kiṇkiṇi aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi (aṭi, 13) kūṟukiṟatu. `kiṇkiṇi-ciṟu cataṅki eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri.
toṇṭi nāṭṭup paṭṭiṉattu (ikkāla māmallapurattu)c celva makaḷir `tamaṉiyap poṟcilampu aṇintiruntaṉar. itaṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `poṟpūṇ kaḷiyum poṟcilampiyum aṇintiruntaṉar eṉṟu poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. itaṉāl, accelva makaḷir poṟcilampiyum, poṟkāppu, poṟkolucu mutaliya kālaṇikaḷiyum aṇintiruntaṉar eṉpatu terikiṟatu.1
maturi nakarac celvamakaḷir `teḷḷarip poṟ cilampu aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 444). itaṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `teḷḷiya uḷḷiṉ maṇikaḷiyuṭiya poṟcilampukaḷ eṉṟu poruḷ varintuḷḷār. ivi, pāṇṭimātēviyiṉ muttupparalkaḷik koṇṭa cilampiyum kaṇṇakiyiṉ māṇikkapparalkaḷiyuṭiya cilampiyum pōṉṟavi.
cōḻanāṭṭuk kuṟumpallūrkaḷil vāḻnta celvar viṭṭuc ciṟuvarkaḷ, `poṟkāṟputalvar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 24) eṉappaṭṭārkaḷ. itaṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `pūṇ aṇinta tāḷiṉiyuṭiya ciṟār eṉṟu poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. eṉavē, celvar vīṭṭuc ciṟuvarkaḷ kālkaḷil poṟkiṇkiṇi, poṟkāppu mutaliya kālaṇikaḷi aṇintārkaḷ eṉpatu uṇarappaṭum.


kaḻuttaṇikaḷ
kaḻuttil toṅkaviṭappaṭṭu mārpi aṇi ceyyum aṇikaḷik `kaḻuttaṇikaḷ allatu `mārpaṇikaḷ eṉṟu collalām.
muttu māli : kaḻuttaṇikaḷuḷ muttu māli oṉṟu. pāṭiṉi muttu māliyi aṇintiruntāḷ (po. M., paṭi, aṭi, 162). maturi nakarattu makaḷir muttu māli aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 680-681). pāṇṭiyaṉ taliyālaṅkāṉattuc ceruveṉṟa neṭuñceḻiyaṉ muttumāliyit tarittiruntāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 715). pāṇṭimātēvi muttāṟceyyappaṭṭa kacciṉi2 mārpil aṇintiruntāḷ (neṭu, aṭi, 136).
poṉṉari māli: karikālaṉ `nūliṉ valavānuṇaṅkaril māliyip (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 161) pāṭiṉikkup paricaḷippāṉ eṉṟu pulavar kūṟiyuḷḷār. `nūlāṟ kaṭṭāta nuṇmiyiyum piṇakkattiyum uṭiya poṉṉari māli eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar itaṟku uri vakuttuḷḷār. poṟkampikaḷ koṇṭu nuṇmiyākavum nerukkamākavum piṉṉappaṭṭa poṉṉari māli eṉpatu itaṉ poruḷ. ittakiya poṉṉari māliyi murukap perumāṉatu ūrtiyāṉa piṇimukam eṉṉum yāṉiyum aṇintiruntatu eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi terivikkiṟatu (aṭi, 79). murukap perumāṉatu mārpil poṉmāli polivuṟṟatu eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi (aṭi, 104, uri) terivikkiṉṟatu.
muttu māliyum poṉṉari māliyum kaḻuttiyum mārpiyum aṇi ceytāṟpōlavē vēṟu cila aṇivakikaḷum aṇi ceytaṉa eṉpatu pala iṭaṅkaḷil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa pūṇ, iḻi, kalam allatu kalaṉ eṉṉum coṟkaḷāl terikiṟatu. āyiṉ, avi yāvi eṉpatu iṉṟu viḷaṅkumāṟilli.
cūrara makaḷir `nuṇpūṇ ākan tiḷippa (muruku. aṭi, 32) iruntaṉar. nuṇṇiya vēlippāṭaminta pūṇkaḷ mārpil viḷaṅka iruntaṉar eṉpatu maṭṭumē ittoṭarāl aṟiyappaṭukiṉṟatē tavira, ākatti aḻaku ceyta appūṇkaḷ iṉṉavi eṉpatu aṟiya iyalavilli. pāṇṭi mātēvi mārpil aṇintiruntāṟpōṉṟa muttukkaccum, mātavi kaḻuttil aṇintirunta vīraccaṅkili, nērñcaṅkili, ñāṇ, cavaṭi, carappaḷi, muttu māli pōṉṟa kaḻuttaṇikaḷum `ākattil tiḷitta nuṇpūṇkaḷ eṉṉalām.
 `pūṇakat toṭuṅkiya vemmuli
eṉpatu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi (aṭi, 26) ākum. itu, viṟaliyiṉ mārpaṇikaḷik kuṟikkiṉṟatu.
maturi nakarap parattiyar, `nuṇpūṇ ākam vaṭukkoḷa muyaṅkiṉar eṉṟu maturikkāñci (aṭi, 569) moḻikiṉṟatu. `pūṇ-pūṇkaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri.
 mintiṟi koṇṭa malarntēt takalattut
toṉṟupaṭu naṟuntār pūṇoṭu poliya
eṉpaṉa kuṟiñcippāṭṭu aṭikaḷ (121-122) ivvaṭikaḷ kuṟiñci nilattalivaṉuṭiya mārpil `toṉṟu toṭṭu varukiṉṟa pēraṇikaḷik kuṟikkiṉṟaṉa.
 karikālaṉ `oṇpūṇ aṇintavaṉ (pa. pāli, aṭi, 297). `oṇpūṇ-oḷḷiya pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri. ippēraṇikalaṅkaḷuḷ mārpaṇikaḷiyum koḷḷalām.
naṉṉaṉ, `perumpūṇ naṉṉaṉ (mali. aṭi, 63-64). `perumpūṇ-pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri kūṟiyuḷḷār.
 aimperuṅkuḻuviṉar polampūṇ aivar (ma. kā. aṭi, 775) eṉappaṭṭaṉar. iṅkum `pūṇ-poṉṉāṟ ceyta pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉṟē nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri kūṟiyuḷḷār.
	 maturic celva makaḷiri, pūṇoṭu
teḷḷarip poṟcilampu olippa oḷḷaḻal
tāvaṟa viḷaṅkiya āypoṉ aviriḻi
aṇaṅkuvīḻ vaṉṉa pūntoṭi makaḷir
eṉṟu maturikkāñci (aṭi, 443-446) moḻikiṉṟatu. ivvaṭikaḷil ammakaḷiruṭiya kālaṇiyākiya cilampum, kiyaṇiyākiya toṭiyum taṉittaṉiyē kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa; pūṇ eṉṟum iḻi eṉṟum iruvēṟu nakivakikaḷum kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. eṉavē, iḻi vēṟu, kālaṇi vēṟu, kiyaṇi vēṟu, pūṇ vēṟu eṉpatu ivvaṭikaḷāl pulaṉākiṉṟatu allavā? āyiṉum, pūṇkaḷ ivi, iḻikaḷ ivi eṉa variyaṟuttuk kūṟac cāṉṟu kiṭṭavilli.
umaṇaruṭiya putalvar, `kiḷarpūṇ putalvar eṉap paṭṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 61). iṅkup `pūṇ eṉpatu naki eṉṉum potupporuḷiyē uṇarttukiṟatu.
toṇṭi nāṭṭu eyiṉar maṇṇik kiḷaṟak kikkoṇṭirunta kōliṉ taliyil pūṇ iruntatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 90-92). iḷantiriyaṉuṭiya yāṉik kompil pūṇ iruntatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 436-437). pūṇ eṉpatu iṟukkamākap pōṭappaṭuvatu. makkaḷ kikaḷil kāppum iṟukkamākap pōṭappaṭuvatēyākum. iṅṅaṉamē kaḻuttil aṭṭikiyum iṟukkamākap pōṭappaṭuvatu. ittakiya kuṟippiṭṭa nakikaḷukku mutalil vaḻaṅkappaṭṭa `pūṇ eṉṉum col, kālappōkkil taṉ poruḷil nekiḻntu vēṟu aṇikaḷukkum vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatātal vēṇṭum eṉak koḷvatē iṅkup poruttamākum.
`ākam, mārpu eṉṉum coṟkaḷōṭu varum `pūṇ eṉṉum col mārpaṇikaḷik kuṟippatu eṉṟum ivi yaṉṟip potuppaṭa varum `pūṇ eṉṉum col potuvāka ellā aṇikaḷiyum kuṟikkap payaṉpaṭṭirukkalām eṉṟum koḷvatē īṇṭikkup poruttamākum.
mātaṇi : kaḻuttaṇiyiliruntu mārpi aṇi ceyyum patakkam `matāṇi eṉappaṭṭatu. maturi nakar vāḻvaracikaḷ matāṇi aṇintiruntārkaḷ (ma. kā. aṭi, 461).
iḻi: `iḻi puṉinar (ma. kā. aṭi, 512) eṉṉum toṭarukku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `iḻikkappaṭṭa nakiyākac ceypavar eṉṟu poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. poṉṉik kampikaḷāka iḻittuc ceyyum caraṭu pōṉṟaviyum, kalliḻittup poṉṉil patittuc ceyyappaṭuvaṉavum `iḻi eṉappaṭṭaṉa pōlum!
1. cūraramakaḷir cāmpūnatam eṉṟa uyarnta poṉṉālāṉa iḻiyi (aviriḻi) aṇintiruntaṉar (muruku. aṭi, 18).
2. kāṭukiḻāḷ (turkki) eṉappaṭṭa `paḻiyōḷ iḻi aṇintiruntāḷ (muruku. aṭi, 259). kāṭu kiḻāḷiṉ tiruṉikku iḻi aṇiyappaṭṭu vaḻipaṭappaṭṭatu eṉpatu itaṉ karuttu.1
3. maturi nakara makaḷir kāliyil eḻuntu, `oṇ poṉ aviriḻi teḻippa iyaṅkiṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 666). ittoṭarukku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `oḷḷiya poṉṉāṟceytu viḷaṅkum cilampu mutaliyaṉa olippa iyaṅkiṉar eṉṟu poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār.
4. māṇiḻi (ma. kā. aṭi, 680) eṉpataṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar `māṭcimippaṭṭa pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉṟu poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār.
5. pāṇṭimātēviyar, `tamaṉiyam vaḷiiya tāvil viḷaṅkiḻi (ma. kā. aṭi, 704) aṇintiruntaṉar. itaṟkup poṉ naṭu aḻuttiṉa maṇikaḷic cūḻnta pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri kūṟiyuḷḷār.
6. pāṇṭiyaṉatu araṇmaṉip paṇippeṇṭirum `ilaṅkiḻi1 aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 779).
7. maturi nakarac celvamakaḷir, `aviriḻi tarittiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 445).
8. makaḷir tam kātalarikkūṭa iḻi puṉintaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 551).
9. maturi nakarap parattiyar `pāciḻi (pacum poṉṉāl āṉa allatu paccikkaṟkaḷ patitta nakikaḷi) aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 579).
10. maturiyil vāṇikam ceyta makaḷir, oḷḷiḻi (oḷḷiya aṇikalaṅkaḷit) tarittiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 623).
11. cōḻanāṭṭuc celvamakaḷir `nēriḻikaḷi aṇintiruntaṉar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 22).
12. paṭṭiṉappāli eṉṉam neṭumpaṭṭiṟkūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa talimakaṉ, taṉ taliviyi vayaṅkiḻi eṉṟu cuṭṭiyuḷḷāṉ (aṭi, 219).
13. karikālaṉ maṉiviyar `muṟṟiḻi makaḷir eṉappaṭṭaṉar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 296). `muṟṟiḻi-meym muḻuvatum aṇinta aṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri.
14. naṉṉaṉ, viṟaliyar aṇiya `viḷaṅkiḻi taravāṉ (mali. aṭi, 570) eṉṟu avaṉiṭam vaṟiya kūttaṉi vaḻippaṭuttiya kūttar talivaṉ kūṟiṉāṉ.
kalam-kalaṉ
cōḻaṉ karikālaṉ araṇmaṉiyil tēṟal polaṅ kalattil vārttup porunarkkut tarappaṭṭatu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 86). polaṅkalam-poṟpāttiram. iṅṅaṉamē pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ araṇmaṉiyilum tēṟal vārkkap polaṅkalamē payaṉpaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 779). ivviraṇṭu iṭaṅkaḷilum `kalam eṉṉum col `pāttiram eṉṉum poruḷil āḷappaṭṭuḷḷatu. āyiṉ, ikkalam eṉṉum col nakiyik kuṟikkavum āḷappaṭṭuḷḷatu. cila cāṉṟukaḷik kīḻē kāṇka.
1. naṉkalañ cīppa eṉpatu maturik kāñcit toṭar (aṭi, 685). `naṉkalam-nalla pūṇkaḷ eṉpatu uri.
2. kuṟiñci nilat talivi,
	muttiṉum maṇiyiṉum poṉṉiṉum attuṇi
nērvaruṅ kuriya kalam (ku. pā. aṭi, 13-14).
aṇintāḷ. `kalam-pūṇ eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri.
3. kalampeṟu kaṇṇuḷar eṉṟu malipaṭukaṭāttil (50) kūttar kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉar. `pēraṇi kalaṅkaḷip peṟum kūttar eṉpatu ittoṭarkku uriyākum. kalam-pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ.
4. `naṉantalit tēettu naṉkalaṉ uymmār eṉpatu maturik kāñciyil varum toṭar. `kalaṉ eṉpataṟkup `pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉṟu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri kūṟiyuḷḷār.
5. maturi nakarak kaḷvar, `kalaṉaciik koṭṭum kaṇmā ṟāṭavar (ma. kā. aṭi, 641-642) eṉappaṭṭaṉar. iṅkum `kalaṉ eṉpataṟkup `pēraṇikalaṅkaḷ eṉpatē poruḷākum.
paricu aṇikaḷ
caṅkakālat tamiḻvēntar tammi nāṭivanta pāṇar, kūttar, viṟaliyarkkup poṉṉakikaḷ paricaḷittaṉar; avaṟṟōṭu ciṟappākac cila nakikaḷi vaḻaṅkiṉar.
1. karikāl vaḷavaṉ porunaṉukkup poṟṟāmari malariyum pāṭiṉikkup poṉṉari māliyiyum vaḻaṅkuvāṉ eṉṟu paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa porunaṉ kūṟiṉāṉ (aṭi, 159-162).
2. iḷantiriyaṉ pāṇaṉukkup poṟṟāmariyum viṟalikkuk kūntalaṇiyākap poṉmāliyiyum vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 481, 485-486).
3. naṉṉaṉ eṉṟa ciṟṟaracaṉ kūttarkkup poṟṟāmariyiyum viṟaliyarkku iḻikaḷiyum (pēraṇikalaṅkaḷiyum) paricaḷittāṉ (mali, aṭi, 569-570).
4. pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ vīrarkkup poṉṉāṟ ceyta tumpip pūvip (polampūn tumpi) paricaḷittāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 737).
ivaṟṟuḷ poṉṉarimaliyum iḻikaḷum muṉpē aṇikaḷ variciyuḷ iṭam peṟṟavi. aṅku iṭam peṟātavi poṟṟāmariyum polampūntumpiyumēyākum. ittakiya paricup poruḷkaḷ aṇiyattakkavi ātaliṉ, aṇikaḷ variciyil iṭam peṟṟaṉa.
yāṉi-kutiri aṇikaḷ
murukapperumāṉuṭiya yāṉi poṉṉari maliyiyum neṟṟippaṭṭattiyum aṇintiruntatu (muruku. aṭi, 79). naṉṉaṉuṭiya kutirikaḷukku aṇiyap paṭṭiruntavaṟṟuḷ poṉṉāṟceyta kalaṉi (cēṇam) eṉpatu oṉṟu (mali. aṭi, 574).
kaḻal-kaḻaṅku
kaḻal: murukapperumāṉip pōla vēṭam aṇinta vēlaṉ kālil kaḻali (vīrakkaḻali) aṇintiruntāṉ (muruku, aṭi, 208). iḷantiriyaṉ vīrakkaḻali aṇintiruntāṉ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 102-103). pāṇṭi nāṭṭu vīrar taliyil poṟpūvum kālil vīrakkaḻalum tarittiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 395-396) maturi nakarac celvar vīrakkaḻari aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 436). kuṟiñci nilattalivaṉ taṉ kālil kaḻalit tarittiruntāṉ (ku. pā. aṭi, 126-127).
kaḻaṅku: toṇṭi nāṭṭup paṭṭiṉattuc celvac ciṟumiyar poṟkaḻaṅkukaḷi (poṉṉāṟceyta kaḻaṟcik kāykaḷi)k koṇṭu viḷiyāṭiṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 334-335).
poṉ vaki
pattuppāṭṭuḷ poṉ vakikaḷ cila veḷippaṭiyākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. cāta rūpam, kiḷicciṟi, āṭakam, cāmpūnatam eṉap poṉ nālvakippaṭum (cilampu, kāti, 14; aṭi, 201-203). tāṉ kiṭikkum iṭattiṟku ēṟpap poṉ peyar peṟum eṉpati nam muṉṉōr kaṇṭaṟintaṉar. `cātakumpā eṉṉum maliyilkiṭitta poṉ `cātakumpā eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. itaṉ niṟam tāmari itaḻiṉ niṟam pōṉṟatu. `jāmpu eṉṟa natiyiṟkiṭitta poṉ `jāmpu natam eṉappaṭṭatu. cāmpu natam-iḷañcivappu (rōcāmalar) niṟam uṭiyatu.1
1. poṉ vakikaḷuḷ uyarntatu cāmpunatam eṉappaṭum (tiruvaḷḷuvamāli, 36). accāmpunatam koṇṭu ceyyap paṭṭa iḻikaḷic cūraramakaḷir aṇintiruntaṉar (muruku. aṭi, 18).
2. civanta nīrmiyuṭiya `kiḷicciṟi eṉṉum poṉṉāṟ ceyta pāvi,
cennīrp pacumpoṉ puṉinta pāvi (ma. kā. aṭi, 410) eṉappaṭṭatu. itu māṟṟu uyarntatu. vīṟuyar pacumpoṉ-māṟṟāl uyarcci peṟṟa paciya poṉ; āvatu kiḷicciṟi eṉpataṉāl (cilampu, 3, 165 uri) iḵtu uṇarappaṭum.
kaṭṭaḷikkal
ippoṉ vakikaḷi urittu māṟṟuk kāṇap payaṉpaṭṭa urikal kaṭṭaḷikkal eṉappaṭṭatu.
perumikkum ēṉic ciṟumikkum tattam
karumamē kaṭṭaḷik kal
eṉpatu tirukkuṟaḷ. itu `kaṭṭaḷi eṉavum vaḻaṅkappaṭum.
poṉkāṇ kaṭṭaḷi kaṭuppa (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 220).
itaṟkup `poṉṉi urittu māṟṟukkāṇum uri kal eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri.
III
maṇikaḷum maṇiyaṇikaḷum
oṉpatu vaki maṇikaḷ
viram, muttu, marakatam, māṇikkam, nīlam, puṭparākam, viṭūriyam, kōmētakam, pavaḻam eṉpaṉa oṉpatu vaki maṇikaḷ eṉappaṭum. ivi mikka vili matippu vāyntavi. ivaṟṟuḷ viram, muttu, marakatam, māṇikkam eṉṉum nāṉkum talimaṇikaḷ eṉṟum; nīlam, puṭparākam, viṭūriyam eṉṉum mūṉṟum iṭimaṇikaḷ eṉṟum; pavaḻam, kōmētakam eṉṉum iraṇṭum kaṭimaṇikaḷ eṉṟum collappaṭum.1 immaṇikaḷiṉ niṟam, ivi kiṭikkum iṭaṅkaḷ, ivipaṟṟiya makkaḷ karuttukaḷ ākiyavaṟṟi mutaṟkaṇ iṅkuk kāṇpōm.
1. viram: ituvē oṉpatu vaki maṇikaḷilum matippu mikkatu; uṟuti vāyntatu. marakkariyē pallāyiram āṇṭukaḷ nilattiṉ aṭiyil aḻuttappaṭṭu viramāy māṟiyatu eṉpatu viyappukkuriyataṉṟō? itu veṇmi, cemmi, poṉmi, karumi eṉa niṟattāl nāṉku vakippaṭum. iḵtu intiyāvilum teṉṉamerikkāvilum āppirikkāvilum kiṭikkiṉṟatu. intiya viram pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷākap pukaḻ peṟṟatu. `kōl koṇṭā vayiram mikka pukaḻ vāyntatu. kuṟṟamaṟṟa viratti aṇipavar kutiri vēḷvi ceyvatāl uṇṭākum payaṉip peṟuvar eṉṟum, uyarnta virattik kuṟinta vili kūṟupavaṉum maṭṭamāṉa virattiṟku uyarnta vili colpavaṉum pala tuṉpaṅkaḷi aṭivar eṉṟum nūlkaḷ kūṟum.
2. muttu: itu viratti aṭuttuc ciṟappuṭiyatākum. paṇṭit tamiḻakattuk kiḻakkuk kariyil pāṇṭi nāṭṭuk kapāṭapuramum piṟkālattil koṟkiyum muttukkup peyar peṟṟa iṭaṅkaḷāyiruntaṉa. tamiḻaka muttukaḷ mēṉāṭukaḷukkup peritum ēṟṟumatiyāyiṉa. cippi eṉṉum kaṭalvāḻ uyiriṉāl uṇṭākkappaṭum muttut tamiḻakattum cīṉāvilum jappāṉilum pāracīka vaḷikuṭāvilum1 amerikkāvilum iṉṟu eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. muttut tūymikku aṟikuṟi. aḵtu eppoḻutum aṇiyattakuvatu. pēraracar palar mutti urukki uṇavōṭu kalantu uṇṭaṉar; tam āṭikaḷi muttukaḷāl aṇi ceytaṉar; tam mitiyaṭikaḷilum muttukaḷip payaṉpaṭuttiṉar. intiyāvil pala aṇikaḷ muttukaḷik koṇṭē ceyyappaṭṭaṉa. aracar, pulavarkkum pōr vīrarkkum piṟarkkum muttu mālikaḷip paricaḷittaṉar.
3. marakatam: itaṉ niṟam pacumi. ataṉāl, itu `paccikkal eṉṟum collappaṭum. marakata liṅkaṅkaḷ namatu tamiḻ nāṭṭuk kōvilkaḷ cilavaṟṟil pūciyil uḷḷaṉa. ivi oḷik katirkaḷuṭaṉ meṉmit taṉmiyum uṭiyavi. marakatam intiyā, raṣiyā, teṉṉamerikkā, vaṭavamerikkā, airōppāvil ālp malippakuti, nārvē, ātirēli yāvil niyūcuttu vēl ākiya nāṭukaḷilum iṭaṅkaḷilum kiṭikkiṟatu; intiyāvil jeyppūr marakatam uyarntatu. marakatam, taṉṉi aṇipavarkkuc celvattiyum pēccu vaṉmiyiyum uṇṭākkum; piḷḷip pēṟṟil tāykku nalam viḷikkum; kaṇṇukku nalam ceyyum; kaṟput tavaṟiyavaḷiṭam uḷḷa marakatam pala tuṇṭukaḷāka veṭikkum eṉṟu makkaḷ nampiṉārkaḷ.
4. māṇikkam: itu cenniṟam uḷḷatu. itu `patumarākam eṉṟum peyar peṟum. itu nāṉku vakippaṭum. māṇikkattiṟkup paṇṭutoṭṭē peyar pōṉa iṭam parmā. ciyām, intōcīṉam, āpkāṉitāṉam, kācumīr eṉṉum iṭaṅkaḷilum māṇikkak kaṟkaḷ kiṭikkiṉṟaṉa. māṇikkam teyvika āṟṟaliyum takutiyiyum taruvatu eṉpatu makkaḷ nampikki.
5. nīlam: iḵtu eṭṭu vakippaṭum eṉṟu kuṭilyar kūṟiyuḷḷār. `iruḷit teḷiya vittālaṉiya nīlamaṇi eṉṟu itaṉi iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. intiyāviṉ teṉpakutiyiliruntu nīlamum pacciyum ulakameṅkum aṉuppappaṭṭaṉavām. itu taṉṉi aṇintavarkku uyarnta naṉmi allatu tīmiyi aḷikka vallatu eṉpatu makkaḷ nampikki.
6. puṭparākam: itu poṉ pōṉṟa mañcaḷ niṟamuṭiyatu. itaṉ mañcaṭpaṭikaṅkaḷ nakikaḷil mikutiyākap payaṉpaṭukiṉṟatu. pirēcil nāṭṭu maliccarivukaḷilum, kiḻakkuc cipīriyāvilum, niyūcuttu vēlsilum, vaṭakku nijīriyā, ṭāmēṉiyā eṉṉum iṭaṅkaḷilum puṭparākak kaṟkaḷ kiṭikkiṉṟaṉa. pirēcil nāṭṭiṟ kiṭippaṉavē mikavuyarnta kaṟkaḷām. `puṭparākam taṅkaniṟamuṭiyatu, vaṭṭavaṭivamāṉatu; nerupputtuṇṭu pōṉṟa oḷiyuṭiyatu; kaṇṭōr maṉattik kavarvatu, eṉṟu āṅkīra muṉivar moḻintuḷḷār. itaṉit toṭarntu aṇiyum malaṭiyum tāyāvāḷ; itu taṉṉi aṇintavarkkup pukaḻ, naṭpu, makiḻcci, āyuḷ nīṭṭi ākiyavaṟṟi uṇṭākkum eṉpatu makkaḷ nampikki.
7. viṭūriyam: itu paḻuppuniṟa oḷiyum veṇmiyāṉa oḷiyum uṭiyatu; tēṉtuḷi pōṉṟa uruvamuṭiyatu. iḵtu airōppāvil riṉ āṟṟiṉ kiḷiyāṟāṉa nāhi (cūyāna) yiṉ kariyil pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷākak kiṭittu varukiṟatu; teṉṉamerikkāvil uḷḷa pirēcil, urukuvē eṉṉum nāṭukaḷil mikutiyākak kiṭikkiṟatu; iṅkilāntu, kāṭṭulāntu nāṭukaḷilum kiṭikkiṟatu; vaṭavamerikkāvil cila iṭaṅkaḷilum kiṭikkiṟatu.
itu vaḷattit tarum; viṭam toṭṭa kiyil iruppiṉ poṭiyāyviṭum; kuḷikkum nīril iṭappeṟiṉ, annīr uṭaṟkaṭṭikaḷi nīkkum eṉpatu makkaḷ nampikki. pāracīka maṉṉar itaṉi aṇintu vantaṉar. cevvintiyar itaṉic ciṟappuṭiyatāka matikkiṉṟaṉar; `nāṭkāliyil itaṉip pārppavar annāḷi naṉ muṟiyiṟkaḻippar; itu taṉṉi aṇintiruppavarkkup pōril veṟṟiyiyum aṉivarālum virumpappaṭum niliyiyum uṇṭākkum, eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.
8. kōmētakam: itu pacuviṉ ciṟunīr niṟattip peṟṟiruppatāl, `kōmētakam eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. itu mañcaḷum civappum kalantatu pōṉṟa niṟamuṭiyatu. itu karuṅkaṟpāṟikaḷil kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. itu pirēcil nāṭṭilum yūral malikaḷilum, ayarlāntu, kāṭṭulāntu, vaṭavamorikkā mutaliya nāṭukaḷilum kiṭikkiṉṟatu. itu niṟattil urukkiya neyttuḷi, tēṉ tuḷi, pacuviṉ ciṟunīr ākiyavaṟṟi ottiruppatu. itupala iṭaṅkaḷiṟ puṭparākak kalluṭaṉ kiṭikkiṟatu. itit toṭarntu aṇintāl, malaṭiyum tāymi aṭivāḷ; itaṉi aṇintavarkkup pukaḻ, naṭpu, makiḻcci, āyuḷ nīṭṭippu ākiyavi uṇṭākum eṉpatu makkaḷ nampikkiyākum.
9. pavaḻam: itu muttippōṉṟa kaṭalpaṭu poruḷākum. itu kaṭalil vāḻum oru vakip pūccikaḷāl uṇṭāvatu. iḵtu uṟutiyāṉatu. itu civappākavum ceṭi koṭikaḷākiya putar pōlavum iruppatu. iḵtu arumpāṭu paṭṭu veṭṭiyeṭukkappaṭum. iḵtu intiyāviṟku mēṟkil uḷḷa ilaṭcattīvukaḷ, mālattīvukaḷic cuṟṟilum, irāmēcuvarat tīvukku aṇmiyilum, pacupikkup peruṅkaṭalil uḷḷa tīvukaḷic cuṟṟilum, ātirēliyāviṟku vaṭakiḻakkilum vaṭa mēṟkilum naṭuttarik kaṭalilum cappāṉ kaṭalilum, ayarlāntukkarukilum kiṭikkiṟatu. naṭuttarik kaṭaliṟ kiṭikkum civanta pavaḷam mika uyarvāṉatu. iḵtu iraṇṭāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē vāṇikac ciṟappip peṟṟatu. tamiḻar ippavaḻattit tūymiyuṭiyateṉa matittaṉar. airōppiyar itikkoṇṭu nakikaḷic ceytaṉar; itu piḷḷikaḷit tīmiyiliruntu kākka vallateṉṟu nampiṉar; itaṉip piḷḷikaṭku aṇivittaṉar; iṉṟum aṇivikkiṉṟaṉar. ittāli, cīṉam, āppirikkā, teṉṉamerikkā, intiyā eṉṉum nāṭukaḷil peṇṭir pavaḷa mālikaḷi viruppattōṭu aṇikiṉṟaṉar.1
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa oṉpatu vaki maṇikaḷum avaṟṟiṉ vakiyum ki. mu. nāṉkām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ piṟpātiyil cantirakupta muriyaṉ kālattil (ki. pi. 325-301) vāḻnta kuṭilyarāl teḷivākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. cilappatikāra nikaḻcci ilaṅkik kayavāku maṉṉaṉ kālattil (ki. pi. 114-136) naṭipeṟṟatu. akkālattavarē iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷum ceṅkuṭṭuvaṉum. eṉavē, iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷ kālam ēṟattāḻak ki. pi. 114-36 eṉṉalām; aḵtāvatu, kuṭilyarukku ēṟattāḻa nāṉūṟu āṇṭukaḷ piṟpaṭṭatākalām.
avar pāṇṭiyaṉ talinakarāṉa pīṭu mikka māṭa maturiyiṉ kaṭitteruvil irunta navamaṇikaḷiyum avaṟṟiṉ akkāla vakikaḷiyum, kuṇaṅkaḷiyum kuṟṟaṅkaḷiyum aḻakuṟak kūṟiyuḷḷār. avar 1. vayiram, 2. marakatam, 3. māṇikkam, 4. puṭparākam, 5. vayiṭūriyam, 6. nīlam, 7. kōmētakam, 8. muttu, 9. pavaḷam ākiyavaṟṟi immuṟiyē kūṟiyuḷḷār. avar coṟkaḷik kīḻē kāṇka:
	kāka pātamum kaḷaṅkamum vintuvum
ēkiyum nīṅki iyalpiṟ kuṉṟā
nūlavar noṭinta nuḻinuṇ kōṭi
nālvaki varuṇattu nalaṅkōḻ oḷiyavum,
ēkiyum māliyim iruḷoṭu tuṟanta
pācār mēṉip pacuṅkatir oḷiyavum,
patumamum nīlamum vintamum paṭitamum
vitimuṟi piḻiyā viḷaṅkiya cātiyum,
pūca vuruvil polanteḷit taṉiyavum,
tītaṟu katiroḷit teṇmaṭ ṭuruvamum,
iruḷteḷit taṉiyavum, iruvē ṟuruvavum,
orumit tōṟṟattu aivēṟu vaṉappiṉ
ilaṅkukatil viṭūum nalaṅkeḻu maṇikaḷum,
kāṟṟiṉum maṇṇiṉum kalliṉum nīriṉum
tōṟṟiya kuṟṟam tukaḷaṟat tuṇintavum
cantira kuruvē aṅkā rakaṉeṉa
vanta nīrmiya vaṭṭat tokutiyum
karuppat tuḷiyavum kalliṭi muṭaṅkalum
tirukku nīṅkiya ceṅkoṭi valliyum,
			ūrkāṇ kāti, aṭi, 180-198
aṭiyārkku nallār ivvaṭikaṭkut teḷivāṉa viḷakkavuri tantuḷḷār.
cilappatikāram oruvaṉ varalāṟu kūṟum periya kāppiyam. atil nāṭu, nakaram, aṇikaḷ, kaṭitteru mutaliya ellāc ceytikaḷip paṟṟiyum virivākak kūṟa vāyppuṇṭu. attakiya vāyppu akapporuḷ paṟṟiya taṉippāṭalkaḷil illi. mēlum, akapporuṭ pāṭalkaḷ kuṟiñci, pāli, mulli, marutam, neytal eṉṉum nilaṅkaḷip paṟṟiyum annilamakkaḷiṉ ilvāḻkki paṟṟiyumē ciṟappākap pēcupavi; avi nakaravāḻvic cittirippavi alla. nakara vāḻvilē tāṉ nākarikam mikutiyākak kāṇappaṭum. aṅkutāṉ uṇavu, uṭi, aṇi mutaliyaṉa paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷ mikutiyākap pēcappaṭum.
aivaki nilaṅkaḷilum aṇikaḷ cila uṇṭu. āyiṉum, avaṟṟi virivākap pēcap pulavarkku vāyppilli; eṉavē, ciṟcila iṭaṅkaḷil cuṭṭic celvatik kāṇalām. avaṟṟuḷḷum oṉpatu maṇikaḷik kuṟikkum iṭaṅkaḷ mikac cilavēyākum. avaṟṟuṭcilavaṟṟik kīḻē kāṇka:
aiṅkuṟunūṟṟil nīlamaṇi (233), maṇippūṇ (232, 234) muttu (105, 185, 193, 195) eṉpaṉa kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
kuṟuntokiyil nīlam (86, 155), poṉṉoṭu maṇi miṭinaki (274), muttu (51, 104), pavaḻam ākiyavi pēcappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
naṟṟiṇiyil muttu (23) iṭam peṟṟuḷḷatu. kuṇṭalam, ūcal, elvaḷi, kāḻ, (kāñci allatu mēkali eṉṟa iṭiyaṇi) ākiya ivi kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa (66, 239, 286). ivi kaṟkaḷ patikkappeṟṟa nakikaḷāyirukkalām.
akanāṉūṟṟil pavaḻam (14, 243), nīlam (14, 304, 374), pavaḻac ceppu (25), tirumaṇi oḷirum pūṇ (32), muttu (108), nūliṟkōkkappeṟṟa muttumāli (289), palavaṭaṅkaḷik koṇṭa mēkali (385) eṉpavi kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
kalittokiyil muttu (4), mēkali (54), talikkōlam (54), nīlamaṇi māli, pala maṇikaḷ koṇṭa mūṉṟuvaṭam, pavaḻam (85) māṇikkak kaṟkaḷik koṇṭa muttuvaṭam ākiyavi kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. mēkaliyilum talikkōlattilum pala vaki maṇikaḷ patittal marapu.
paripāṭalil muttu vaṭam (6), pavaḻavaḷi (11), aḻal puṉi aviriḻi (irattiṉaṅkaḷ patitta) oḷi viḷaṅkum nakikaḷ (21), muttup paralkaḷ iṭappeṟṟa poṟ cilampu (21), mēkali (22) eṉpavi pēcappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
patiṟṟuppattil muttu māli (11) kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. kātaṇikaḷum kaḻuttaṇikaḷum piṟavum piṟa nūlkaḷil pēcappaṭṭavāṟē pēcappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avvaṇikaḷuḷ cilavō palavō maṇikaḷ patikkappeṟṟaṉa nakikaḷ ākalām eṉakkōṭal poruttamākum.
puṟanāṉūṟṟil naḷḷi eṉṟa vaḷḷaliṉ taliyil nīlamaṇi iruntatu; mārpil muttu vaṭam toṅkiyatu; kiyil kaṭakam iruntatu (150), viccikkō eṉṟa ciṟṟaracaṉ maṇikaḷ patitta vaḷinta nakiyi aṇintiruntāṉ (200). vīraṉ oruvaṉ pala vaki maṇikaḷ viraviya māliyit tarittiruntāṉ (291). puṟanāṉūṟṟil vayiram, pavaḻam (218), nīlam (56, 147), māṇikkam (172, 318), muttu (19), maṇiyāram (365) eṉpaṉa iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
caṅkakāla aṇikaḷiṉ, peyarkaḷi mikutiyākak kūṟattakum nūl cilappatikāramēyākum. atil mātavi aṇinta aṇikaḷ teḷivāyk kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟuṭpala, kal patitta nakikaḷēyākum. kaṇṇaki teyvattiṉ kātil vayirattōṭu iruntateṉṟu ceṅkuṭṭuvaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ (29:9). marakatamaṇiyuṭaṉ vayiram vittup patikkappeṟṟa palakimītu cempavaḷattūṇ niṟuttappaṭṭatu (5:149-150). oṉpatu maṇikaḷip paṟṟip pēcum cilappatikāram eḻunta kālattil ammaṇikaḷ tamiḻ aracar mutaliyōrit takkavāṟu aṇi ceytaṉa eṉpatil aiyamilli.
maṇimēkali eṉṉum maṟṟoru peruṅkāppiyattil nīlam (4:24), māṇikkam (2:72). pavaḻam (18:160), pavaḻattūṇ (17:45), muttu (4:100), muttu māli (1:49) eṉpaṉa iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
caṅkanūlkaḷip paṭikkumpōtu, pēraracar, ciṟṟaracar, celvar eṉpavarē immaṇikaḷip peritum payaṉpaṭuttiṉar eṉpatum, apperumakkaḷ pulavar, pāṇar, kūttar, viṟaliyar eṉṟa muttamiḻ vāṇarkkum, veṟṟi peṟṟa pōr vīrarkkum, tāṉittalivarkaḷukkum immaṇikaḷālāṉa aṇikalaṅkaḷip paricilāy vaḻaṅki makiḻntaṉar eṉpatum aṟiyappaṭum.
maṇikaḷ paṟṟi itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa ceytikaḷi uḷaṅkoṇṭu, pattuppāṭṭuḷ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa maṇikaḷip paṟṟiya ceytikaḷik kāṇpōm:
maṇikaḷ
nīlamaṇi pōlum pūviṉiyuṭiya kāyā
				(po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 201)
nīlamaṇi pōṉṟa ciccilippaṟavi
(ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 181)
nīlamaṇi pōṉṟa mayil tōki 				(   264)
eṉa ippattuppāṭṭuḷ pala iṭaṅkaḷil varum cāṉṟukaḷ nīlamaṇikaḷ iruntamiyi uṇarttukiṉṟaṉa.
 parūukkā ḻāram corinta muttamoṭu
poṉcuṭu neruppiṉ nilamuk keṉṉa
ammeṉ kurumpik kāypaṭuvu piṟavum
				(ma. kā. aṭi, 681-684).
mūṉṟām aṭiyiṉ īṟṟil uḷḷa `piṟavum eṉpataṟku nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `muttu oḻinta māṇikkamum marakatamum poṉṉum maṇikaḷum eṉap poruḷ kūṟiyuḷḷār. iṅku `maṇi eṉpatu nīlamaṇi pōlum!
3. `vaṭamalip piṟanta maṇiyum poṉṉum eṉpatu paṭṭiṉappāli aṭi (187). iṅku `maṇi-māṇikkam eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uriyākum.
naṉṉaṉuṭiya malināṭṭup poruḷkaḷuḷ `palavuṟu tirumaṇi oṉṟākum (mali, 516). `pala vili peṟṟa aḻakiya māṇikkam, eṉpatu uri.
māṇikkam oḻukiṉālotta oḷḷiya ceṅkaḻunīr māliyi maturi nakarac celvar aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 438-439).
4. avari pavaḻam pōlap pūttatu (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 164). pūmpukār nakarac celvamakaḷir pavaḻam pōlum niṟattiṉar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 148),
pavaḻattiṉ piṟappiṭam kīḻkkaṭalākum.
			(pa. māli, aṭi, 189)
pavaḻattiṟkut `tukir eṉṟum peyaruṇṭu.
			(pa. pāli, aṭi, 189)
1. pāṇṭiyaṉ taliyālaṅkāṉattuc ceru veṉṟa neṭuñceḻiyaṉ maṉiviyar, `ōṭṭaṟṟa poṉ naṭu aḻuttiṉa maṇikaḷic cūḻntu viḷaṅkukiṉṟa pēraṇi kalaṅkaḷi aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 704).
2. muttiṉum maṇiyiṉum poṉṉiṉum attuṇi
nērvaruṅ kuriya kalam (ku. pā. aṭi, 13-14)
eṉavarum aṭikaḷ, muttukaḷum maṇivakikaḷum koṇṭa nakikaḷ iruntamiyi uṇarttukiṉṟaṉa.
3. `poṉṉil aḻuttiṉa nīlamaṇi pōlac ciṟiya mutukiṭattut tāḻntu kiṭanta kariya kūntal eṉa oru kuṟippuk kuṟiñcip pāṭṭil (aṭi, 58-60) vantuḷḷatu.
maṇikaḷ patitta mōtiram (ma. kā. aṭi, 719) marakatamaṇikaḷ kōtta mēkali (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 329), maṇipparalkaḷiyuṭiya cilampukaḷ (ma. kā. aṭi, 441) pōṉṟa maṇikaḷāl āṉaviyum maṇikaḷ patittaviyum muṉṉark kūṟappaṭṭa aṇivakikaḷuḷ uḷḷaṉa eṉpatum iṅku aṟiyattakum, avi muṟpakutiyiṟ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa cāṉṟukaḷāl, caṅkakālat tamiḻar oṉpatu maṇikaḷuṭpala maṇikaḷi naṉku aṟintavar eṉpatum payaṉpaṭuttiṉavar eṉpatum teḷivātal kāṇalām.
piṟcērkki
piṟkālac cōḻappēraracaruḷ taliciṟantavaṉ mutalām irācarācaṉ. avaṉ kālattil (ki. pi. 985-1012) uṇṭākkappaṭṭa tañci irāca rācēccarattu ammaṉukkup pala nakikaḷ ceyyappaṭṭaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ peyarkaḷiyum avi evaṟṟāṟ ceyyappaṭṭaṉa eṉpatiyum iṅku aṟital nalamākum. inta aṟivu namakku iḻi, pūṇ, kalaṉ eṉpavaṟṟi oruvāṟ uṇarttalām. iccōḻar kāla nakikaḷ tiṭīreṉṟu cōḻarkālattil uṇṭāṉaviyalla. ivi caṅkakāla mutal vāḻiyaṭi vāḻiyāy iruntu vanta naki vakikaḷēyākalām.

23. maṇapporuḷkaḷ
malliki mulli mutaliya pala vaki malarkaḷ naṟumaṇam uḷḷavi. iṅṅaṉamē, cātikkāy, takkōlakkāy mutaliya cila kāykaḷum maṇamuḷḷavi. akil, cantaṉam eṉṉum maraṅkaḷiṉ kaṭṭikaḷum naṟumaṇam uḷḷavi. kattūri, puḻuku eṉpavi vilaṅkukaḷiliruntu kiṭikkum maṇapporuḷkaḷ, paṇṭittamiḻar immalarkaḷiyum, kāykaḷiyum, marakkaṭṭikaḷiyum, kattūri puḻuku eṉpavaṟṟiyum naṟumaṇattiṟkup payaṉpaṭuttiṉar eṉpatu pattuppāṭṭāl terikiṟatu. ivi paṟṟiya vivaraṅkaḷi iṅkuk kāṇpōm:
malarkaḷ
kuṟiñci nilamākiya malināṭṭil toṇṇūṟṟukku mēṟpaṭṭa malarkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷ kuṟiñcip pāṭṭiṟ kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. appeyarkaḷik kīḻē kāṇka:
kōṭaṟpū, āmpaṟpū, aṉiccappū, ceṅkaḻunīrppū, kuṟiñcippū, veṭcippū, ceṅkoṭu vērippū, tēmāmpū, cemmaṇippū, perumūṅkiṟpū, vilvappū, eṟuḻampū, marāmarappū, kūvirappū, vaṭavaṉappū, vākaṉappū, veṭpālippū, pañcāykkōri, veṇkākkaṇampū, karuviḷampū, payiṉippū, vāṉippū, kuravampū, paccilippū, makiḻampū, kāyāmpū, āvirampū, ciṟumūṅkiṟpū, cūrippū, ciṟupūḷi, kuṉṟippū, murukkili, marutappū, kōṅkampū, mañcāṭippū, tilakappū, pātirippū, ceruntippū, puṉalippū, caṇpakappū, nāṟu karanti, kāṭṭumallikippū, māmpū, tillippū, pālippū, (kalliṟpaṭarnta) mullippū, kañcaṅkullippū, piṭavampū, ceṅkaruṅkālippū, vāḻippū, vaḷḷippū, neytaṟpū, teṅkiṟpāḷi, cemmullippū, tāmarippū, ñāḻaṟpū, muvaṟpū, kokuṭippū, pavaḻamallikippū, cātippū, karuntāmakkoṭippū, veṇkōṭaṟpū, tāḻampū, curapuṉṉippū, kāñcippū, karuṅkuvaḷippū, ōmippū, maravampū, taṇakkampū, iṇṭampū, ilavampū, koṉṟippū, aṭumpampū, āttippū, avarippū, pakaṉṟippū, palācampū, acōkampū, vañcippū, piccippū, karunoccippū, tumpippū, tuḻāyppū, tōṉṟippū, nantiyāvaṭṭappū, naṟikkoṭi, puṉṉākappū, paruttippū, pīrkkampū, kurukkattippū, cantaṉappū, akiṟpū, puṉṉippū, nārattampū, nākappū, iruvāṭcippū, kuruntampū, vēṅkippū, maliyerukkampū, cempū.
immalarkaḷuḷ maliyiṟpūttavi cila; nilattiṟ pūttavi cila. kompukaḷiṟpūttavi cila; cuṉikaḷiṟ pūttavi cila. ivaṟṟiṉ niṟaṅkaḷum palavakip paṭṭavi.
tiṉikkollikaḷik kāttu vanta kuṟiñci nila makaḷir, immalarkaḷip paṟittu ivaṟṟiṉ puṟavitaḻkaḷi nīkkiviṭṭut tamakkuriya taḻikaḷi amittu aṇintu koṇṭaṉar; palaniṟa malarkaḷit toṭuttu mālikaḷāka aṇintu iṉpuṟṟaṉar (aṭi, 61-104).
cūraramakaḷir veṭcippūkkaḷi viṭupūvākat taliyiṟ tūvi avaṟṟiṟku naṭuvē kuvaḷi itaḻkaḷik kiḷḷiyiṭṭut taliyaṇikaḷi aṇintaṉar (tirumuruku. aṭi, 21-25). ceṅkaṭampiṉ malarkaḷ tēruruḷikaḷip pōṉṟa vaṭiviṉi uṭiyaṉa. murukaṉ ammalarkaḷālākiya māliyi aṇivāṉ (aṭi, 10-11).
murukaṉippōla vēlēnti veṟiyāṭṭayarnta vēlaṉ, cātikkāy, takkōlakkāy, kāṭṭu malliki malar, veṇṭāḷi malar ākiya ivaṟṟi viravik kaṭṭiya māliyta taliyil aṇintāṉ (aṭi, 190-193). kuraviyāṭiya kuṟamakaḷir itaḻ paṟittukkaṭṭiṉa māliyit taliyil aṇintiruntaṉar; kañcaṅkullip pūvik kūntalil aṇintiruntaṉar; iliyiyuṭiya naṟiya pūṅkottukaḷiyum cevviya kāliṉiyuṭi marāttiṭattaṉavākiya veḷḷiya kottu kaḷiyum iliyit taliyilē aṇinta kañcaṅkulli yiṉiyum toṭutta taḻiyuṭiyi iṭiyil aṇin tiruntaṉar (aṭi, 200-203).
mulli nilattil mulli, taḷavam, tōṉṟi, tēṟṟā, koṉṟi, kāyā eṉṉum malarkaḷ pūkkum. mulli nila makkaḷ immalarkaḷi virumpip payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 199-220). neytal nilattumakkaḷ neytaṟpūmāliyi aṇintārkaḷ (aṭi, 218-219). ōymāṉāṭṭiyāṇṭa nalliyakkōṭaṉ taḷir viraviṉa māliyi aṇintiruntāṉ (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 267-9). toṇṭi nāṭṭu umaṇar, taḻi viraviṉa māliyi aṇintiruntaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 60). tamiḻaracar, veṭci, karanti, vañci, kāñci, uḻiñi, nocci, tumpi, vāki eṉṉum pōrttuṟikaḷil īṭupaṭum poḻutu muṟiyē veṭci, karanti, vañci, kāñci, uḻiñi, nocci, tumpi, vāki malar mālikaḷic cūṭutal marapu (aṭi, 101-102). iṭimakaṉ kāṭṭu maraṅkaḷilum koṭikaḷilum malarnta pala pūkkaḷ kalantu neruṅkiya kalampakam ākiya māliyi aṇintiruntāṉ (aṭi, 172-4). uḻavar neytaṟpūkkaḷi allatu muḷḷip pūkkaḷit taṇṭāṉ kōri nārāṟkaṭṭi māliyāy aṇintaṉar (aṭi, 213-218).
teyvattiṉ muṉpu ceṉṟu kōvilil viricci kēṭpavar, mulli malarkaḷiyum nelliyum tūvutal vaḻakkam (mullippāṭṭu, aṭi, 8-11). maturi nakara vāḻvaraciyar iravu nēraṅkaḷil ceṅkaḻunīr māliyi aṇintiruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 550-551); parattiyar pala niṟap pūkkaḷi nerukkamākap puṉintu taliyiṟcūṭik koṇṭaṉar (aṭi, 566-568). pāṇṭi nāṭṭu iṭiyar kāntaṉ itaḻkaḷāṟkaṭṭiṉa kaṇṇiyi aṇintaṉar (neṭunal. aṭi, 5-6). maturiyil irunta milēccar (veḷi nāṭṭavar) taḻi viraviṉa māliyi aṇintaṉar (aṭi, 31-32).
kuṟiñcinilat talivaṉ palaniṟa malarkaḷit toṭuttut talimāliyāy aṇintukoḷṭāṉ; pitti malarkaḷit toṭuttu māliyāy aṇintukoṇṭāṉ; taṉ oru kātil acōkantaḷiric cerukikkoṇṭāṉ (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 114-120). kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattup paratavar piḷḷikaḷ maṇaliṟpaṭarnta aṭumpiṉ pūvit taliyiṟkaṭṭiṉārkaḷ; nīril niṉṟa āmpaṟpūvic cūṭiṉārkaḷ (pa. pāli, aṭi, 61-66); paratavar veṇṭāḷippūmāliyi aṇintaṉar; maṭaliyuṭiya tāmapūvic cūṭiṉar (aṭi, 84-88). kūttar marāmarattup pūkkaḷiyum `yā marattup pūkkaḷiyum taḷirkaḷōṭu nāriṟkaṭṭi māliyāy aṇintaṉar (malipaṭu. aṭi, 428-431). valiyar makaḷir, pakaṉṟippūvāṟ ceyta uṇṇiyi aṇintaṉar (aṭi, 459). maturik kaṭit tēruvil viṭupūkkaḷum malar mālikaḷum viṟkappaṭṭaṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 397-398). kōvil vaḻipāṭṭiṟkum pūkkaḷam mālikaḷum payaṉpaṭṭaṉa.
cuṇṇam-cāntu-puki
maturiyil navamaṇikaḷ, poṉ, cantaṉam, karuppūram mutaliyavaṟṟip puḻukilum paṉinīrilum naṉiya vittu iṭittuc cuṇṇam tayārikkappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 399). celvamakaḷir tamatu kūntalil naṟiya mayirccāntip pūciṉar; kattūriyiyum cantaṉattiyum arittup payaṉpaṭuttiṉar; tām uṭukka eṭutta kaliṅkaṅkaḷukku akiṟpukiyi ūṭṭiṉar (aṭi, 552-554). kuṟṟēval viṉiñar vaḷamaṉikaḷil cāntarikkum ammiyil kattūri mutaliya maṇapporuḷkaḷi iṭṭuc cāntāka arittaṉar. celva makaḷir accāntiṉip payaṉpaṭuttiṉar; cantaṉa viṟakil neruppi uṇṭākki atil akiloṭu veḷḷiya kaṇṭa carukkariyiyum kūṭṭip pukittaṉar. cantaṉakkal vaṭanāṭṭiliruntu koṇṭu vantu viṟakappaṭṭatu (neṭunal. aṭi, 49-56).
kuṟiñci nilattalivaṉ, taṉ taliyil kuḷirnta naṟiya mayirccānti maṇakkumpaṭi pūcikkoṇṭāṉ; piṉṉar akiṟpukiyi ūṭṭi ataṉi ularavittāṉ; piṉpu akiliṉ neyyi ataṟkup pūciṉāṉ; pala niṟaṅkaḷiyuṭiya malarkaḷit taṉ kuñciyiṟcūṭiṉāṉ (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 108-115).
muṭivuri
caṅkakālat tamiḻ makkaḷ malarkaḷiyum, koḻuntu ilikaḷiyum, cātikkāy pōṉṟa maṇamuḷḷa kāykaḷiyum payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ; kattūri, puḻuku, paṉinīr, cantaṉam, akil eṉpavaṟṟiyum payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ eṉṉum vivaraṅkaḷi itukāṟum kūṟiyavi koṇṭu aṟiyalām.
24. ilvāḻkki
aracar ilvāḻkki
tamiḻaracarāṉa cēra cōḻa pāṇṭiyar, tammuḷ peṇ koṭuttalum vāṅkalum uṇṭu; tam āṭcikku uṭpaṭṭa ciṟṟaracariṭam uṭpaṭāta ciṟṟaracariṭamum makaḷ koṇṭaṉar; vēḷāḷar talivarāṉa vēḷiriṭam peṇ koṇṭaṉar. uruvap paḵṟēr iḷañcēṭceṉṉi, aḻuntūr vēḷ makaḷi maṇantāṉ. avaṉ makaṉāṉa karikālaṉ, nāṅkūr vēḷiṉ makaḷi maṇantāṉ. (tol poruḷ. nūṟpā, 30, nac. uri). maṇimēkaliyiṉ kālattil vāḻnta neṭumuṭikkiḷḷi, pāṇa aracaṉ makaḷāṉa cīrtti eṉpavaḷi maṇantāṉ (maṇi mēkali, kāti, 19; aṭi, 51-55). karikālaṉ iṟantāṉ; avaṉ peṇṭir iḻi kaḷintaṉar (puṟam. 224) eṉpatāl, avaṉ palari maṇantāṉ eṉpatu terikiṟatu.
ivvāṟē pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉum maṉiviyar palari maṇantavaṉ eṉpatu, āytoṭi makaḷir naṟuntōḷ puṇarntu (ma. kā. aṭi, 712) eṉṉum māṅkuṭi marutaṉār vākkāl pulappaṭukiṟatu. avvaraca mātēviyar iḷaveyil tōṉṟiṉāṟpōlap puṇarcciyāṟpeṟṟa poliviṉi yuṭiyavar; pēraṇi kalaṅkaḷi aṇintavar; kaṟpu mēmpaṭap polivu peṟṟavar; mayil pōṉṟa cāyaliyuṭiyavar; māntaḷir mēṉiyar. pāṇṭiyaṉ ittakiya nalaṅkaḷip peṟṟa aracamātēviyaruṭaṉ ilvāḻkki naṭattiṉāṉ. avaṉatu kaṭṭilic cuṟṟilum maṇamikunta mālikaḷ toṅkaviṭap paṭṭiruntaṉa. (aṭi, 713, uri).
avaṉ kāliyil eḻuntu kālikkaṭaṉkaḷi muṭittu, nīrāṭi, iṟivaḻipāṭu ceytāṉ; maṉiviyar uṭaṉiruntu utava āṭiyaṇikaḷi aṇintāṉ; piṉpu nāḷōlakka maṇṭapam ceṉṟu araciyal aluvalkaḷik kavaṉittāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 702-724).
aracaṉ maṉiviyaruḷ mutal maṉivi kōpperuntēvi eṉappaṭṭāḷ. avaḷē aracaṉuṭaṉ kolu vīṟṟiruttal marapu. avaḷukkuc cevilittāyarum cēṭiyarum iruntaṉar (neṭunal. 151-3). aracaṉukku arukil iruntu matuvip poṟ kiṇṇattil vārttutara aḻakiya paṇippeṇṭir iruntaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 779-781).
maṉṉaṉ pōr mutaliyavaṟṟikkākat taṉṉip pirintu ceṉṟa pōtu mātēvi avaṉ pirivāl uṇṭāṉa tuyari aṭakkikkoṇṭu araṇmaṉiyuḷ iruttal mulli oḻukkam (kaṟpuṭiya maṉiviyiṉ oḻukkam) eṉappaṭṭatu. pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ maṉivi, kaṇavaṉ irunta pōtu pūttoḻil aminta tukili uṭuttāḷ; avaṉ illāta pōtu ēṟpaṭṭa kavaliyāl, nūlāṟceyta puṭaviyi aṇintiruntāḷ; nakikaḷi aṇiyavilli. cevilittāyarum cēṭiyarum avaḷukku aṭikkaṭi āṟutal moḻikaḷik kūṟiṉar. āyiṉum, kōpperuntēviyiṉ maṉakkavali kuṟiyavilli. avaḷ taṉ tantakkaṭṭiliṉ mēṟkūriyil tīṭṭappaṭṭirunta ōviyattip pārttāḷ; cantiraṉi viṭṭup piriyāta urōkiṇiyākiya viṇmīṉi avvōviyattiṟkaṇṭāḷ; tāṉ atu pōlat taṉ kaṇavaṉōṭu eṉṟum cērntirukka iyalavilliyē eṉṟu eṇṇip perumūccu viṭṭāḷ (neṭunal. aṭi, 145-163).
pāṇṭimātēvi taṉ kaṇavaṉāṉa pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ enta aḷavu uṇmiyaṉpuṭaṉ nēcittāḷ eṉpatu mēṟkūṟappaṭṭa ceytiyiliruntu naṉkaṟiyalāmaṉṟō? iḵtu avartam ilvāḻkkic ciṟappiṉi naṉku eṭuttukkāṭṭuvatākum.
maṉṉaṉāṉa kaṇavaṉ eppoḻutu varuvāṉ eṉpati aṟiya araṇmaṉi mutupeṇṭir nellum mullimalarum eṭuttuc ceṉṟu kōvilil tūvi, naṟcol kēṭṭu niṉṟaṉar. avvamayam āy makaḷ, tāyip pirinta kaṉṟukaḷi nōkki, iṉṉē varukuvar num tāyar, eṉṟu kūṟiṉāḷ. ataṉi naṟcollākak koṇṭa mutupeṇṭir, aracamātēviyiṭam ataṉit terivittu, makiḻntaṉar (mu. pā. aṭi, 8-20). paṇippoṇṭir aracamātēviyiṉ aṭiyi varuṭi avaḷi uṟaṅkuvittaṉar (neṭunal. aṭi, 151).
nalliyakkōṭaṉic cevvari poruntiṉa miyuṇṭa kaṇṇiṉiyuṭiya avaṉ maṉiviyar pukaḻntu pēciṉar. avar uḷamārap pukaḻntu pēcumaḷaviṟku avaṉ uṇmik kaṇavaṉāy naṭantukoṇṭāṉ eṉpatu itaṉāṟpulaṉākum (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 215).
pōrukkup pirinta kaṇavaṉ pirivāl tuṉpuṟṟu vāṭiya talivi, tuyil tuṟantāḷ; tuyar uḻantāḷ; ampu paṭṭa mayil pōla naṭuṅkiṉāḷ. uṭal melivāl iḻi nekiḻntatu; iṅṅaṉam eḻunili māṭattil kaṇavaṉ varavi etirnōkki vaṭikkiṭantāḷ (mu. pā. aṭi, 80-88).
ittakiya aracamātēviyar tam kaṇavariṭam mikka aṉpukoṇṭaṭiruntaṉar eṉpatik kūṟavum vēṇṭumō? ivarkaḷip pōlavē ammaṉṉarkaḷum taṅkaḷ maṉiviyari mika virumpiyatālētāṉ pōr muṭintatum avarkaḷi nōkki virintārkaḷ. ivaṟṟikkoṇṭu avarkaḷatu ilvāḻkkic ciṟappiṉi iṉitiṉ uṇaralām.
karikālaṉ mārpiṉmītu avaṉuṭiya piḷḷikaḷ viḷiyāṭi avaṉ mārpiṟpūciyirunta cantaṉattik kalittu viṭṭaṉa. avaṉ maṉiviyar avaṉatu mārpit taḻuviyataṉāl avaṉ mārpiṟpūciyirunta cantaṉam aḻintuviṭṭatu (pa. pāli. aṭi, 295-7). ivviru nikaḻccikaḷālum karikālaṉatu ilvāḻkkic ciṟappiṉi naṉkaṟiyalām.
antaṇar ilvāḻkki
toṇṭi nāṭṭuk kaṭaṟṟuṟippaṭṭiṉattiṟku aṇmiyil maṟiyavar uṟipati iruntatu. appatiyil maṟiyil valla antaṇar vāḻntaṉar. avarkaḷ illaṅkaḷ tūymiyāy iruntaṉa. ammaṟiyavar maṉiviyar aruntatiyaṉṉa kaṟpiṉar; nalla tōṟṟattiyuṭiyavar; vaḷiyali aṇintavar; kaṇavaṉmār ākuti ceytaṟku ēṟṟa `irācāṉṉam7 eṉpatit tayārittaṉar; tām tamakkeṉṟu tayāritta uṇavupporuḷkaḷi pāṇar mutaliya viruntiṉarkkum uvappōṭu paṭittaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 297-310). ammakaḷir `aruntatiyaṉṉa kaṟpiṉar eṉpatiliruntē avarkaḷatu illaṟac ciṟappi eḷitil uṇaralām. ilvāḻkki kaṭamikaḷuṭciṟantatu viruntōmpal. ammakaḷir atilum ciṟantu viḷaṅkiṉar.
vaṇikar ilvāḻkki
uppu vaṇikar tam maṉivi makkaḷuṭaṉē uppu vaṇṭikaḷiṟceṉṟu uppu vāṇikam ceytaṉar. uppu vaṇikaṉ maṉiviyē uppu vaṇṭiyi ōṭṭiṉāḷ. vaṇikaṉ tuṇi erutukaḷi ōṭṭikkoṇṭu vaṇṭikkuppiṉ ceṉṟāṉ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 58-65).
ittakiya pirayāṇa vāḻkkiyilum avarkaḷ illaṟam ciṟantiruntatu eṉpati, maṉivi vaṇṭi ōṭṭiṉāḷ eṉpatiliruntē iṉituṇaralām.
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattu vaṇikar, tēvarkaḷi vaḻipaṭṭaṉar; vēḷvikaḷ ceytu avaṟṟāl āvutikaḷit tēvar nukarac ceytaṉar; pacukkaḷiyum erutukaḷiyum pātukāttaṉar; antaṇarkku uṇṭākum pukaḻkaḷi nilipeṟacceytaṉar; periya puṇṇiyaṅkaḷic ceytaṉar; avaṟṟic ceyyamāṭṭātārkkut tāṉam paṇṇiṉar. `avarkaḷ kuḷirnta aruḷuṭaṉē vāḻum il vāḻkkiyi uṭiyavarkaḷ; naṉṉeñciṉarkaḷ, eṉṟu avarkaḷi māṅkuṭi marutaṉār pārāṭṭiyuḷḷār (ma. kā. aṭi, 200-207).
kaḷavu-kaṟpu
maliyum malicārnta iṭamumākiya kuṟiñci nilattil kāṉavar makaḷir tiṉippuṉattik kāval kāppatu vaḻakkam. ammakaḷir pūppaṟittu viḷiyāṭuvar; cuṉiyil kutittu nīrāṭuvar. aṅkut tiṭīreṉat tōṉṟiya iḷiñaṉ kāṉavar makaḷiruḷ taliviyāyiṉāḷ virumpiya malarkaḷip paṟittut taruvāṉ; allatu cuṉinīriliruntu tavikkum avaḷik kari cērttuk kāppāṉ; allatu mataṅkoṇṭa yāṉiyiṉ tākkutaliliruntu avaḷik kāppāṉ. iṅṅaṉam taṉakku utavi ceyta talivaṉit talivi virumpuvāḷ. aṉṟu mutal avarkaḷiṭiyē kātal vāḻvu toṭaṅkum. ivvāḻvukkut taliviyiṉ uyirttōḻi uṟṟa tuṇiyāvāḷ. talivaṉ taliviyip palar aṟiya maṇappatāka vākkaḷippāṉ.
talivaṉ cila nāḷ vari vārāmiyāl, talivi kavaliyāl melivāḷ. uṇmik kāraṇatti uṇarāta cevilittāyum naṟṟāyum cēriyiṉ mutupeṇṭākiya kuṟi colpavaḷi vīṭṭil aḻittu vantu, muṟattil piṭi nelliyiṭṭu, etiril talimakaḷi niṟuttuvar. uṭaṉē teyvattiṟku vaḻipāṭu ceyyappaṭum. kuṟi colpavaḷ appiṭi nelli nannāṉkāka eṇṇi eñciyavi oṉṟu, iraṇṭu, mūṉṟu aḷavum murukaṉāl nērnta kuṟi eṉṟum, nāṉkāyiṉ, vēṟoru nōy eṉṟum kūṟuvāḷ. iḵtu oru vakik kuṟiyākum. itu `kaṭṭuk kēṭṭal eṉappaṭum (naṟṟiṇi, cey. 288). aṭuttapaṭi kaḻaṅku pārttal naṭipeṟum. vēlaṉ eṉpavaṉ murukaṉippōla vēṭampūṇṭu āṭum malināṭṭup pūcāri. avaṉ vīṭṭiṉ ōriṭattil murukaṉi eḻuntaruḷac ceytu, akkaṭavuḷ muṉ kaḻaṟṟik kāykaḷi iṭuvāṉ. avaṉ taṉ taliyil īṭi aṇintiruppāṉ; pala kaṇukkaḷiyuṭiya kōli ēntiyiruppāṉ; akkaṇukkaḷil ciṟu pikaḷik kaṭṭiyiruppāṉ. avaṉ akkōlāl kaḻaṟcikkāykaḷi vāriyeṭukkum pōtu avaṉ uḷḷattiṟpaṭṭatik kuṟiyākak kūṟuvāṉ. itu `kaḻaṅku pārttal eṉappaṭum (naṟṟiṇi, cey. 47).
ivviruvakic cōtaṉikaḷiyayum nikaḻttiya piṟakum taliviyiṉ uṭal iḷipput tīrāmiyiṉ, ceviliyum naṟṟāyum ceyvaki aṟiyātu varuntuvar. avvamayam tōḻi taṉ tāyāṉa ceviliyiṭam, aṉṉāy, muttālum poṉṉālum māṇikkattatālum ceyyappaṭṭa pūṇkaḷ keṭumāyiṉ, piṉṉum avaṟṟip poruttac ceyyalām. āyiṉ, oruvaruṭiya kuṇaṅkaḷiṉ amitiyum mēmpāṭum oḻukkamum paḻiya taṉmi keṭiṉ, akkēṭṭi nīkki avaṟṟi muṉpu pōla niṟuttutal teyva iruṭikaṭkum iyaluvataṉṟu.
eṉ tantiyatu ariya kāvalik kaṭantu yāṉum talivaṉum perumiyum uraṉum accamum nāṇamum nuṇukiya niliyāṟpiṟanta maṉṟal (kātal maṇam) paṟṟi nam yāykku aṟivuṟuttalāl namakkup pukaḻēyaṉṟip paḻiyilli. iṅṅaṉam aṟattoṭu niṉṟa piṉpu talivarkkē nammi maṇam ceytu koṭāviṭiṉum, nām uyir pōmaḷavum ivvaruttattip poṟuttirukka, namakku maṟu piṟappiṉum ikkūṭṭam kūṭuva toṉṟāyiruntatu, eṉṟu talivi eṉṉiṭam moḻintāḷ, eṉṟu kūṟit talivi talivaṉic cantitta cūḻniliyiyum kātal vaḷarnta niliyiyum eṭutturippāḷ (ku. pā. aṭi, 1-26).
cevili itaṉi naṟṟāykku urippāḷ. naṟṟāy taṉ kaṇavaṉukkum piḷḷikaḷukkum urippāḷ. makaḷ viruppappaṭi tirumaṇam naṭipeṟum.
talivaṉ, talivi, tōḻi, pāṅkaṉ eṉṉum nālvarkku maṭṭum terintirukkum variyil itu kaḷavu maṇam eṉappaṭum. palar aṟiya maṇam nikaḻntu talivaṉum taliviyum maṇavāḻkki naṭattutal kaṟpu maṇam eṉap peyar peṟum. kaḷavu maṇanikaḻccikaḷum kuṟamakaḷir ceyalkaḷum kuṟiñcippāṭṭil aḻakuṟak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
ikkaḷavu maṇam maṉita camutāyattiṉ paṇṭiya maṇamuṟiyik kūṟuvatākum. caṅkakālattu ovvōr iḷiñaṉum peṇṇum kaḷavumaṇam nikaḻttiya piṉpē kātal maṇam ceytukoṇṭaṉar eṉak karututal tavaṟu. kaḷavu maṇattiṟku nakaraṅkaḷil vacatiyilli; kirāmaṅkaḷilum peruvaḻakkil iruntateṉṟu kūṟa iyalātu. tamiḻc camutāyattiṉ toṉmi vāynta maṇamuṟiyi aṭippaṭi yākakkoṇṭu caṅkakālap pulavarkaḷ taṅkaḷ kālattil iruntatiyum illātatiyum cērttu akappāṭalkaḷic ceytaṉar eṉṟu kōṭalē aṟiviṟkum ārāyccikkum poruttamākum. itaṉālētāṉ tolkāppiyar,
nāṭaka vaḻakkiṉum ulakiyal vaḻakkiṉum
pāṭal cāṉṟa pulaṉeṟi vaḻakkam
eṉṟu itaṉik kūṟalāyiṉar (tol. poruḷ. nūṟpā, 53).
kalivāṇar ilvāḻkki
pāṇaṉ, icikkaruvikaḷi icittup pāṭupavaṉ. avaṉ maṉiviyāṉa viṟali, āṭal pāṭalkaḷil tērntavaḷ. avaḷ ciṟanta aḻaki; `mulli cāṉṟa kaṟpiṉ melliyal (ci. a. paṭi, aṭi, 30). avaḷ taṉ kaṇavaṉuṭaṉ kāṭum maliyum kaṭantu ceṉṟu, vaḷḷalkaḷik kaṇṭu, naṭaṉamāṭiṉāḷ; pāṇaṉ icik karuvikaḷi icittup pāṭiṉāṉ. iruvarum vaḷḷalkaḷ pāl iyinta paricil peṟṟu vāḻkkiyi naṭattiṉar. pāṇar, kūttar, viṟaliyar, porur vāḻkki kali vāḻkki yākum. kaṇavaṉum maṉiviyum oṟṟumiyāy iruntu viḻākkaḷilum tam kalittiṟaṉik kāṭṭip poruḷ peṟṟaṉar (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 1-2). avarkaḷ ilvāḻkki nēriya muṟiyil naṭipeṟṟatālētāṉ avarkaḷāl ici, naṭaṉam, nāṭakam eṉṉum kalikaḷ caṅka kālattil naṉku vaḷarkkappaṭṭaṉa.
pērūrkaḷil celvar maṉikaḷil cevilittāyar iruntu piḷḷikaḷi vaḷarttaṉar; piḷḷikaḷic ciṟutēr uruṭṭi viḷiyāṭac ceytaṉar; amaḷiyil uṟaṅkac ceytaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 247-253).
maturi makkaḷ ilvāḻkki
pīṭumikka māṭamaturiyil mālikkālattil kōvilkaḷil vaḻipāṭu naṭipeṟṟatu. māṭamakaḷir tam maṉikaḷiṉ nilāmuṟṟaṅkaḷil iruntapaṭiyē teyvaṅkaḷi vaṇaṅkiṉar. illakkiḻattiyar cilar tam kaṇavari aḻittuk koṇṭum tāmarip pūvip piṭittāṟpōlat tam piḷḷikaḷi eṭuttukkoṇṭum pūcikku vēṇṭum pū, tūpaṅkaḷ ākiyavaṟṟi eṭuttuk koṇṭum peṟattap paḷḷiyi aṭintaṉar; cilar antaṇar paḷḷiyi aṭintaṉar; vēṟu cilar camaṇap paḷḷiyi aṭintu aṟavuri kēṭṭaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 444-488).
kulamakaḷir, palar, anti nērattil naṟiya ceṅkaḻunīr malarkaḷi māliyākakkaṭṭiṉar; tam kūntalukku mayirc cāntiṉi arittup pūciṉar; piṉpu accāntu pōkumpaṭi kūntali alittuk kaḻuvi nīrāṭiṉar; melliya nūlāṟceyta kaliṅkattiṟku maṇakkum akiṟ pukiyi ūṭṭiṉar; cantaṉattiyum kattūriyiyum arittu mārpiṟ pūcikkoṇṭaṉar; aṇikaḷi aṇintaṉar; neṭiya oḷiyittarum viḷakkiṉi ēṟṟiṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 550-6).
piḷḷi peṟṟa tāyar ciṟitu kālam vaḷiyali aṇiyār (malipaṭu. aṭi, 253). makaḷir tam kaṟpiṉ mikuti pōṉṟa mulli malarkaḷic cūṭutal iyalpu (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 28-30).
piḷḷikaḷ pēy mutaliyavaṟṟāl paṟṟappaṭātirukka vīṭṭil vēppiliyik kaṭṭutal marapu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 59).
maṉiviyar tam kaṇavar maṉamakiḻap piḷḷikaḷip peṟṟu nakilkaḷil pāl curappataṟkākak kuḷattu nīril nīrāṭiṉar; mutaṟcūl koṇṭa makaḷir iṭukkaṇ iṉṟip putalvarip payattal vēṇṭum eṉṟu teyvattip paravik kuṟi tīrntaṉar. mikka cuṟṟattāruṭaṉ celvattiyuṭiya maṉi makaḷir yāḻeṭuttuc cevvaḻi eṉṉum paṇṇi vācittaṉar. cēri maṉṟukaḷil murukaṉi niṉintu āṭavarum peṇṭirum kuravik kūttāṭiṉar (ma. kā. ṭi, 609-615). kulamakaḷir viḷakkēṟṟi nelliyum malariyum tūvi illuṟi teyvatti vaṇaṅkiṉar (neṭunal. aṭi, 43).
mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa ceytikaḷ aṉittum maturi makkaḷiṉ ciṟanta ilvāḻkkiyip paṭam piṭittuk kāṭṭuvaṉavākum.
kiṇi makaṉ ilvāḻkki
kiṇi vācippavaṉ vaṟiyavaṉ. avaṉ maṉivi paciyāl varuntiṉāḷ; camikka uṇavupporuḷkaḷ illi. ataṉāl avaḷ kuppik kīriyit taṉ nakaṅkaḷāl kiḷḷiṉāḷ; vīṭṭil uppiṉmiyāl, ataṉi uppiṉṟiyē vēkavittāḷ; ataṉit taṉ vīṭṭār uṇpati veḷiyār pārttāl iḻivākak karutuvar eṉṟa eṇṇattāl, vīṭṭuk katavit tāḻiṭṭāḷ; piṉpu taṉ viṭṭāruṭaṉ tāṉum iruntu uṇṭāḷ eṉṟu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi ceppukiṟatu (aṭi, 136-139). uḷḷatik koṇṭu uvappuṭaṉ kuṭumpam naṭattuvatē ilvāḻkkikku aḻaku eṉpati inta nikaḻcci uṇarttukiṟataṉṟō?
viruntaḷikkum paṇpu
ilvāḻkki naṭattum kaṇavaṉum maṉiviyum tam uṟṟār uṟaviṉarik kākkak kaṭamippaṭṭavar; avaruṭaṉ nillātu, tam illam nāṭi varum piṟariyum uṇṭiyālum uṟiyuḷālum upacarittal avartam kaṭami eṉṟu aṟanūlkaḷ aṟikiṉṟaṉa. ippaṇiyik kaṇavaṉ allatu maṉivi maṭṭum virumpic ceytal iyalātu; iruvarum maṉam oṉṟupaṭṭālē ceytal iyalum. iruvaruḷ oruvar māṟupaṭiṉum viruntu naṉmuṟiyil naṭipeṟātu. eṉavē, viruntu pōṟṟum kaṇavaṉum maṉiviyum otta uṇarcciyuṭiyavarāyiruttal iṉṟiyamiyātatu. ākavē, viruntu naṭipeṟum illattil uḷḷa kaṇavaṉum maṉiviyum maṉam ottu vāḻkiṉṟaṉar eṉpatu karuttākum. aḵtāvatu, avarkaḷatu ilvāḻkki cemmiyuṟa naṭipeṟukiṉṟatu eṉpatu poruḷākum.
tam uṟṟār uṟaviṉariyē aṉṟip pulavar, pāṇar, porunar, kūttar, viṟaliyar pōṉṟa kalivāṇariyum varavēṟṟu uṇṭiyum uṟiyuḷum tantu upacarittalic caṅkakālat tamiḻ makkaḷ taṅkaḷ ciṟanta kaṭamiyākak karutiṉārkaḷ eṉpati āṟṟuppaṭi nūlkaḷ meyppikkiṉṟaṉa. kuṟiñci, pāli, mulli, marutam, neytal ākiya aintu nilaṅkaḷil vāḻnta eḷiyarum celvarum pērūr makkaḷum ciṟṟaracarum pēraracarum pāṇar mutaliyōri iṉmukattuṭaṉ varavēṟṟu uṇṭiyum uṟiyuḷum vaḻaṅkiṉar; maliyik kāval kātta vīrarkaḷ, karuppañcāliyil paṇipurintavar. neṟkaḷaṅkaḷil vēli ceytu vanta uḻavar pōṉṟārum paḻaṅkaḷ, karuppañ cāṟu, uṇavu pōṉṟavaṟṟi maṉamuvantu utaviṉami koṇṭu, avartam viruntu pōṟṟum cīriya paṇpiṉ uyarviṉi nām naṉkuṇaralām.
iṅṅaṉam viruntiṉari upacarittavar paṭṭiyalik kīḻē kāṇka:
