ivaruṭperumpālār eḷiya vāḻkki vāḻntaṉar; poruḷ vacatiyaṟṟavar; vaṟiya eyiṉar; pullariciyit tokuttavar. attakiyavarum makiḻcciyōṭu viruntiṉari varavēṟṟu upacarittaṉar eṉpatu viyappukkuriyatākum. iḵtu avartam ilvāḻkkic ciṟappiṉi eṭutturikkum cāṉṟākum.
ōymāṉāṭṭu uḻavar taṅki, pāṇar mutaliyōrit taṉ piḷḷikaḷik koṇṭu uṟavu muṟi kūṟi, avar pōkkit taṭuttu upacarittu uṇavu paṭittāḷ (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 190-5). naṉṉaṉatu maliyaṭivārattil irunta kāṉavar ciṟu kuṭiciyil ovvoru vīṭṭuk kuṟamakaḷum kūttarit taṉ piḷḷikaḷik koṇṭu uṟavu muṟi kūṟit taṭuttu uṇavu vaḻaṅkiṉāḷ (malipaṭu. aṭi, 182-5). uḻavar taṅkikkum kuṟamakaḷirkkum viruntu pēṇutalil irunta aḷavaṟṟa ārvattik kāṇka!
muṉpu kūṟiyāṅkuk kaṇavaṉum maṉiviyum ciṟanta maṉavoṟṟumiyōṭu vāḻāviṭil, vaṟiyavarāṉa eyiṉar, kōvalar, valiyar pōṉṟār viruntiṉarittam illattil varavēṟṟu viruntaḷittu upacarittal iyalāta ceyalākum. mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa tamiḻakattup pala nilamakkaḷum mikka makiḻcciyōṭum uḷḷa niṟivōṭum pāṇar mutaliyōri uṇṭiyālum uṟiyuḷālum upacaritta ceyal, avartam illaṟavāḻkkic ciṟappiṉic cīriya muṟiyil eṭuttiyampuvatākum.
25. viḷiyāṭṭukaḷ
kuṟuntoki, naṟṟiṇi, akanāṉūṟu, kalit toki eṉṉum akapporuḷ nūlkaḷil makaḷir viḷiyāṭṭukaḷ palavum mintar viḷiyāṭṭukaḷ cilavum iṭampeṟa vacatiyuṇṭu. pattuppāṭṭuḷ aintu pāṭalkaḷ āṟṟuppaṭiyi nōkkamākak koṇṭavi; mullip pāṭṭum neṭunalvāṭiyum pōrip paṟṟiyavi. maturikkāñciyum paṭṭiṉappāliyum nakaracciṟappiṉi mikutiyākak kūṟuvaṉa. kuṟiñcippāṭṭu oṉṟē muḻumiyum akapporuḷip paṟṟiyatu. eṉavē, ippāṭalkaḷuḷ viḷiyāṭṭukaḷip paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ cilavē kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. mutaṟkaṇ kuṟuntoki mutaliya nūlkaḷil kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷa viḷiyāṭṭukaḷi iṅku aṟivōm.
kuṟuntokiyil viḷiyāṭṭukaḷ
peṇṭiruṭcilar pūntātukaḷikkoṇṭu pāvi ceytu viḷiyāṭiṉar. ivvāṟu viḷiyāṭiya ciṟumiyar kūṭṭam `ōra āyam eṉappaṭṭatu (48, 278). pañcāyk kōriyiṉāṟceyta pāviyic ciṟumi, taṉ makaveṉak karuti viḷiyāṭiṉāḷ (114); neytal nilap peṇṭir, uppaṅkaḻikku arukil malarnta malarkaḷip paṟittu viḷiyāṭiṉar; kaṭal aliyiṉkaṇ viḷiyāṭiṉar (144); pāvikkup pala vaki oppaṉi ceytu viḷiyāṭiṉar (195).
naṟṟiṇiyil viḷiyāṭṭukaḷ
pāli nilacciṟuvar kaṭṭaḷikkal pōṉṟa araṅki vaṭṭiṉāl kīṟi, nellikkāyi vaṭṭākak koṇṭu pāṇṭil āṭiṉar (3). celvar vīṭṭuc ciṟuvar, ciṟiya paṟi oṉṟit tōḷil māṭṭiyiruntaṉar. ataṉ kaṇṇil kuruvi eḻutappaṭṭiruntatu. avarkaḷ ciṟiya kōlikkoṇṭu akkuruviyi aṭittu ōcippaṭuttiṉar (58). peṇkaḷ pañcāyk kōriyiṉāl pāvi ceytu viḷiyāṭiṉar (68); āṟṟu niril viḷiyāṭiṉar (68); paṉi nāriṉālē tiritta kayiṟṟi marakkiḷiyil piṇittut toṅkaviṭṭa ūñcalil āṭiṉar (90); vēṅki marakkiḷiyil kayiṟṟiṉāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa ūñcalil āṭiṉar (222, 368). ciṟumiyar, ciṟṟil amittu viḷiyāṭiṉar (123). acciṟumiyar pañcāyk kōriyik koṇṭu ceyta pāvi `īṉāppāvi (127) eṉappaṭṭatu; vaṇṭal maṇṇikkoṇṭu iḻitta pāvi `vaṇṭaṟ pāvi eṉappaṭṭatu (191). makaḷir kippantum kāṟpantum viḷiyāṭiṉar (104, 324). ciṟuvar, tēr uruṭṭi viḷiyāṭiṉar (250).
kalittokiyil viḷiyāṭṭukaḷ
ciṟumiyar ciṟṟil iḻittaṉar; varippantu āṭiṉar (51, 57); marappāṉiyum marappāviyum vittu viḷiyāṭiṉar (59); `kuḻamakaṉ eṉṟa oruvaki marappāviyi vittum viḷiyāṭiṉar (66). iṅṅaṉam viḷiyāṭiya ciṟumiyar, `ōri makaḷir eṉappaṭṭaṉar (75). ōri eṉpatu makaḷir viḷiyāṭṭu. icciṟumiyar taṇṭāṉ kōriyip paṟittuk kiḻittup pāviyākkiyum viḷiyāṭiṉar (76). ciṟur marayāṉiyi vittu viḷiyāṭiṉar (80). celvacciṟuvar, periya maṇikaḷ patitta ciṟiya tēril irukka, cēṭiyar attēri iḻuttuc ceṉṟaṉar (83). ēḻicciṟuvar paṉaṅ kurumpiyik koṭiyāṟkaṭṭi iḻuttu viḷiyāṭiṉar (83). mulli nilac ciṟumiyar pākaṟkoṭiyum mullik koṭiyum paṭarnta tōṭṭattil ciṟṟil iḻittu viḷiyāṭiṉar (111). ammakaḷir piṭavam, taḷavam, tōṉṟi, koṉṟi mutaliya malarkaḷik koṇṭu taḻiyum pāviyum ceytu viḷiyāṭiṉar (102); mullippūvum tam kūntaliṟcūṭik kāṭṭāṟṟu maṇal niṟinta kuḷirnta cōliyil viḷiyāṭiṉar (113). kuṟiñci nilappeṇ ūcalāṭiṉāḷ (37). neytal nilacciṟumi cuṟāmīṉ kompāl ceyta palakiyil tāḻiyiṉ viḻutāl tiritta kayiṟu kōtta ūñcalil āṭiṉāḷ (113).
pattuppāṭṭil viḷiyāṭṭukaḷ
iḷamakaḷir pāvi ceytu viḷiyāṭiṉar; nūlāl varintu puṉiyappaṭṭa panti eṟintum aṭittum viḷiyāṭiṉar (tirumuruku. aṭi, 68). cōḻa nāṭṭu uḻavar makaḷir, neytal nilattu maṇaṟkuṉṟukaḷil vaṇṭal iḻittu viḷiyāṭiṉar (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 187). vaṇṭal-maṇaṟciṟṟil. toṇṭi nāṭṭu marutanilap pērūrkaḷil ciṟuvar piṟarāl ēṟappaṭāta ciṟiya tērkaḷi uruṭṭi viḷiyāṭiṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 248-249). toṇṭi nāṭṭut tuṟimuka nakarattuc celvac ciṟumiyar tamatu vaḷamaṉiyiṉ mēl māṭattil nūliṉāl varintu kaṭṭappaṭṭa panti aṭittu viḷiyāṭiṉar (aṭi, 331-333). veṇmaṇalilē amarntu poṉṉāl ceyta kaḻalikkoṇṭu viḷiyāṭiṉar (aṭi, 334-5). kuṭṭaṅkaḷil nīrāṭuvōr tam kiyi mēlē kūppi muḻuki nīriṉ āḻattik kāṭṭutal marapu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 272-3).
maturi mānakaril ñāyiṟu maṟinta piṉpu mutal yāmattil vīrar cilar pōrppayiṟci koṇṭa yāṉiyit tammit toṭarntu vantu piṭikkumpaṭi ēviṉar. atu tammip piṉ toṭarnta pōtu ataṉ pōkkit taṭukkat tam maṭiyilirunta kappaṇaṅkaḷit tariyil citaṟiviṭṭaṉar. `kappaṇam eṉpatu. āṉi neruñci muḷ pōla irumpāl ceyyappaṭṭa karuvi. yāṉi avaṟṟi mitikka añci niṉṟuviṭṭatu. iḵtu akkāla vīrarkaṭku oru viḷiyāṭṭāy iruntatu. (ma. kā. aṭi, 594-599).
kuṟiñci nilamakaḷir cuṉiyil nīrāṭiṉar; mali aruvikaḷil viḷiyāṭiṉar; tam maṉattukku viruppamāṉa vaṟṟip pāṭikkoṇṭē kūntali ulartiṉar; kōṭaṟpū, āmpaṟpū, kuṟiñcippū, mutaliya toṇṇūṟṟukku mēṟpaṭṭa kuṟiñcinila malarkaḷip paṟittaṉar; avaṟṟip pāṟiyilē kuvittaṉar; pala mālikaḷākak kaṭṭit tam kariya muṭiyilē aḻakupeṟac cūṭik koṇṭaṉar (ku. pā. aṭi, 54-106). cōḻanāṭṭu ūrkaḷil ciṟuvar, kutiri pūṭṭāmal kiyāl uruṭṭum mūṉṟu uruḷikaḷiyuṭiya ciṟu tēriṉi vittu viḷiyāṭiṉar.
pūmpukār nakarattil mīṉavar piḷḷikaḷ maṇalilē paṭarnta aṭampampūvit taliyilē kaṭṭiyum, nīril niṉṟa āmpaṟpūvip paṟittuc cūṭiyum, taṅkaḷ maṉṟilē āṭṭukkiṭāyp pōriyum kavutārip pōriyum kaṇṭu kaḷittārkaḷ (pa. pāli, aṭi, 61-77). kaṭaliṭic ceṉṟu mīṉ piṭittu vāḻnta paratavar. uvā nāḷil mīṉ piṭikkac cellār; ataṟku māṟāka, āṭiyum pāṭiyum poḻutik kaḻittaṉar. avarkaḷ taṅkaḷ makaḷirōṭu kūṭi maṇal muṟṟattil cuṟāviṉ kompi naṭṭu, veṇṭāḷi malar māliyiṉiyum tāḻi malariyum cūṭip paṉaṅkaḷḷiyum neṟkaḷḷiyum uṇṭu viḷiyāṭiṉārkaḷ; kāviri kaṭaloṭu kalakkum iṭattil kaṭalāṭiṉārkaḷ; uṭampiṟpaṭinta uppup pōkumpaṭi, kāviriyil nīrāṭiṉārkaḷ; naṇṭukaḷip piṭittu viḷiyāṭiṉārkaḷ.
pāvikaḷip paṇṇi viḷiyāṭiṉārkaḷ; aimpoṟikaḷāl nukarum poruḷkaḷi nukarntu mayaṅkiṉārkaḷ; nīṅkāta viruppattuṭaṉē pakaṟpoḻutellām viḷiyāṭiṉārkaḷ (aṭi, 90-103).
26. camayam
kuṟiñci nilattukkuriya kaṭavuḷ murukaṉ; mulli nilattukkuriya kaṭavuḷ māyōṉ; pāli nilattiṟkuriya kaṭavuḷ paḻiyōḷ eṉappaṭṭa turkki; maruta nilattukkuriya kaṭavuḷ vēntaṉ (intiraṉ); neytal nilattukkuriya kaṭavuḷ, varuṇaṉ. itu tolkāppiyar kūṟum ceytiyākum.1
muruka vaḻipāṭu
vēlum cēvalum murukaṉukkuriyavi. ivi iraṇṭum varalāṟṟuk kālattiṟku mika muṟpaṭṭa paḻimi vāynta āticcanallūrp putiporuḷkaḷukkiṭiyiṟ kiṭittuḷḷaṉa. vēlkaḷ irumpāl ceyyappaṭṭavi; cēvalkaḷ pittaḷiyāl ceyyappaṭṭavi. ivaṟṟi nōkka, muruka vaṇakkam mikappaḻiya kālattiliruntē tamiḻariṭam iruntu varuvatu eṉpatu teḷivākum.2
vaṭavintiyāvil civaṉ allatu uruttiraṉ kuṟiñci nilakkaṭavuḷākak karutappaṭṭāṉ. āyiṉum, tamiḻ nāṭṭil cēyōṉ eṉṉum murukaṉ kuṟiñci nilak kaṭavuḷākak karutappaṭṭāṉ. vaṭavar murukaṉukkuc cuppiramaṇiyaṉ eṉṟum kārttikēyaṉ eṉṟum peyar vaḻaṅkiṉar. vētakālattil cuppiramaṇiya vaṇakkam vaḻakkil illi. itikāca kālattil kārttikēyaṉ eṉṟa cuppiramaṇiyaṉatu piṟappip paṟṟiya kuṟippukaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. aṅku avaṉ uruttiraṉ allatu akkiṉiyiṉ makaṉeṉak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷāṉ. cuppiramaṇiya vaḻipāṭu civaṉ allatu uruttira vaḻipāṭṭu vaḷarcciyiṉ payaṉākum. avvaḷarcciyiṉ payaṉāyt teṉṉāṭṭavar tam paḻiya kaṭavuḷāṉa murukaṉi vaṭanāṭṭuc cuppiramaṇiyaṉōṭu oṉṟupaṭutti avaṉi intiraṉukkum varuṇaṉukkum oppākak karutalāyiṉar.1
uruttiraṉ, varuṇaṉ eṉṟa vētakālak kaṭavuḷar peyarkaḷukku iṇiyāṉavi, piṟa intō-jermāṉiya moḻikaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭavilli. eṉavē, akkaṭavuḷar tirāviṭar kaṭavuḷarāy iruntiruttal vēṇṭum. kaṭal teyvamāṉa varuṇaṉ, kaṭal ōram vāḻnta tirāviṭar kaṭavuḷākalām. āriya iruṭikaḷ akkaṭavuḷukkut taṅkaḷ vaḻipāṭṭil iṭam tantirukkalām. malikkuriya kaṭavuḷāṉa uruttiraṉ tirāviṭar kaṭavuḷ āvāṉ. uruttiraṉ eṉpataṟkuc `civantavaṉ eṉpatu poruḷ. itu civaṉ eṉṉum tirāviṭap peyariṉ vaṭamoḻi ākkamākum. teṉṉāṭṭu malikkaṭavuḷāṉa murukaṉ, koṟṟaviyiṉ makaṉāvāṉ. maruta nilattukkuriya tirāviṭar kaṭavuḷ vētakāla intiraṉuṭaṉ aikkiyap paṭuttappaṭṭaṉaṉ pōlum! vētaṅkaḷ kūṟum kiruṣṇaṉ, tirāviṭaratu mulli nilakkaṭavuḷāṉa māyōṉ eṉpavaṉ āvaṉ.2
kālappōkkil koṟṟavi umiyākkappaṭṭāḷ. ataṉāl, avaḷ makaṉāṉa murukaṉ umiyiṉ makaṉākavum civaṉ makaṉākavum karutappaṭṭāṉ.3
`kārttiki mātar aṟuvarāl vaḷarkkappaṭṭamiyāl cuppiramaṇayiṉ kārttikēyaṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ, eṉṟu purāṇaṅkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. kārttikēyaṉ eṉappaṭṭa cuppiramaṇiyaṉ, āṟu talikaḷiyum paṉṉiraṇṭu kikaḷiyum uṭiyavaṉ eṉṟu purāṇaṅkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. avaṉ tamiḻ murukaṉōṭu iṇikkappaṭṭa kāraṇattāl, tirumurukāṟṟup paṭiyil āṟu talikaḷum paṉṉiru kikaḷum avaṟṟukkuriya ceyalkaḷum pēcappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. (aṭi, 91-118).
pāṭalipurattil ki. mu. 188il puṣyamittira cuṅkaṉ aracaṉāṉāṉ. cuṅkar āṭciyil vitikar celvākkup peṟṟaṉar; irāmāyaṇa pārata nūlkaḷ tirutti eḻutappaṭṭaṉa; piramaṉ, viṣṇu, civaṉ ākiya mūvarum camaniliyil vikkappaṭṭaṉar. irāmaṉum kiruṣṇaṉum viṣṇuviṉ avatāraṅkaḷeṉak karutappaṭṭaṉar. oru cārār civaṉi uyarttiṉar; maṟṟoru cārār viṣṇuvi uyarttiṉar; kīti muṭivāṉa uruvam eṭuttatu. kiruṣṇaṉ viṣṇuviṉ avatāram eṉṟu karutappaṭṭāṉ; `pakavāṉ eṉṟu vaḻaṅkappaṭṭāṉ. avaṉip paṟṟiya katikaḷ potumakkaḷiṭam paraviṉa. ammatattip piṉpaṟṟiyavar `pākavatar eṉappaṭṭaṉar.1 pakavāṉ varalāṟṟik kūṟum nūl `pākavatam eṉappaṭṭatu. vaṭavintiyāvil uṇṭāṉa immāṟupāṭukaḷ teṉṉinti yāvilum paravutal iyalpēyaṉṟō?
murukaṉip paṟṟiyavi
murukaṉ, pañcapūtaṅkaḷuḷ oṉṟāṉa tī, taṉ kiyil ēṟpa, kārttiki mātar aṟuvarāl vaḷarkkappaṭṭavaṉ; āṟu uruvaṅkaḷip peṟṟavaṉ; kallāliṉ kīḻirunta kaṭavuḷiṉ putalvaṉ; maliyariyaṉ makaḷukku makaṉ; pakivarkkuk kūṟṟuvaṉ; koṟṟavi ciṟuvaṉ; kāṭukiḻāḷ; makaṉ; tēvarpattalivaṉ; villiyum tāṉiyiyum uṭiya talivaṉ; māli aṇinta mārpaṉ; ellā nūlkaḷiyum aṟinta pulavaṉ; pōrttoḻilil oppaṟṟavaṉ; porukiṉṟa veṟṟiyiyuṭiya maḷḷaṉ; cāṉṟōr pukaḻntu kūṟum coṟkaḷiṉ caṭṭamāyiruppavaṉ; teyvayāṉi vaḷḷiyammiyōrkkuk kaṇavaṉ; vīrar ēṟu; vēlēntiya peruñcelvaṉ; kiravuñca maliyip piḷanta kiḻavaṉ; vāṉaḷāviya mālikaḷiyuṭiya kuṟiñci nilattukku urimiyuṭiyavaṉ; kalvi matattiyuṭiya yāṉi pōlvārkkuc ciṅka ēṟu pōṉṟavaṉ; perumpeyar murukaṉ; vīṭṭiṉpatti virumpi vantavarkku aruḷpuriyum aṇṇal; piṟarāl iṭukkaṇpaṭṭu vantavarkku aruḷ puriyum cēy; poṉṉāṟceyyap paṭṭa pēraṇikalaṅkaḷi mārpil aṇintavaṉ; irantu vantōrkku vēṇṭuvaṉa koṭuttu avarip pātukāppavaṉ; tēvarum muṉivarum ēttum periya tiruppeyariyuṭiya iyavuḷ (talivaṉ allatu kaṭavuḷ); cūrapaṉmāviṉ cūlatti illiyākkiṉa `matavali eṉṉum peyari uṭiyavaṉ. apperumāṉ porunaṉ (uvamikkappaṭupavaṉ); kuricil (talivaṉ); taṉṉōṭu oppārillāta meyyaṟivi uṭiyavaṉ. iṅṅaṉam palavāṟu murukap perumāḷip pukaḻntu vaḻipaṭumpaṭi, vīṭupēṟṟik kaṇṭa pulavaṉ, appēṟṟi avāvum pulavaṉukkuk kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ (tirumuruku. aṭi, 255-280).
mali nāṭṭil vaḻipāṭu
kuṟamakaḷ murukavaḻipāṭṭukkuriya iṭattit tūymiyākki, aṅku murukaṟkariya kōḻikkoṭiyi nāṭṭiṉāḷ; akkoṭimītu neyyōṭu veṇciṟu kaṭuki appiṉāḷ; tāṉ vaḻipaṭaṟkuriya mantiratti mella uccarittu vaḻipaṭṭāḷ; aḻakiya malarkaḷi akkoṭi mītu tūviṉāḷ; iraṇṭu āṭikaḷi uḷḷoṉṟum puṟam oṉṟumāka uṭuttāḷ; civanta nūlik kiyil kāppākak kaṭṭiṉāḷ; veḷḷiya poriyit tūviṉāḷ; āṭṭukkiṭāyiṉ kurutiyōṭu picinta tūya veḷḷariciyic ciṟupaliyāka iṭṭāḷ; pala pirappukaḷi (nivētaṉapporuḷ) vittāḷ; ciṟiya pacu mañcaḷōṭu naṟiya cantaṉam mutaliyavaṟṟiyum teḷittāḷ; periya kuḷirnta cevvalari māliyiyum piṟa kuḷirnta maṇamikka mālikaḷiyum aciyat toṅkaviṭṭāḷ; `malip pakkattu ūrkaḷiliruntu paciyum piṇiyum pakiyum nīṅkuka, eṉṟu vāḻttiṉāḷ; cēvaṟkoṭikku naṟiya tūpaṅkāṭṭiṉāḷ; kuṟiñcippaṇṇil murukaṉip pāṭiṉāḷ; appoḻutu aruvi ōciyōṭu palliyaṅkaḷiṉ oliyum olittaṉa. kuṟamakaḷ civanta niṟamuṭiya pala pūkkaḷiyum tūvik kurutiyaḷinta civanta tiṉiyip parappiṉāḷ; murukaṉ uvakkum vācciyaṅkaḷi vācikkap paṇṇiṉāḷ; maṉamuruki murukaṉi vaḻipaṭṭāḷ.
appoḻutu uṭaṉ iruntavar, avveṟiyāṭu kaḷam āravārippa ataṟku ēṟpaṉavaṟṟip pāṭiṉar; kompukaḷ palavaṟṟiyum cēravūtiṉar; maṇiyi olippittaṉar; murukaṉatu ūrtiyākiya `piṇimukam eṉṉum yāṉiyi vāḻttiṉar; murukap perumāṉi vaḻipaṭṭaṉar (tirumuruku. aṭi, 227-248).
vēlaṉ veṟiyāṭṭu
murukaṉippōla vēṭam pūṇṭu kiyil vēlēnti āṭum mali nāṭup pūcāri `vēlaṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ. avaṉ kuṟamakaḷatu nōy murukaṉāl vantateṉṟu aiyuṟiṉ, akkaṭavuḷit tirutti ceyya oru kaḷatti amittup pūciyiṭṭu āṭippāṭi vaḻipaṭuvatu vaḻakkam. avaṉ iṅṅaṉam pūciyiṭṭu vaḻipāṭu ceytal `veṟiyāṭṭu eṉappaṭum. avaṉ āṭa, avaṉip piṉpaṟṟik kāṉavarum āṭuvar. ittakiya vēlaṉatu āṭal oṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyiṟ kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
vēlaṉ cātikkāy, takkōlakkāy, kāṭṭu malliki, veṇṭāḷi malar eṉpavi tammuḷ viravak kaṭṭiṉ kaṇṇiyi aṇintāḷ; civanta āṭiyi aṇintāḷ; kātukaḷil acōkantaḷirik koṇṭāṉ; kacciyik kaṭṭik kaḻali aṇintāṉ; veṭci māliyic cūṭiṉāṉ. aṅku iruntavar kuḻali ūtiṉar; kompi ūtiṉar; ciṟiya palliyaṅkaḷi eḻuppiṉar. vēlaṉ mayilēṟic cēvaṟkoṭiyi uyarttit toṭiyit tōḷil aṇintu, kuraviyāṭik koṇṭirunta makaḷiroṭu kikōttu āṭiṉāṉ.
kuṟavar mūṅkilil iruntu muṟṟiṉa tēṉāṟceyta kaḷ teḷivic cuṟṟattuṭaṉ uṇṭu makiḻntu, toṇṭakap paṟiyiṉ tāḷattiṟku ēṟpat taḻiyaṇinta kuṟamakaḷirōṭu kūṭik kuravik kūttāṭiṉar (tirumuruku. aṭi, 190-217).
piṟa ceytikaḷ
kuṟiñci nilattalivaṉ taliviyiṭam taṉ kātaluṟutiyi vaṟpuṟutta, `murukaṉ aṟiya niṉṉip piriyēṉ; piriyiṉ, ayaṉ allatu ceytēṉāvēṉ, eṉṟu cūḷ ceytal vaḻakkam 
(ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 208-210).
kuṟiñci nilamakkaḷāl ceyyappaṭṭatāka mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa murukavaḻipāṭṭil vētaṅkaḷilō ākamaṅkaḷilō aṟivu peṟṟa purōkitar iṭam peṟavilli eṉpatu kavaṉittaṟkuriyatu. kuṟiñci nila makkaḷ, tāṅkaḷ toṉṟu toṭṭu vaḻipaṭṭuvanta muṟiyilēyē vaḻipaṭṭu vantārkaḷ; attakiya vaḻipāṭṭil taṅkaḷ kaṭavuḷ veḷippaṭuvāṉ eṉṟu nampiṉārkaḷ. akkaṭavuḷ avaruḷ oruvarmītu āvēcittu veḷippaṭutalē vaḻakkamāy iruntatu. ivvaḻakkam iṉṟum tamiḻariṭiyē iruntu varukiṉṟatu. murukaṉāl āvēcikkappaṭṭavaṉ `vēlaṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ.1
murukaṉ uḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷ
āṭṭukkiṭāyi aṟuttuk kōḻikkoṭiyi niṟutti, ūrār vaḻipaṭum iṭattilum, taṉ aṭiyavar toḻukiṉṟa iṭattilum, vēlaṉ amitta veṟiyāṭu kaḷattilum, kāṭṭilum, poḻililum, āṟṟiṭik kuṟiyilum, āṟukaḷilum, kuḷaṅkaḷilum, palvēṟupaṭṭa ūrkaḷilum, nāṟcantiyilum, muccantiyilum, aiñcantiyilum, kaṭampamarattilum, ūr naṭuvil uḷḷa marattaṭiyilum, ampalattilum, ātīṇṭu kuṟṟiyiyuṭiya iṭattilum, kuṟamakaḷ vaḻipaṭum iṭattilum murukaṉ tōṉṟi aruḷ purivāṉ (tirumuruku. aṭi, 218-248).
murukap perumāṉ cūraramakaḷir āṭum cōlikaḷ poruntiya tirupparaṅkuṉṟattil eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷāṉ; āṟu mukaṅkaḷuṭaṉum paṉṉiraṇṭu kikaḷuṭaṉum alivāyil eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷāṉ; viratattāl vaṟṟiya yākkiyiyuṭiya muṉivarum kantiruvarum vaḻipaṭat tiru āvinaṉkuṭiyil kōyil koṇṭuḷḷāṉ; piramacārikaḷ tōttiraṅ kaḷikkūṟa, īra āṭiyuṭaṉ iruntu aruccakar vaḻipāṭu ceyyum ērakattil eḻuntaruḷiyuḷḷāṉ; kuṉṟutōṟum āṭalpurikiṉṟāṉ. itu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi kūṟum ceytiyākum.
tirumāl vaṇakkam
kāñci nakarattiṟku aṇmiyil cūriyaṉ veḷiccam paṭāta aṭarnta cōli iruntatu. accōliyil maṇal mikuti. ammaṇalil kuḻikaḷ iruntaṉa. akkuḻikaḷil nīr kāṇappaṭṭatu. annīril kurukkatti malarkaḷ viḻuntu kiṭantaṉa. makkaḷ appoḻilil taṅki viḷiyāṭiṉārkaḷ. accōliyiyaṭuttu āṟṟuttuṟi amintiruntatu. makkaḷ aṅku iḷavēṉiṟcevviyi nukarntārkaḷ. aṅku, nīṇṭa pūṅkottukaḷi yuṭiya kāntaḷip peṟṟa aḻakiya pakkamaliyil yāṉikiṭantāṟ pōlap pāmpaṇiyākiya paṭukkiyilē perumāḷ paḷḷikoṇṭiruntāṉ. (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 371-390). perumāḷ iṅṅaṉam paḷḷi koṇṭa tirukkōvil iṉṟu ciṟiya kāñcīpurattil uḷḷa yatōttakāri kōvilākum. coṉṉa vaṇṇam ceyta perumāḷ kōvil eṉṉum tamiḻppeyarum ataṟkuṇṭu. tirumāl piṟanta ōṇanāḷ maturiyiṟkoṇṭāṭappaṭṭatu.1 annaṉṉāḷil maṟavar tammuṭ cērippōr purintaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 590-596).
civaperumāṉ
potiyamali nāṭṭi āṇṭuvanta āyvēḷ taṉakku nīlanākam nalkiya uyarnta kaliṅkatti ālamarattaṭiyil amarnta teṉmukak kaṭavuḷukkuk koṭuttāṉ (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 95-97). aimpūtaṅkaḷiyum cērappaṭitta maḻuvākiya vāḷiyuṭiya periyōṉ ēṉiyōriṉ mutalvaṉ eṉṟu maturikkāñci pukalkiṉṟatu.
nīru nilaṉun tīyum vaḷiyu
māka vicumpo ṭintuṭaṉ iyaṟṟiya
maḻuvāḷ neṭiyōṉ taliva ṉāka
			(ma. kā. aṭi, 453-455)
eṉpataṉāl civaperumāṉ, kaṭavuḷaruḷ mutaṉmiyāṉavaṉ eṉṟa koḷki akkālattil, iruntami teḷivākum.
nutalviḻi nāṭṭat tiṟiyōṉ mutalāp
pativāḻ catukkap pūtamī ṟāka             (kāti, aṭi, 54-55).
eṉṟu putta kāviyamākiya maṇimēkaliyilum civa pirāṉē kaṭavuḷaruḷ mutalvaṉāyk kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷāṉ. civaperumāṉ ālamar celvaṉāka vaḻipaṭappaṭṭāṉ eṉpatum terikiṟatu.
nakarattil camayanili
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil murukaṉukkum kaṭavuḷar piṟarkkum kōvilkaḷ iruntaṉa. aṅkup palliyaṅkaḷ olikka, nāḷum vaḻipāṭu naṭipeṟṟatu; kuḻal iciyi uṇṭākka, yāḻ vācikka, muḻavu muḻaṅka, muracu olikka, pāṭumakaḷir pāṭat tiruviḻā naṭipeṟṟatu. nakaramakkaḷ vaḻipāṭṭilum tiruviḻāvilum kalantukoṇṭārkaḷ (pa. pāli, aṭi, 145-158).
maturiyil civaperumāṉ mutaliya kaṭavuḷarkkuk kōvilkaḷ iruntaṉa. kōvil viḻāvil ēḻām nāḷ ciṟantatu. ēḻām nāḷ antiyil kaṭavuḷ tīrttamāṭutal marapu. atu maturiyil ciṟappākak koṇṭāṭappaṭṭatu (ma. kā. aṭi, 427-428, 453-455). tiruviḻāviṉ toṭakkam paṟiyaṟintu makkaḷukkut terivikkappaṭṭatu (aṭi, 361-2).
maturiyil irunta ellām kōvilkaḷilum antik kālappūci pala vāttiyaṅkaḷ olikkac ciṟappāka naṭipeṟṟatu. avvamayam vāḻvaraciyar tam kaṇavariyum piḷḷikaḷiyum aḻittukkoṇṭu pūcikku vēṇṭiya malarkaḷiyum pukipporuḷkaḷiyum ēnti, avaravar viruppappaṭi, puttappaḷḷikkum antaṇar paḷḷikkum camaṇar paḷḷikkum ceṉṟaṉar. puttap paḷḷiyil putta pikkukaḷ iruntu aṟavuri kūṟiṉar; antaṇar paḷḷiyil vētāntaṅkaḷil valla antaṇamuṉivar iruntu aṟavuri vaḻaṅkiṉar; camaṇar paḷḷiyil camaṇa muṉivar iruntu aṟavuri āṟṟiṉar.
antaṇar paḷḷi, maliyi uḷ veḷiyāka vāṅki iruppiṭam ākkiṉāṟpōṉṟa amippuṭiyatāy ōṅki uyarntu uṭpuṟam akaṉṟiruntatu. camaṇappaḷḷiyiṉ cuvarkaḷ cempāṟceyyappaṭṭavi pōla uṟutiyāyiruntaṉa. accuvarkaḷiṉmītu ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. appaḷḷiyil naṟiya malarccōli iruntatu. aṅku irunta camaṇa muṉivarkaḷ ciṟanta kalvimāṉkaḷ (ma. kā. aṭi, 461-488).
ōymāṉ nalliyakkōṭaṉatu talinakarāṉa `kiṭaṅkil eṉṟa nakaram, `cāṟayar mūtūr eṉappaṭṭatu (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 2001). `viḻā naṭakkiṉṟa paḻiya ūr eṉpatu ittoṭariṉ poruḷākum. kāñci mānakaram,
                        	                             palartoḻa
viḻavumēm paṭṭa paḻaviṟal mūtūr
eṉappaṭṭatu (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 410-411).
`palacamayattārum toḻumpaṭi eṭutta viḻākkaḷāl ēṉiya nakarkaḷiṉ mēlāṉa veṟṟiyiyuṭiya paḻiya ūr eṉpatu nacciṉārkkiṉiyar uri. kāñci mānakar kalviyilum camayattuṟiyilum piṟa nakaraṅkaḷiviṭa uyarntatu eṉpatu varalāṟu kaṇṭa uṇmi. `nakarēṣū kāñci eṉpatu vaṭamoḻi vācakam. puttar kāñciyil aṟavupatēcam ceytār. avar iruntu upatēcitta iṭaṅkaḷil acōkaṉ tūpikaḷi amittāṉ eṉṟu yuvāṉcuvāṅku eṉṟa cīṉa vaḻippōkkaṉ kūṟiyuḷḷāṉ.1
cantirakuptamuriyaṉ taṉ āṭciyit tuṟantu paṉṉīrāyiram tikampara camaṇaruṭaṉ kaṉṉaṭa nāṭṭuc ciravaṇapeḷakoḷāvukku (veḷḷikkuḷattukku) vantu taṅkiyatākac camaṇa nūlkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. akkālattiliruntu tamiḻakattilum camaṇam paraviyatākak koḷḷalām. ki. mu. mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭic cērnta pirāmik kalveṭṭukaḷ kaḻukumali mutaliya malikkukikaḷil kāṇappaṭutal putta camayam tamiḻakattil paraviyatik kuṟippatākum.2
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉam, kāñci, vañci ākiya nakaraṅkaḷil pala camayaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉṟu maṇimēkaliyum kūṟutal iṅku niṉikkattakum. eṉavē, maturiyil putta, camaṇa, vitika neṟikaḷ iruntāṟpōlak kāñciyilum pala camayaṅkaḷ tiriyaṉ kālattil iruntirukkalām eṉṟu karututal poruttamākum. pala camayattār kōvilkaḷ iruntaṉa. eṉavē, kāñciyil avvaccamayattārukkuriya viḻākkaḷ naṭipeṟṟaṉa eṉpatu tāṉē pōtarum.
iṭiyaṟāta celva varuvāyiṉiyuṭiya akaṉṟa iṭattiyuṭiya periya ūrkaḷil viḻākkaḷ naṭantaṉa. viḻākkālaṅkaḷil ayalūrārkkum porunar pāṇar mutaliyōrkkum pērūrkaḷil cōṟu vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 1-2). mali nāṭṭu ūrkaḷil viḻāvik kāṇa vantavarkku miṭāccōṟu variyātu vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu (ku. pā. aṭi, 201-203).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil kāḷi kōvilum iruntatu. akkōvil vāyilil pūtaṅkaḷ kāval iruntaṉa (pa. pāli, aṭi, 53-57). annakara vaṇikar tēvarkaḷi vaḻipaṭṭu yākaṅkaḷic ceytaṉar; nāṉmaṟiyōri matittu naṭantaṉar (aṭi, 200-202).
nāṭṭil irunta ūrkaḷil ūrārkūṭum ampalaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa. aṅkut taṟi (neṭiya tūṇ) naṭappaṭṭu vaḻipaṭappaṭṭatu. ūr mātarār māliyil avviṭattit tūymi ceytu viḷakkēṟṟi, attaṟiyi malariṭṭu vaṇaṅkiṉar; ūr makkaḷ teyvam uṟinta attaṟiyi vaḻipaṭṭaṉar; viḻā iyaṟṟiṉar. avviḻāvil kūttar paṅku koṇṭaṉar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 246-255). ūrt tiruviḻāvil makaḷir pāṭiṉar, āṭiṉar; muḻavu kaṇṇuṟakkamiṉṟi muḻaṅkikkoṇṭiruntatu (malipaṭu kaṭām, aṭi, 286).
camayam paṟṟiya piṟa ceytikaḷ
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattuk kaṭaṟkariyil vāḻnta paratavar. valikiṭantu ularnta maṇaliyuṭiya muṟṟattu maṉiyil ciṉiyiyuṭiya cuṟaviṉ kompi naṭṭu, ataṉiṭattē teyvatti ēṟṟi, vaḻipaṭṭaṉar; veṇṭāḷi malar māliyi aṇintu tāḻi malaric cūṭip paṉiyiṉ kaḷḷipparukiyum neṟkaḷḷip parukiyum viḷiyāṭiṉar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 82-93).
viṟaliyar malivāḻ teyvaṅkaḷip paṇintu kuṟiñcip paṇṇil pala pākkaḷip pāṭutal marapu. avarkaḷ mutaliṟkaṭavuḷi vāḻttiṉārkaḷ; piṉṉarē pala pāṭalkaḷip pāṭiṉārkaḷ (malipaṭu. aṭi, 360, 538-540). navira malimītu kāriyuṇṭik kaṭavuḷ kōvil iruntatu. kūttar akkaṭavuḷi vaṇaṅkic ceṉṟaṉar (aṭi, 229-231). itaṉāl, malimītu civapirāṉ kōvilum arukiyiruntami aṟiyappaṭum.
pōril taṉṉāl iyaṉṟavariyil ciṟappuṟap pōr purintu uyir viṭṭa vīraṉatu uṭalip putitta allatu eritta iṭattil oru kalli naṭuvar; akkallil avaṉatu uruvattiyum peyariyum, iṉṉa pōril ivvāṟu pōr purintu māṇṭāṉ eṉṟa vivarattiyum poṟippar. akkal naṭukal eṉappaṭum. vīrar ciṟappākavum piṟar potuvākavum naṭukalli vaḻipaṭuvar. ittakiya naṭukaṟkaḷ paṇṭit tamiḻakattil ovvoru nāṭṭilum iruntaṉa. ivvīra vaṇakkam tamiḻarkku vīrattiyum nāṭṭuppaṟṟiyum ūṭṭi vantatu eṉṉalām.
naṉṉaṉuṭiya malikaḷiṉ mītu ittakiya naṭukaṟkaḷ iruntaṉa. avaṟṟuṭcila, marāmarattaṭiyil iruntaṉa. avvaḻiyiṟceṉṟa kūttar, yāḻ vācittu, naṭukal vīrarkaḷi vaḻipaṭṭuc ceṉṟaṉar (malipaṭu. aṭi, 386-396).
kāṭṭil `cūr eṉṉum koṭunteyvam irunta teṉpatip paḻantamiḻar nampiṉar (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 255).
tavam ceyyum vaḻakkam akkālattil iruntatu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 91-92). mukkōl1 antaṇar kāviyāṭi uṭutta tuṟavikaḷ.1 ivarkaḷ tamiḻakattil iruntārkaḷ (mu. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 37).2
ivarkaḷ kalittokiyil mukkōṟpakavar eṉap paṭṭārkaḷ. mukkōṟpakavar eṉpavar uṟiyilē taṅkiṉa kamaṇṭalatti uṭiyavar; ari, ayaṉ, araṉ eṉṉum mūvarum oruvarē eṉpati aṟivikkum aṭiyāḷamāka mukkōlit tōḷilē vittavar; kuṭiyi uṭiyavar; kāṭṭiṭattē pōtali iyalpāṉa oḻukkamākak koṇṭavar (kalittoki, 9); piraṇavatti eppōtum niṉintiruppavar (kali, 126).
talivi orutti talivaṉ oruvaṉōṭu uṭaṉpōkki mēṟkoṇṭāḷ. avaḷit tēṭi vanta cevili, vaḻiyil mukkōṟpakavarik kaṇṭu paṇintu, taliviyippaṟṟi vicārittāḷ. apperumakkaḷ tāṅkaḷ taliviyiyum talivaṉiyum kaṇṭatākak kūṟit talivi talivaṉuṭaṉ ceṉṟatu neṟippaṭṭatē eṉpatik kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟiṉārkaḷ.
maṇapporuḷkaḷ kūṭṭappeṟṟa cantaṉam maliyiṭattē piṟantatu āyiṉum, pūcikkoḷpavarukku tāṉ payaṉit tarum; tāṉ vaḷarnta malikkup payaṉit tārātu. muttukaḷ kaṭaliṟpiṟantaviyāyiṉum, tammi aṇivārkkup payaṉpaṭumē tavirat tām piṟanta kaṭalukku oru payaṉiyum tārā. ēḻu narampāl kūṭṭiya iṉimiyāṉa ōcikaḷ yāḻiṭattē piṟantavi āyiṉum, avi pāṭuvōrkkup payaṉ tarumē allātu yāḻukkup payaṉit tārā. ātalāl, uṉ makaḷ uṉ illattil piṟantu vaḷarntālum, peṟṟōriṉum ciṟanta kaṇavaṉi vaḻipaṭṭu avaṉ piṉṉē ceṉṟāḷ. iṅṅaṉam kaṟpup pūṇṭu nikaḻttum illaṟamē aṟaṅkaḷil taliyāya aṟam. ivviruvarum maṟumiyil nīṅkāmal tuṟakkattilē cellum vaḻiyum avvaḻipāṭēyākum (kali.9).
makkaḷ nelliyum malarkaḷiyum koṇṭu ceṉṟu ūrkkōvilil kaṭavuḷ tirumuṉpu vittu niṟpārkaḷ. appoḻutu evarēṉum pēcuvatikkoṇṭu ataṉi naṟcol allatu tīya collākakkoṇṭu, tām karutiyatu naṭipeṟum allatu naṭipeṟātu eṉṟu muṭivu ceyvārkku (mulli. aṭi, 8-11). cōṟṟil āṭṭukkurutiyiyō, vēṟu paliyiṭappaṭṭa uyiriṉ kurutiyiyō kalantu kākkikkup paliyiṭutal marapu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 183-184). mērumali teyvaṅkaḷ uṟiyum mali eṉṟu nampi, tamiḻar ataṉik `kaṭavuḷ mālvari eṉṟaṉar (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 205). ātittar paṉṉiruvar, uruttirar patiṉoruvar, vacukkaḷ eṇmar, maruttuvar iruvar, patiṉeṇkaṇaṅkaḷ, kantaruvar, cūraramakaḷir ākiyōrippaṟṟiyum tamiḻar aṟintiruntaṉar eṉpatu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭiyāl terikiṟatu (aṭi, 167-168).
murukaṉ piṟappu, murukaṉ cūraṉik koṉṟami, murukaṉ kiravuñca maliyip piḷantami, tirumāl mūṉṟaṭi maṇ kēṭṭu ulakaḷantami, tirumāl acurari veṉṟami, nalliyakkōṭaṉ vēṇṭa murukaṉ oru kiṇaṟṟil irunta malari vēlāka māṟṟit tantami pōṉṟa camayat toṭarpāṉa katikaḷ cila pattup pāṭṭil vantuḷḷaṉa; aruccuṉaṉ kāṇṭava vaṉatti erittamiyum, pāratappōr paṟṟiya ceytikaḷum iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
muṭivuri
vaṭanāṭṭiliruntu ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭil camaṇamum puttamum tamiḻakattiṟku vantaṉa. avaṟṟukku muṉṉarē vētaneṟi tamiḻakattiṟpukuntu paravat toṭaṅkiyatu eṉpatu tolkāppiyattāl terikiṟatu. ivaṟṟōṭu civamum viṇamum innāṭṭil caṅkakālattiṟ paraviyiruntaṉa eṉpatu mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa cāṉṟukaḷāl teḷivākum.
27. aḻakukkalikaḷ
1. ōviyakkali
muṉṉuri
nām kaṇṇāl kāṇum poruḷkaḷic cittirittu eḻutum kaliyē ōviyakkali. paṇṭi maṉitaṉ tāṉ pārttavaṟṟiyē paṭamāka eḻutikkāṭṭiṉāṉ; piṉpu aṟivu vaḷaravaḷara, taṉ maṉattāṟpala uruvaṅkaḷiyum kāṭcikaḷiyum muṭivu ceytu, avaṟṟip paṭaṅkaḷāka varintāṉ; eṇṇum āṟṟalil ciṟanta pulavar perumakkaḷuṭiya karuttōviyaṅ kaḷukku uruvaṅkaḷi amittāṉ. ivvāṟu kāṇum poruḷiliruntu eṇṇum poruḷkaḷ ceytikaḷ variyilum uruvam tarum muṟi ōviyaṅkaliyil vaḷarcci peṟṟatu. paḻiya makkaḷ vāḻnta kukikaḷil ciṟuciṟu ōviyaṅkaḷ iṉṟum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. itaṉi nōkka, vīṭu kaṭṭa aṟiyāta maṉitaṉ kukiyil vāḻnta pōtē ōviyakkali tōṉṟiyatu eṉṟu kūṟalām.
ēṟattāḻa aiyāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṟpaṭṭa cintu veḷip poruḷkaḷil ōviyam tīṭṭappeṟṟa maṭpāṇṭaṅkaḷ palavākum; tāyittukaḷ palavākum. ivvāṟē cumēriyar, ekiptiyar putiporuḷkaḷilum ōviyaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭu kiṉṟaṉa. eṉavē, ōviyam variyum paḻakkam maṉitaṉukkut toṭakkattiliruntē vaḷarntu vantirukkiṟatu eṉṟu kūṟutal poruttamākum.
caṅka kālattil
iṉṟuḷḷa tamiḻnūlkaḷuḷ kālattāl muṟpaṭṭatu tolkāppiyam eṉṉum ilakkaṇa nūl. pōril viḻuppuṇ paṭṭu vīrarkaḷ iṟanta iṭattil-allatu avarkaḷip putitta iṭattil-allatu avarkaḷatu uṭaṟcāmpali aṭakkam ceyta iṭattil-oru kal naṭappaṭum; akkallil iṟanta vīraṉatu uruvam cetukkappaṭum; piṉṉar ataṟkup pūci naṭattappaṭum. ataṟku `naṭukal eṉpatu peyar. atu vīrarālum iṟantavaṉ marapiṉarālum toḻappaṭum. kallil ivvāṟu ōr uruvam cetukkappaṭutaṟku muṉpu avvuruvatti ōviyamāka varintukoḷḷutalē vaḻakkamākum. anta ōviyattil utavikoṇṭēṭa, kallil uruvam cetukkappaṭum. eṉavē, tolkāppiyar kālattilēyē (ēṟattāḻa 2300 āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē) ōviyam tīṭṭum vaḻakkam tamiḻariṭam iruntu vantatu eṉpatu teḷivākum.
caṅkakāla naṭaṉamakaḷir naṭaṉakkalikkākap palvēṟu kalikaḷiyum kaṟṟaṉar; avaṟṟuḷ ōviyakkali oṉṟu eṉṟu maṇimēkali ceppukiṉṟatu.
	nāṭaka makaḷirkku naṉkaṉam vakutta
ōviyac cennūl urinūṟ kiṭakkiyum
kaṟṟuttuṟi pōkiya poṟṟoṭi naṅki.
				-maṇi. kāti 2: 30-32.
ivvaṭikaḷi nōkka, ōviyakkali paṟṟiya ciṟanta nūl oṉṟu caṅkakālattil iruntatu eṉpatu teḷivākalām. mātaviyiṉ naṭaṉa araṅkēṟṟam nikaḻnta araṅkiṉ mēṟ kūriyil kaṇkavar ōviyaṅkaḷ pala tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. akkūri ōviyavitāṉam eṉappeyar peṟṟatu. (cilap. 95:128). ulōkaṅkaḷālāṉa kēṭayaṅkaḷil kaṇṇik kavarum ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa eṉṟu cilappatikāram ceppukiṟatu.
celvar vāḻum vaḷamaṉic cuvarkaḷiṉmītum māṭaṅkaḷiṉ mītum tēvar mutal ellā uyirkaḷiyum kuṟikkattakka ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa eṉṉum ceyti maṇimēkaliyil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
vampa mākkaḷ kampali mutūrc
cuṭumaṇ ōṅkiya neṭunili maṉitoṟum
miyaṟu paṭivattu vāṉavar mutalā
evvaki yuyirkaḷum uvamaṅ kāṭṭi
veṇcuti viḷakkattu vittakar iyaṟṟiya
kaṇkavar ōviyam kaṇṭuniṟ kunarum.
				-kāti, 3 : 126-131.
maturiyi aṭutta tirupparaṅkuṉṟattil murukap perumāṉ tirukkōyilil maṇṭapaṅkaḷ pala iruntaṉa. avaṟṟil purāṇa itikācak katikaḷ pala ōviyaṅkaḷākak kāṭciyaḷittaṉa. avaṟṟuḷ katiravaṉ, tiṅkaḷ, kōḷkaḷ, irati, maṉmataṉ, intiraṉ, akaliki, pūṉi, kutamaṉ eṉṉum uyartiṇi-aḵṟiṇip poruḷkaḷik kuṟikkum ōviyaṅkaḷ eḻutappaṭṭiruntaṉa eṉap paripāṭāl pakarkiṉṟatu. (pāṭal, 19 : aṭi, 46-53).
kātalaṉ tāṉ virumpiya peṇṇi maṇakka iyalāta niliyil oru tuṇiyil avaḷ uruvatti ōviyamāka varintukoṇṭu maṭal ēṟutal vaḻakkam eṉṟu akapporuḷ nūlkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.
ōviyaṅkaḷi amittu āṭi neytal caṅkakālat tamiḻakattil vaḻakkamāyiruntatu. āṭikaḷil ōviyaṅkaḷi amittal eḷitāṉa ceyalaṉṟu. aṅṅaṉam amittavar mikacciṟanta ōviyattiṟaṉ vāyntavarāy iruttal vēṇṭum allavā? kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil irunta uvavaṉam, ciṟanta ōviyarāl ōviyam amittu neyyappaṭṭa āṭi pōlak kāṭciyaḷittatu eṉṟu maṇimēkali āciriyar kuṟittuḷḷār.
	vittakar iyaṟṟiya viḷaṅkiya kiviṉic
cittirac ceykip paṭāmpōrt tatuvē
ōppat tōṉṟiya uvavaṉam
				-kāti, 3 : 167-169.
ivvāṟu āṭikaḷilum cuvarkaḷilum maṇṭapak kūrikaḷilum kēṭayaṅkaḷiṉ mītum kaṇkavar ōviyaṅkaḷit tīṭṭa vallavar mikacciṟanta ōviyarāy irukka vēṇṭum allavā?
caṅkakālattil ōviyakkali ciṟanta muṟiyil vaḷarcci peṟṟiruntatu eṉpati itukāṟum kūṟiya vivaraṅkaḷik koṇṭu naṉku teḷiyalām.1
pattuppāṭṭuḷ ōviyakkaliyippaṟṟiya kuṟippukaḷ mikaccilavē vantuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟik kīḻē kāṇpōm:
ōvu-ōvam
ōvukaṇ ṭaṉṉa aruperu niyamam (ma. kā. aṭi, 365).
ōvat taṉṉa uṇṭuṟi; (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 70).
eṉṉum aṭikaḷi nōkkac cittiram eṉṟa poruḷil ōvu eṉpatum ōvam eṉpatum payiṉṟuḷḷami aṟiyappaṭum.
ōviyavakivaṇṇaṅkaḷik koṇṭu tīṭṭappaṭāta ōviyam (Sketch) puṉiyā ōviyam eṉappaṭṭatu. `pāṇṭiyaṉ pōrukkucceṉṟa piṉpu avaṉ pirivāl vāṭit taṉṉi aṇi ceytukoḷḷāta racamātēvi, puṉiyā ōviyam pōlak kāṇappaṭṭāḷ, eṉṟu neṭunalvāṭi vaṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 145-147).
cōḻanāṭṭu nīrttuṟi ōviyattip pōṉṟiruntatu eṉṟu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi kūṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 70). vaṇṇaṅkaḷāl muṟṟuppeṟṟa ōviyam kaṇṇik kavarvatu pōla nīrttuṟiyum pūntātu paravik kaṇkavar vaṉappiṉip peṟṟiruntatu eṉpatu karuttām.
iṉimiyum teyvattaṉmiyum
ōviyaṅkaḷik kaṇṭāṟpōṉṟu kaṇṇukku iṉimiyiyuṭiya `nāḷaṅkāṭi allaṅkāṭi eṉṉum iraṇṭu kaṭitterukkaḷ maturiyil iruntaṉa eṉṟu maturikkāñci moḻikiṉṟatu (aṭi, 365). ōviyaṅkaḷ kaṇṇukku iṉimi taruvaṉa eṉpatu tamiḻ makkaḷ karuttāl teḷiyalām. kaṇṇukku iṉimi tarum ōviyaṅkaḷ tamiḻakattil variyappaṭṭaṉa. eṉpatāl, caṅkakāla ōviyakkaliyiṉ uyarvi oruvāṟu aṟiyalām. ataṉāṟpōlum akkāla ōviyaṉ `vallōṉ (Expert) eṉappaṭṭāṉ (ma. kā. aṭi, 723).
`pāṇṭiyaṉ neṭuñceḻiyaṉ kāliyil eḻuntāṉ; vallōṉ eḻutiya pāviyil teyvattaṉmi nikaḻntāṟpōṉṟa vaṭiviṉi uṭiyavaṉāyiruntāṉ; eṉṟu māṅkuṭi marutaṉār kūṟiyuḷḷār (ma. kā. aṭi, 723-24). eṉavē, vallōṉ eḻutiya pāvi ōviyattil teyvattaṉmi nikaḻum eṉpatu tamiḻar nampikki eṉpatu terikiṟatu. maṇimēkalik kāviyattil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa kantiṟpāvi itaṟku ēṟṟa cāṉṟākum (maṇi. kāti, 21 : aṭi, 1157-7, 120-27, 131-3). ittakiya vallōr pala vakippaṭṭa nuṇṇiya toḻilkaḷiyum oppukkāṭṭi eḻutavalla kūriya aṟiviṉiyuṭiyavar. avarkaḷ nōkkiṉār kaṇṇiṭattē tam toḻili niṟuttum tiṟami vāyntavar. ataṉāl avarkaḷ `kaṇṇuḷ viṉiñar eṉappaṭṭaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 516-518; uri).
kaṭṭiṟcuri ōviyam
pāṇṭimātēviyiṉ vēlippāṭu niṟinta tantak kaṭṭiliṉ mēṟkūriyil ōviyaṅkaḷ eḻutappaṭṭiruntaṉa; mēṭarāci mutaliya irācikaḷ variyappaṭṭiruntaṉa; tiṅkaḷum urōkiṇiyum eḻutappaṭṭiruntaṉa. tiṅkaḷōṭu cērntu urōkiṇi iruppatu pōlap paṭam variyappaṭṭiruntatu. urōkiṇi taṉ kaṇavaṉākiya tiṅkaḷi viṭṭup piriyātiruppatu pōlat tāṉum taṉ kaṇavaṉi viṭṭup piriyātirukka iyalavilliyē eṉṟu eṇṇip pāṇṭimātēvi perumūccu viṭṭāḷ eṉṟu neṭunalvāṭi iyampukiṟatu (aṭi, 159-163). araṇmaṉiyuḷ eḻutappaṭṭa inta ōviyaṅkaḷ mikacciṟanta ōviyarāl eḻutappaṭṭaṉavātal vēṇṭum eṉpatil aiyamilli aṉṟō?
paḷḷi, kōvil ōviyaṅkaḷ
maturiyil irunta amaṇappaḷḷic cuvarkaḷiṉmītu accamayat toṭarpāṉa ōviyaṅkaḷ variyappaṭṭiruntaṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 485).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil irunta kōviṟcuvarkaḷ veṇmi niṟattaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ cuvarkaḷil vēṟupaṭṭa toḻilkaḷiyuṭiya (pala nikaḻccikaḷi uṇarttum) ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa eṉṟu paṭṭiṉappāli pakarkiṉṟatu (aṭi, 49-50).
ōviyattiṉ ciṟappu
ōviyaṉ taṉ kittiṟaṉ muḻumiyiyum kāṭṭi oru maṅkiyiṉ uruvatti ōviyamāka varikiṉṟāṉ. avaṉ ammaṅkiyiṉ nakili aḻukupeṟattīṭṭi muṭikkiṉṟāṉ. anta ōviyattil uḷḷa nakiliṉ aḻakit taṉṉiṭattē peṟṟa nakili uṭiyavar naṉṉaṉuṭiya maṉivimār eṉṟu neṭunalvāṭi kūṟukiṟatu (aṭi, 57). itaṉāl, ōviyattiṉ ciṟappiyum ataṉi varinta ōviyaṉatu ōviyappulami mutircciyiyum nām naṉku uṇaralāmaṉṟō?
muṭivuri
`vaṇṇaṅkaḷikkoṇṭu eḻutappaṭāta ōviyam puṉiyā ōviyam eṉappaṭṭatu. kaṇṇikkavarattakka nīrttuṟi, kaṭitteru mutaliyavaṟṟukku vallōṉ varin ōviyaṅkaḷ uvami kūṟappaṭṭaṉa. araca mātēviyiṉ kaṭṭiliṉ mēṟkūriyilum kōviṟcuvarkaḷiṉmītum ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ōviyaṉ `vallōṉ eṉṟum, `kaṇṇuḷ viṉiñaṉ eṉṟum peyar peṟṟāṉ, eṉṉum vivaraṅkaḷi mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa ceytiyiliruntu nām naṉkuṇaralām.
ōviyaṅkaliyi niṉivūṭṭum ūrkaḷ
ōviyam tamiḻccol: cittiram-vaṭacol. ippeyarkaḷik koṇṭa ūrkaḷ cila tamiḻakattil uṇṭu. avaṟṟik kīḻē kāṇka:

2. ciṟpakkali
muṉṉuri
maṇ, maram, ceṅkal, kal, ulōkam, tantam, meḻuku, arakku mutaliyavaṟṟikkoṇṭu uruvaṅkaḷ amikkum kaliyē `ciṟpakkali eṉpatu.
vaḻuvaṟu maraṉum maṇṇuṅ kallum
eḻutiya pāvi.................
			-kāti, 21; aṭi, 115-116
maṇṇiṉum kalliṉum marattiṉum cuvariṉum
kaṇṇiya teyvatam kāṭṭunar vakukka
			-kāti, 21; aṭi, 125-126.
eṉa varum maṇimēkali aṭikaḷ kavaṉikkattakkavi.
caṅkakālattil
vīrakkal pāvi mutaliyaṉa
ēṟattāḻak ki. mu. 300il iyaṟṟappaṭṭa tol kāppiyam eṉṉum paḻam pērilakkaṇa nūlil ciṟpakkali paṟṟiya kuṟippuk kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu. pōril viḻuppuṇ paṭṭu iṟanta vīraṉukkuk kal naṭuvatu paḻantamiḻar vaḻakkam. māṇṭa vīraṉatu uruvam akkallil poṟikkap peṟum. iṅṅaṉam vīrarkkuk kal naṭutal tolkāppiyar kālattil tiṭīreṉa eḻuntataṉṟu; avarukku muṉpē toṉṟu toṭṭu vanta paḻakkamākum. eṉavē, ciṟpakkali tamiḻakattil pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷukku muṉṉarē tōṉṟiya kali eṉpatu aiyamaṟa viḷaṅkum uṇmiyākum.
ki. pi. 2ām nūṟṟāṇṭil iyaṟṟappaṭṭa cilappatikārattil kaṇṇaki eṉṉum pattiṉikku uruvam poṟitta varalāṟu kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
kolli maliyiṉ oru pakutiyil cetukkappeṟṟa pāvi oṉṟu iruntatu. atu `kollip pāvi eṉappaṭṭatu (kuṟuntoki, 89, 100). pāṟiyil uruvam cetukkum ciṟpakkali aṟivu akkālattil iruntatu eṉpataṟku itu ciṟanta eṭuttukkāṭṭākum aṉṟō?
nīriṉ aṭiyil maṇṭiya poṭimaṇ `vaṇṭal eṉappaṭum. appoṭi maṇṇikkoṇṭu pāvi ceytu viḷiyāṭutal caṅkakālat tamiḻcciṟumiyar vaḻakkamākum. vaṇṭal koṇṭu ceyta pāvi vaṇṭaṟpāvi eṉappaṭṭatu (aiṅkuṟunūṟu, 124; naṟṟiṇi, 191). makaḷir pañcāykkōriyāl pāvi ceytu viḷiyāṭutalum vaḻakkam (kuṟuntoki, 276). taṇṭāṉ kōriyip paṟittuk kiḻittup pāviyākkutalum vaḻakkam (kali. 76). ciṟumiyar marappāṉi, marappāvi ākiyavaṟṟi vittu viḷiyāṭiṉar (kali. 59). maṇ, kōri, maram ivaṟṟāl ciṟpa uruvaṅkaḷ amikkum vaḻakkam akkālattil iruntatu eṉpatu mēṟkūṟiyavaṟṟāl teḷivākum.
maturi nakarap perunteru oṉṟil aṇinili māṭam oṉṟiruntatu. ammāṭattil pala uruvaṅkaḷ cutiyāl ceyyappaṭṭiruntaṉa. avaṟṟuḷ vēṅkiyiṉ uruvam oṉṟu. atu `kipuṉi kiḷarvēṅki eṉappaṭṭatu. avvaḻiyē ceṉṟa peṇ yāṉi ataṉi mey vēṅki eṉṟu eṇṇi accamuṟṟup pākaṉukku aṭaṅkāmal aliyattoṭaṅkiyatu. itaṉi nōkka, akkālac ciṟpattoḻiliṉ ciṟappi nām naṉkuṇaralām. (paripāṭal, 10; aṭi, 41-46).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil tūṇil pāvi oṉṟu iruntatu. atu `kantiṟpāvi eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. atu varuvatu urikkum āṟṟal uṭiyatu eṉṟu maṇimēkali kūṟukiṉṟatu (kāti, 21).
mukkaṇṇaṉāṉa civaperumāṉ kōvil puṟanāṉūṟṟil kuṟikkappaṭukiṟatu (ce. 6). palarāmaṉ, kaṇṇaṉ, civaṉ, murukaṉ eṉpavar nāṟperun teyvaṅkaḷeṉa vaḻaṅkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉar (puṟam. 56).
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil civaṉ kōvil, murukaṉ kōvil, palarāmaṉ kōvil, tirumāl kōvil, catukkap pūtattiṉ kōvil, koṟṟavi kōvil, puttar kōvil, arukar kōvil eṉappala kōvilkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉac cilappatikāram ceppukiṟatu. cūriyaṉ, cantiraṉ, veḷḷi yāṉi, intiraṉatu vaccirāyutam ākiyavaṟṟukkum kōvilkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉṟu akkāviyamē kūṟukiṉṟatu. akkōvilkaḷil vaḻipāṭṭukkuriya tiruvuruvaṅkaḷ cutiyālum marattālum kallālum ceyyappaṭṭiruttal vēṇṭum eṉṟu koḷvatu poruttamākum.
māṅkāṭṭu maṟiyavaṉ tiruvēṅkaṭamaliyil tirumālatu niṉṟakōlattiyum tiruvaraṅkattil kiṭanta kōlattiyum kaṇmaṇi kuḷirppak kaṇṭatākac cilappatikārattil ciṟappittuk kūṟuvatāl, apperumāṉ urucavaccilikaḷ cilappatikāra kālattil (ki. pi. 2ām nūṟṟāṇṭil) ciṟanta vēlippāṭu koṇṭaṉavāy iruntiruttal vēṇṭumallavā?
catukkappūtam
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattil nāṉku terukkaḷ cantikkum iṭattil periya pūtattiṉ kōvil oṉṟu iruntatu. catukkattil aminta appūtattiṉ kōvil, catukkappūtam eḻuntaruḷiya kōvil eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. atu mucukuntaṉ eṉṟa cōḻa maṉṉaṉāl niṟuvappaṭṭatu. appūtam poykkari pukalvōriyum, puṟaṅkūṟuvōriyum, oḻukkaṅkeṭṭa variyum, piṟar poruḷik kavarpavariyum, aṟaneṟi tavaṟum amiccariyum taṉ kippācattāl piṇittup puṭittuk kollum eṉṟu cilappatikāram kūṟukiṟatu. attakiya pūtattiṉ kallāl āṉa uruvaccili oṉṟu koccikku vaṭakkē eṭṭukkal tolivil uḷḷa aḻintupaṭṭa paḻiya vañci mānakarap pakutiyil akaḻntu eṭukkappaṭṭatu. atu mikapperiya uruvam; ciṟanta vēlippāṭu koṇṭatu.1 ataṉip pōṉṟa uruvacciliyē pūmpukār nakarattilum iruntirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu karututal poruttamākum. ellā makkaḷum catukkap pūtatti vaṇaṅki vantārkaḷ.
pattup pāṭṭil
murukapperumāṉ tirupparaṅkuṉṟam, tiruccīrali vāy, tiruvāvinaṉkuṭi, tiruvērakam ākiya nāṉku iṭaṅkaḷilum kōyil koṇṭiruntāṉ eṉṟu tirumurukāṟṟuppaṭi terivikkiṉṟatu. eṉavē, akkōvilkaḷil murukaṉ tiruvuruvaṅkaḷ iruntami teḷivākum.
maturiyil civaperumāṉ, tirumāl, puttar, arukar kōyilkaḷ iruntaṉa. akkaṭavuḷari makkaḷ vaḻipaṭṭārkaḷ. kōyilkaḷil viḻākkaḷ naṭipeṟṟaṉa eṉṟu maturikkāñci moḻikiṉṟatu (aṭi, 444-464, 467-488). akkōyil kaḷilellām vaḻipāṭṭiṟkuriya kaṭavuḷar tiruvuruvaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉpatu kūṟāmalē amiyum. eṉavē, attiruvuru vaṅkaḷi amikkum ciṟpakkalittiṟaṉ tamiḻarkku iruntatu eṉpatu teḷivākum.
pāṇṭiyaṉatu araṇmaṉi vāyiliṉ mēl niliyil kacalaṭcumiyiṉ uruvam amikkappaṭṭiruntatu (neṭunal vāṭi, aṭi, 81-86). vāyil nili perumpālum uṟuti vāynta marattāṟceyyappaṭṭiruttal vēṇṭum. mēl niliyiṉ naṭuppakutiyil ilakkumiyiṉ uruvam amikkappaṭṭatu. ataṉ iru puṟaṅkaḷilum peṇ yāṉikaḷ tutikkikaḷi ilakkumiyiṉ talikkumēl uyarttic ceṅkaḻunīr malarkaḷi ilakkumiyiṉmītu corital pōlac cetukkappaṭṭiruntaṉa. iṅṅaṉam tirumakaḷ iraṇṭu yāṉikaḷiṉ iṭiyil vīṟṟiruttal iṉṟuḷḷa kōvilkaḷilum kāṇalām. pala paḻiya kōvilkaḷil ikkāṭci cutiyāl amikkap paṭṭuḷḷatu.
tolkāppiyattil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷa naṭukal vaṇakkam iraṇṭiṭaṅkaḷil malipaṭukaṭāttil kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu. naṉṉaṉuṭiya malikaḷiṉmītu naṭukaṟkaḷ iruntaṉa. avi makkaḷāl vaḻipaṭappaṭṭaṉa (aṭi, 388-396).
pāvi taṉ kiyilē takaḻiyi ēntiyuḷḷa niliyil ulōkam koṇṭu amikkappaṭṭa (yavaṉar ceyta) pāvi viḷakkukaḷ tamiḻakattil mikutiyāy iruntaṉa. ulōkaṅkaḷi urukki vēṇṭum uruvaṅkaḷi amikkum tiṟaṉ akkālattil iruntamiyālētāṉ kaṭavuḷar tirumēṉikaḷ ulōkaṅkaḷil ceyyappaṭṭaṉa. ulōka uruvaṅkaḷ ūr valattiṟku (ikkālattiluḷḷavi pōla)p payaṉpaṭṭirukkalām.
3. icikkali
iciyiṉ ciṟappu
ici eṉṉum col, `icivippatu-taṉ vayappaṭuttuvatu eṉap poruḷpaṭum. ici, kal maṉattiyum karinturukac ceyyum peṟṟi vāyntatu. kaṟṟōrum maṟṟōrum iciyiṉ vayappaṭṭē niṟpar; aṉpip perukki āruyiri vaḷarppatu ici. iciyik kēṭṭu iṉpuṟāta uyirkaḷ illiyeṉṟē kūṟalām. vilaṅkukaḷ, paṟavikaḷ, ceṭikaḷ, pāmpukaḷ mutaliya uyirkaḷ iciyāl iṉpamaṭikiṉṟaṉa. pāl vēṇṭi aḻum pacuṅkuḻaviyum ici vayappaṭṭup pāliyum paciyiyum maṟantu kaṇkaḷ ceruka makiḻcci aṭikiṉṟatu. iciyiṉ vayappaṭātār aṉpiṉ vayap paṭātār eṉṟē kūṟutal amiyum. ici vāḻkkiyil iṉpatti aḷikkum. iciyiṉ arumiyiyum perumiyiyum ōrntē tamiḻar icittamiḻi muttamiḻuḷ naṭu nāyakamāy vittuḷḷaṉar. tamiḻ ilakkiya nūlkaḷ icittamiḻil irukkiṉṟaṉa.
paṇṭit tamiḻakattil iyaṟṟappaṭṭa nūlkaḷil perumpālāṉa ceyyuḷ vaṭivilēyē amintavi. piṟkālattil tōṉṟiya kalveṭṭukḷa, ceppēṭukaḷ palavum aṅṅaṉamē amintuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟiṟkum piṟpaṭat tōṉṟiya vaṭitavaṭivil amintuḷḷa cīṭṭuk kavikaḷum mikkiruttalik kāṇa, ēṟattāḻap patiṉeṭṭām nūṟṟāṇṭu variyil tamiḻakattil icit tamiḻ nūlkaḷē mikkiruntaṉa eṉṟu kūṟuvatu poruntum.
tamiḻappiḷḷikaḷ taṅkaḷ kuḻantipparuvattil tālāṭṭuppākkaḷiyum ūcaṟpākkaḷiyum kēṭṭārkaḷ; viḷiyāṭum paruvattil pantu viḷiyāṭum pāṭalkaḷ (kantukavari), ammāṉi, poṟcuṇṇam, cāḻal, teḷḷēṇam, unti paṟattal, tōḷnōkkam mutaliya āṭalkaḷukkuriya pāṭalkaḷip pāṭi makiḻntārkaḷ; maṇattil maṅkala vāḻttup pāṭalip pāṭiṉārkaḷ; ulakki koṇṭu kuṟṟum toḻilukkuriya pāṭṭu vaḷḷippāṭṭu eṉṉum peyar peṟṟatu. ēṟṟam koṇṭu nīr iṟippavar pāṭiya ēṟṟappāṭṭu mutaliya uḻipput terikiṟatu. aṉittiṟkum pāṭalkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉpatu terikiṟatu. tamiḻaṉ iṟanta piṉṉarum pāṭṭu avaṉi viṭavilli; palavakic cantaṅkaḷil oppārippākkaḷ iṉṟum pāṭappaṭuvatik kēṭkalām. iṅṅaṉam paḻantamiḻar tam piṟappu mutal iṟappu vari iciyilēyē vāḻntu vantaṉar eṉṟu kūṟutal poruntum.
caṅkakālattil
tamiḻppaṇkaḷ ēḻu avi kural, tuttam, kikkiḷi, uḻi, iḷi, viḷari, tāram eṉappeyar peṟṟaṉa. ivaṟṟiliruntu piṟappaṉa `tiṟaṅkaḷ eṉappaṭṭaṉa. paṇkaḷum tiṟaṅkaḷum pala kiḷikaḷāy iyaṅkum vakikaḷil eṇṇiṟanta ici vakikaḷ kaṇṭaṟiyappaṭṭaṉa. tamiḻpperumpaṇkaḷ kuṟiñcippaṇ, mullippaṇ, pālippaṇ, marutappaṇ, neytaṟpaṇ eṉṉum aintu. ivaṟṟiṉ vakippaṭṭa paṇkaḷ pala. avaṟṟuḷ pakaṟpaṇkaḷ, iravuppaṇkaḷ, kāli mālip paṇkaḷ eṉa avvappoḻutiṟkaminta paṇkaḷum vaḻakkil iruntaṉa.
paḻiya maṉitaṉ uṇarccip perukkāl pāṭiṉāṉ. koṇṭar, cavarar mutaliya anākarika makkaḷiṭam pāṭṭu mutaṉmi peṟṟiruppati iṉṟum kāṇalām. eṉavē, maṉita uḷḷattiṟkup pāṭṭu amutamāyp payaṉpaṭṭatu. payaṉpaṭṭu varukiṟatu eṉpatu teḷivu. inta uṇmiyi uṇarntu kuṟiñci mutaliya nilaṅkaḷukku uriya karupporuḷkaḷik kūṟa vanta tolkāppiyar mutaliya tollāciriyarkaḷ icikkaruvi kaḷiyum paṇkaḷiyum cērttuk kūṟiṉārkaḷ. tol kāppiyam-akattiṇiyiyal ivipaṟṟiya vivaraṅ kaḷik kāṇalām. kuṟiñci nilamakkaḷ, iṟi vaḻipāṭṭil iṉimiyāyp pāṭik koṇṭu kuṉṟakkuravi āṭiṉārkaḷ; koṟṟaviyi vaḻipaṭap pāli nilamakkaḷ icikkaruvikaḷiyum payaṉpaṭutti vēṭṭuva vari pāṭiṉārkaḷ. mullinila āycciyar tām āṭiya āycciyar kuraviyil mulli nilattiṟkuriya icikkaruvikaḷiyum paṇkaḷiyum payaṉpaṭuttiṉar. marutayāḻum marutappaṇṇum marutanilattiṟkuriyavi. neytal yāḻum neytaṟpaṇṇum neytal nilattiṟku uriyavi.1
icikkaruvikaḷ
icikkaruvikaḷ `iyaṅkaḷ eṉappaṭṭaṉa. ciṟiya pala icikkaruvikaḷ `kuṟumpalliyaṅkaḷ eṉappaṭṭaṉa. periya pala icikkaruvikaḷ `neṭumpalliyaṅkaḷ eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉa. ivi tōṟkaruvi, tuḷikkaruvi, narampukkaruvi, kañcakkaruvi eṉa nālvakippaṭum. muḻavu, uṭukki mutaliyaṉa, tōṟkaruvikaḷ; kuḻal, vaṅkiyam pōṉṟavi, tuḷikkaruvikaḷ; yāḻ, narampukkaruvi; pittaḷi ulōkattāl āṉa tāḷavaki, kañcak karuviyākum.
icikkaruvikaḷuḷ mika iṉiya ōciyuṭiyavi kuḻalum yāḻumēyākum. mulli nilattu āyaṉ ciṟiya mūṅkiṟkaḻiyit tērnteṭuttuk kaṭikkoḷḷiyāl atil tuḷikaḷ ceytu, attuḷikaḷil ōciyi eḻuppik kuḻal vācittāṉ. (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 177-179). kuḻal vēyṅkuḻal, āmpaṟkuḻal eṉac cila vakippaṭum. avaṟṟuḷ vēyṅkuḻalē uyarntatu. mulli nilattu āyar ataṉi ūtiṉar. piṉṉar atu piṟa nilaṅkaḷilum paraviyatu.
yāḻkaḷ oṟṟi narampuṭiyatu, ēḻunarampukaḷi uṭiyatu, ataṟkum mēṟpaṭṭa narampukaḷi uṭiyavi eṉap pala vakippaṭum. avi cīṟiyāḻ, pēriyāḻ, vil yāḻ eṉap pala peyarkaḷip peṟum. kumiḻiṉatu uṭpoyyākiya kompiṭattē vaḷittuk kaṭṭiṉa māṟ kayiṟākiya viralālē teṟittu vācikkum narampiṉiyuṭiyatu vilyāḻ eṉpatu (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 180-182).
caṅku, muracu, toṇṭakappaṟi (tirumuruku. aṭi, 119-121, 197), taṭāri, taṇṇumi, kuḻal, yāḻ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 144, 179, 182), āmpaṟkuḻal, vayir (ūtu kompu), calli, karaṭi (ma. kā. aṭi, 612 uri), muḻavu, ākuḷi, kañcatāṉam, kompu, neṭuvaṅkiyam, kuṟuntūmpu, kuḻal, karaṭiki, ellari (calli), patali (malipaṭu. aṭi, 2-11) mutaliyaṉa pattup pāṭṭuḷ iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa., muḻavu, ākuḷi, tāḷam, neṭuvaṅkiyam, kuṟuntūmpu, kuḻal, karaṭiki, ellari, patali eṉpavaṟṟik kūttar payaṉpaṭuttiṉar; ivaṟṟuḷ ovvoṉṟiyum taṉittaṉi uṟiyil iṭṭu eṭuttuc ceṉṟaṉar (malipaṭu. aṭi, 2-12).
ivaṟṟuḷ taṭāri eṉpatu kiṇippaṟi eṉappaṭum. taṇṇumi eṉpatu mattaḷam pōṉṟa karuvi. calli allatu ellari eṉpatu oruvakippaṟi. karaṭi allatu karaṭiki eṉpatu karaṭi kattiṉāṟpōṉṟa ōciyuṭiya paṟi vaki. muḻavu eṉpatu mattaḷam. ākuḷi eṉpatu ciṟupaṟi. neṭuvaṅkiyam eṉpatu, kaṇkaḷiṉ naṭuvē veḷiyāyt tiṟanta yāṉiyiṉ kipōṉṟa karuvi. kuṟuntūmpu eṉpatu `iḷi eṉṉum narampiṉ ōciyi olikkum karuvi. calliyum karaṭikiyum aritteḻum ōciyiyuṭiyavi. patali eṉpatu oru kaṇ mākkiṇi.
pāli yāḻ
yāḻiṉ uṟuppukaḷuḷ `pattal eṉpatu oṉṟu. atu, māṉiṉ kuḷampu aḻuntap peṟṟa iṭam pōla iru puṟamum tāḻntu naṭuppakuti uyarnta niliyil amintiruppatu. anta yāḻukkut tōl pōrvi oṉṟu uṇṭu. appōrvi cuṭar niṟam vāyntatu; vayiṟṟiṉ mayir oḻuṅkupōla iru puṟamum cērttup kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. anta yāḻil, āṇikaḷi muṭukkutaṟku naṇṭiṉ kaṇ pōṉṟa tuḷikaḷ amintiruntaṉa; yāḻiṉ kariya taṇṭu, paṭameṭutta pāmpiṉip pōṉṟatu; attaṇṭil aminta vārkkaṭṭuk kiyil aṇiyappaṭṭa toṭi eṉṉum naki pōlak kāṭciyaḷittatu; yāḻil oṉṟukkoṉṟu nerukkamāka narampukaḷ iḻuttuk kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. curuṅkak kūṟiṉ, anta yāḻ maṇamāṉa peṇṇi oppaṉi ceytāṟpōṉṟa aḻaku peṟṟiruntatu eṉṟu kūṟalām. avyāḻ, yāḻiṟkuriya teyvam taṉṉiṭattē nilipeṟattakka ilakkaṇattip peṟṟiruntatu; vaḻiyiṟcelvōrit tuṉpuṟuttum kaḷvarum, taṉ ōci kēṭpiṉ, tam kippaṭiyi naḻuva viṭṭut tam koṭuñceyaliyum maṟakkac ceyyum iṉṉiciyi veḷippaṭutta vallatu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 4-22)
cīṟiyāḻ
ciṟupāṇaṉ payaṉpaṭuttiya cīṟiyāḻ, kariya kuraṅku pāmpiṉ taliyip piṭittapōtu appāmpu oru kāl iṟukavum orukāl nekiḻavum ataṉ kiyic cuṟṟuvatu pōla aḻakiṉi uṭiya taṉatu taṇṭiṭattil ceṟiyac cuṟṟiṉa, nekiḻa vēṇṭum iṭattu nekiḻntum iṟukavēṇṭum iṭattu iṟukiyum narampu tuvakkum vārkkaṭṭiṉi uṭiyatu; iraṇṭu viḷimpum cērattittu muṭukkiṉa āṇikaḷālē maṇiyi niṟittu vittatu pōṉṟa aḻakiyuṭiyatu; vayiṟu cērntu oḻuṅkupaṭṭa toḻil vaki aminta pattar eṉṉum uṟuppiṉiyuṭiyatu; kumiḻamarattup paḻattiṉatu niṟattip pōṉṟa tuvar ūṭṭiṉa polivu peṟṟa pōrviyi uṭiyatu; tēṉ pōṉṟa iṉiya taṉmiyik koṇṭa muṟukkaṭaṅkiṉa narampiṉiyuṭiyatu; ellāttuṟikaḷilum pāṭutaṟku ēṟṟa vāyppuṭiyatu; ici nūl kūṟukiṉṟa muṟimippaṭi cempālippaṇ pōṉṟa paṇkaḷi eḻuppattakkatu  (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 221-230).
pēriyāḻ
pēriyāḻ, periyaṉavum ciṟiyaṉavumāka oṉpatu vārkkaṭṭukaḷik koṇṭatu; vaṭittu muṟukkikkaṭṭiṉa iṉiya ōciyittarum narampukaḷi uṭiyatu; nērmiyāṉa varakiṉ katirkaḷ iraṇṭu variciyāka oḻuṅkupaṭṭu amintiruppatu pōlat taṉatu naṭu nīḷattil variciyākavum nerukka mākavum aminta ciṟiya tuḷikaḷil cuḷḷāṇikaḷ tikkappeṟṟatu. yāṉik kompiṉāl putitākac ceyyappaṭṭa aḻakiya āppu anta yāḻiṉ pattalil kuṟukkē cerukappaṭṭiruntatu. aḻakaṉittum oruṅkē tiraṇṭu uruveṭuttāṟpōṉṟa maṭanti oruttiyiṉ aṭivayiṟṟi liruntu mēl nōkki vaḷarntu paṭinta mayiriṉ oḻuṅku cemmiyāka amintiruppatu pōla, anta yāḻiṉip potinta tōli iṇittu aḻakākat tikkappeṟṟa tiyaliṉ oḻuṅku amintiruntatu. yāḻiṉ unti eṉṉum uṟuppil aminta tiyaliṉ oḻuṅku maṭantiyiṉ untiyiṉ mēl eḻunta mayiriṉ oḻuṅki ottiruntatu. yāḻiṉ kōṭu nuṇṇiya arattiṉāl nuṭpamāka arāvi amikkap paṭṭiruntu. atu vaḷintu nimirntu kaḷam paḻattiṉ niṟattiṉi ottuk kaṭumiyāyk kāṇappaṭṭatu. ittakiya ciṟappiṉi yuṭiya pēriyāḻ, irupattoru narampukaḷiyuṭiyatu. (malipaṭu, aṭi, 21-37, aṭikkuṟippu).1
paṇkaḷ mutaliyaṉa
yāḻiṟkuriya teyvam yāḻil taṅkiyirukkum eṉpatu icivāṇar nampikki. yāḻiṟkuriya teyvam mātaṅki (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 20 kuṟippu). yāḻiṉ kōṭu koṉṟi marattiṉālum karuṅkāli marattiṉālum ceyyappaṭum; pattal ceytaṟkuriya maram kumiḻamaramum murukka maramum taṇakku maramumākum (aṭi, 21-22 uri). icivāṇar yāḻ narampukaḷik kūṭat taḻuvuvar; itu vārttal eṉappaṭum; yāḻ narampukaḷi uruvuvar; itu vaṭittal eṉappeyar peṟum; yāḻ narampukaḷit teṟippar; itu untutal eṉappaṭum; yāḻ narampukaḷuḷ oṉṟi viṭṭu oṉṟit teṟippar; .itu uṟaltal eṉappaṭum. porunar, pāṇar eṉpavar yāḻi eṭuttu ittoḻilkaḷic ceytu tēvarip pukaḻntu pāṭuvar. ippāṭal vaki `tēvapāṇi eṉappaṭum. teyvaṅkaḷip paṟṟiya perumpāṭal, vaki `peruntēvapāṇi eṉap peyar peṟum (nakkiratēva nāyaṉār pāṭiya peruntēvapāṇiyik kāṇka); teyvaṅkaḷip paṟṟiya ciṟiya pāṭal vaki `ciṟu tēvapāṇi eṉappaṭum (cilampu, 6:35 uri). cīr mutaliyavi tāḷavicēṭaṅkaḷ. cīr, muṭiyuṅkārattit taṉṉiṭattē uṭiyatu; pāṇi, eṭukkum kālattit taṉṉiṭattē uṭiyatu; tūkku, nikaḻum kālattit taṉṉiṭattē uṭiyatu (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 24 kuṟippu).
`nivaḷam eṉpatu, `naṭṭapāṭi eṉṉum paṇ; `kāmaram eṉpatu, `cīkāmaram eṉṉum paṇ; kuralkural eṉpatu, cempālippaṇ (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 36, 77, 229); iviyum, pālippaṇ (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 180) mutaliya cila paṇkaḷum pattuppāṭṭuḷ kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ippaṇkaḷuḷ pakaṟpaṇkaḷ cila; irāppaṇkaḷ cila. naṭṭapāṭi eṉṉum paṇ pakaṟpaṇkaḷuḷ oṉṟu (ku. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 146-148 uriyum aṭikkuṟippum). āmpal eṉpatu oru vakippaṇ eṉpar cilar. nacciṉārkkiṉiyar, `veṇkalattāl kumutavaṭivāka aṇicu paṇṇic ceṟitta kuḻal eṉpatu (cīvaka. cey. 1662 uri). kōvalar āmpalantīṅkul payiṟṟiṉar (ku. pāṭṭu,aṭi, 221-222). valivu, melivu, camam eṉṉum  mūṉṟu tāṉattilum ovvoṉṟilum  ēḻutāṉam muṭittup pāṭum irupattoru pāṭal tuṟikaḷ uṇṭu (puṟam. 152). pāṇar attuṟikaḷ palavaṟṟiyum vācittu aracarkaḷi makiḻvittaṉar (malipaṭu. aṭi, 39-40). pāṭumakaḷir yāḻ oliyōṭu tammiṭaṟṟu oli poruntap pāṭic ciṟappuṟṟaṉar (ma. kā. aṭi, 217-218).
ilakkiya ilakkaṇaṅkaḷik kaṟṟavar pulavar eṉappaṭṭaṉar; kūtta nūlkaḷik kaṟṟa aṟiñar kūttar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. aṅṅaṉamē icikkalikkuriya nūlkaḷik kaṟṟavarē porunar, pāṇar, pāṭiṉiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. caṅka kālattil icikkalikkariya nūlkaḷ iruntaṉa. (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 2308; malipaṭu. aṭi, 38 uri).
icivāṇar
tolkāppiyattil icivāṇarip paṟṟiyum kūttarippaṟṟiyum pēcappaṭṭaṭuḷḷatu. porunar eṉpavar ērkkaḷattēṉum pōrkaḷattēṉum ceṉṟu pāṭum kūttar; avarkaḷ icikkaruvikaḷi icittup pāṭiṉārkaḷ; viḻā naṭakkum ūrkaḷil taṅkaḷ icittiṟaṉik kāṭṭi, viḻā muṭintavuṭaṉ viḻā naṭipeṟum vēṟu ūrkaḷukkuc celvatu porunar vaḻakkam (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 1-3). avarkaḷ vikaṟiyiṟceṉṟu vaḷḷalkaḷ araṇmaṇiyi aṭintu, taṅkaḷ kiṇippaṟiyiyō piṟa icikkaruviyiyō olittu vaḷḷaliṉ pukaḻippāṭutal vaḻakkam (aṭi, 70-76). pāṇar icikkaliyil vallunar; pala narampukaḷiyuṭiya periya yāḻi icittup pāṭiṉar `perumpāṇar eṉappaṭṭaṉar; cila narampukaḷiyuṭiya ciṟiya yāḻi icittuppāṭiyavar `ciṟupāṇar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. iciyil valla makaḷir `pāṭiṉiyar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. .ippāṇarum vaḷḷalkaḷi nāṭic ceṉṟu pāṭip paricil peṟṟaṉar. porunarum pāṇarum kūttarum viṟaliyarum karikālaṉ pōṉṟa vaḷḷalkaḷiṭam peṟṟa ciṟappiṉi `maṉṉar upacarippu eṉṉum talippiṟparakkak kāṇalām.
pala icikkaruvivaḷi icittuk kūttu (naṭaṉam) āṭiyavar kūttar eṉappaṭṭaṉar. avaruṭ peṇpālār `viṟaliyar eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉar. (tol. po. 91 uri). kuḻal, yāḻ, muḻavu mutaliya pala vaki icikkaruvikaḷi icippatilum vallunar iruntaṉar. ivarkaḷ vaḷḷalkaḷiṭam ceṉṟu paricil peṟṟu vāḻntārkaḷ; potu makkaḷiṭam taṅkaḷ kalittiṟaṉik kāṭṭip poruḷ peṟṟu vāḻntārkaḷ. vaṟumi vāṭṭumpoḻutu pāṇaṉ tāṉ kaṟṟa kalviyi ikaḻntu pēcutal vaḻakkam (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 22).
vaḷḷalkaḷiṭam paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭa porunarum, pāṇarum, kūttarum tammip pōṉṟa icivāṇari avvaḷḷalpōl āṟṟuppaṭuttutal marapu. aṅṅaṉam āṟṟuppaṭuttutal `āṟṟuppaṭi eṉappaṭum. atu porunar āṟṟuppaṭi, pāṇāṟṟupṭi, viṟaliyāṟṟuppaṭi, kūttarāṟṟuppaṭi eṉappeyar peṟum. tolkāppiyarē ivvāṟṟuppaṭiyip paṟṟik kūṟutalāl, avar kālattilum avarkku muṉṉum āṟṟuppaṭi nūlkaḷ iruntami teḷivu. ākavē, tolkāppiyarkku muṉpē innāṭṭil icikkaliyum kūttukkaliyum tōṉṟi vaḷarntiruntaṉa eṉpati nām naṉku aṟiyalām.
pāṭiṉi
porunaṉuṭaṉ karikālaṉiṭam paricil peṟac ceṉṟa pāṭiṉi, āṟṟuk karumaṇal pōṉṟa kūntaliyum, piṟi pōṉṟa aḻakiya  nutaliṉiyum, vil pōṉṟa puruvattiyum, kuḷirnta kaṇkaḷiyum, ilaviṉatu itaḻiyokkum civanta vāyiṉiyum, iṉiya coṟkaḷiyum, muttukaḷ pōṉṟa paṟkaḷiyum, mayiri veṭṭukiṉṟa kattarikiyiṉ kuḻicci yottatum, poliviṉiyuṭiya makarakkuḻiyiṉ aciviṉip poṟuttalamintatumāṉa kātiṉiyumuṭiyavaḷ; nāṇam varuttalāl piṟari nōkkātu kaviḻnta kaḻuttiṉi yuṭiyavaḷ; aciyum mūṅkil pōlum parutta tōḷkaḷip peṟṟavaḷ; melliya mayiriṉiyuṭiya muṉ kiyi uṭiyavaḷ; kāntaḷ pōlum melliya viralkaḷiyuṭi yavaḷ; kiḷiyiṉatu alakōṭu oppiṉiyuṭiya oḷi viṭukiṉṟa perumiyuṭiya nakaṅkaḷi uṭiyavaḷ; īrkku naṭuvē cella muṭiyāta eḻucciyiyuṭiya iḷamiyum aḻakum poruntiya nakilkaḷip peṟṟavaḷ; nīrccuḻi pōṉṟa uttama ilakkaṇaṅkaḷ niṟinta koppūḻiṉi uṭiyavaḷ; `uṇṭu eṉṟu piṟarāl uṇarappaṭāta varuntum iṭiyiṉip peṟṟavaḷ; pala maṇikaḷ kōtta vaṅkaḷiyuṭiya mēkali eṉṉum aṇiyi aṇintavaḷ; periya peṇyāṉiyiṉ perumiyiyuṭiya kipōla oḻuka vantu melliyavāyt tammil neruṅki oṉṟit tiraṇṭa tuṭikaḷiyuṭiyavar; mayir oḻuṅkupaṭṭa kaṇikkāli uṭiyavaḷ; ōṭi iḷitta nāyiṉatu nāvip pōṉṟa ciṟiya aṭiyiṉiyuṭiyavaḷ; mayil pōṉṟa cāyali uṭiyavaḷ; kalviyāl perumi peṟṟavaḷ (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 25-47).
pāṇar kuṭiyiruppukaḷ
maturiyi aṭutta viyiyāṟṟiṉ nīrttuṟikaḷiṉ arukil pūntōṭṭaṅkaḷ amintiruntaṉa. avaṟṟiṉiṭiyē perumpāṇar kuṭiyiruppu iruntatu. (ma.kā.aṭi, 340-342). pāṇar kuṭiyiruppil pāṭal āṭalāl ōci eḻuntatu (aṭi, 268-9).
iṉṟuḷḷa ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattil paṇṭikkāla āmūrkkōṭṭam aṭaṅkiyiruntatu. ``āmūrk kōṭṭattu mōntūr nāṭṭup perumpāccēri eṉpatu kalveṭṭu vācakam.1 perumpāccēri eṉpatu `perumpāṇaccēri eṉpataṉ marūuvākum. itu tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattiṟku arukil iruntatu. tiruvaḷḷur vaṭṭattil `pāṇaṉ pākkam eṉṟa ciṟṟūr iruntateṉak kalveṭṭuk kūṟukiṟatu.1 ``perumpāṇ etirvāyil eṉpatu pōḷūri aṭutta tirumaliyil uḷḷa oru kalveṭṭu vācakam.2 kuṭantiyil kāvirikkariyil irunta pāṇaṉ tuṟiyē ikkālattil `pāṇātuṟi eṉṟu māṟi vaḻaṅkukiṟateṉak karutalām. viyiyāṟṟiṉ nīrttuṟiyil pāṇar cēri amintiruntatu eṉṟu maturikkāñci kūṟukiṟatu. avvāṟē kāviriyiṉ nīrttuṟiyil pāṇar cēri oṉṟu iruntirukkalām. pāṇar cēri arukil irunta nīrttuṟi `pāṇar tuṟi eṉap peyar peṟṟirukkalām. atu kālappōkkil `pāṇā tuṟi eṉa māṟi vaḻaṅkalāyiṟṟeṉak karutalām.
ki.pi. 9ām nūṟṟāṇṭil vāḻnta pallava kampavarmaṉ kālattil kāñci vaṭṭattuk kīḻpputtūril perumpāṇaṉ cakkāṭi ariyaṉ eṉpavaṉ makaṉ oru kuḷam toṭap poṉ koṭuttāṉ.3
vantavāci vaṭṭattut toṇṭūric cērnta perumpāṇaṉ atti māṭamaṉ eṉpavaṉ teḷḷāṟṟuc civa perumāṉukku oru cantiviḷakku erikkap poṉtantāṉ. avaṉ mūṉṟām kulōttuṅkaṉ kālattavaṉ (ki.pi. 1178-1218) eṉṟa teḷḷāṟṟuc civaṉ kōvil kalveṭṭuk kūṟukiṟatu.4
itukāṟum kūṟappaṭṭa cāṉṟukaḷāl caṅkakālattup pāṇar marapiṉar pallavar kālattilum piṟkālac cōḻar kālattilum toṭarntu iruntu vantaṉar eṉpatum, avarkaḷ taṉiyāy irunta iṭam pāṇar cēri eṉappaṭṭatu eṉpatum naṉkaṟiyak kiṭattal kāṇka. toṇṭi nāṭṭil perumpāṇar .iruntaṉar eṉpataṟkup `perumpāccēri eṉṟa ūrppeyarum mēlē kāṭṭappaṭṭa kalveṭṭukaḷum cāṉṟātal kāṇalām. eṉavē, toṇṭimāṉmītu perumpāṇāṟṟuppaṭi pāṭappaṭṭaṭi poruttamē eṉpati aṟintiṉpuṟalām.

4. naṭaṉakkali
kūttiṉ tōṟṟam
iṟivaṉatu aruṭpaṭippilē kūttu nikaḻkiṉṟatu. evariṭamum payiṟci peṟāmalum, kūttukkaliyiṉ paṇpic ciṟitaḷavum kallāmalum, karumukilkaḷik kāṇum mayilkaḷ ciṟakukaḷi virittu āṭukiṉṟaṉa. koṭiya aravaṅkaḷ makuṭi ōciyik kēṭṭatum tam puṟṟukaḷiliruntu veḷippōntu iciyil īṭupaṭṭu meymmaṟantu paṭameṭuttu āṭukiṉṟaṉa. kaṇṇaṉip pōṉṟāratu vēyṅkuḻalil īṭupaṭṭup pacukkaḷ tammi maṟantu acintāṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivaṟṟik kūrntu nōkkiṉ, iyaṟkip paṭippilēyē kūttu iyalpāy amintuḷḷa uṇmiyi uṇaralākum.
paṇṭu mali muḻikaḷil vāḻntavar mutaṟkaṇ palavāṟu ōciyeḻuppi oruvarukkoruvar tam eṇṇaṅkaḷi aṟivittukkoṇṭaṉar. piṉṉar am makkaḷ cikikaḷ cērttut tam karuttukaḷi veḷippaṭuttiṉar; piṉṉarp paṭippaṭiyāyt tamakkeṉa moḻiyi amittuk koṇṭaṉar. ivvāṟu ovvoru nāṭṭiṉarum tamakkeṉat taṉittaṉi moḻiyi amittukkoṇṭaṉar. maṉitaṉ palavaki uṇarccikaḷ koṇṭavaṉ; aḷavu kaṭanta makiḻcci uṇṭākum poḻutu avaṉ taṉṉi maṟantu kūttāṭuvāṉ; kōpamāyirukkum poḻutu kaṇ civantu utaṭukaḷ tuṭikkap paraparappuṭaṉ pēcuvāṉ. iṅṅaṉam maṉitaṉ ovvōr uḷḷa niliyil ovvoṉṟi veḷippaṭiyākak kāṭṭutal allatu ceytal iyalpu.
`maṉitaṉ makiḻcci niliyil taṉ viruppappaṭi pala vaki ōcikaḷi eḻuppa, avvōcikaḷ, cila camayaṅkaḷil avaṉiyaṟiyātu avaṉukku iṉpatti aḷikka avaṉ mīṇṭum mīṇṭum avvōcikaḷi eḻuppi aṉupavikka ivvāṟu eḻuppappaṭṭa olikaḷiṉ cērkki kātukaḷukku iṉpamaḷitta niliyil, avaṉip piṉ paṟṟip palar attuṟiyil iṟaṅkiyirukkalām.
`maṉitaṉ taṉ kūttukkēṟpa olikaḷi eḻuppiyum, kikaḷik koṭṭiyumirukkalām. avaṉ iṅṅaṉam kutittatu kūttākavum olikaḷi eḻuppi ōciyiṭṭatu iciyākavum, kikaḷik koṭṭiyatu tāḷamākavum māṟiyirukkalām, eṉṟu aṟiñar karutukiṉṟaṉar.
ivvāṟu piṟantirukkalām eṉṟu karutappaṭum ici, kūttu, tāḷam ākiya mūṉṟum cērnta tokuppē kūttu allatu `naṭaṉam eṉpatu.
intiyāvukku veḷiyē
mikappaḻiya ekiptiya -camēriya- pāpilōṉiya nākarikac ciṉṉaṅkaḷil pala vaki naṭaṉaṅkaḷi uṇarttum ōviyaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ataṉāl, appaṇṭi nākarikaṅkaḷil tiḷittavar kūttukkaliyil aṟivu peṟṟiruntaṉar eṉpatu terikiṟatu.
intiyāvil
intiyāvil vētakālattiṟku muṟpaṭṭa cintu veḷi nākarikatti uṇarttum putiporuḷkaḷil veṇ kalattāṟceyyappaṭṭa kūttiyiṉ vaṭivam oṉṟu kiṭit tuḷḷatu. cila kaṟcilikaḷ naṭaṉa muṟiyil kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. tavilik kaḻuttil māṭṭit toṅka viṭṭa maṉita uruvam (kaḷimaṇṇāṟceyyappaṭṭatu) kiṭittuḷḷatu. mirutaṅkam, vīṇi, tāḷam eṉpavaṟṟik kuṟikkum ōviyaṅkaḷ akappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟic cērttu nōkkum poḻutu, cintu veḷi makkaḷ naṭaṉakkaliyil aṟivuṭiyavarkaḷāy iruntārkaḷ eṉpatu pulappaṭukiṟataṉṟō?
vaṭavintiyāvil naṭaṉattippaṟṟi eḻunta mutal vaṭamoḻi nūl `paratam eṉpatu. itaṉic ceytavar parata muṉivar. innūl ki.mu. mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉatu eṉṟu aṟiñar aṟikiṉṟaṉar. iḵtu iṉṟaḷavum mikac ciṟanta nūlāy iruntu varukiṉṟatu. ittakiya ciṟanta nūl ki.mu. 3ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉatu eṉiṉ, ataṟku muṉṉarē vaṭavintiyāvil naṭaṉakkali mika uyarnta niliyil iruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu peṟappaṭukiṟataṉṟō?
`naṭaṉakkali , `aṟam, poruḷ, iṉpam, vīṭu eṉṉum nāṟpēṟukaḷiyum nalka vallatu; maṉavuṟuti, uṭal vaḷam, iṉpa uṇarcci mutaliya naṟpaṇpukaḷi aḷikka vallatu. ikkali tarum iṉpam tavattiṉar aṭiyum iṉpattiṟku iṇiyāṉatu, eṉpatu paratattiṟkūṟappaṭum ceytiyākum.
paratam tōṉṟiya piṉṉar eḻunta vaṭanāṭṭu ōviyaṅkaḷilum ciṟpaṅkaḷilum ilakkiyaṅkaḷilum naṭaṉakkali naṉku viḷakkappaṭṭuḷtu. kuptarkaḷ āṭcikkālattil eḻunta ayalār paṭiyeṭuppukaḷālum kuḻappaṅkaḷālum vaṭavintiyāvil ikkali naṉku vaḷara iṭam peṟatāyiṟṟu. āyiṉum, vinta malikkut teṉpāṟpaṭṭa nāṭukaḷil ikkali naṉṉiliyil vaḷarcci peṟalāyiṟṟu.
caṅka kālattiṟkūttukkali
paḻiya nūlākiya tolkāppiyattil paḻantamiḻ makkaḷiṭam irunta vanta kūttu vakikaḷ cila kuṟikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avi, 1. vēlaṉ āṭum (kāntaḷ) veṟikkūttu. 2. veṉṟa vīrar tam aṭiyāḷap pūccūṭi āṭum karuṅkūttu, 3. veṟṟiyip pārāṭṭip peṇkaḷ āṭum vaḷḷikkūttu, 4. kaḷatti viṭṭu ōṭāta iḷiya vīraṉukkuk kāliṟ kaḻalikkaṭṭi iru pālārum āṭum kaḻaṉilikkūttu mutaliyaṉavākum. ivi perumpālum pōrttoṭar puḷḷavi. iviyaṉṟi, āycciyar kuravi, vēṭṭuvavari mutaliya kūttu vakikaḷum iruntaṉa.
`paṇṭittamiḻakattiṟ kūttar iruntu vantaṉar; kūttukaḷ naṭipeṟṟu vantaṉa, eṉpatic caṅka nūlkaḷāl nām aṟiyalām. kuṟiñci nilak kiḻavaṉākiya murukap perumāṉi vaḻipaṭṭu āṭum kūttu, `kuṉṟakkuravi eṉappaṭum. ituvē mulli nila makaḷirāl māyōṉit tutittu āṭappaṭumāyiṉ, `āycciyar kuravi eṉap peyar peṟum. `kuravi eṉpatu, `maṅkiyar eḻuvar cennili maṇṭalak kaṭakak kikōttu annilik koppa niṉṟu āṭum kūttākum. kuraviyāṭutal irupālārukkum uriyatu. kuṟavartoṇṭakappaṟi koṭṭak kuraviyāṭuvar. atu kāṇum makaḷirum mēṟcoṉṉa ilakkaṇappaṭi niṉṟu āṭuvar. aṅṅaṉamāṭum pōtu avarkaḷ pāṭikkoṇṭē āṭuvārkaḷ. itaṉ vivaraṅkaḷit toki nūlkaḷilum cilappatikārattilum virivākak kāṇalām.
`tuṇaṅki eṉpatu kūttu vakikaḷuḷ oṉṟu. atu muṭaṅkiya iru kikaḷiyum vilāppuṭikaḷil oṟṟi aṭittukkoṇṭu acintāṭum oru vakik kūttu. makaḷir viḻākkālaṅkaḷil tuṇaṅkik kūttu āṭuvar. āṭavar ammakaḷirkku mutaṟki koṭuttal vaḻakkam.
nāṉilaṅkaḷilum irunta vaḷḷalkaḷ pāṟceṉṟu uḷḷakkuṟippup puṟattu veḷippaṭa āṭiya naṭaṉamaṅki paṇṭit tamiḻakattil viṟali eṉap peyar peṟṟāḷ. viṟaliyar pāṇaruṭaṉum kūttaruṭaṉum ceṉṟu tam kalit tiṟaṉikkāṭṭi vaḷḷalkaḷiṭam paricu peṟṟu vantaṉar.
iṅṅaṉam meyppāṭukaḷ tōṉṟa naṭikkum viṟaliyar palar caṅkakālattil iruntaṉar eṉpatit toki nūlkaḷāl aṟiyalām. paṇṭi aracarkaḷ viṟaliyar āṭal pāṭalkaḷip pārāṭṭip poṉṉari māliyip paricaḷittārkaḷ; toṭi mutaliya ciṟanta nakikaḷiyum vaḻaṅkiṉārkaḷ.1 viṟaliyar niṟamuṭiya kalavi pūcappaṭṭa vaḷinta cantiṉiyuṭiya muṉkikaḷiyum vēṟ pōṉṟa tōḷiṉiyum oḷi poruntiya neṟṟiyiyum uṭiyavar eṉṟu kōvūrkiḻār pārāṭṭi yuḷḷār. `viṟaliyar, yāḻ vācittāṟpōlap pāṭum nayappāṭu tōṉṟum pāṭṭiṉiyuṭiya viṟalpaṭa āṭutaliyuṭiyōr, eṉṟu māṅkuṭi marutaṉārum peruṅ kavucikaṉārum kūṟuvatu, viṟaliyaruṭiya icic ciṟappiṉiyum naṭaṉap payiṟciyiṉ mēṉmiyiṉiyum naṉku uṇarttuvatākum.2 `cōḻaṉ nalaṅkiḷḷi (ittakiya) viṟaliyarkku māṭa maturiyiyō vañcimā nakarattiyō vēṇṭumāyiṉ,  tara vallavaṉ,eṉṟu kōvūr kiḻār kūṟiyuḷḷatiliruntu viṟaliyar paṇṭi aracarpāl peṟṟirunta peruñciṟappiṉik kāṇalām.3 naṭaṉamakaḷ, `viṟali, kūtti, āṭumakaḷ, āṭukaḷamakaḷ eṉavum nūlkaḷilē kuṟikkappaṭṭāḷ. `aṅṅaṉamē, naṭaṉamāṭupavaṉ, `kūttaṉ, āṭumakaṉ, āṭukaḷamakaṉ eṉappaṭṭāṉ. ivarkaḷ caṅkakālattiṟ kūttukkaliyi vaḷartta kalivāṇarkaḷ. ivarkaḷ naṭaṉamāṭiṉa araṅkaṭ `āṭukaḷam eṉappaṭṭatu. viḻākkālaṅkaḷil ivarkaḷ pala vakik kūttukaḷi āṭiṉārkaḷ; puṟa kālaṅkaḷil aracarkaḷ mutaliya vaḷḷiyōr pāṟ ceṉṟu, pāṭi āṭip paricil peṟṟu mīṇṭaṉar. ivarkaḷatu kaliyi uṇarttum nūlē `kūtta nūl eṉpatu.
cilappatikārattil
cilappatikārattil kūttu eṉpatu nāṭakam eṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ vaḻaṅkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. `nāṭakamakaḷir eṉṉum toṭar, naṭaṉa makaḷir, kūtta makiḷar, viṟaliyar eṉṉum peyarkaḷiṉ poruḷiyē kuṟippatākum. mātavi nāṭaka maṅki (viṟali). avaḷ āṭiya kaḷam nāṭaka araṅku eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. ippeyarkaḷ vaṭavar nuḻiviṉāl uṇṭāṉa peyar māṟṟaṅkaḷ eṉṉalām. cilappatikārattil naṭaṉakkaliyip paṟṟiya pala vivaraṅkaḷ araṅkēṟṟu kātiyil viḷakkamākat tarappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. naṭaṉamakaḷ ciṟappākak kūttu, pāṭṭu, aḻaku immūṉṟilum niṟivu peṟṟavaḷāy iruttal vēṇṭum. avaḷ 7 vayatu mutal 12 vayatu vari (ēṟattatāḻa āṟāṇṭukaḷ) kūttakkaliyilē payiṟci peṟutal vēṇṭum.
vīram, accam, iḻivu, viyappu, iṉpam, tuṉpam, naki, naṭuvu nili, vekuḷi eṉṉum oṉpatu cuvikaḷ naṭippiṟkuriyavi.1 naṭippavar ivaṟṟi naṉku pulappaṭutti naṭikka vēṇṭum. cōmpalukku uriya naṭippu, veṭkattiṟkuriya naṭippu, perumikkuriya naṭippu, maḻiyil naṉivataṟkuriya naṭippu, paṉiyil talippaṭuvataṟku uriya naṭippu, veyilil celvataṟkuriya naṭippu mutaliya 24 vakiyāka naṭippup pakuttuk kāṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. ovvoru vakikkum ilakkaṇam uṇṭu.2
ki naṭippukaḷil oru kiyiṉāl naṭittuk kāṭṭutal, iru kikaḷālum naṭittuk kāṭṭutal eṉṉum pirivukaḷ uṇṭu. oru kiyiṉāl naṭittuk kāṭṭum naṭippukaḷ 33 vakippaṭum.3 avi `patāki, iḷampiṟi, viṟpiṭi, kuṭaṅki, valampuri mutaliya taṉittaṉi peyarkaḷ peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. inta naṭippukaḷil ki viralkaḷ muṭaṅkutal, nimirtal, kuṉital, virital, toṭutal, viṭutal muṟikaḷil iyakkik kāṭṭappaṭum. iraṇṭu kikaḷāl naṭittuk kāṭṭum naṭippukaḷ patiṉintu vakippaṭum. avi añcali, puṭpāñcali, apaya attam, makaram mutaliya pala peyarkaḷip peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.4
naṭaṉamakaḷi akkaliyiṟpayiṟṟum āṭal āciriyaṉ amiti, iciyāciriyaṉ amiti, taṇṇumi āciriyaṉ amiti, kuḻalōṉ amiti, yāḻāciriyaṉ amiti eṉpavi yāvi eṉpatic cilappatikāram, araṅkēṟṟu kātiyil teḷivuṟak kāṇalām. iṉṉiṉṉavaṟṟil muḻuppayiṟci peṟṟavarē iṉṉiṉṉa āciriyar eṉa iḷaṅkōvaṭikaḷ kūṟutalik kāṇa, avar kālattil tamiḻakattil iciyum kūttum mikavuyariya niliyil cīrum ciṟappum peṟṟiruntaṉa eṉpatu veḷḷiṭi malipōla viḷakkamākum. āṭaṟkuriya araṅku eṅṅaṉam amikkappaṭal vēṇṭum eṉpatum, innūluḷ teḷivāka viḷakkappaṭṭuḷḷatu; araṅkiṟpukuntu āṭum iyalpum vivarikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
araṅkiṉiṟpukuntu mātavi pāṭiṉāḷ; āṭiṉāḷ. appoḻutu mēṟcoṉṉa pala vaki āciriyarkaḷ araṅkil iruntu tattam toḻilic ceytārkaḷ. avvamayam,
``kuḻalvaḻi niṉṟatu yāḻē; yāḻvaḻit
taṇṇumi niṉṟatu takavē; taṇṇumip
piṉvaḻi niṉṟatu muḻavē; muḻavoṭu
kūṭiniṉ ṟicintatu āman tiriki;
āman tirikiyo mantara miṉṟik
koṭṭiraṇṭu ṭuṭiyatōr maṇṭila mākak
kaṭṭiya maṇṭilam patiṉoṉṟu pōkki
vanta muṟiyiṉ vaḻimuṟi vaḻāmal.1
mātavi āṭiṉāḷ.
caṅka kālattil irunta kūtta nūlkaḷ
mēṟcollappaṭṭa palvakik kūttu vakikaḷiyum, viṟaliyar kūttar mutaliyavar iruntamiyiyum nōkkac caṅkakālattil kūttanūlkaḷ iruntiruttal vēṇṭum eṉpatu veḷḷiṭi mali. āyiṉ, annūṟ peyarkaḷi uḷḷavāṟu aṟiyac cāṉṟilli. ki.pi. 14ām nūṟṟāṇṭirum cilappatikārattiṟku uri vakuttavarumāṉa aṭiyārkku nallār, tamakkup palanūṟṟāṇṭukaḷukku muṉpu pāṭappaṭṭa cilappatikārattiṟku uri kāṇkiyil cila kūtta nūṟpeyarkaḷik kuṟikkiṉṟār. avaṟṟuḷ pala cilappatikāra kālattil iruntaṉa eṉṟu koḷvativiṭa, aṭiyārkku nallār kālattil  iruntaṉa eṉavum, avaravaṟṟi naṉku paṭittaṟintavar eṉavum kōṭalē poruttamuṭiyatākum. avar kuṟikkum kūtta nūlkaḷāvaṉa:
1. paratam, 2. akattiyam, 3. muṟuval, 4. cayantam, 5.kuṇanūl, 6. ceyiṟṟiyam, 7. iṇinuṇukkam, 8. .intira kāḷiyam, 9. pañcamarapu, 10. parata cēṉāpatīyam, 11. mativāṇaṉār nāṭakat tamiḻ nūl, 12. kūttanūl.
ivaṟṟuḷ mutal iraṇṭu nūlkaḷ aṭiyārkku nallār kālattilēyē iṟantaṉa eṉpatu kuṟikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. piṟa nūlkaḷiliruntu iraṇṭoru cūttiraṅkaḷ aṭiyārkku nallār, pērāciriyar mutaliyōrāl āḷappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. innūlkaḷuḷ oṉṟēṉum ikkālattil kiṭittilatu.1
iṉip pattuppāṭṭuḷ iṭam peṟṟuḷḷa kūttukaḷip paṟṟiya ceytikaḷik kāṇpōm:
viṟali
naṭaṉakkalikkuriyavaḷ viṟali. avaḷ porunaruṭaṉum, pāṇaruṭaṉum, kūttaruṭaṉum ceṉṟu taṉ kalittiṟaṉi vaḷḷalkaḷukkum potumakkaḷukkum kāṭṭip paricil peṟutal vaḻakkam. ikkāla naṭikiyar kaṇ kavarum uṭaṟkaṭṭum pēraḻakum peṟṟiruttal pōlavē caṅkakāla viṟaliyarum peṟṟiruntaṉar eṉpatu pattuppāṭṭāl terikiṟatu.
ciṟupāṇaruṭaṉ ceṉṟa viṟali, ulakiṟku aruḷutalic ceytu melliyatāy vīḻntu tāḻkiṉṟa maḻiyiṉatu aḻakit taṉṉiṭattē koṇṭu eṇṇeyilē muṟṟup peṟṟu iruṇṭa kūntaliyuṭiyavaḷ; mayilkaḷ palavuṅkūṭi nīlamaṇipōlum kaṇṇiṉiyuṭiya tōkikaḷi makaḷir kūntali virittāṟpōla virittuppārttu, `ivarkaḷ cāyalukku ovvēm! eṉṟu pēṭṭiṟkuḷḷē ceṉṟu maṟitaṟkuk kāraṇamāṉa cāyali2 uṭiyavaḷ; ōṭiiḷittu varuntukiṉṟa nāyiṉatu nāviṉ nalla aḻaki varutti, vaṟumiyāl cilampu mutaliyaṉa iṉṟip polivaḻinta aṭiyiṉip peṟṟavaḷ; iḻukkappaṭṭu nilattuc ceṟiyum kariya piṭiyiṉatu periya ki pōlat tāmum aṭiyōṭē toṭarpuṇṭa muṟiyāṟparuttu maliyil oḻuṅkupaṭa vaḷarnta vāḻiyeṉattiraṇṭu neruṅkiyuḷḷa iraṇṭu kuṟaṅkiṉi uṭiyavaḷ; vāḻippū eṉṉumpaṭi aḻaku peṟṟa paṉicciyip peṟṟavaḷ; kōṅkiṉ mukiyi ikaḻnta melliya maṇikaḷ iṭiyil kiṭakkap peṟṟa nakilkaḷi uṭiyavaḷ; nuṅkiṉ iṉiya nīrpōṉṟa nīric curappikkum paṟkaḷip peṟṟavaḷ; mulli cūṭutaṟkaminta kaṟpiṉiyuṭiyavaḷ; melliya iyalpiṉiyum maṭappattiyum uṭiya māṉ pōlum pārviyip peṟṟavaḷ; oḷi poruntiya neṟṟiyi uṭiyavaḷ (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 13-31).
kūttup paṟṟiya ceytikaḷ
tamiḻ nāṭṭu ūrkaḷil makaḷir tuṇaṅkik kūttiṉiyum aḻakiṉiyuṭiya tāḷa aṟutiyiyuṭiya kuravik kūttiṉiyum āṭutal vaḻakkam (ma. kā. aṭi, 159-160). mali nāṭṭil kuṟavarkaḷ kaḷḷiṉ teḷivip paruki makiḻntu toṇṭakap paṟiyiṉatu tāḷattiṟku ēṟpak kuraviyāṭutal marapu. (tirumuruku. aṭi, 195-197). kuṟappeṇkaḷ taḻiyuṭi uṭuttu murukaṉ ciṟappiṉip pāṭikkoṇṭē oruvarōṭoruvar kikōttukkoṇṭu kuraviyāṭi acivatu vaḻakkam (aṭi, 202-216). maturiccērikaḷil peṇṭir kaṭampa malaric cūṭiya murukaṉi niṉintu tammuḷ taḻuvik kikōttu maṉṟutōṟum kuravik kūttāṭiṉar (ma. kā. aṭi,612-614).
naṉṉaṉatu mali nāṭṭil maliyucciyil vāḻnta kuṟavar naṟavi aruntit tam peṇṭirōṭu kūṭi, māṉ tōl pōrtta ciṟupaṟi kalleṉṟu olikkak kuravik kūttāṭiṉar (malipaṭu. aṭi, 320-322). vaḷḷikkūttu eṉpatu iḻintōr kāṇum kūttu. ikkūttu irupālārkkum potuvāy varuvatu. ciṟṟūrkaḷil ikkūttu naṭipeṟutal vaḻakkam (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 370-371). nāṭakam eṉpatu kati taḻuvi varum kūttu. ataṉi āṭiya makaḷir nāṭakamakaḷir eṉappaṭṭaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, 55). viṟaliyar tāḷa aṟutiyiyuṭiya kuḻalōciyiṉ tāḷattiṟku oppa naṭaṉam āṭiṉar (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 162).


kūttari ātarittavar
kūtta nūlkaḷi naṉku kaṟṟu akkaliyil pulami peṟṟa kūttarit tamiḻ neṭunila maṉṉarum kuṟunila maṉṉarum naṉku pōṟṟip pātukāttaṉar. kaṭiyeḻu vaḷḷalkaḷuḷ oruvaṉāṉa ōri, kūttarkkup pala nāṭukaḷi vaḻaṅkip pukaḻ peṟṟāṉ. ōymāṉāṭṭi āṇṭa nalliyakkōṭaṉum pala vācciyaṅkaḷiyuṭiya kūttarip purantu peyar peṟṟāṉ (ci. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 107-109, 125). vattarāṟṟuppaṭiyiyē taṉmītu pāṭappeṟṟa peruñciṟappuṭiyavaṉ naṉṉaṉ eṉṟa ciṟṟaracaṉ. avaṉ kūttar talivaṉukkup poṟṟāmari malaric cūṭṭiṉāṉ; viṟaliyarkkup pēraṇikalaṅkaḷi vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ; yāṉi, kutiri, pacukkaḷ, celvam mutaliyavaṟṟi maḻipōla vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ )malipaṭu. aṭi, 568-580).
kūttaṉ pākkam eṉṟa ōrūr ki.pi. 13 allatu 14ām nūṟṟāṇṭil iruntateṉṟu māmallapurattuk kalveṭṭu oṉṟu terivikkiṟatu.1 ``puliyūrk kōṭṭattu māṅkāṭu nāṭṭuk kūttaṉ pākkam2 eṉpatu oru kalveṭṭu vācakam. kūttāṭi paṭṭi eṉṟu ōrūr iruntati maṟṟoru kalveṭṭuk kuṟikkiṟatu.3 irāmanātapura māvaṭṭattut tirupputtūr vaṭṭattil kūttakkuṭi eṉṟa aticaya pāṇṭiya nallūr iruntatu.4 tañcimāvaṭṭattil kūttaṉūr eṉṟa peyaril ōrūr iruntatu eṉpatu kalveṭṭāl terikiṟatu.5 mutaṟ kulōttuṅkaṉ 18ām āṭciyāṇṭil kōvil viḻāvil tamiḻakkūttu nikaḻttiya vikkiramātittaṉ tirumutukuṉṟaṉ eṉṟa virutarācapayaṅkara ācāriyaṉukkuk kūttāṭṭuk kāṇiyāka nilam viṭappaṭṭatu.6

28. vāṉakkali
caṅkakālat tamiḻar, aintu pūtaṅkaḷip paṟṟiyum, maḻi uṇṭātal paṟṟiyum, āṟu paruvaṅkaḷ paṟṟiyum, apparuvaṅkaḷil nikaḻum iyaṟki māṟutalkaḷ paṟṟiyum, nāḷ mīṉkaḷ kōḷ mīṉkaḷ eṉpavi paṟṟiyum ōraḷavu aṟintiruntaṉar eṉpata pattup pāṭṭāl  terikiṟatu.
aimpūtaṅkaḷ
nilam, nīr, tī, kāṟṟu, vāṉam eṉpaṉa aintu pūtaṅfḷ.ivaṟWŸ vāṉam, taṉṉi oḻinta nāṉku pūtaṅkaḷum taṉṉiṭattē akaṉṟu virivataṟkuk kāraṇamāyuḷḷatu eṉpatip paḻantamiḻar aṟintiruntaṉar (pe. ā. paṭi, aṭi; ma. kā. aṭi, 266-7).
maḻi uṇṭātal
mēkam kaṭal nīrik kuṭittu valamāy eḻuntu malikaḷi iruppiṭamākak koḷkiṉṟatu; peyyuṅkālattil ulakatti vaḷittu eḻuntu kaṭiya celaviṉi mēṟkoṇṭu maḻi peyyum (mu. pāṭṭu, aṭi, 4-5).
irācikaḷ
vāṉaviyal aṟiñarkaḷ, viṇṇil cūriyaṉ celvatākat tōṉṟum vītiyākiya irāci maṇṭalatti ovvoṉṟum 30s, aḷavuḷḷa paṉṉiraṇṭu camapākaṅkaḷākap pirittiruk kiṟārkaḷ. intappākaṅkaḷi `irācikaḷ eṉpar. ivaṟṟukku muṟiyē mēṭam, (Aries), iṭapam (Taurus), mituṉam (Gemini), kaṭakam (Cancer), cimmam (Leo), kaṉṉi (Virigo), tulām (Libra), viruccikam (Scorpionis), taṉucu (sagittarius), makaram (Capricornis), kumpam (Aquarius), mīṉam (Pisces) eṉpaṉa peyar. ippeyarkaḷ, antanta irācikaḷil amiyum naṭcattirat tokutikaḷ mēṭam (āṭu) mutaliya vaṭivuṭiyaṉavākat tōṉṟuvatāl ēṟpaṭṭaṉa eṉpar. cūriyaṉ inta irācikaḷil irukkum kālaṅkaḷi muṟiyē cittiri, vikāci mutaliya mātaṅkaḷ eṉa vaḻaṅkukiṟōm.
naṭcattiraṅkaḷiṉiṭiyē pūmiyip poṟuttuc cūriyaṉ iyaṅkum pātiyum, cantiraṉum piṟa kirakaṅkaḷum iyaṅkam pātikaḷum vāṉamaṇṭalattil cūriyappātikku irupuṟamum cumār 9s tūrattiṟkuḷ aṭipaṭum oru maṇṭalattil amiyum. itiyē irāci maṇṭalam eṉpar. inta maṇṭalattilēyē acuvati, mutaliya 27 naṭcattiraṅkaḷum irukkiṉṟaṉa. āṉāl, inta vitikku vilakkāka aṉuṣam, kēṭṭi, mūlam eṉṉum naṭcattiraṅkaḷ immaṇṭalattiṟku mikavum teṟkē irukkiṉṟaṉa.1
tiṅkaḷ
vāṉa veḷiyil iyaṅkum pala kōḷaṅkaḷuḷ tiṅkaḷ (cantiraṉ) oṉṟu. iḵtu uḷḷattil iṉpak kiḷarcciyi ūṭṭum pēreḻil uṭiyatu. ulakil pala moḻikaḷil uḷḷa ilakkiyaṅkaḷ tiṅkaḷip pukaḻntu pēcukiṉṟaṉa. pūmikku mika irukil uḷḷa kōḷam tiṅkaḷē. .itu namakkuc cumār 238,000 kal tūrattil irukkiṟatu. itaṉ kuṟukkaḷavu 2,160kal. itu pūmiyiṉ kuṟukkaḷavil kāṟpaṅku. cantiraṉ parappu, pūmiyiṉ parappil 1/13 paṅku; parumaṉil 1/49 paṅku. tiṅkaḷiṉ eṭi pūmiyiṉ eṭiyil 1/82 paṅku.
cūriyaṉiviṭac cantiraṉ mikac ciṟiyatēyāyiṉum, pūmikkuc cūriyaṉiviṭa mikavum camīpattil iruppatāl, nam kaṇkaḷakkuc cūriyaṉum cantiraṉum perumpālum orē aḷavuḷḷaṉavāyt tōṟṟukiṉṟaṉa.
pūmiyip pōlac cantiraṉukkum iru vakic cuḻaṟcikaḷ uṇṭu. oṉṟu, taṉṉil tāṉē cuḻaṉṟu koḷvatu; maṟṟoṉṟu, pūmiyic cuṟṟi varuvatu. cantiraṉ maṇikku 2300 mil vītam pūmiyi nīḷvaṭṭap pātiyil cuṟṟukiṟatu. iṅṅaṉam atu pūmiyi oru muṟi cuṟṟivara ēṟattāḻa 30 eḷkaḷMkiṉṟaṉa.mJ taṉṉil tāṉē orumuṟi cuḻala 271/2 nāḷkaḷ ākiṉṟaṉa. cantiraṉ taṉṉil tāṉē cuḻaṉṟukoḷḷum vēkamum ēṟattāḻac camamākum. ātalāl, cantiraṉiṉ oru pākatti maṭṭumē nām pārkka iyalkiṟatu. pūmiyip pōlavē cantiraṉukkum pakal iravu uṇṭu. pūmiyiṉ pakal iravu cērnta oru nāḷukku 24 maṇi; cantiraṉilō, kiṭṭattaṭṭa oru mātam. atāvatu, cūriyaṉ tōṉṟiṉāl, maṟiyac cumār 15 nāḷkaḷ ākum; maṟintāl, mīṇṭum tōṉṟa 15 nāḷkaḷākum. cantiraṉil niṉṟu pārttāl, pūmiyum oru periya cantiraṉip pōlat tōṉṟum.1
urōkiṇi
urōkiṇi (Alebaran) acuviṉi mutal eṇṇappaṭṭa naṭcattiraṅkaḷuḷ nāṉkāvatu; iṭaparāciyil mikavum pirakācamāy viḷaṅkuvatu. inta mīṉ caṟṟuc cenniṟamuṭiyatu; vāṉattiṟkāṇappaṭum irupatu oḷi mikunta naṭcattiraṅkaḷuḷ oṉṟu; cūriyaṉatu viṭṭattip pōla aimpatu maṭaṅku koṇṭatu; eṇpatu oḷiyāṇṭut tolivil uḷḷatu.2
`cantiraṉ takkaṉuṭiya putalviyar irupatteḻuvari maṇantāṉ; avarkaḷuḷ urōkiṇiyiṭam mikunta aṉpu celuttiṉāṉ eṉpatu purāṇakkati.
pāṇṭimātēviyiṉ kaṭṭiliṉ mēṟkūriyil iracimaṇṭalam virayappaṭṭiruntatu; cantiraṉ, unrākiṇi, uruvaṅkaḷum virayappaṭṭiruntaṉa. ākāyattiṭattē tiṇṇiya niliyiṉiyuṭiya kompiṉiyuṭiya mēṭarāci mutalāka ēṉi irācikaḷiṟ ceṉṟu tiriyum mikka celaviṉiyuṭiya ñāyiṟṟōṭē māṟupāṭu mikunta talimiyiṉi yuṭiya tiṅkaḷōṭu tiriyāmal niṉṟa urōkiṇi eḻutappaṭṭiruntatu (neṭunal. aṭi, 159-163).
cūriya maṇṭalam
vāṉavītiyil oḷi vīcum cūriyaṉum, atic cuṟṟi varum oṉpatu kirakaṅkaḷum, avaṟṟiṉ 28 upakirakaṅkaḷum pala ciṟu kirakaṅkaḷum vāl naṭcattiraṅkaḷum eri naṭcattiraṅkaḷum cūriya maṇṭalattil aṭaṅkum.
putaṉ, veḷḷi, pūmi, cevvāy, viyāḻaṉ, caṉi, yurēṉa, nepṭiyūṉ, puḷūṭṭō eṉpaṉa oṉpatu kirakaṅkaḷākum.
cūriyaṉukku miku aṇmiyil uḷḷa kirakam putaṉ; miku tolivil uḷḷatu puḷūṭṭō. peruṅkirakaṅkaḷ oṉpatuḷ mutal āṟu kirakaṅkaḷic cātāraṇamākak kaṇṇiṉāl kāṇa iyalum. avaṟṟip paṇṭikkāla mutalē aṟintiruntaṉar. ivi yāvum tāmākavē oḷirāp poruḷkaḷ; tāṉē oḷirum naṭcattiramāṉa cūriyaṉiṭamiruntu oḷiyip peṟṟup piratipalikkiṉṟaṉa. kirakaṅkaḷ yāvum nīḷvaṭṭamāyuḷḷa vevvēṟu pātikaḷil orē ticiyil cūriyaṉic cuṟṟi varukiṉṟaṉa; pūmi ettaḷattil cūriyaṉic cuṟṟi varukiṟatō, kiṭṭattaṭṭa atē taḷattil, atāvatu, caṟṟu māṟupaṭṭa taḷattil cūriyaṉic cuṟṟukiṉṟaṉa.1
veḷḷi
cūriyaṉic cuṟṟivarum oṉpatu kirakaṅkaḷil veḷḷi eṉṟa cukkiraṉum oṉṟu. cūriya maṇṭalattilē oḷi mikka kirakam cukkiraṉē. ataṉāl, mēṉāṭṭār aḻakut tēvatikkuriya vīṉa (Venus) eṉṉum peyari itaṟku iṭṭuḷḷaṉar. itu cila mātaṅkaḷil piṉṉiravil kiḻakkilum, cila mātaṅkaḷil muṉṉiravil mēṟkilum tōṉṟum. itu paṟṟiyē itaṉik kāli naṭcattiram eṉṟum, māli naṭcattiram eṉṟum kūṟuvar.
cūriyaṉi aṭuttuc cuṟṟuvatu putaṉ; ati aṭuttuc cuṟṟuvatu cukkiraṉ. itu uruvam, parimāṇam, aṭartti ivaṟṟil ellām pūmiyi ottuḷḷatu. itu putaṉippōla āṟu maṭaṅku oḷiyuṭiyatu; cantiraṉip pōla eṭṭu maṭaṅku piratipalikkum tiṟamiyuṭiyatu. ivvāṟu piratipalikkum taṉmi mikkatāyiruppatālē tāṉ cukkiraṉ oḷi mikka kirakamāy miḷirkiṉṟatu.2
porunaṉ, virikiṉṟa kiraṇaṅkaḷiyuṭiya veḷḷi eḻunta ceṟinta iruḷiyuṭiya viṭiyaṟkālattil karikālaṉ araṇmaṉiyiṟpukuntu, taṉ taṭāriyil ōciyip piṟappittup pāṭiṉāṉ (po. ā. paṭi, aṭi, 69-72).
veḷḷi teṉticiyil vGjltīya nimi¤tam.aḵJ aṅṅaṉam eḻiṉum, pāṇṭi nāṭṭu yāṟukaḷ veḷḷam māṟāmal vantu viḷivip perukkiṉa (ma. kā. aṭi, 108-9).
`veḷḷiyākiya mīṉ tāṉ niṟṟaṟkuriya vaṭaticiyil nillāmal teṉticikkaṇṇē celliṉ, peyyum paruvattu maḻi peyyātu, eṉṟu nam muṉṉōr nampiṉar (pa. pāli,  aṭi, 1-2).
viṇmīṉkaḷ
viṇmīṉkaḷ eṉappaṭum naṭcattiraṅkaḷ cūriyaṉip pōṉṟa kōḷaṅkaḷēyākum. cila, mikunta oḷiyuṭiyaṉa; cila, kuṟinta oḷiyuṭiyaṉa. mikavum aṇmiyil uḷḷatu, nāṉku oḷiyāṇṭut tolivil uḷḷatu. oḷiyāṇṭu eṉpatu, oḷiyāṉatu oru vināṭikku oru laṭcattu eṇpattu āṟāyiram mil tūram vītam ōrāṇṭu kālattil cellum tūramākum. cila naṭcattiraṅkaḷ pattāyiram oḷiyāṇṭut tolivil uḷḷaṉa. vāṉattil kōṭikkaṇakkāṉa naṭcattiraṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. āyiṉum, nām veṟuṅkaṇṇōṭu orē camayattil teḷivāṉa iravil kāṇakkūṭiyaṉa ēṟakkuṟiya mūvāyiramēyākum.
paṇṭikkālattil vāḻnta makkaḷ naṭcattiraṅkaḷik kūṭṭam kūṭṭamāka vakuttu, avi iṉṉa uruvam uṭiyaṉa eṉṟu kūṟiṉārkaḷ; naṭcattirak kūṭṭattiṉuruvatti vittu riṣapam (erutu), viruccikam (tēḷ), tulām (tarācu), eṉṟu palavāṟu peyariṭṭārkaḷ.
cila naṭcattiraṅkaḷ, cūriyaṉip pōla nūṟu maṭaṅku kaṉa aḷavuuṭiyavi. cūriyaṉ pūmiyip pōla 330 āyiram maṭaṅku kaṉa aḷavuṭiyatu. naṭcattiraṅkaḷ iṭam peyarkiṉṟaṉa. naṭcattiraṅkaḷ vēṟu vēṟu niṟaṅkaḷ uṭiyaṉa. potuvākac civappu, ārañcu, mañcaḷ, nīlam eṉa nāṉku niṟaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭum. niṟam vēṟupaṭuvataṟkuk kāraṇam, veppanili vēṟupāṭēyākum.
naṭcattiraṅkaḷiliruntu varum oḷikkiraṇaṅkaḷil naṭuvil uḷḷaviyum viḷimpil uḷḷaviyum orē camayattil nammuṭiya kaṇṇukku vantu cēruvatilli. ataṉālētāṉ naṭcattiraṅkaḷ imi koṭṭuvatu pōlat tōṉṟukiṉṟaṉa.1
nāḷ mīṉkaḷ
nīla niṟattiyuṭiya ākāyattē valamāka eḻuntu tiriyum nāḷkaḷākiya mīṉkaḷōṭē kalanta kōḷkaḷākiya mīṉkaḷ pōla-akaṉṟa iṭattiyuṭiya maṉṟilē āṭṭukkiṭāyuṭaṉ cival eṉṉum paṟaviyip paratavar poruvittaṉar (pa. pāli, aṭi, 67-69).
nāḷkaḷākiya mīṉkaḷ- irupattēḻu naṭcattiraṅkaḷ; kōḷkaḷākiya mīṉkaḷ- navakkirakaṅkaḷ eṉpavi. navakkirakaṅkaḷ ivi eṉpatu muṉpē kūṟappaṭṭatu. iṅku irupattēḻu naṭcattiraṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷik kāṇpōm:

6. tiruvātiri	19. mūlam
7. puṉarpūcam	20. pūrāṭam
8. pūcam	21. uttirāṭam

ivaṟṟuḷ acuviṉi (acuvati) eṉpatu, kutiriyiṉ tali pōla uḷḷa āṟu naṭcattiraṅkaḷ koṇṭatu. (acuvam-kutiri).2 paraṇi eṉpatu mūṉṟu naṭcattiraṅkaḷ uḷḷatu. aḵtu aṭuppuppōla iruppateṉak kūṟuvar. (paraṇi-aṭuppu)1. ivvāṟu irupattēḻu naṭcattiraṅkaḷuḷ ovvoṉṟum, cila naṭcattiraṅkaḷiṉ cērkkiyēyākum. accērkki tarum uruvattik koṇṭē ovvoru cērkkiyum acuviṉi, paraṇi mutaliya kāraṇap peyarkaḷip peṟṟatu.
kāvirippūmpaṭṭiṉattuk kaṭaṟkariyil irunta periya poyki, maḻi mācu nīṅkiṉa periya ākāyattiṭattu matiyic cērnta makamākiya veḷḷiya mīṉiṉatu vaṭivu poruntiya valiya uyarnta kariyip peṟṟiruntatu. (pa. pāli,  aṭi, 34-38). iṅku, mati-poykikkum, makamīṉ-karikkum uvamikkum poruḷākum.
makam eṉṉum peyaruṭiya naṭcattirak kūṭṭattil aintu pirakācamāṉa naṭcattiraṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. avi veṭṭarivāḷ pōla iruppatākat tamiḻarum, pallakkup pōṉṟu iruppatāka maṟṟavarum kūṟuvar. inta arivāḷiṉ kippiṭiyil pēroḷi poruntiya oru naṭcattiram uḷḷatu. ataṟku rekula (Regulus) eṉpatu peyar. makanamcattirakkūṭṭam cimmarāciyil uḷḷatu.2
inta ilakkaṇam koṇṭu kāṇiṉ, mēlē kūṟappaṭṭa poykiyiṉ kari veṭṭarivāḷ pōla iruntateṉpatu teḷivākiṉṟatu. poykiyiṉ karikku makamīṉi uvami kūṟiya pulavaratu vāṉakkali aṟivu viyakkaṟpālataṉṟō?
koḻuviya koṭiyiyuṭiya mucuṇṭi (mucuṭṭi) kārttikiyākiya mīṉ pōla veḷḷitāy malarntatu eṉṟu malipaṭukaṭām kūṟukiṉṟatu (aṭi, 100-101). mucuṇṭi koṭṭam pōṉṟa pūvit taṉṉiṭattē peṟṟatu eṉṟu ciṟupāṇāṟṟuppaṭi ceppukiṟatu (aṭi, 166). paṉaṅkurut tāṟceyyappaṭum oru vakic ciṟiya peṭṭikkuk koṭṭam3 eṉpatu peyar.4 tīccuṭariṉ nuṉipōṉṟa amippil āṟuviṇmīṉkaḷik koṇṭa kūṭṭam kārttiki eṉappaṭum. aḵtu uṭivāḷiṉ vaṭivam koṇṭatu. erittal ataṉ iyalpu. atu cemmi kalanta veṇmi niṟamuṭiyatu. aḵtu aṅki, aḻal, āṟumīṉ, āral, ēri, taḻal eṉap pala peyarkaḷip peṟum.
ivvāṉak kaliyiṟ pulami peṟṟu nalla nēram mutaliyavaṟṟik kaṇittavaṉ `kaṇi eṉṟum `kaṇiyaṉ eṉṟum peyar peṟṟāṉ. kaṇi, aracaṉuṭaṉ irunta uyaraluvalaruḷ oruvaṉ. avaṉip `peruṅkaṇi eṉṟu cilappatikāram kūṟum. kaṇiyaṉ pūṅkuṉṟaṉār eṉpavar caṅkakālap pulavar. kaṇiyaṉi niṉivūṭṭum ūrp peyarkaḷ .iṉṟu tamiḻ nāṭṭil uṇṭu. avaṟṟik kīḻē kāṇka:

poḻutukaḷ
taṭpaveppanili, iravu pakal nēra aḷavu ivi āṇṭu muṟṟum orē mātiri iruppatilli; kālattukkuk kālam vēṟupaṭum. inta vēṟupāṭṭiyoṭṭi āṇṭic cila iyaṟkik kālap pakutikaḷākap pirikkalām. avvāṟu pirikkappaṭum pakutikaḷ, `paruvaṅkaḷeṉappaṭu kiṉṟaṉa.
caṅkakālat tamiḻar, yāṇṭi āṟu pirivukaḷākap pirittaṉar. avi kār, kūtir, muṉpaṉi, piṉpaṉi, iḷavēṉil, mutuvēṉil eṉpavi. ivi perum poḻutukaḷ eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉa.
1. āvaṇiyum puraṭṭāciyum - kār kālam
2. aippaciyum kārttikiyum-kūtirkkālam
3. mārkaḻiyum tiyum-muṉ paṉikkālam
4. māciyum paṅkuṉiyum-piṉ paṉikkālam
5. cittiriyum vikāciyum-iḷavēṉiṟkālam
6. āṉiyum āṭiyum-mutuvēṉiṟkālam
ivvāṟu paruvaṅkaḷ māṟi māṟi varuvataṟkuk kāraṇam, pūmi nīḷvaṭṭap pātiyil cūriyaṉic cuṟṟi varuvatē.1 ipparuvaṅkaḷ tolkāppiyar kālattukku (ēṟattāḻak ki.mu. 300kku) muṉpē nam muṉṉōrāṟ kaṇṭaṟiyappaṭṭaviyākum. apperumakkaḷ ovvoru paruvattiṟkum uriya ciṟupoḻutukaḷiyum kūṟiyuḷḷārkaḷ.
paṇṭittamiḻar yāṇṭiṉi āṟu perumpoḻutu kaḷākap pirittāṟpōlavē oru nāḷiyum āṟu pirivukaḷākap pirittaṉar. avi vikaṟi, kāli, naṇpakal, eṟpāṭu, māli, yāmam eṉpavi. ivi `ciṟu poḻutukaḷ eṉap peyar peṟṟaṉa.
1.	vikaṟi- iravu iraṇṭu maṇi mutal kāli
		    āṟu maṇi variyil uḷḷa nēram.
2. kāli -kāli āṟumaṇiyiliruntu pattumaṇi
		  variyuḷḷa nēram.
3. naṇpakal -pakal pattu maṇiyiliruntu iraṇṭu 
		   maṇi variyuḷḷa nēram.
4. eṟpāṭu - piṟpakal iraṇṭu maṇi mutal āṟu
		   maṇi variyuḷḷa nēram.
5. māli -āṟu maṇi mutal iravu pattu maṇi variyuḷḷa                  		  nēram.
6. yāmam - iravu pattumaṇi mutal iravu
		   iraṇṭu maṇi variyuḷḷa nēram.
iṅṅaṉam nam muṉṉōr ēṟattāḻa nāṉku maṇi nēram koṇṭati oru ciṟu poḻutākak koṇṭaṉar.
tolkāppiyal kuṟiñci, mulli, marutam, neytal, pāli eṉṉum aintu ōḻukkaṅkaṭkum uriya perum poḻutukaḷiyum ciṟu poḻutukaḷiyum kīḻ varumāṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār.
1. mulli oḻukkattiṟkuk kār kālamum mālip poḻutum uriyavi.
2. kuṟiñci oḻukkattiṟkuk kūtirkkālamum muṉ paṉikkālamum yāmamum uriyavi.
3. maruta oḻukkattiṟku āṟuparuvaṅkaḷum vikaṟiyum uriyavi.
4. neytal oḻukkattiṟku āṟu paruvaṅkaḷum eṟpāṭum uriyavi.
5. pāli oḻukkattiṟkup piṉpaṉiyum iḷavēṉilum mutuvēṉilum naṇpakalum uriyavi.1
pattuppāṭṭuḷ mullipāṭṭum kuṟiñcippāṭṭum neṭunalvāṭiyum akapporuḷ paṟṟiyavi. mullippāṭṭil kārkālac ciṟappum ataṟkuriya mālippoḻutu nikaḻccikaḷum talivaṉip pirinta talivi āṟṟiyiruttalum ciṟappuṟak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. kuṟiñcip pāṭṭil yāma nikaḻccikaḷum puṇartalum puṇartal nimittamum naṉku kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. neṭunalvāṭiyum mulli oḻukkattiṟ uriyatu ātaliṉ, ataṉkaṇ kārkālamum kūtirkkāla nikaḻccikaḷum talivaṉip pirinta talivi āṟṟiyiruttalum virivākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
iṉip pattuppāṭṭuḷ intap perumpoḻutukaḷ paṟṟiyum ciṟupoḻutukaḷ paṟṟiyum vantaḷḷa ceytikaḷi iṅkuk kāṇpōm:
perumpoḻutukaḷ
kār
kār kālattu mutal maḻiyip peṟṟa kāṭṭil ceṅkaṭampamaram tēruruḷ pōlum pūvi malarac ceytatu (tirumuruku. aṭi, 9-11). mulli nilattil kār kālattu maḻi peytatu. veḷḷatti veṟutta kōvalar tam pacukkaḷiyum erutukaḷiyum kaṉṟukaḷiyum mēṭṭu nilattil mēyaviṭṭaṉar; kuḷircci varuttiyatāl, paṟkaḷ paṟi koṭṭa naṭuṅkiṉar. vilaṅkukaḷ mēytali maṟantaṉa. kuraṅkukaḷ kuḷircciyāl tuṉpuṟṟaṉa. paṟavikaḷ kāṟṟu mikutiyāl nilattil vīḻntaṉa. mucuṇṭiyum pīrkkum malarntaṉa. maḻi nīr virintu ōṭiyatu. atil kayalkaḷ etirttu nīntiṉa. kokkukaḷum nārikaḷum avaṟṟip piṭittut tiṉṉa nīr vaḻiyiṟ kāttiruntaṉa (neṭunal. aṭi, 1-19). kār kālattil urumēṟu (iṭi) muḻakkatti uṇṭākkiyatu (ku. pā. aṭi, 162). kār kāla maḻiyip peṟṟa palākkaḷ, mattaḷaṅkaḷ pōlak kīḻum mēlum tūṅki muṟṟutal koṇṭu tāḻntaṉa (malipaṭu. aṭi, 12, 142-4).
kūtir
